+name: Register TimeSpace export checkpoint
+
+on:
+  push:
+    branches: [feature/trend-registration-time-space-export]
+
+permissions:
+  actions: read
+  contents: read
+
+jobs:
+  checkpoint:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
+          fetch-depth: 0
+          persist-credentials: false
+      - name: Enforce append-only registration history
+        shell: bash
+        env:
+          PUSH_BEFORE: ${{ github.event.before }}
+          PUSH_AFTER: ${{ github.sha }}
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          base_protection_validator="$RUNNER_TEMP/time-space-external-protection-validator.py"
+          base_protection_config="$RUNNER_TEMP/time-space-external-protection.json"
+          git show "$PUSH_BEFORE:scripts/validate_time_space_external_protection.py" > "$base_protection_validator"
+          git show "$PUSH_BEFORE:config/research/time_space_export_external_protection_v1.json" > "$base_protection_config"
+          python "$base_protection_validator" --config "$base_protection_config"
+          base_validator="$RUNNER_TEMP/time-space-registration-push-validator.py"
+          git show "$PUSH_BEFORE:scripts/validate_time_space_registration_push.py" > "$base_validator"
+          python "$base_validator" \
+            --repository "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" \
+            --before "$PUSH_BEFORE" \
+            --after "$PUSH_AFTER" \
+            --phase checkpoint \
+            --github-env "$GITHUB_ENV"
+      - name: Validate immutable checkpoint manifest
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          manifest=$CHECKPOINT_MANIFEST
+          test -f "$manifest"
+          git ls-files --error-unmatch -- "$manifest"
+          git cat-file -e "$GITHUB_SHA:$manifest"
+          git show "$GITHUB_SHA:$manifest" | cmp -s - "$manifest"
+          python - "$manifest" <<'PY'
+          import pathlib, sys
+          from scripts.build_time_space_export_receipt import _validate_manifest
+          path = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
+          _validate_manifest(path.as_posix(), path.read_bytes())
+          PY
+      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: time-space-export-checkpoint-${{ env.CHECKPOINT_CUTOFF }}-${{ github.run_id }}
+          path: ${{ env.CHECKPOINT_MANIFEST }}
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 90

+name: Generate canonical TimeSpace export
+
+on:
+  workflow_dispatch:
+    inputs:
+      as_of:
+        description: Literal confirmed 4h UTC cutoff
+        required: true
+        type: string
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+jobs:
+  export:
+    # No registered corpus artifact exists today. This job is intentionally
+    # unreachable on GitHub-hosted runners and remains PENDING until Task 7
+    # proves a runner with the exact `zenquant-data` corpus mount is online.
+    runs-on: [self-hosted, zenquant-data]
+    timeout-minutes: 30
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
+          fetch-depth: 1
+          persist-credentials: false
+      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v6
+      - name: Verify registered corpus precondition
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          uv sync --frozen
+          test -f data/derived/trend_research/20260824/BTCUSDT/5m/data.parquet
+          test -f data/derived/trend_research/20260824/BTCUSDT/funding/data.parquet
+          test -f data/derived/trend_research/20260824/BTCUSDT/1d/data.parquet
+          uv run python - <<'PY'
+          from pathlib import Path
+          from zenquant.research.time_space_replay import _registered_source_files
+          from zenquant.research.registration import load_execution_manifest
+          manifest = load_execution_manifest(
+              Path("config/research/registrations/time_space_shadow_execution_v1.json")
+          )
+          _registered_source_files(manifest.payload["sources"])
+          PY
+      - name: Generate from registered baseline and point-in-time slices
+        shell: bash
+        env:
+          REQUESTED_AS_OF: ${{ inputs.as_of }}
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          uv run python scripts/export_time_space_architecture.py \
+            --execution-manifest config/research/registrations/time_space_shadow_execution_v1.json \
+            --hypothesis-manifest config/research/time_space_shadow_hypothesis_v1.json \
+            --output-dir time-space-export \
+            --provider-run-id "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" \
+            --as-of "$REQUESTED_AS_OF"
+          cutoff=$(python -c 'from scripts.export_time_space_architecture import _parse_as_of; import sys; print(_parse_as_of(sys.argv[1]))' "$REQUESTED_AS_OF")
+          printf 'EXPORT_CUTOFF=%s\n' "$cutoff" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: time-space-export-${{ env.EXPORT_CUTOFF }}-${{ github.run_id }}
+          path: time-space-export
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 90

+name: Attest TimeSpace export checkpoint
+
+on:
+  workflow_run:
+    workflows: [Register TimeSpace export checkpoint]
+    types: [completed]
+
+permissions:
+  actions: read
+  contents: read
+
+jobs:
+  receipt:
+    if: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' }}
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
+          fetch-depth: 1
+          persist-credentials: false
+      - name: Download independently uploaded checkpoint
+        shell: bash
+        env:
+          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
+          RUN_ID: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          test "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" = "infdahai/zenQuant"
+          repository="infdahai/zenQuant"
+          gh api "repos/$repository/actions/runs/$RUN_ID" > provider-run.json
+          gh api "repos/$repository/actions/runs/$RUN_ID/artifacts" > artifacts.json
+          python - <<'PY'
+          import json, os, pathlib
+          payload = json.loads(pathlib.Path("artifacts.json").read_text())
+          suffix = f"-{os.environ['RUN_ID']}"
+          matches = [
+              item for item in payload["artifacts"]
+              if item["name"].startswith("time-space-export-checkpoint-")
+              and item["name"].endswith(suffix) and not item["expired"]
+          ]
+          if len(matches) != 1:
+              raise SystemExit("exact checkpoint artifact not found")
+          pathlib.Path("artifact.json").write_text(json.dumps(matches[0]))
+          pathlib.Path("artifact-id").write_text(str(matches[0]["id"]))
+          cutoff = matches[0]["name"].removeprefix("time-space-export-checkpoint-").removesuffix(suffix)
+          pathlib.Path("checkpoint-path").write_text(
+              f"config/research/registrations/time_space_exports/{cutoff}/"
+              "time_space_shadow_export_checkpoint_v1.json"
+          )
+          PY
+          artifact_id=$(<artifact-id)
+          gh api "repos/$repository/actions/artifacts/$artifact_id/zip" > checkpoint.zip
+          unzip -q checkpoint.zip -d checkpoint-artifact
+          manifest=$(find checkpoint-artifact -type f -name time_space_shadow_export_checkpoint_v1.json)
+          test "$(printf '%s\n' "$manifest" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" = 1
+          printf 'ARTIFACT_MANIFEST=%s\n' "$manifest" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          printf 'CHECKPOINT_LOGICAL_PATH=%s\n' "$(<checkpoint-path)" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          generator_run=$(python -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))["generator_provider_run_id"])' "$manifest")
+          cutoff=$(basename "$(dirname "$(<checkpoint-path)")")
+          gh api "repos/$repository/actions/runs/$generator_run/artifacts" > generator-artifacts.json
+          python - "$generator_run" "$cutoff" <<'PY'
+          import json, pathlib, sys
+          run_id, cutoff = sys.argv[1:]
+          payload = json.loads(pathlib.Path("generator-artifacts.json").read_text())
+          name = f"time-space-export-{cutoff}-{run_id}"
+          matches = [item for item in payload["artifacts"] if item["name"] == name and not item["expired"]]
+          if len(matches) != 1:
+              raise SystemExit("exact generator artifact not found")
+          pathlib.Path("generator-artifact-id").write_text(str(matches[0]["id"]))
+          pathlib.Path("generator-artifact.json").write_text(json.dumps(matches[0]))
+          PY
+          generator_artifact_id=$(<generator-artifact-id)
+          gh api "repos/$repository/actions/artifacts/$generator_artifact_id/zip" > generator.zip
+          unzip -q generator.zip -d generator-artifact
+          export_file=$(find generator-artifact -type f -name time_space_shadow_export.json)
+          provenance_file=$(find generator-artifact -type f -name time_space_shadow_export_provenance.json)
+          test "$(printf '%s\n' "$export_file" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" = 1
+          test "$(printf '%s\n' "$provenance_file" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" = 1
+          printf 'GENERATOR_EXPORT=%s\nGENERATOR_PROVENANCE=%s\n' \
+            "$export_file" "$provenance_file" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+      - name: Build receipt from provider and artifact evidence
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          python scripts/build_time_space_export_receipt.py \
+            --manifest "$ARTIFACT_MANIFEST" \
+            --manifest-path "$CHECKPOINT_LOGICAL_PATH" \
+            --provider-run-json provider-run.json \
+            --artifact-json artifact.json \
+            --generator-export "$GENERATOR_EXPORT" \
+            --generator-provenance "$GENERATOR_PROVENANCE" \
+            --generator-artifact-json generator-artifact.json \
+            --output time_space_export_registration_receipt.json
+          mkdir time-space-registration-bundle
+          cp time_space_export_registration_receipt.json \
+            time-space-registration-bundle/time_space_export_registration_receipt_v1.json
+          cp "$GENERATOR_EXPORT" time-space-registration-bundle/time_space_shadow_export.json
+          cp "$GENERATOR_PROVENANCE" \
+            time-space-registration-bundle/time_space_shadow_export_provenance.json
+      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: time-space-export-receipt-${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}
+          path: time-space-registration-bundle
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 90

@@ -0,0 +1,98 @@
+name: Register trend research manifest
+
+on:
+  push:
+    branches:
+      - feature/trend-registration-time-space-hypothesis
+      - feature/trend-registration-trend-participation-hypothesis
+      - feature/trend-registration-time-space-execution
+      - feature/trend-registration-trend-participation-execution
+  workflow_dispatch:
+    inputs:
+      manifest_kind:
+        description: Immutable record type to register
+        required: true
+        type: choice
+        options:
+          - hypothesis
+          - execution
+      manifest_path:
+        description: Checked-in JSON manifest path
+        required: true
+        type: string
+
+permissions:
+  actions: read
+  contents: read
+
+jobs:
+  register:
+    name: Register one immutable manifest
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps:
+      - name: Check out dispatched commit
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
+          fetch-depth: 1
+          persist-credentials: false
+
+      - name: Select immutable registration manifest
+        shell: bash
+        env:
+          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
+          REF_NAME: ${{ github.ref_name }}
+          INPUT_MANIFEST_KIND: ${{ inputs.manifest_kind }}
+          INPUT_MANIFEST_PATH: ${{ inputs.manifest_path }}
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          case "$EVENT_NAME" in
+            push)
+              python scripts/build_trend_registration_receipt.py select-bootstrap \
+                --branch-name "$REF_NAME" \
+                --github-env "$GITHUB_ENV"
+              ;;
+            workflow_dispatch)
+              python scripts/build_trend_registration_receipt.py select-manual \
+                --github-ref "$GITHUB_REF" \
+                --manifest-kind "$INPUT_MANIFEST_KIND" \
+                --manifest-path "$INPUT_MANIFEST_PATH" \
+                --github-env "$GITHUB_ENV"
+              ;;
+            *) exit 1 ;;
+          esac
+
+      - name: Validate manifest identity
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          python scripts/build_trend_registration_receipt.py validate \
+            --manifest-kind "$MANIFEST_KIND" \
+            --manifest-path "$MANIFEST_PATH"
+          test -f "$MANIFEST_PATH"
+          git ls-files --error-unmatch -- "$MANIFEST_PATH"
+          git cat-file -e "$GITHUB_SHA:$MANIFEST_PATH"
+          git diff --quiet "$GITHUB_SHA" -- "$MANIFEST_PATH"
+          git show "$GITHUB_SHA:$MANIFEST_PATH" | cmp -s - "$MANIFEST_PATH"
+          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
+
+      - name: Build trusted registration receipt
+        shell: bash
+        env:
+          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID" > provider-run.json
+          python scripts/build_trend_registration_receipt.py build \
+            --manifest-path "$MANIFEST_PATH" \
+            --commit-sha "$GITHUB_SHA" \
+            --provider-run-json provider-run.json \
+            --output registration_receipt.json
+
+      - name: Upload registration receipt
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: trend-registration-receipt-${{ github.run_id }}
+          path: registration_receipt.json
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 90

+### 2.1 Legacy accounting integrity boundary
+
+Legacy portfolio cash is a signed balance. A fill and fee must conserve the
+following identity without flooring negative cash:
+
+```text
+cash_after = cash_before - signed_quantity * fill_price - fee
+equity      = cash + sum(position_quantity * mark_price)
+```
+
+The removed `max(0, cash - fee)` floor erased financing liability after
+leveraged purchases and created equity. The August huge-profit claim is invalid.
+The checked-in validity manifest classifies its equity (including final equity
+and multiples), return, net PnL, Sharpe, Sortino, drawdown and promotion-gate
+families as `CONFIRMED_AFFECTED`. Historical artifacts stay available for
+audit, but their performance metrics cannot be used for comparison or
+promotion.
+
+The historical report's indicator formula identity is:
+
+```text
+sha256:82af23a08c68a94641e1d7769ecdf9619059dddbeb531dd3703cc4d2ff809f4a
+```
+
+That hash fingerprints the indicator formula; it does not fingerprint fee,
+fill, cash or mark-to-market accounting. Current code separately computes the
+accounting-kernel semantic identity:
+
+```text
+sha256:a2e7a4039556aa427ec258a2f38d302c6edf5e37e8e81b9cedd4a36897b66c1a
+```
+
+The frozen replay-input Parquet corpus contract covers the complete read-only
+snapshot taken at 2026-08-23 13:48 CST: 5,114 files / 21,375,864,438 bytes:

+## Frozen Trend-Research Spot Repair
+
+The TimeSpace Shadow and Trend Participation donor share one required BTC spot-daily source. This is a manual,
+network-dependent repair and freeze operation; it is not part of the hourly collector. The source contract is
+`BINANCE_SPOT_BTCUSDT_1D`, with fallback `NONE`.
+
+The required half-open market-event range is exactly:
+
+- warmup: `[2025-10-08T00:00:00Z, 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z)` (85 daily closes)
+- reused diagnostic window: `[2026-01-01T00:00:00Z, 2026-08-24T00:00:00Z)`
+- frozen exclusive end: `2026-08-24T00:00:00Z`
+
+Run these commands from the repository root. Binance archive downloads require network access. The downloader's
+`--end-date` is inclusive, so `2026-08-23` is intentional: specifying `2026-08-24` would download a bar at or after
+the frozen exclusive end and readiness would fail closed with `INSUFFICIENT_DATA_SPOT_DAILY_POST_END`.
+
+```bash
+uv run python scripts/download_spot_data.py \
+  --symbol BTCUSDT \
+  --start-date 2025-10-08 \
+  --end-date 2026-08-23 \
+  --timeframes 1d
+
+uv run python scripts/convert_csv_to_parquet.py \
+  --source binance_spot \
+  --symbol BTCUSDT \
+  --timeframes 1d \
+  --start-open-date 2025-10-08 \
+  --end-open-date-exclusive 2026-08-24 \
+  --spot-daily-output-path data/derived/trend_research/20260824/BTCUSDT/1d/data.parquet
+
+uv run python scripts/prepare_trend_market_tail.py \
+  --perp-source data/raw/binance/klines/BTCUSDT/5m/data.parquet \
+  --funding-source data/raw/binance/funding/BTCUSDT/data.parquet \
+  --output-root data/derived/trend_research/20260824/BTCUSDT \
+  --start 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z \
+  --end 2026-08-24T00:00:00Z
+
+uv run python scripts/data_readiness_status.py \
+  --trend-spot-path data/derived/trend_research/20260824/BTCUSDT/1d/data.parquet
+```
+
+Do not run either donor until `results/data_readiness/data_readiness.json` reports
+`trend_research_status.status == "READY"`. Missing, malformed, gapped, stale, duplicate, or post-end data has no
+neutral fallback and is a blocker when `--trend-spot-path` is supplied.
+
+The October monthly Binance archive contains valid rows before the 85-close warmup. They remain in raw provenance,
+but the strict normalizer validates the complete raw archives and then deterministically crops the normalized corpus
+to the exact half-open research range. Readiness and the freezer reject any normalized row before the warmup or at or
+after the frozen end. The bounded converter requires a dedicated derived output and refuses the shared canonical
+`data/raw/binance_spot/klines/BTCUSDT/1d/data.parquet`; `--timeframes 1d` also prevents this repair from rewriting
+existing `5m`, `1h`, or `4h` Parquet files used by other research paths.
+
+The market-tail preparer likewise never rewrites either shared canonical Parquet. It crops them into the exact frozen
+window, fills only missing fixed-window 5m bars or funding anchors from Binance REST, and publishes isolated `5m` and
+`funding` outputs together with `market_tail_provenance.json`. Every exact REST request, raw response page, inserted
+event list, and digest is retained so the freezer can rebuild the derived frames without network access. Retryable
+timeouts, HTTP 429, and HTTP 5xx responses use a bounded deterministic retry schedule; malformed payloads fail closed.
+Funding provider timestamps are retained as `raw_funding_time_ns` and canonicalized to an 8h
+`funding_time_ns` anchor only when they fall in `[anchor, anchor + 60 seconds]`; gaps, duplicates, non-finite values,
+bad candles, and later timestamps fail closed. Existing isolated `1d` bytes are preserved if already present.
+The provenance file is the publication commit marker. If a process stops before that marker appears, the next run
+removes only files described by the validated transaction marker; it refuses unknown or modified orphan contents.
+
+The execution freeze binds both normalized bytes and every raw Binance CSV as provenance. The following zsh-safe

+| `execution_shortfall` | `CONSISTENT` | `5/5` | observed shortfall corroborates the failed economics |
+| `cost_flip` | `UNATTRIBUTABLE` | `0/5` | evidence does not support “extra cost alone caused failure” |
+| `regime_localization` | `UNATTRIBUTABLE` | `0/5` | no regime-specific redesign is justified by this result |
+| `episode_tail` | `UNATTRIBUTABLE` | `0/5` | no stable episode-tail explanation was established |
+
+Confidence weighting improved A1 extra-15bp PnL by approximately `105,171` to
+`157,967` across the five seeds, but A1_SCORE remained negative in all five.
+The correct conclusion is “useful loss compression, no OOS rescue,” not “no
+incremental information” and not “promote confidence as a standalone edge.”

+## Evidence boundary and unresolved questions
+
+Established:
+
+- the donor fails late-dev at baseline and under extra 15bp costs;
+- confidence compresses loss but does not restore positive OOS net profitability;
+- execution does not create unauthorized exposure;
+- OptionsState has no order or position effect;
+- more training on this donor is not justified.
+
+Not established:
+
+- that time-insensitive decisions are the primary failure mechanism;
+- that failure concentrates in the first days of a breakout or an incomplete
+  weekly bar;
+- that regime information is unimportant—the current result is
+  `UNATTRIBUTABLE`, not a negative finding;
+- that execution shortfall is the root cause rather than a consequence of poor
+  trade selection;
+- hostile-window control, because no hostile window and threshold were frozen;
+- OptionsState OOS explanatory value, because real options history begins in
+  2026 and does not overlap the frozen 2025 late-dev window.
+
+## Proposed time-space hypothesis
+
+The current donor does not explicitly model `trend_age`, `breakout_age`, weekly
+bar progress or conditional weekly reversal hazard. The next candidate
+hypothesis is:
+
+> After a long decline or long basing period, a confirmed breakout may have a
+> persistence horizon that is not captured by price-level signals alone. A
+> large long-to-short reversal during the first one or two days, while the first
+> weekly bar is incomplete and market structure remains intact, implicitly bets
+> that the first weekly impulse will immediately fail or form a long upper wick.
+> The system may currently assign too much probability to that event.
+
+This is a falsifiable research hypothesis, not an explanation already proven by
+the frozen result. It must not be implemented as a crude minimum holding period.
+Such a rule would hide the causal question and could prevent legitimate exits.
+
+A shadow-only study should pre-register, without tuning:
+
+- `trend_age` since the confirmed structural trend transition;
+- `breakout_age` in 4h, daily and weekly bars;
+- current weekly-bar completion fraction;
+- an explicit point-in-time structural-integrity definition;
+- reversal hazard conditional on age and structural integrity;
+- point-in-time definitions for long decline, long base and confirmed breakout,
+  plus frozen age-bucket boundaries;
+- early-reversal versus mature-trend net PnL, MFE, MAE, episode PF, trend-return
+  retention, valid-stop losses and 15bp sensitivity;
+- the cost of early flips versus a frozen no-flip counterfactual.
+
+The 2025 late-dev window helped generate this hypothesis and therefore cannot
+serve as an unbiased confirmation set. Acceptance requires a previously
+untouched OOS window or forward data, stable direction across frozen seeds and
+windows, and rejection when the effect appears only after choosing favorable
+age buckets. Until then the fields are diagnostic only and cannot change target
+or execution.
+

-  supports when summed shortfall explains at least `25%` of absolute baseline loss.

-  unmet sample floors are `INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE`.

+
+**Architecture:** Keep the strategy and execution contracts unchanged while making the portfolio ledger a signed-cash, fail-closed accounting kernel. Publish immutable validity and provenance sidecars instead of rewriting historical artifacts, then run the already-frozen matrix to distinguish pure ledger deltas from downstream risk-path divergence.
+
+**Tech Stack:** Python 3.11+, frozen dataclasses, canonical JSON/SHA-256, pytest, existing `HistoricalBacktest`, `RiskOverlay`, and Quant V2 architecture runner.
+
+**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-23-legacy-accounting-integrity-design.md`
+
+## Global Constraints
+
+- Cash is signed; `cash_after_fee = cash_before_fee - fee` with no floor.
+- Fees must be finite, non-negative, validated before any fill event mutates state, and applied exactly once.
+- Fixed-event ledger replay and full-system replay are separate evidence classes.
+- Legacy funding and financing remain `OUT_OF_SCOPE_NOT_EQUITY_INTEGRATED`.
+- Historical artifacts are preserved; validity is recorded in sidecars at metric-family and stage granularity.
+- States are exactly `CONFIRMED_AFFECTED`, `UNVERIFIED_LEGACY`, `PROVEN_UNAFFECTED`, and `SUPERSEDED_REPAIRED`.
+- No Optuna, RL, manual search, parameter change, window change, seed change, or cost change is permitted.
+- Golden output is not updated until its behavioral diff is reviewed and explicitly accepted.
+
+---

+- [ ] **Step 3: Implement the minimal validation and signed subtraction**
+
+Use this contract:
+
+```python
+def validate_execution_fee(fee: float) -> None:
+    if not math.isfinite(fee) or fee < 0.0:
+        raise ValueError("fee must be finite and non-negative")
+
+@property
+def cash(self) -> float:
+    return self._cash
+
+def apply_fee(self, fee: float) -> None:
+    validate_execution_fee(fee)
+    if fee == 0.0:
+        return
+    self._cash -= fee
+    self._revalue_equity()
+```
+
+Validate the complete execution report before publishing it or applying any of its fill state. Do not silently sanitize a bad fee and do not charge a valid fee twice. Both execution and risk import the validator from `zenquant.domain`; execution must not import `zenquant.risk`.

+# TimeSpace Shadow Implementation Plan
+
+> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.
+
+**Goal:** Implement a research-only, point-in-time sidecar that measures whether early August Alpha flips abandon intact young trends without changing any trading output.
+
+**Architecture:** Build immutable TimeSpace state and flip observations from frozen 4h exports, then mature fixed-horizon counterfactual labels in a separate attribution pipeline. The module consumes existing Alpha and execution evidence read-only, writes independent artifacts, and is mechanically barred from production imports.
+
+**Tech Stack:** Python 3.12, frozen dataclasses, NumPy/pandas only in the offline runner, existing architecture experiment exports, pytest, JSON artifacts.
+
+**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-23-time-space-shadow-design.md` plus registration governance in `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-24-trend-participation-two-layer-design.md`.
+
+## Global Constraints
+
+- Primary population is an A1_SIGN `alpha_flip` in the same UTC week as its old-side breakout, with old-side structure `INTACT` and zero source gaps.
+- Primary label is fixed-1x `hold_minus_flip_6`; horizons 1/2/3 are descriptive.
+- A current-bar pivot cannot define a same-bar breakout; boundaries are visible at `t-1`.
+- Shadow OFF/ON must leave snapshots, targets, orders, fills, equity, and episodes byte-identical.
+- 2025 is discovery-only; 2026 is reused diagnostic; confirmation requires trusted dual receipts, 180 elapsed days, 30 matured flips, and a market-state transition.
+- No field is added to domain models, A1-A5 rows, strategy, risk, or execution.
+- Each task gets a fresh implementation subagent, spec reviewer, and code-quality reviewer.
+
+## File Map
+
+- Create `zenquant/research/time_space_shadow.py`: immutable state, PIT structure tracking, flip joining, label maturation, and acceptance statistics.
+- Create `scripts/run_time_space_shadow.py`: isolated runner and deterministic artifact writer.
+- Create `tests/test_time_space_shadow.py`: unit and causal tests.
+- Create `tests/test_time_space_shadow_cli.py`: CLI/artifact/evidence-role tests.
+- Modify `tests/test_import_boundaries.py`: prohibit production imports of the shadow.
+- Modify `tests/test_architecture_experiment.py`: OFF/ON byte-identity contract only; no production behavior change.
+
+---
+

+```python
+class StructureIntegrity(StrEnum):
+    INTACT = "INTACT"
+    BROKEN = "BROKEN"
+    UNKNOWN = "UNKNOWN"
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class TimeSpaceState:
+    state_id: str
+    alpha_id: str
+    cutoff_time_ns: int
+    feature_available_at_ns: int
+    trend_age_bars: int | None
+    trend_age_ns: int | None
+    long_breakout_age_bars: int | None
+    short_breakout_age_bars: int | None
+    utc_week_start_ns: int
+    weekly_completion_fraction: float
+    long_structure_integrity: StructureIntegrity
+    short_structure_integrity: StructureIntegrity
+    source_gap_bars: int
+    quality_flags: tuple[str, ...]
+    blocks_order: bool = field(default=False, init=False)
+```
+
+IDs use SHA-256 over canonical state inputs. Reject duplicate/non-monotonic cutoffs. Count retained bars and elapsed nanoseconds separately. Reset breakout association on opposite breakout, invalidation crossing, or real source gap.

+# Trend Participation Donor Implementation Plan
+
+> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.
+
+**Goal:** Implement an isolated fixed-1x BTC trend donor that compares exact `z84` sign with frozen hysteresis and determines whether it captures persistent trends profitably after 15bp stress.
+
+**Architecture:** A pure daily signal module produces latent state and diagnostics; a private replay adapter projects PIT safety and converts research intents into independently timed 5m execution events. Separate accounting, placebo, perturbation, trend-capture, and acceptance modules produce deterministic artifacts without importing into production paths.
+
+**Tech Stack:** Python 3.12, frozen dataclasses, NumPy/pandas for offline statistics, existing execution fee/slippage primitives and episode ledger, pytest, JSON/Parquet artifacts.
+
+**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-24-trend-participation-two-layer-design.md`
+
+## Global Constraints
+
+- Active signal source is only `BINANCE_SPOT_BTCUSDT_1D`; spot fallback is `NONE`.
+- `z84` uses 85 consecutive closes, 84 log returns, sample standard deviation `ddof=1`, and `sigma_floor=1e-12`.
+- A daily bar available at 00:00 UTC first affects the strictly later 04:00 UTC decision.
+- Compare only `z84_sign_fixed_1x` and `z84_hysteresis_fixed_1x`; August A5 is appendix-only.
+- Starting capital and notional are fixed, leverage is 1x, and compounding is disabled.
+- Actual-fill gross PnL already contains slippage; implementation shortfall is diagnostic and is not deducted twice.
+- Stress costs use `realized_turnover_notional`; a completed direct flip targets 2x but partial fills pay only realized costs.
+- Forward FSM and ledger start flat; pre-start rows warm only rolling buffers.
+- Production strategy, risk, execution, domain snapshots, A1-A5, and OptionsState remain unchanged.
+- Every task is handled by a fresh implementation subagent and two fresh reviewers before commit.
+
+## File Map
+
+- Create `zenquant/research/trend_participation.py`: z-score math, latent FSM, diagnostics, monthly labels, perturbations, placebo, and acceptance.
+- Create `zenquant/research/trend_participation_replay.py`: private intent, safety projection, execution-time adapter, fill/accounting result.
+- Create `scripts/run_trend_participation.py`: registered diagnostic/forward runner and artifact writer.
+- Create `tests/test_trend_participation.py`: signal/FSM/diagnostic/statistics tests.
+- Create `tests/test_trend_participation_replay.py`: execution, partial fill, safety, funding, and cost tests.
+- Create `tests/test_trend_participation_cli.py`: identity, evidence-role, artifact, and source-drift tests.
+- Modify `tests/test_import_boundaries.py`: block production imports.
+- Reuse without schema changes: `zenquant/research/episode_ledger.py`, `zenquant/research/accounting_kernel_identity.py`, and fee/slippage primitives from `zenquant.execution`.
+

+- [ ] **Step 3: Implement both paths as pure functions**

+```python
+def next_hysteresis_state(state: TrendSide, z84: float | None) -> TrendSide:
+    if z84 is None:
+        return TrendSide.UNKNOWN
+    if state is TrendSide.LONG:
+        return TrendSide.SHORT if z84 <= -.50 else TrendSide.FLAT if z84 <= 0 else TrendSide.LONG
+    if state is TrendSide.SHORT:
+        return TrendSide.LONG if z84 >= .50 else TrendSide.FLAT if z84 >= 0 else TrendSide.SHORT
+    return TrendSide.LONG if z84 >= .50 else TrendSide.SHORT if z84 <= -.50 else TrendSide.FLAT
+```
+
+`run_latent_path()` initializes `FLAT` at the registered boundary, applies at most one daily transition, and emits a stable ID for every observation.

+- [ ] **Step 3: Implement exact projection precedence**
+
+```python
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class TrendParticipationResearchIntent:
+    intent_id: str
+    signal_decision_cutoff_ns: int
+    latent_target: int
+    approved_target: float
+    safety_snapshot_id: str
+
+def project_research_target(
+    latent_target: int,
+    current_filled: float,
+    safety: ResearchSafetySnapshot,
+    *,
+    decision_cutoff_ns: int,
+) -> float:
+    if safety.available_at_ns > decision_cutoff_ns:
+        raise ValueError("safety available_at_ns exceeds decision cutoff")
+    if safety.kill or safety.unsafe:
+        return 0.0
+    if safety.reduce_only:
+        return 0.0 if current_filled * latent_target <= 0 else math.copysign(min(abs(current_filled), abs(latent_target)), current_filled)
+    if safety.cap_violation:
+        return math.copysign(min(abs(current_filled), safety.cap_value), current_filled) if current_filled else 0.0
+    return float(latent_target)
+```
+
+Safety does not mutate latent state. Recovery can alter approved exposure only on the next confirmed 4h decision.
+

+# Trend Research Foundation Implementation Plan
+
+> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.
+
+**Goal:** Build the fail-closed BTC spot-daily data, source-identity, evidence-role, and trusted-registration foundation required by both trend research layers.
+
+**Architecture:** Add immutable research contracts under `zenquant.research` and a dedicated Binance spot-daily normalizer/auditor under `zenquant.data`. Keep downloaded data and generated receipts outside Git; checked-in hypothesis manifests freeze formulas and requested windows, while execution envelopes bind the final corpus before any result is computed.
+
+**Tech Stack:** Python 3.12, frozen dataclasses, pandas/pyarrow, hashlib/json, pytest, existing `uv` and `zenquant-check` tooling.
+
+**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-24-trend-participation-two-layer-design.md`
+
+## Global Constraints
+
+- Asset and active signal source are exactly BTC and `BINANCE_SPOT_BTCUSDT_1D`.
+- Requested reused window is `[2026-01-01T00:00:00Z, 2026-08-24T00:00:00Z)` and may not be shortened after inspection.
+- Spot fallback is `NONE`; REQUIRED spot, perpetual 5m, and funding inputs fail closed.
+- Evidence role is determined by market-event cutoff, never ingest/backfill time.
+- Forward start is the first confirmed 4h cutoff at or after the later trusted receipt plus 24 hours.
+- No production strategy, risk, execution, `DecisionSnapshot`, or A1-A5 schema change is allowed.
+- Each task is implemented by a fresh subagent, then reviewed first for spec compliance and second for code quality before commit.
+
+## File Map
+
+- Create `zenquant/research/registration.py`: canonical manifest hashing, receipt validation, forward-cutoff derivation, and evidence-role classification.
+- Create `zenquant/data/spot_daily.py`: deterministic CSV normalization, daily-grid audit, and immutable source-envelope construction.
+- Create `scripts/freeze_trend_research_inputs.py`: CLI that audits all REQUIRED inputs and writes an execution manifest without computing signals.
+- Create `zenquant/data/trend_market_tail.py` and `scripts/prepare_trend_market_tail.py`: isolate the exact-window
+  perpetual/funding corpus, normalize funding timestamp jitter, fetch only missing fixed-window events, and bind every
+  source/output/REST page in an immutable provenance envelope without touching canonical Parquet.
+- Create `scripts/build_trend_registration_receipt.py` and `.github/workflows/trend-research-registration.yml`: bind manifest and commit identities to a verifiable GitHub Actions run creation time.
+- Modify `scripts/convert_csv_to_parquet.py`: delegate Binance spot 1d normalization to the strict library path.
+- Modify `scripts/data_readiness_status.py`: expose trend-research readiness and blockers.
+- Create `config/research/time_space_shadow_hypothesis_v1.json` and `config/research/trend_participation_hypothesis_v1.json`: checked-in frozen hypotheses.
+- Create `tests/test_trend_research_registration.py`, `tests/test_spot_daily.py`, and `tests/test_trend_research_input_freeze.py`: focused contracts.

+- [ ] **Step 3: Implement the frozen contracts**
+
+```python
+class EvidenceRole(StrEnum):
+    DISCOVERY_ONLY = "DISCOVERY_ONLY"
+    TEST_REUSED_DIAGNOSTIC = "TEST_REUSED_DIAGNOSTIC"
+    FORWARD_CONFIRMATION = "FORWARD_CONFIRMATION"
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class RegistrationReceipt:
+    manifest_sha256: str
+    provider_run_id: str
+    commit_sha: str
+    remote_identity: str
+    received_at_ns: int
+
+def derive_forward_start_ns(
+    hypothesis: HypothesisManifest,
+    execution: ExecutionManifest,
+    receipts: Sequence[RegistrationReceipt],
+    *,
+    expected_remote_identity: str,
+    expected_hypothesis_provider_run_id: int | str,
+    expected_hypothesis_commit_sha: str,
+    expected_execution_provider_run_id: int | str,
+    expected_execution_commit_sha: str,
+) -> int:
+    hypothesis_receipt, execution_receipt = validate_registration_receipt_pair(
+        hypothesis,
+        execution,
+        receipts,
+        expected_remote_identity=expected_remote_identity,
+        expected_hypothesis_provider_run_id=expected_hypothesis_provider_run_id,
+        expected_hypothesis_commit_sha=expected_hypothesis_commit_sha,
+        expected_execution_provider_run_id=expected_execution_provider_run_id,
+        expected_execution_commit_sha=expected_execution_commit_sha,
+    )
+    candidate = max(hypothesis_receipt.received_at_ns, execution_receipt.received_at_ns) + DAY_NS
+    return ((candidate + FOUR_HOURS_NS - 1) // FOUR_HOURS_NS) * FOUR_HOURS_NS
+```
+
+The hypothesis and execution descriptors must come from validated local manifest payloads. Execution v1 uses an exact top-level schema: no unknown or result keys, the exact reused window and checkpoint rule, the exact three READY/REQUIRED/NONE sources, canonical and internally recomputed source/construction/accounting/workspace identities, and recursively canonical SHA fields. The freezer calls this same validator before publication. Receipt-pair validation must plain-copy and fully revalidate both descriptor payloads, then prove every exposed field and canonical payload hash matches; frozen dataclass construction alone is not trusted. Both descriptors must name the same supported layer, and the execution manifest must embed the exact hypothesis SHA. Receipt-pair validation must reject missing, duplicate, swapped, unexpected, cross-layer, same-run, or wrong-kind evidence; bind canonical provider run IDs and 40/64-character lowercase Git SHAs; and require both receipts to match the independently expected remote/run/commit identities. Legacy numeric GitHub run IDs are canonicalized before comparing already-issued envelopes.

+```python
+def verify_github_receipt(envelope: Mapping[str, Any], provider: Mapping[str, Any]) -> RegistrationReceipt:
+    expected = (envelope["provider_run_id"], envelope["commit_sha"], envelope["remote_identity"])
+    observed = (provider["id"], provider["head_sha"], provider["repository"]["full_name"])
+    if expected != observed:
+        raise RegistrationError("provider identity mismatch")
+    received_at_ns = iso8601_to_ns(str(provider["created_at"]))
+    return RegistrationReceipt(str(envelope["manifest_sha256"]), provider_run_id, provider_commit_sha, remote_identity, received_at_ns)
+```
+
+The workflow retains `workflow_dispatch` for post-merge use and accepts one
+`manifest_path` plus `manifest_kind`. Before merge, it bootstraps only from the
+four fixed registration branches, each mapped to exactly one manifest. It
+checks out the selected immutable commit, fetches its own run payload with
+`gh api repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID`, writes one JSON
+envelope, and uploads it as a GitHub artifact. It must fail when a manifest is
+untracked, differs from the checked-out commit, the bootstrap branch is
+unmapped, or the run head SHA differs.

+- [ ] **Step 3: Implement strict normalization and audit**
+
+```python
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class SpotDailyAudit:
+    status: str
+    row_count: int
+    first_open_ns: int | None
+    last_close_ns: int | None
+    missing_open_ns: tuple[int, ...]
+    duplicate_open_ns: tuple[int, ...]
+    sha256: str
+
+def audit_spot_daily(path: Path, start_ns: int, end_ns: int) -> SpotDailyAudit:
+    frame = pd.read_parquet(path).sort_values("open_time_ns")
+    expected = set(range(start_ns, end_ns, DAY_NS))
+    observed = set(int(value) for value in frame.open_time_ns)
+    missing = tuple(sorted(expected - observed))
+    status = "READY" if not missing and frame.open_time_ns.is_unique else "INSUFFICIENT_DATA_SPOT_DAILY_GAPS"
+    return SpotDailyAudit(status, len(frame), _first(frame), _last(frame), missing, _duplicates(frame), sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
+```
+
+Normalization must accept microsecond/millisecond Binance archives, require positive finite OHLC, require `high >= max(open, close)` and `low <= min(open, close)`, preserve raw source digests, accept only byte/value-identical overlap, and write ordered Parquet atomically. Change the existing converter only for `source=binance_spot` and `tf=1d`; futures and other timeframes retain current behavior.

+```python
+def build_execution_manifest(inputs: FreezeInputs) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    audits = {source.source_id: source.audit() for source in inputs.sources}
+    blockers = sorted(source_id for source_id, audit in audits.items() if audit.required and not audit.ready)
+    if blockers:
+        raise InputFreezeError(f"REQUIRED sources not ready: {blockers}")
+    return {
+        "schema_version": "trend-research-execution-manifest.v1",
+        "hypothesis_sha256": inputs.hypothesis_sha256,
+        "reused_window": [inputs.reused_start_ns, inputs.reused_end_ns],
+        "sources": {key: value.to_dict() for key, value in sorted(audits.items())},
+        "accounting_kernel": build_accounting_kernel_identity(),
+    }
+```

+# Trend Participation Donor V1 Implementation Plan
+
+> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.
+
+**Goal:** Build and evaluate an isolated BTC `LONG | FLAT` structural trend donor that must remain below 30% MDD on every fixed non-train path and beat fixed EMA-family and breakout-only controls after realistic costs.
+
+**Architecture:** Keep signal, controls, perturbation, execution, accounting, stages, acceptance, and reporting as separate deterministic research modules. Reuse the audited execution gateway and episode ledger, share only a byte-parity simulated-price quote, and keep target-delta planning private to research so TimeSpace-bound production files remain untouched; do not import the donor into strategy, risk, app, infra, or live adapters. Historical and reused results may reject the donor, while only one precommitted 365-day forward window may make it eligible for a separate activation review.
+
+**Tech Stack:** Python 3.11, frozen dataclasses, pandas/pyarrow, DuckDB-backed Parquet reads, existing `SimulatedGateway`, `PositionEpisodeLedger`, pytest, ruff, canonical JSON/SHA-256.
+
+**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-24-trend-participation-two-layer-design.md`
+
+## Global Constraints
+
+- BTC only; daily spot signal, confirmed 4h decision cutoff, first retained perpetual 5m open strictly after the cutoff.
+- Core state is exactly `FLAT | LONG | UNKNOWN`; it never emits `SHORT`.
+- Entry is prior-55-day high breakout plus EMA20–100 majority; exit is prior-20-day low failure plus loss of EMA majority.
+- At least 100 consecutive valid completed daily rows are required; a real source gap resets warmup and `UNKNOWN` approves flat.
+- T1 is fixed initial capital, fixed 1x entry notional, fixed quantity within an episode, no compounding.
+- T2 scalar is `min(1.50, (0.85 * 0.30) / train_stress_mdd)` and may read only `TRAIN_FULL`.
+- T3 may only reduce exposure; the 28% 5m marked-to-market drawdown kill latches for the remainder of its window.
+- Final T3 MDD must be strictly below 30% on the canonical and all five seed paths in every fixed non-train window.
+- Costs are observed 4bp taker fee plus 1.5bp fallback slippage, with additional 15bp acceptance and 25bp diagnostic turnover stress.
+- Seeds are exactly `42, 123, 456, 789, 1024`; no parameter search or result-driven threshold change.
+- `DEV_2024_REUSED`, `DISCOVERY_2025`, and `TEST_2026_REUSED` may reject but never promote or resize.
+- Forward evidence is exactly `[F, F + 365 calendar days)` with one look; an extension requires a new prospective evidence envelope.
+- EMA controls remain all 81 named members; no best EMA may be selected.
+- OptionsState and TimeSpace remain observation-only and byte-neutral to orders and positions.
+- Local committed manifests, Git SHA, source/code/config hashes, exact commands, and result hashes are sufficient for research; no remote receipt is required.

+- [ ] **Step 3: Implement immutable source identity**
+
+```python
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class TrendSourcePaths:
+    spot_daily: Path
+    perp_5m: Path
+    funding: Path
+
+def build_trend_source_manifest(
+    paths: TrendSourcePaths,
+    config: TrendParticipationConfig,
+    *,
+    repository_root: Path,
+    execution_manifest: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    before = hash_trend_sources(paths)
+    audited_sources = audit_trend_sources(paths, config)
+    after = hash_trend_sources(paths)
+    if before != after:
+        raise TrendInputError("source mutated during manifest construction")
+    return canonical_trend_source_manifest(
+        paths=paths,
+        config=config,
+        audited_sources=audited_sources,
+        source_hashes=after,
+        repository_root=repository_root,
+        execution_manifest=execution_manifest,
+    )
+
+def build_trend_execution_manifest(
+    source_manifest: Mapping[str, Any],
+    config: TrendParticipationConfig,
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    return canonical_execution_envelope(source_manifest, config)
+```
+
+Implement the three named helpers in the same module: `hash_trend_sources()` returns canonical file identities, `audit_trend_sources()` returns immutable grid/cutoff facts without fill or carry-forward, and `canonical_trend_source_manifest()` binds those facts to Git/config/formula identities and resolved windows. Hash ordered raw CSVs and normalized Parquet for spot daily, perpetual 5m, and funding, plus config, formula, source-normalization modules, `uv.lock`, and Git HEAD. Require an exact UTC daily grid, an exact perpetual 5m grid, and every 8h funding anchor strictly before the common cutoff.
+
+Resolve `common_source_cutoff_ns` as the final retained perpetual 5m open immediately before the latest fully covered UTC midnight, normally `23:55`. It is not 4h-aligned. Compute `F = strict_next_4h_cutoff(common_source_cutoff_ns)` and require `F % DAY_NS == 0` for V1; a non-midnight result fails closed because the existing archive downloader cannot obtain an intraday endpoint without observing later rows. Require the initial snapshot to contain a complete historical grid through `F` exclusive: every perpetual 5m open `<F`, every funding anchor `<F`, and every spot-daily row whose availability is needed before `F`, with no retained event timestamp `>=F`. Add a golden where the last 5m open is `23:55`, `F` is next-day `00:00`, `[...F)` is gap-free, and the first forward row would be `00:00`. The later formula manifest binds the execution, perturbation, signal, stages, accounting, and acceptance kernels after those modules exist.
+
+`build_trend_execution_manifest()` may derive `F = strict_next_4h_cutoff(common_source_cutoff_ns)` only when no committed envelope exists. It stores resolved midnight `F`, midnight `F + 365 days`, exact UTC `forward_end_iso`, and `forward_last_complete_date_utc` equal to the calendar day immediately before the endpoint, plus every resolved window, donor/config/source-identity SHA-256 value, `construction_git_sha`, `one_look: true`, and `authority: "RESEARCH_ONLY"`. Define `source_identity_sha256` over the stable audited source/config subsection before either manifest embeds the envelope, so no circular manifest hash exists. The finalized source manifest embeds the exact execution-envelope SHA-256; the envelope binds the stable source identity rather than the final source-manifest bytes. When an envelope exists, validate it byte-for-byte and reuse its `F`; never slide it to a refreshed source cutoff.

+- [ ] **Step 4: Implement atomic CLI publication**

+`scripts/freeze_trend_participation_inputs.py` accepts only explicit canonical paths, `--resolved-last-complete-date`, paired repeatable `--record-command`/`--record-exit-code` values, `--execution-manifest-path`, and `--output-dir`. Reject an unequal command/exit-code count and every non-zero recorded exit. Persist the expanded command strings and the resolved UTC date in the source manifest.

+The CLI has exactly two mutually exclusive publication modes:
+
+- `--initialize-execution-envelope`: allowed once when the envelope and output target do not exist; creates the initial source seal ending before `F` and the envelope candidate;
+- `--seal-forward`: allowed only with the byte-identical committed envelope and only when complete source coverage reaches its exact `F + 365d` endpoint; compares every normalized INITIAL_SEAL row with event timestamp `<F` across all three sources, including the final pre-F 5m row, against ordered row/content hashes stored in the envelope; freezes the exact `[F, F + 365d)` additions and fails if any historical prefix byte changed.
+
+There is no partial-forward publication mode. Before maturity, `--seal-forward` exits non-zero with `FORWARD_NOT_MATURE` and writes nothing. It also rejects an existing output directory, so the fixed endpoint seal cannot be silently overwritten.
+

Initialization slices cover the complete grid through `F` exclusive and contain no event at or after `F`. Forward-seal slices contain the unchanged historical/warmup prefix plus exactly the fixed endpoint interval and carry `evidence_mode: "FORWARD_SEAL"`. Apply every half-open bound in the Parquet/DuckDB scan itself; no Python frame, audit row, content hash, or strategy event may ever contain a timestamp `>= forward_end_ns` and then be sliced afterward. Hash the exact snapshot bytes and make the runner consume these slices, not mutable canonical inputs. In initialization mode, once both staged products validate, publish the envelope candidate through a sibling temporary file plus `os.replace`, then rename the staging directory into the previously absent `--output-dir`; if the second replace fails, remove only the just-created envelope before returning failure. Forward-seal mode never rewrites the existing envelope and atomically publishes only its new output directory. Never rewrite canonical source data or call a backtest.

+- [ ] **Step 3: Implement chronological equity accounting**
+
+```python
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class TrendEquityPoint:
+    timestamp_ns: int
+    cash: float
+    position_qty: float
+    mark_price: float
+    equity: float
+    drawdown: float
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class TrendAccountingState:
+    cash: float
+    position_qty: float
+    average_entry_price: float
+    high_water_equity: float
+    current_drawdown: float
+    equity_points: tuple[TrendEquityPoint, ...]
+
+def net_cagr(initial_equity: float, terminal_equity: float, elapsed_days: float) -> float | None:
+    if terminal_equity <= 0.0:
+        return None
+    return (terminal_equity / initial_equity) ** (365.2425 / elapsed_days) - 1.0
+```
+
+Every state transition accepts exactly one current event and returns a new frozen state. For each completed 5m bar, book already-scheduled opening fills first, mark at that bar's close at the bar-end timestamp, then expose the updated drawdown to the T3 coordinator. Book fees/funding once in chronological order. `account_trend_run()` is only a fold over the same causal functions; it may not contain an alternative formula. A non-positive equity point returns `RUIN`, MDD `1.0`, and invalid CAGR.
+

Count a direction switch only when filled position crosses through zero from one non-zero sign to the opposite non-zero sign; `FLAT -> LONG` and `LONG -> FLAT` are not switches, so the V1 donor must report zero. Attribute a future sleeve's switch to the UTC day of its zero-crossing fill and report maximum plus mean, with gates later using maximum.

+- [ ] **Step 3: Implement stage contracts**
+
+```python
+class TrendStage(StrEnum):
+    T1 = "T1"
+    T2 = "T2"
+    T3 = "T3"
+
+def compute_train_risk_scalar(train_rows: Sequence[StageRunMetric]) -> float:
+    stress_mdd = max(row.max_drawdown for row in train_rows)
+    if stress_mdd <= 0.0:
+        raise TrendStageError("train stress MDD must be positive")
+    return min(1.50, (0.85 * 0.30) / stress_mdd)
+```
+
+Require every input row to carry `window_id == "TRAIN_FULL"`; passing non-train rows is an error, not an ignored value. T1 emits one initial-capital entry-notional intent per episode with scalar `1.0`; T2 changes only that intent's frozen scalar. The execution event converts notional and scalar into quantity once from its shared deterministic gateway quote.
+
+- [ ] **Step 4: Implement one chronological T3 event loop**
+
+`run_causal_trend_path()` merges confirmed 4h intents, retained 5m bars, and funding settlements in timestamp order and owns the only T3 coordination path:
+
+1. a 4h cutoff may update latent core intent but may not fill;
+2. the first later retained 5m open may freeze entry quantity and fill a scheduled target;
+3. at the completed 5m bar end, accounting marks equity and updates current drawdown;
+4. a newly reached 28% drawdown latches immediately, cancels pending exposure-increasing work, and schedules only a reduce-only flat for the next retained 5m open strictly after the trigger;
+5. funding is booked at its event timestamp and its new equity may also trigger the same next-open flatten path;
+6. the kill keeps approved exposure zero for the rest of the window, even while latent core state stays `LONG`.
+
+Separate latent core intent, risk-approved target, filled position, accounting state, and latch state. `KILL`, `UNSAFE`, `REDUCE_ONLY`, cap violation, and the 28% latch may only reduce absolute exposure. A non-latching safety flatten cannot restore exposure before a later confirmed 4h decision. No stage function may accept a completed equity curve, future event sequence, or precomputed maximum drawdown as an execution input.
+

+def _check_name_prefix_boundary(
+    source_dirs: list[Path],
+    forbidden_prefix: str,
+    label: str,
+) -> list[str]:
+    violations: list[str] = []
+    for source_dir in source_dirs:
+        for py_file in source_dir.glob("*.py"):
+            for imported in _collect_imports(py_file):
+                if imported.startswith(forbidden_prefix):
+                    violations.append(f"{label}: {py_file.relative_to(PROJECT_ROOT)} imports '{imported}'")
+    return violations
+
+def test_operational_packages_do_not_import_trend_research() -> None:
+    violations = _check_name_prefix_boundary(

+            PROJECT_ROOT / "zenquant" / "app",

+            PROJECT_ROOT / "zenquant" / "ingestor",

+        "TREND_PARTICIPATION_ISOLATION",

+# August Donor Retirement Design
+
+## Status
+
+Approved direction as of 2026-08-23. This design retires the August rank1
+donor from new training and promotion while preserving historical replay and
+audit evidence.
+
+## Decision
+
+The immutable retirement state is:
+
+```text
+donor_id               = august_rank1_20260821
+research_state         = RETIRED
+training_allowed       = false
+parameter_search       = false
+promotion_allowed      = false
+historical_replay      = true
+reason                 = late_dev_baseline_negative_5_of_5
+terminal_recommendation = stop_donor_training
+```
+
+Retirement is a governance decision, not deletion. The candidate parameters,
+manifest, generated artifact identities and committed analyzers remain
+available for reproducibility.
+
+## Authority
+
+A tracked machine-readable donor registry becomes the only authority for
+whether a named donor may enter a new campaign. It records donor lineage, source
+selector and parameter hash. Human-readable docs explain the decision but
+cannot unlock a donor.
+
+Campaign and promotion entrypoints must fail closed before loading parameters
+when a donor is retired. A generic research command without a declared donor
+identity must not silently default to August. A new donor ID with the same
+retired parameter hash or source selector is rejected as an alias.
+
+Retirement may be reversed only by a new product-owner decision that names a
+new donor identity. The original `august_rank1_20260821` identity itself remains
+retired permanently; any materially different hypothesis receives a new ID.
+
+## Allowed operations
+
+- reproduce the frozen A0-A5 experiment only with
+  `mode=reproduce_frozen`, the original manifest and exact parameter hash;
+- regenerate compact acceptance or attribution reports from the frozen raw artifact;
+- compare a new donor against August as a historical benchmark;
+- inspect parameters, decisions, episodes and execution diagnostics.
+
+## Forbidden operations
+
+- start Optuna, RL or manual parameter search from August parameters;
+- use August as the implicit default donor for a new campaign;
+- change its windows, seeds, costs or parameters and retain the same donor ID;
+- promote it to paper-live or capital deployment;
+- reinterpret a historical replay as new OOS evidence.
+
+## Compatibility
+
+The legacy production path remains unchanged. Existing frozen result hashes and
+golden files must remain byte-identical. The retirement gate applies only to
+research campaign and promotion authority; it must not prevent deterministic
+historical reproduction.
+
+The rejected historical contract
+`docs/NEXT_RESEARCH_HYPOTHESIS_EXECUTION_INVENTORY_RETHINK.json` remains a known
+runtime dependency until a separate migration moves it under `config/research/`
+and makes its closed state fail-closed.
+
+## Acceptance
+
+- every new campaign names a donor identity explicitly;
+- a retired donor exits before training, parameter loading or output mutation
+  in campaign and promotion modes;
+- `mode=reproduce_frozen` loads only the original manifest and parameter hash,
+  marks all outputs reproduction-only and cannot emit promotion evidence;
+- historical replay remains available under an explicit reproduction mode;
+- changing the registry changes its content hash and audit output;
+- August acceptance summary remains
+  `BLOCKED_PAUSE_PROMOTION_AND_TRAINING`;
+- full legacy/plugin parity and golden tests remain unchanged.

+# BTC Spot-Perpetual Carry Foundation Design
+
+## Objective
+
+Build the accounting, data-quality and multi-leg research contracts required to
+measure a BTC spot-perpetual funding carry. V1 is shadow-only and does not place
+orders or alter the existing directional strategy.
+
+Quarterly futures, naked options and production capital are outside V1.
+
+## Current blockers
+
+- historical replay reports funding separately but does not include funding
+  cashflow in strategy equity and net PnL;
+- BTC spot data is stale and contains duplicate timestamps;
+- basis joins can return the last value indefinitely without a stale flag;
+- funding `mark_price` is mostly unavailable;
+- no dated-futures curve, canonical OI or borrow-cost history exists;
+- the system has no atomic two-leg intent, hedge error or pair episode contract.
+
+The existing `funding_alpha_signal` is a directional contrarian feature. It is
+not a market-neutral carry strategy and cannot serve as the Carry V1 donor.
+
+## Data contract
+
+Every input carries source timestamp, visible-at timestamp, coverage, staleness,
+quality flags and content identity. Price inputs older than one 4h decision
+interval are stale; execution quotes older than one 5m interval are stale.
+Byte-identical duplicate timestamps collapse deterministically, while
+conflicting duplicates fail closed.
+
+The minimum aligned observation contains:
+
+- BTC spot and perpetual executable price proxies at the same cutoff;
+- perpetual mark and index price when available;
+- realized funding settlements and a next-funding estimate only when its source
+  has explicit `published_at` or `visible_at` history;
+- spot-perpetual basis as a diagnostic mark-to-market state;
+- expected funding over a frozen 24h holding horizon;
+- conservative two-leg fees and slippage;
+- spot financing cost and, for reverse carry, borrow rate and availability;
+- margin, maintenance margin and liquidation buffer;
+- instrument multipliers and minimum quantities.
+
+Final realized settlement rates can never be backfilled as earlier forecasts.
+Without a point-in-time next-funding source, expected carry is `UNKNOWN` and no
+candidate episode opens. Missing, stale or unaligned critical data also produces
+`UNKNOWN` and a flat shadow target.
+
+V1 enables only positive carry: long spot and short perpetual. Reverse carry is
+disabled until point-in-time borrow rate and availability history exists. The
+primary financing stress is a pre-registered `10%` annual rate, with `0%`, `5%`
+and `20%` reported as non-promoting sensitivities. Venue fee tier, contract
+multiplier, minimum quantity and margin parameters remain instrument-specific.
+
+## Carry decision contract
+
+An immutable research-only `CarryDecisionSnapshot` records:
+
+- decision and hedge-group identity;
+- confirmed 4h cutoff;
+- long/short instrument identities;
+- aligned source observations and hashes;
+- expected gross funding over 24h and current basis;
+- financing, borrow, fees and slippage;
+- expected net carry and breakeven holding horizon;
+- hedge ratio, maximum hedge error and maximum unhedged duration;
+- margin and liquidation buffers;
+- quality flags and `blocks_order=true` for V1 shadow publication.
+
+Expected net carry equals visible expected funding minus financing, two-leg fees
+and two-leg slippage. Basis is not counted as expected convergence; it enters PnL
+only through actual entry-to-exit mark changes. Breakeven holding time divides
+round-trip costs by visible expected funding per hour and is `UNKNOWN` when that
+rate is non-positive or unavailable.
+
+The snapshot is separate from the directional `DecisionSnapshot` and cannot be
+consumed by the production executor.
+
+## Pair accounting
+
+A pair ledger measures one hedge group:
+
+```text
+spot mark-to-market PnL
++ perpetual mark-to-market PnL
++ funding cashflow
+- spot financing or borrow cost
+- two-leg fees
+- two-leg slippage
+= net carry PnL
+```
+
+Funding enters the versioned carry ledger's cash and equity exactly once at its
+point-in-time settlement. Carry-disabled legacy replay, acceptance summaries and
+goldens remain byte-identical; V1 does not silently rewrite global historical
+accounting.
+The ledger separately reports gross basis PnL, funding, financing, fees,
+slippage, maximum hedge error, unhedged duration, margin usage and liquidation
+distance.
+
+## Execution boundary
+
+The existing V2 target-tracking kernel may later execute each approved leg. A
+new hedge-group coordinator must own leg pairing, partial-fill recovery and
+maximum unhedged exposure. The executor cannot invent the hedge leg or alter the
+pair ratio.
+
+V1 implements no live coordinator. A confirmed 4h cutoff creates only a
+decision; it cannot fill at that same close. Counterfactual legs fill from the
+next visible executable 5m quote using bid/ask, frozen latency and slippage.
+Leg order, partial fills and hedge error are recorded. Exceeding maximum hedge
+error or unhedged duration produces `INVALID_PAIR`, closes no valid carry
+episode and cannot enter PF or return numerators or denominators.
+
+## ETH validation boundary
+
+ETH is not a production expansion in this phase. Before it can validate the
+frozen carry hypothesis, the repository must:
+
+- add current ETH spot and refresh funding/1d data;
+- disable BTC options, COT, on-chain, liquidation and metrics inputs;
+- remove the invalid ETH-to-ETH cross-asset context;
+- run the exact BTC carry formula, thresholds and cost methodology without ETH
+  retuning, while using ETH-specific fee tier, multiplier, minimum quantity,
+  spread/slippage, financing and margin inputs.
+
+ETH results are an independent falsification panel and never feed back into BTC
+threshold selection.
+
+## Acceptance for Carry Foundation
+
+- funding settlement reconciles cash, equity and pair ledger exactly once;
+- basis refuses stale, duplicate or future data;
+- every aligned input is point-in-time reproducible;
+- pair PnL reconciles all legs and costs to floating-point tolerance;
+- missing borrow, financing or margin data fails flat;
+- single-leg fill and hedge-error scenarios are explicitly censored or failed;
+- censored and `INVALID_PAIR` observations are excluded from PF and return Gates
+  and reported with an explicit failure rate;
+- no shadow object reaches strategy, risk or production order subjects;
+- BTC and ETH symbol scopes cannot load each other's auxiliary data;
+- quarterly futures and options trading remain unavailable.
+
+Passing this foundation proves accounting and data-contract correctness only.
+It is not Alpha, OOS or promotion evidence.

+# Legacy Accounting Integrity Repair Design
+
+## Status
+
+Proposed P0 correction as of 2026-08-23. This repair must be accepted and
+completed before old parameter sets are compared, retrained or promoted.
+
+## Problem
+
+The legacy portfolio ledger permits negative cash after a leveraged purchase,
+but fee application currently floors cash at zero:
+
+```text
+cash_after_fee = max(0, cash_before_fee - fee)
+```
+
+Whenever `cash_before_fee - fee < 0`, this erases some or all of the financing
+liability and creates equity. The defect is path-dependent and is amplified by
+leverage and compounding. Consequently, historical equity, return, Sharpe,
+drawdown and equity-multiple claims produced by this ledger require explicit
+validity classification before they can be used as performance evidence.
+
+This is an accounting defect, not a strategy-policy change. In a fixed-event
+ledger replay it changes only cash, equity and their derived metrics. In a full
+system rerun, corrected equity, drawdown and risk state may legitimately change
+subsequent targets, orders and fills; those downstream differences must be
+attributed rather than suppressed.
+
+## Accounting Contract
+
+Cash is a signed balance. Fees are always an expense and may make cash more
+negative:
+
+```text
+cash_after_fill = cash_before_fill - signed_quantity * fill_price
+cash_after_fee  = cash_after_fill - fee
+equity          = cash + sum(position_quantity * mark_price)
+```
+
+Events have an explicit order. With the mark held constant, a fill must satisfy:
+
+```text
+cash_after  = cash_before - delta_quantity * fill_price - fee
+equity_delta = delta_quantity * (mark_price - fill_price) - fee
+```
+
+A mark event with no fill satisfies
+`equity_delta = position_before * delta_mark`. External cash flow is added
+exactly once as cash. Funding and financing are not integrated into legacy
+equity today and are explicitly out of scope for this repair; their diagnostic
+accumulators must not be represented as portfolio-equity parity.
+
+Fees must be finite, non-negative and applied exactly once. Invalid fees fail
+closed; they are never clamped, ignored or converted into an account credit.
+Short-sale proceeds, realized PnL and signed positions remain governed by the
+same identity.
+
+## Repair Boundary
+
+The minimum code change removes the zero floor from legacy fee application and
+adds explicit validation. The repair also introduces invariant checks at the
+portfolio-ledger boundary so the same class of defect cannot silently return.
+
+The following are intentionally deferred:
+
+- exchange-specific margin liquidation;
+- borrowing limits and interest models;
+- carry-strategy financing semantics;
+- changes to Alpha, risk sizing or execution policy;
+- retroactive mutation of frozen raw artifacts.
+
+Those are separate models. Their absence cannot justify breaking cash and
+equity conservation.
+
+## Historical Result Validity
+
+Affected artifacts are preserved for audit, not deleted or silently rewritten.
+Validity is assigned at metric-family and stage granularity using these states:
+
+```text
+CONFIRMED_AFFECTED     clamp condition occurred in the event path
+UNVERIFIED_LEGACY     event-level evidence is insufficient; cannot promote
+PROVEN_UNAFFECTED     fixed-event audit proves the clamp never bound
+SUPERSEDED_REPAIRED   a corrected frozen-input rerun exists
+```
+
+The mechanical clamp condition is `cash_before_fee - fee < 0`. Confirmed and
+unverified legacy metric families cannot enter promotion. At minimum, the audit
+covers return, net PnL, equity multiple, Sharpe, Sortino, drawdown and any gate
+derived from them. Parameter identity and raw market data remain valid if their
+hashes verify. Strategy decisions, orders and fills remain descriptions of the
+old event path, but are not automatically canonical repaired evidence because
+risk state may have consumed defective equity.
+
+The August 2026 rank1 train diagnostic is explicitly invalidated. It was also
+never an accepted candidate: test was not evaluated, no frozen candidate ID
+was issued and handoff readiness was false.
+
+A machine-readable validity manifest records:
+
+- artifact identity and content hash;
+- ledger implementation/formula hash;
+- validity state and mechanical reason;
+- affected metric families and stages;
+- superseding rerun identity, when available;
+- timestamp and approving decision.
+
+Reports and campaign loaders must display or fail on invalidated performance
+evidence instead of presenting it as comparable to repaired results.
+
+## V2 Isolation
+
+The frozen V2 stage ledger uses fixed notional and its own fee accounting, but
+some stages can still consume legacy `RiskSnapshot` safety state. No A1-A5
+stage is presumed valid. A provenance audit must rebuild the legacy risk donor
+and compare, per stage, the input-row hash, safety flags, approved exposure,
+filled exposure and PnL.
+
+A stage is `PROVEN_UNAFFECTED` only when its extracted stage payload remains
+field-identical after the corrected risk donor is substituted. The comparison
+excludes the artifact-level validity envelope and unrelated A0 fields. Any
+stage whose output changes is `CONFIRMED_AFFECTED` and must be regenerated.
+A0 episode output may describe the frozen old fill path, but cannot become
+canonical promotion evidence without a repaired full-system rerun.
+
+## Replay and Runtime Parity
+
+Backtest, replay and paper/live adapters must call the same corrected portfolio
+accounting kernel for equivalent fill, fee and mark events. No adapter may
+repair the number downstream or use a private cash floor. Legacy funding and
+financing remain `OUT_OF_SCOPE_NOT_EQUITY_INTEGRATED` until a separately
+approved accounting design integrates them.
+
+Existing golden output is expected to change where it encoded defective
+performance. The golden must not be updated as a mechanical test fix. The
+review record must first show:
+
+1. a fixed-event replay showing identical fills, marks and charged fees with
+   only cash, equity and derived metrics changing;
+2. corrected event-level conservation identities;
+3. a full-system rerun that attributes any risk-state, target, order and fill
+   divergence after the first affected fee;
+4. explicit product-owner acceptance of the new golden.
+
+## Required Tests
+
+- leveraged long purchase leaves cash negative and a fee reduces equity by the
+  exact fee amount;
+- short open, cover and long/short round trips conserve equity;
+- partial fills and multiple fees apply each fee exactly once;
+- multi-symbol marking sums signed position values correctly;
+- zero-fee behavior is unchanged;
+- fees smaller than, equal to and larger than positive cash, plus fees applied
+  while cash is already negative, obey the signed-cash contract;
+- invalid, negative or non-finite fees fail closed atomically without mutating
+  cash, equity or risk state;
+- cash/equity and episode ledgers reconcile fill gross PnL plus fees, explicitly
+  excluding funding and financing from the comparison;
+- high-water mark and drawdown are derived from corrected equity;
+- backtest, replay and paper/live fill/fee/mark accounting parity holds for one
+  shared event stream;
+- fixed-event ledger replay and full-system rerun have separate assertions;
+- mutating legacy `RiskSnapshot` drawdown, flags or reduce-only state proves
+  that every dependent V2 stage is classified as affected;
+- extracted V2 stage payloads remain field-identical only when proven
+  independent, while the mixed-validity artifact receives a new envelope;
+- a mixed-validity loader blocks only affected or unverified metric families
+  and stages;
+- the historical validity manifest prevents invalidated metrics from entering
+  training comparison or promotion gates.
+
+## Rerun Order
+
+After the repair passes focused and full gates:
+
+1. register affected historical artifacts as invalidated;
+2. rerun the canonical legacy baseline with frozen data, costs and parameters;
+3. rerun only historically important candidate parameter sets, without search;
+4. publish fixed-event and full-system old-versus-corrected attribution at
+   risk-state, order, fill, fee and equity levels;
+5. proceed to donor retirement and new-donor experiments using only repaired
+   performance evidence.
+
+The rerun is diagnosis, not an opportunity to retune parameters.
+
+## Acceptance
+
+- no tested event can create equity through fee application;
+- cash/equity and episode fill gross PnL plus fees reconcile within a declared
+  numeric tolerance; episode funding is reported separately as
+  `OUT_OF_SCOPE_NOT_EQUITY_INTEGRATED` and no total-net reconciliation is
+  claimed;
+- all affected historical performance is discoverably invalidated;
+- invalidated evidence cannot pass a campaign or promotion gate;
+- August raw artifacts remain reproducible as historical event paths, but the
+  historical high-profit claim is no longer treated as valid;
+- `zenquant-check` passes, with any golden change separately reviewed and
+  approved.
