+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Export one frozen architecture replay for TimeSpace shadow registration."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import tempfile
+from collections.abc import Callable
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from zenquant.research.time_space_export import recompute_time_space_export
+from zenquant.research.time_space_replay import ReplayRequest, produce_frozen_architecture_replay
+
+_CANONICAL_REPOSITORY = "infdahai/zenQuant"
+_ROOT = Path(__file__).parents[1]
+_NAMES = (
+    "time_space_shadow_export.json",
+    "time_space_shadow_export_provenance.json",
+    "time_space_shadow_export_checkpoint.json",
+)
+_MARKER = "TIME_SPACE_EXPORT_COMPLETE.json"
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class ExportArgs:
+    execution_manifest: Path
+    hypothesis_manifest: Path
+    output_dir: Path
+    provider_run_id: str
+    as_of: str
+
+
+def export_architecture(args: ExportArgs) -> tuple[Path, ...]:
+    """Build and atomically publish the three registration inputs."""
+
+    return _export_architecture_with_producer(
+        args,
+        replay_producer=produce_frozen_architecture_replay,
+        repository_resolver=_resolve_repository,
+    )
+
+
+def _export_architecture_with_producer(
+    args: ExportArgs,
+    *,
+    replay_producer,
+    repository_resolver: Callable[[], tuple[str, str]],
+) -> tuple[Path, ...]:
+    """Library seam for deterministic tests; the production CLI has no injector."""
+
+    if type(args) is not ExportArgs:
+        raise TypeError("args must be ExportArgs")
+    output_dir = Path(args.output_dir)
+    if output_dir.exists() or output_dir.is_symlink():
+        raise FileExistsError("output directory already exists")
+    repository_identity, commit_sha = repository_resolver()
+    bundle = recompute_time_space_export(
+        ReplayRequest(
+            execution_manifest=Path(args.execution_manifest),
+            hypothesis_manifest=Path(args.hypothesis_manifest),
+            as_of_ns=_parse_as_of(args.as_of),
+        ),
+        repository_identity=repository_identity,
+        commit_sha=commit_sha,
+        provider_run_id=args.provider_run_id,
+        replay_producer=replay_producer,
+    )
+    payloads = (bundle.export, bundle.provenance, bundle.checkpoint)
+    output_dir.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    lock_path = output_dir.parent / f".{output_dir.name}.publish.lock"
+    lock_descriptor = os.open(lock_path, os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_WRONLY, 0o600)
+    staging: Path | None = None
+    try:
+        staging = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=f".{output_dir.name}.staging-", dir=output_dir.parent))
+        staging_paths = tuple(staging / name for name in _NAMES)
+        hashes = {}
+        for path, payload in zip(staging_paths, payloads, strict=True):
+            with path.open("xb") as handle:
+                content = _canonical_bytes(payload)
+                handle.write(content)
+                handle.flush()
+                os.fsync(handle.fileno())
+                hashes[path.name] = hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()
+        marker = {
+            "schema_version": "time-space-export-complete.v1",
+            "layer": "time_space_shadow",
+            "artifacts": hashes,
+        }
+        marker_path = staging / _MARKER
+        with marker_path.open("xb") as handle:
+            handle.write(_canonical_bytes(marker))
+            handle.flush()
+            os.fsync(handle.fileno())
+        _fsync(staging)
+        if output_dir.exists() or output_dir.is_symlink():
+            raise FileExistsError("output directory already exists")
+        staging.rename(output_dir)
+        _fsync(output_dir.parent)
+    except Exception:
+        if staging is not None:
+            shutil.rmtree(staging, ignore_errors=True)
+        raise
+    finally:
+        os.close(lock_descriptor)
+        lock_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
+        _fsync(output_dir.parent)
+    result = tuple(output_dir / name for name in _NAMES)
+    _validate_complete_export(output_dir)
+    return result
+
+
+def _validate_complete_export(output_dir: Path) -> None:
+    if output_dir.is_symlink() or not output_dir.is_dir():
+        raise ValueError("export directory is not a completed regular directory")
+    expected_names = {*_NAMES, _MARKER}
+    if {path.name for path in output_dir.iterdir()} != expected_names:
+        raise ValueError("export directory is incomplete or contains uncommitted files")
+    marker = json.loads((output_dir / _MARKER).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    if set(marker) != {"schema_version", "layer", "artifacts"}:
+        raise ValueError("export completion marker schema changed")
+    if marker["schema_version"] != "time-space-export-complete.v1" or marker["layer"] != "time_space_shadow":
+        raise ValueError("export completion marker identity changed")
+    if set(marker["artifacts"]) != set(_NAMES):
+        raise ValueError("export completion marker artifact set changed")
+    for name in _NAMES:
+        path = output_dir / name
+        if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file() or _sha256_file(path) != marker["artifacts"][name]:
+            raise ValueError(f"export artifact failed completion validation: {name}")
+
+
+def _resolve_repository() -> tuple[str, str]:
+    commit = _git("rev-parse", "HEAD")
+    status = _git("status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=no")
+    if status:
+        raise ValueError("repository tracked workspace must be clean before export")
+    trust_path = _ROOT / "config/research/time_space_export_registration_trust_v1.json"
+    try:
+        trust = json.loads(trust_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    except (OSError, UnicodeError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
+        raise ValueError("export registration trust root is unavailable") from exc
+    if not isinstance(trust, dict) or not isinstance(trust.get("remote_identity"), str):
+        raise ValueError("export registration trust root has no repository identity")
+    remote = _git("remote", "get-url", "origin")
+    repository = _normalize_remote(remote)
+    if repository != _CANONICAL_REPOSITORY or trust["remote_identity"] != _CANONICAL_REPOSITORY:
+        raise ValueError("origin and trust root must match the canonical repository")
+    return repository, commit
+
+
+def _git(*args: str) -> str:
+    completed = subprocess.run(
+        ["git", *args],
+        cwd=_ROOT,
+        check=True,
+        capture_output=True,
+        text=True,
+    )
+    return completed.stdout.strip()
+
+
+def _normalize_remote(remote: str) -> str:
+    value = remote.removesuffix(".git")
+    if value.startswith("git@github.com:"):
+        value = value.removeprefix("git@github.com:")
+    elif value.startswith("https://github.com/"):
+        value = value.removeprefix("https://github.com/")
+    else:
+        raise ValueError("registration export requires a canonical GitHub remote")
+    if value.count("/") != 1 or not all(value.split("/")):
+        raise ValueError("registration export repository identity is invalid")
+    return value
+
+
+def _canonical_bytes(payload: object) -> bytes:
+    return (json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
+
+
+def _fsync(path: Path) -> None:
+    try:
+        descriptor = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY)
+    except OSError:
+        return
+    try:
+        os.fsync(descriptor)
+    finally:
+        os.close(descriptor)
+
+
+def _sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as handle:
+        for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
+            digest.update(chunk)
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def _parse_args() -> ExportArgs:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--execution-manifest", required=True, type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--hypothesis-manifest",
+        type=Path,
+        default=Path("config/research/time_space_shadow_hypothesis_v1.json"),
+    )
+    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", required=True, type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--provider-run-id", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--as-of", required=True)
+    return ExportArgs(**vars(parser.parse_args()))
+
+
+def _parse_as_of(value: str) -> int:
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or len(value) != 20 or not value.endswith("Z"):
+        raise ValueError("as_of must be a literal canonical UTC 4h cutoff")
+    parsed = datetime.strptime(value, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ").replace(tzinfo=UTC)
+    ns = int(parsed.timestamp()) * 1_000_000_000
+    if ns % (4 * 60 * 60 * 1_000_000_000):
+        raise ValueError("as_of must be a literal canonical UTC 4h cutoff")
+    return ns
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    for path in export_architecture(_parse_args()):
+        print(path)
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+class InputFreezeError(ValueError):
+    """Raised when a required research input cannot be frozen safely."""

+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class FreezeInputs:
+    """Explicit paths and immutable cutoffs required for one execution manifest."""
+
+    hypothesis_path: Path
+    spot_1d_path: Path
+    spot_raw_paths: tuple[Path, ...]

+    funding_path: Path | None

+    funding_source_path: Path
+    market_tail_provenance_path: Path
+    reused_start_ns: int
+    reused_end_ns: int
+    repository_root: Path
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        object.__setattr__(self, "hypothesis_path", Path(self.hypothesis_path))
+        object.__setattr__(self, "spot_1d_path", Path(self.spot_1d_path))
+        object.__setattr__(self, "spot_raw_paths", tuple(Path(path) for path in self.spot_raw_paths))
+        object.__setattr__(self, "perp_5m_path", Path(self.perp_5m_path))
+        if self.funding_path is not None:
+            object.__setattr__(self, "funding_path", Path(self.funding_path))
+        object.__setattr__(self, "perp_source_path", Path(self.perp_source_path))
+        object.__setattr__(self, "funding_source_path", Path(self.funding_source_path))
+        object.__setattr__(self, "market_tail_provenance_path", Path(self.market_tail_provenance_path))
+        object.__setattr__(self, "repository_root", Path(self.repository_root).resolve())
+
+    def all_input_paths(self) -> tuple[Path, ...]:
+        """Return every file whose bytes contribute to the frozen envelope."""
+
+        paths = [
+            self.hypothesis_path,
+            self.spot_1d_path,
+            *self.spot_raw_paths,
+            self.perp_5m_path,
+        ]
+        if self.funding_path is not None:
+            paths.append(self.funding_path)
+        paths.extend((self.perp_source_path, self.funding_source_path))
+        paths.append(self.market_tail_provenance_path)
+        paths.extend(self.repository_root / relative for relative in _CONSTRUCTION_PATHS)
+        return tuple(paths)

+def build_execution_manifest(inputs: FreezeInputs) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Audit all REQUIRED inputs, bind identities, and return canonical data only."""
+
+    _validate_frozen_window(inputs)
+    before = _snapshot_inputs(inputs.all_input_paths())
+    workspace_before = _workspace_state(inputs.repository_root)
+    manifest = _load_checked_in_hypothesis(inputs)
+
+    audits = {
+        "BINANCE_SPOT_BTCUSDT_1D": _audit_spot(inputs),
+        "BINANCE_PERPETUAL_BTCUSDT_5M": _audit_regular_parquet(
+            inputs.perp_5m_path,
+            source_id="BINANCE_PERPETUAL_BTCUSDT_5M",
+            timestamp_column="open_time_ns",
+            interval_ns=FIVE_MINUTES_NS,
+            start_ns=inputs.reused_start_ns,
+            end_ns=inputs.reused_end_ns,
+            cutoff_column="close_time_ns",
+            value_columns=("open", "high", "low", "close", "volume"),
+            value_contract="PERPETUAL_OHLCV",
+        ),
+        "BINANCE_PERPETUAL_BTCUSDT_FUNDING": _audit_regular_parquet(
+            inputs.funding_path,
+            source_id="BINANCE_PERPETUAL_BTCUSDT_FUNDING",
+            timestamp_column="funding_time_ns",
+            interval_ns=EIGHT_HOURS_NS,
+            start_ns=inputs.reused_start_ns,
+            end_ns=inputs.reused_end_ns,
+            cutoff_column="funding_time_ns",
+            value_columns=("funding_rate",),
+            value_contract="FUNDING_RATE",
+        ),
+    }
+    blockers = sorted(source_id for source_id, audit in audits.items() if audit["status"] != "READY")
+    if blockers:
+        raise InputFreezeError(f"REQUIRED sources not ready: {blockers}")
+    if before != _snapshot_inputs(inputs.all_input_paths()):
+        raise InputFreezeError("input mutated during freeze")
+
+    market_tail_provenance = _validate_market_tail_provenance(inputs)
+    for source_id in ("BINANCE_PERPETUAL_BTCUSDT_5M", "BINANCE_PERPETUAL_BTCUSDT_FUNDING"):
+        audits[source_id]["market_tail_provenance"] = market_tail_provenance
+
+    sources = {key: audits[key] for key in sorted(audits)}
+    construction_identity = _construction_identity(inputs.repository_root)
+    try:
+        accounting_kernel = build_accounting_kernel_identity(repository_root=inputs.repository_root)
+    except ValueError as exc:
+        raise InputFreezeError(f"accounting kernel identity is unavailable: {exc}") from exc
+    payload: dict[str, Any] = {
+        "schema_version": "trend-research-execution-manifest.v1",
+        "layer": manifest.layer,
+        "hypothesis_sha256": manifest.sha256,
+        "formula_sha256": _prefixed_digest(_formula_payload(manifest)),
+        "config_sha256": f"sha256:{manifest.sha256}",
+        "reused_window": [inputs.reused_start_ns, inputs.reused_end_ns],
+        "fixed_end_cutoff_ns": inputs.reused_end_ns,
+        "sources": sources,
+        "source_set_sha256": _prefixed_digest(sources),
+        "accounting_kernel": accounting_kernel,
+        "construction_identity": construction_identity,
+        "forward_checkpoint_rule": "later_trusted_receipt_plus_24h_ceil_confirmed_4h",
+        "workspace_state": workspace_before,
+    }
+    try:
+        validate_execution_manifest_payload(payload)
+    except ValueError as exc:
+        raise InputFreezeError(f"execution manifest contract violation: {exc}") from exc
+    forbidden = _FORBIDDEN_EXECUTION_KEYS.intersection(_all_keys(payload))
+    if forbidden:
+        raise InputFreezeError(f"execution manifest contains forbidden result fields: {sorted(forbidden)}")
+
+    after = _snapshot_inputs(inputs.all_input_paths())
+    if before != after:
+        changed = sorted(str(path) for path in before.keys() | after.keys() if before.get(path) != after.get(path))
+        raise InputFreezeError(f"input mutated during freeze: {changed}")
+    if workspace_before != _workspace_state(inputs.repository_root):
+        raise InputFreezeError("workspace state mutated during freeze")
+    if market_tail_provenance != _validate_market_tail_provenance(inputs):
+        raise InputFreezeError("market-tail provenance mutated during freeze")
+    return payload

+def _validate_frozen_window(inputs: FreezeInputs) -> None:
+    if (inputs.reused_start_ns, inputs.reused_end_ns) != (REUSED_START_NS, REUSED_END_NS):
+        raise InputFreezeError("reused window must match the exact frozen hypothesis window")
+

+def _load_checked_in_hypothesis(inputs: FreezeInputs) -> HypothesisManifest:
+    expected_directory = (inputs.repository_root / "config/research").resolve()
+    path = inputs.hypothesis_path.resolve()
+    if path.parent != expected_directory or path.name not in _HYPOTHESIS_FILES:
+        raise InputFreezeError("hypothesis must be one of the checked-in frozen manifests")
+    try:
+        manifest = load_hypothesis_manifest(path)
+    except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
+        raise InputFreezeError(f"hypothesis identity is invalid: {exc}") from exc
+    if (manifest.reused_start_ns, manifest.reused_end_ns) != (
+        inputs.reused_start_ns,
+        inputs.reused_end_ns,
+    ):
+        raise InputFreezeError("hypothesis reused window differs from freeze inputs")
+    requirements = tuple(
+        (str(item["id"]), str(item["requirement"]), str(item["fallback"])) for item in manifest.source_requirements
+    )
+    expected = tuple((source_id, "REQUIRED", "NONE") for source_id in REQUIRED_SOURCE_IDS)
+    if requirements != expected:
+        raise InputFreezeError("hypothesis source contract is not the exact REQUIRED/NONE set")
+    if manifest.layer != _HYPOTHESIS_LAYERS[path.name]:
+        raise InputFreezeError("hypothesis filename does not match its frozen layer")
+    return manifest

+def _audit_spot(inputs: FreezeInputs) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    source_id = "BINANCE_SPOT_BTCUSDT_1D"
+    if not inputs.spot_raw_paths:
+        return _not_ready(source_id, "missing raw spot archives")
+    try:
+        raw_sha256 = [
+            {"path": str(path), "sha256": _sha256_file(path)}
+            for path in sorted(inputs.spot_raw_paths, key=lambda item: str(item))
+        ]
+        if any(path.stat().st_size <= 0 for path in inputs.spot_raw_paths):
+            return _not_ready(source_id, "empty raw spot archive")
+        warmup_start_ns = inputs.reused_start_ns - 85 * 86_400_000_000_000
+        complete_audit = audit_spot_daily(inputs.spot_1d_path, warmup_start_ns, inputs.reused_end_ns)
+        warmup_audit = audit_spot_daily(inputs.spot_1d_path, warmup_start_ns, inputs.reused_start_ns)
+        diagnostic_audit = audit_spot_daily(
+            inputs.spot_1d_path,
+            inputs.reused_start_ns,
+            inputs.reused_end_ns,
+        )
+        spot_frame = pd.read_parquet(
+            inputs.spot_1d_path,
+            columns=["open_time_ns", "close_time_ns", "close"],
+        )
+        if not pd.api.types.is_integer_dtype(spot_frame["open_time_ns"].dtype):
+            return _not_ready(source_id, "spot open_time_ns must use an integer nanosecond dtype")
+        spot_times = spot_frame["open_time_ns"]
+        pre_start_count = int((spot_times < warmup_start_ns).sum())
+        post_end_count = int((spot_times >= inputs.reused_end_ns).sum())
+        required = spot_frame[(spot_times >= warmup_start_ns) & (spot_times < inputs.reused_end_ns)]
+        closes = pd.to_numeric(required["close"], errors="coerce")
+        valid_closes = bool(closes.notna().all()) and all(
+            math.isfinite(float(value)) and float(value) > 0 for value in closes
+        )
+        warmup_count = int(((spot_times >= warmup_start_ns) & (spot_times < inputs.reused_start_ns)).sum())
+        diagnostic_count = int(((spot_times >= inputs.reused_start_ns) & (spot_times < inputs.reused_end_ns)).sum())
+        diagnostic_rows = spot_frame[(spot_times >= inputs.reused_start_ns) & (spot_times < inputs.reused_end_ns)]
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="trend-spot-lineage-") as temporary_directory:
+            reconstructed_path = Path(temporary_directory) / "data.parquet"
+            reconstructed = normalize_spot_daily_csvs(
+                inputs.spot_raw_paths,
+                reconstructed_path,
+                start_open_ns=warmup_start_ns,
+                end_open_ns=inputs.reused_end_ns,
+            )
+            reconstructed_frame = pd.read_parquet(reconstructed_path)
+            supplied_frame = pd.read_parquet(inputs.spot_1d_path)
+            content_matches = reconstructed_frame.equals(supplied_frame)
+            identity_matches = reconstructed.normalized_sha256 == _sha256_file(inputs.spot_1d_path)
+        normalizer_path = inputs.repository_root / "zenquant/data/spot_daily.py"
+        ready = (
+            complete_audit.status == "READY"
+            and warmup_audit.status == "READY"
+            and diagnostic_audit.status == "READY"
+            and complete_audit.last_close_ns == inputs.reused_end_ns - 1
+            and warmup_count == 85
+            and valid_closes
+            and pre_start_count == 0
+            and post_end_count == 0
+            and content_matches
+            and identity_matches
+        )
+        return {
+            "requirement": "REQUIRED",
+            "fallback": "NONE",
+            "status": "READY" if ready else "INSUFFICIENT_DATA_SPOT_CONTRACT",
+            "raw_sha256": raw_sha256,
+            "normalizer_identity": {
+                "callable": "zenquant.data.spot_daily.normalize_spot_daily_csvs",
+                "sha256": _sha256_file(normalizer_path),
+            },
+            "normalized_path": str(inputs.spot_1d_path),
+            "normalized_sha256": complete_audit.sha256,
+            "last_cutoff_ns": complete_audit.last_close_ns,
+            "lineage": {
+                "status": "VERIFIED" if content_matches and identity_matches else "MISMATCH",
+                "reconstructed_sha256": reconstructed.normalized_sha256,
+            },
+            "warmup": {
+                "start_ns": warmup_start_ns,
+                "end_ns": inputs.reused_start_ns,
+                "required_closes": 85,
+                "observed_closes": warmup_count,
+                "status": ("READY" if warmup_audit.status == "READY" and warmup_count == 85 else "INSUFFICIENT_DATA"),
+            },
+            "coverage": {
+                "start_ns": inputs.reused_start_ns,
+                "end_ns": inputs.reused_end_ns,
+                "first_open_ns": int(diagnostic_rows["open_time_ns"].min()),
+                "last_close_ns": int(diagnostic_rows["close_time_ns"].max()),
+                "row_count": diagnostic_count,
+                "missing_count": len(diagnostic_audit.missing_open_ns),
+                "duplicate_count": len(diagnostic_audit.duplicate_open_ns),
+                "pre_start_count": pre_start_count,
+                "post_end_count": post_end_count,
+            },
+        }
+    except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
+        return _not_ready(source_id, str(exc))
+

+def _audit_regular_parquet(
+    path: Path | None,
+    *,
+    source_id: str,
+    timestamp_column: str,
+    interval_ns: int,
+    start_ns: int,
+    end_ns: int,
+    cutoff_column: str,
+    value_columns: tuple[str, ...],
+    value_contract: str,
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    if path is None:
+        return _not_ready(source_id, "missing path")
+    try:
+        digest = _sha256_file(path)
+        frame = pd.read_parquet(
+            path,
+            columns=sorted({timestamp_column, cutoff_column, *value_columns}),
+        )
+        if frame.empty:
+            return _not_ready(source_id, "empty parquet")
+        if not pd.api.types.is_integer_dtype(frame[timestamp_column].dtype) or not pd.api.types.is_integer_dtype(
+            frame[cutoff_column].dtype
+        ):
+            return _not_ready(source_id, "timestamps must use an integer nanosecond dtype")
+        timestamps = pd.to_numeric(frame[timestamp_column], errors="coerce")
+        cutoffs = pd.to_numeric(frame[cutoff_column], errors="coerce")
+        if timestamps.isna().any() or cutoffs.isna().any():
+            return _not_ready(source_id, "non-numeric timestamp")
+        observed_all = tuple(int(value) for value in timestamps)
+        observed_window = tuple(value for value in observed_all if start_ns <= value < end_ns)
+        counts = pd.Series(observed_all, dtype="int64").value_counts()
+        duplicate_count = int((counts - 1).clip(lower=0).sum())
+        expected = set(range(start_ns, end_ns, interval_ns))
+        missing_count = len(expected.difference(observed_window))
+        off_grid_count = sum((value - start_ns) % interval_ns != 0 for value in observed_all)
+        post_end_count = sum(value >= end_ns for value in observed_all)
+        pre_start_count = sum(value < start_ns for value in observed_all)
+        expected_row_count = (end_ns - start_ns) // interval_ns
+        invalid_cutoff_count = 0
+        if cutoff_column != timestamp_column:
+            valid_deltas = {interval_ns - 1, interval_ns - 1_000_000}
+            invalid_cutoff_count = sum(
+                int(cutoff) - int(timestamp) not in valid_deltas
+                for timestamp, cutoff in zip(timestamps, cutoffs, strict=True)
+            )
+        values_ready, invalid_value_count = _validate_source_values(frame, value_contract)
+        ready = (
+            missing_count == 0
+            and duplicate_count == 0
+            and off_grid_count == 0
+            and post_end_count == 0
+            and pre_start_count == 0
+            and len(frame) == expected_row_count
+            and invalid_cutoff_count == 0
+            and values_ready
+        )
+        return {
+            "requirement": "REQUIRED",
+            "fallback": "NONE",
+            "status": "READY" if ready else "INSUFFICIENT_DATA_GRID_GAPS",
+            "path": str(path),
+            "sha256": digest,
+            "last_cutoff_ns": int(cutoffs.max()),
+            "coverage": {
+                "first_event_ns": min(observed_all),
+                "last_event_ns": max(observed_all),
+                "row_count": len(frame),
+                "expected_row_count": expected_row_count,
+                "window_row_count": len(observed_window),
+                "missing_count": missing_count,
+                "duplicate_count": duplicate_count,
+                "off_grid_count": off_grid_count,
+                "post_end_count": post_end_count,
+                "pre_start_count": pre_start_count,
+                "invalid_cutoff_count": invalid_cutoff_count,
+                "invalid_value_count": invalid_value_count,
+            },
+        }
+    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError) as exc:
+        return _not_ready(source_id, str(exc))
+
+
+def _validate_market_tail_provenance(inputs: FreezeInputs) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    path = inputs.market_tail_provenance_path
+    try:
+        digest = _sha256_file(path)
+        payload = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
+            raise ValueError("root must be an object")
+        if payload.get("schema_version") != "trend-market-tail-provenance.v1":
+            raise ValueError("schema_version mismatch")
+        if payload.get("symbol") != "BTCUSDT":
+            raise ValueError("symbol mismatch")
+        if payload.get("window") != [inputs.reused_start_ns, inputs.reused_end_ns]:
+            raise ValueError("window mismatch")
+        output_paths = {PERP_SOURCE_ID: inputs.perp_5m_path, FUNDING_SOURCE_ID: inputs.funding_path}
+        source_paths = {PERP_SOURCE_ID: inputs.perp_source_path, FUNDING_SOURCE_ID: inputs.funding_source_path}
+        outputs = payload.get("outputs")
+        sources = payload.get("sources")
+        if not isinstance(outputs, dict) or set(outputs) != set(output_paths):
+            raise ValueError("output source IDs mismatch")
+        if not isinstance(sources, dict) or set(sources) != set(source_paths):
+            raise ValueError("canonical source IDs mismatch")
+        expected_counts = {
+            PERP_SOURCE_ID: (inputs.reused_end_ns - inputs.reused_start_ns) // FIVE_MINUTES_NS,
+            FUNDING_SOURCE_ID: (inputs.reused_end_ns - inputs.reused_start_ns) // EIGHT_HOURS_NS,
+        }
+        expected_columns = {PERP_SOURCE_ID: list(PERP_COLUMNS), FUNDING_SOURCE_ID: list(FUNDING_COLUMNS)}
+        for source_id, supplied_path in output_paths.items():
+            if supplied_path is None:
+                raise ValueError(f"missing output for {source_id}")
+            output = outputs[source_id]
+            if not isinstance(output, dict):
+                raise ValueError(f"invalid output envelope for {source_id}")
+            if (
+                output.get("path") != str(supplied_path)
+                or Path(str(output.get("path"))).resolve() != supplied_path.resolve()
+            ):
+                raise ValueError(f"output path mismatch for {source_id}")
+            if output.get("sha256") != _sha256_file(supplied_path):
+                raise ValueError(f"output digest mismatch for {source_id}")
+            actual_row_count = len(pd.read_parquet(supplied_path))
+            if (
+                output.get("row_count") != actual_row_count
+                or output.get("expected_row_count") != expected_counts[source_id]
+                or actual_row_count != expected_counts[source_id]
+                or output.get("columns") != expected_columns[source_id]
+            ):
+                raise ValueError(f"invalid output row count for {source_id}")
+        for source_id, source_path in source_paths.items():
+            source = sources[source_id]
+            if not isinstance(source, dict):
+                raise ValueError(f"invalid canonical source envelope for {source_id}")
+            if source.get("path") != str(source_path) or source.get("resolved_path") != str(source_path.resolve()):
+                raise ValueError(f"canonical source path mismatch for {source_id}")
+            if source.get("sha256") != _sha256_file(source_path):
+                raise ValueError(f"canonical source digest mismatch for {source_id}")
+        normalizer = payload.get("normalizer")
+        repository = payload.get("repository")
+        if not isinstance(normalizer, dict) or not _is_sha256(normalizer.get("sha256")):
+            raise ValueError("normalizer identity mismatch")
+        expected_normalizer_sha = _sha256_file(inputs.repository_root / "zenquant/data/trend_market_tail.py")
+        if (
+            normalizer.get("callable") != "zenquant.data.trend_market_tail.prepare_market_tail"
+            or normalizer.get("sha256") != expected_normalizer_sha
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("normalizer identity mismatch")
+        current_head = subprocess.run(
+            ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
+            cwd=inputs.repository_root,
+            check=True,
+            capture_output=True,
+            text=True,
+        ).stdout.strip()
+        if (
+            not isinstance(repository, dict)
+            or not _is_git_sha(repository.get("head"))
+            or repository.get("head") != current_head
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("repository identity mismatch")
+        replay_inputs = MarketTailInputs(
+            perp_source_path=inputs.perp_source_path,
+            funding_source_path=inputs.funding_source_path,
+            output_root=inputs.perp_5m_path.parent.parent,
+            start_ns=inputs.reused_start_ns,
+            end_ns=inputs.reused_end_ns,
+            repository_root=inputs.repository_root,
+        )
+        replayed = replay_market_tail_provenance(payload, replay_inputs)
+        pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(
+            replayed[PERP_SOURCE_ID], pd.read_parquet(inputs.perp_5m_path), check_dtype=True, check_like=False
+        )
+        pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(
+            replayed[FUNDING_SOURCE_ID], pd.read_parquet(inputs.funding_path), check_dtype=True, check_like=False
+        )
+    except (AssertionError, MarketTailError, OSError, ValueError, TypeError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
+        raise InputFreezeError(f"market-tail provenance is invalid: {exc}") from exc
+    return {
+        "path": str(path),
+        "sha256": digest,
+        "schema_version": payload["schema_version"],
+        "normalizer": payload["normalizer"],
+        "repository": payload["repository"],
+    }
+
+
+def _is_sha256(value: object) -> bool:
+    return isinstance(value, str) and len(value) == 64 and all(character in "0123456789abcdef" for character in value)
+
+
+def _is_git_sha(value: object) -> bool:
+    return (
+        isinstance(value, str)
+        and len(value) in {40, 64}
+        and all(character in "0123456789abcdef" for character in value)
+    )
+
+
+def _validate_source_values(frame: pd.DataFrame, contract: str) -> tuple[bool, int]:
+    if contract == "FUNDING_RATE":
+        rates = pd.to_numeric(frame["funding_rate"], errors="coerce")
+        invalid = sum(not math.isfinite(float(value)) for value in rates)
+        return invalid == 0, invalid
+    if contract != "PERPETUAL_OHLCV":
+        raise InputFreezeError(f"unknown source value contract: {contract}")
+    numeric = frame[["open", "high", "low", "close", "volume"]].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce")
+    invalid = 0
+    for row in numeric.itertuples(index=False):
+        open_price, high, low, close, volume = (float(value) for value in row)
+        if (
+            not all(math.isfinite(value) for value in (open_price, high, low, close, volume))
+            or min(open_price, high, low, close) <= 0
+            or volume < 0
+            or high < max(open_price, close)
+            or low > min(open_price, close)
+            or high < low
+        ):
+            invalid += 1
+    return invalid == 0, invalid
+
+
+def _not_ready(source_id: str, reason: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    return {
+        "requirement": "REQUIRED",
+        "fallback": "NONE",
+        "status": "INSUFFICIENT_DATA",
+        "source_id": source_id,
+        "reason": reason,
+    }
+
+
+def _formula_payload(manifest: HypothesisManifest) -> Mapping[str, Any]:
+    fields = ("formula", "thresholds", "costs", "robustness", "gates", "policy", "authority")
+    return {field: _plain_json(manifest.payload[field]) for field in fields if field in manifest.payload}
+
+
+def _plain_json(value: object) -> Any:
+    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
+        return {str(key): _plain_json(item) for key, item in value.items()}
+    if isinstance(value, tuple | list):
+        return [_plain_json(item) for item in value]
+    return value
+
+
+def _prefixed_digest(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
+    return f"sha256:{canonical_sha256(payload)}"
+
+
+def _construction_identity(repository_root: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    files = [
+        {
+            "path": relative,
+            "sha256": _sha256_file(repository_root / relative),
+        }
+        for relative in _CONSTRUCTION_PATHS
+    ]
+    identity = {"files": files}
+    return {**identity, "sha256": _prefixed_digest(identity)}
+
+
+def _snapshot_inputs(paths: Sequence[Path]) -> dict[Path, str | None]:
+    identities: dict[Path, str | None] = {}
+    for path in paths:
+        resolved = Path(path).resolve()
+        try:
+            identities[resolved] = _sha256_file(resolved)
+        except OSError:
+            identities[resolved] = None
+    return identities
+
+
+def _workspace_state(repository_root: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    try:
+        head = subprocess.run(
+            ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
+            cwd=repository_root,
+            check=True,
+            capture_output=True,
+            text=True,
+        ).stdout.strip()
+        status = subprocess.run(
+            ["git", "status", "--porcelain=v1", "-z", "--untracked-files=all"],
+            cwd=repository_root,
+            check=True,
+            capture_output=True,
+        ).stdout
+    except (OSError, subprocess.CalledProcessError) as exc:
+        raise InputFreezeError("unable to bind dirty/untracked workspace state") from exc
+    entries = _parse_workspace_entries(repository_root, status)
+    identity = {"head": head, "entries": entries}
+    return {**identity, "sha256": _prefixed_digest(identity)}
+
+
+def _parse_workspace_entries(repository_root: Path, payload: bytes) -> list[dict[str, str | None]]:
+    tokens = payload.split(b"\0")
+    entries: list[dict[str, str | None]] = []
+    index = 0
+    while index < len(tokens) and tokens[index]:
+        record = tokens[index]
+        index += 1
+        if len(record) < 4 or record[2:3] != b" ":
+            raise InputFreezeError("unable to parse dirty/untracked workspace state")
+        status = record[:2].decode("ascii")
+        path = record[3:].decode("utf-8", errors="surrogateescape")
+        entry: dict[str, str | None] = {
+            "status": status,
+            "path": path,
+            "content_sha256": _workspace_content_sha256(repository_root / path),
+        }
+        if "R" in status or "C" in status:
+            if index >= len(tokens) or not tokens[index]:
+                raise InputFreezeError("unable to parse renamed workspace entry")
+            entry["original_path"] = tokens[index].decode("utf-8", errors="surrogateescape")
+            index += 1
+        entries.append(entry)
+    return sorted(entries, key=lambda item: (str(item["path"]), str(item["status"])))
+
+
+def _workspace_content_sha256(path: Path) -> str | None:
+    if path.is_symlink():
+        return hashlib.sha256(os.readlink(path).encode("utf-8", errors="surrogateescape")).hexdigest()
+    if path.is_file():
+        return _sha256_file(path)
+    if not path.exists():
+        return None
+    raise InputFreezeError(f"workspace entry is not a file: {path}")
+
+
+def _sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with Path(path).open("rb") as stream:
+        for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
+            digest.update(chunk)
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def _all_keys(value: object) -> set[str]:
+    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
+        keys = {str(key) for key in value}
+        for item in value.values():
+            keys.update(_all_keys(item))
+        return keys
+    if isinstance(value, list | tuple):
+        keys: set[str] = set()
+        for item in value:
+            keys.update(_all_keys(item))
+        return keys
+    return set()
+
+
+def _canonical_json(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
+    return (
+        json.dumps(
+            payload,
+            ensure_ascii=False,
+            allow_nan=False,
+            separators=(",", ":"),
+            sort_keys=True,
+        )
+        + "\n"
+    )
+
+
+def _publish_atomic_directory(output_dir: Path, payloads: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, Any]]) -> None:
+    output_dir = output_dir.resolve()
+    if output_dir.exists():
+        raise InputFreezeError(f"immutable output directory already exists: {output_dir}")
+    output_dir.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    staging = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=f".{output_dir.name}.", dir=output_dir.parent))
+    try:
+        for name, payload in sorted(payloads.items()):
+            (staging / name).write_text(_canonical_json(payload), encoding="utf-8")
+        os.replace(staging, output_dir)
+    finally:
+        if staging.exists():
+            shutil.rmtree(staging)
+
+
+def _validate_cli_canonical_sources(
+    repository_root: Path,
+    perp_source: Path,
+    funding_source: Path,
+) -> None:
+    """Reject substituted canonical sources before the freezer reads any bytes."""
+
+    expected_sources = {
+        PERP_SOURCE_ID: repository_root / "data/raw/binance/klines/BTCUSDT/5m/data.parquet",
+        FUNDING_SOURCE_ID: repository_root / "data/raw/binance/funding/BTCUSDT/data.parquet",
+    }
+    supplied_sources = {
+        PERP_SOURCE_ID: Path(perp_source),
+        FUNDING_SOURCE_ID: Path(funding_source),
+    }
+    for source_id, expected_path in expected_sources.items():
+        supplied_path = supplied_sources[source_id]
+        if supplied_path.is_symlink():
+            raise InputFreezeError(f"canonical source leaf may not be a symlink: {source_id}")
+        if supplied_path.resolve() != expected_path.resolve():
+            raise InputFreezeError(f"canonical source path mismatch: {source_id}")
+
+
+def _parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--spot-1d", required=True, type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--spot-raw", required=True, action="append", type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--perp-5m", required=True, type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--perp-source", required=True, type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--funding", required=True, type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--funding-source", required=True, type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--market-tail-provenance", required=True, type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--time-space-hypothesis", required=True, type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--trend-hypothesis", required=True, type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--reused-start", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--reused-end", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", required=True, type=Path)
+    return parser
+
+
+def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
+    parser = _parser()
+    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
+    if args.reused_start != FIXED_REUSED_START:
+        parser.error(f"fixed reused start must be {FIXED_REUSED_START}")
+    if args.reused_end != FIXED_REUSED_END:
+        parser.error(f"fixed reused end must be {FIXED_REUSED_END}")
+
+    repository_root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+    try:
+        _validate_cli_canonical_sources(repository_root, args.perp_source, args.funding_source)
+    except InputFreezeError as exc:
+        parser.error(str(exc))
+    common = {
+        "spot_1d_path": args.spot_1d,
+        "spot_raw_paths": tuple(args.spot_raw),
+        "perp_5m_path": args.perp_5m,
+        "funding_path": args.funding,
+        "perp_source_path": args.perp_source,
+        "funding_source_path": args.funding_source,
+        "market_tail_provenance_path": args.market_tail_provenance,
+        "reused_start_ns": REUSED_START_NS,
+        "reused_end_ns": REUSED_END_NS,
+        "repository_root": repository_root,
+    }
+    try:
+        freeze_inputs = tuple(
+            FreezeInputs(hypothesis_path=path, **common) for path in (args.time_space_hypothesis, args.trend_hypothesis)
+        )
+        all_input_paths = tuple(dict.fromkeys(path for inputs in freeze_inputs for path in inputs.all_input_paths()))
+        before = _snapshot_inputs(all_input_paths)
+        workspace_before = _workspace_state(repository_root)
+        manifests = tuple(build_execution_manifest(inputs) for inputs in freeze_inputs)
+        after = _snapshot_inputs(all_input_paths)
+        if before != after:
+            raise InputFreezeError("input mutated during multi-manifest freeze")
+        if workspace_before != _workspace_state(repository_root):
+            raise InputFreezeError("workspace mutated during multi-manifest freeze")
+        if manifests[0]["source_set_sha256"] != manifests[1]["source_set_sha256"]:
+            raise InputFreezeError("layers observed different source identities")
+        for identity_key in ("accounting_kernel", "construction_identity", "workspace_state"):
+            if manifests[0][identity_key] != manifests[1][identity_key]:
+                raise InputFreezeError(f"layers observed different {identity_key}")
+        payloads = {_OUTPUT_FILES[str(payload["layer"])]: payload for payload in manifests}
+        if set(payloads) != set(_OUTPUT_FILES.values()):
+            raise InputFreezeError("the two exact research layers are required")
+        _publish_atomic_directory(args.output_dir, payloads)
+    except InputFreezeError as exc:
+        parser.error(str(exc))
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Prepare the immutable 2026-08-24 BTC trend-research market tail."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import time
+import urllib.error
+import urllib.parse
+import urllib.request
+from collections.abc import Sequence
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any, Final
+
+from zenquant.data.trend_market_tail import MarketTailError, MarketTailInputs, prepare_market_tail
+from zenquant.research.registration import REUSED_END_NS, REUSED_START_NS
+
+FIXED_START: Final = "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"
+FIXED_END: Final = "2026-08-24T00:00:00Z"
+_BASE_URL: Final = "https://fapi.binance.com"
+
+
+def _fetch(path: str, params: dict[str, int | str]) -> list[Any]:
+    query = urllib.parse.urlencode(params)
+    request = urllib.request.Request(f"{_BASE_URL}{path}?{query}", headers={"User-Agent": "zenquant/1"})
+    payload = _request_json_with_retry(request)
+    _validate_endpoint_payload(path, payload)
+    return payload
+
+
+def _request_json_with_retry(
+    request: urllib.request.Request,
+    *,
+    urlopen=urllib.request.urlopen,
+    sleep=time.sleep,
+    max_attempts: int = 3,
+) -> list[Any]:
+    if not 0 < max_attempts <= 4:
+        raise MarketTailError("max_attempts must be in [1, 4]")
+    for attempt in range(1, max_attempts + 1):
+        try:
+            with urlopen(request, timeout=30) as response:
+                payload = json.loads(response.read())
+            if not isinstance(payload, list):
+                raise MarketTailError("Binance REST response must be a list")
+            return payload
+        except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
+            retryable = exc.code == 429 or 500 <= exc.code <= 599
+            if not retryable or attempt == max_attempts:
+                raise MarketTailError(f"Binance REST HTTP failure: {exc.code}") from exc
+        except TimeoutError as exc:
+            if attempt == max_attempts:
+                raise MarketTailError("Binance REST request exhausted retries") from exc
+        except urllib.error.URLError as exc:
+            if not isinstance(exc.reason, TimeoutError):
+                raise MarketTailError("Binance REST transport failure is not retryable") from exc
+            if attempt == max_attempts:
+                raise MarketTailError("Binance REST request exhausted retries") from exc
+        except (json.JSONDecodeError, UnicodeDecodeError) as exc:
+            raise MarketTailError("Binance REST response is not valid JSON") from exc
+        sleep(0.25 * (2 ** (attempt - 1)))
+    raise MarketTailError("Binance REST request exhausted retries")
+
+
+def _validate_endpoint_payload(path: str, payload: list[Any]) -> None:
+    if path == "/fapi/v1/klines":
+        if any(not isinstance(row, list) or len(row) < 12 for row in payload):
+            raise MarketTailError("Binance kline response contains a malformed element")
+        return
+    if path == "/fapi/v1/fundingRate":
+        if any(
+            not isinstance(row, dict)
+            or row.get("symbol") != "BTCUSDT"
+            or "fundingTime" not in row
+            or "fundingRate" not in row
+            for row in payload
+        ):
+            raise MarketTailError("Binance funding response contains a malformed element")
+        return
+    raise MarketTailError(f"unsupported Binance REST endpoint: {path}")
+
+
+def _fetch_perp(start_ms: int, end_ms: int, limit: int) -> list[Any]:
+    return _fetch(
+        "/fapi/v1/klines",
+        {
+            "symbol": "BTCUSDT",
+            "interval": "5m",
+            "startTime": start_ms,
+            "endTime": end_ms - 1,
+            "limit": limit,
+        },
+    )
+
+
+def _fetch_funding(start_ms: int, end_ms: int, limit: int) -> list[Any]:
+    return _fetch(
+        "/fapi/v1/fundingRate",
+        {
+            "symbol": "BTCUSDT",
+            "startTime": start_ms,
+            "endTime": end_ms - 1,
+            "limit": limit,
+        },
+    )
+
+
+def _parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--perp-source", required=True, type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--funding-source", required=True, type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--output-root", required=True, type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--start", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--end", required=True)
+    return parser
+
+
+def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
+    parser = _parser()
+    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
+    if args.start != FIXED_START:
+        parser.error(f"fixed start must be {FIXED_START}")
+    if args.end != FIXED_END:
+        parser.error(f"fixed end must be {FIXED_END}")
+    repository_root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+    expected_paths = {
+        "perpetual": repository_root / "data/raw/binance/klines/BTCUSDT/5m/data.parquet",
+        "funding": repository_root / "data/raw/binance/funding/BTCUSDT/data.parquet",
+    }
+    supplied_paths = {"perpetual": args.perp_source, "funding": args.funding_source}
+    for label, supplied in supplied_paths.items():
+        if supplied.is_symlink() or supplied.resolve() != expected_paths[label].resolve():
+            parser.error(f"{label} source must be the exact canonical BTCUSDT Binance path")
+    try:
+        prepare_market_tail(
+            MarketTailInputs(
+                perp_source_path=args.perp_source,
+                funding_source_path=args.funding_source,
+                output_root=args.output_root,
+                start_ns=REUSED_START_NS,
+                end_ns=REUSED_END_NS,
+                repository_root=repository_root,
+            ),
+            fetch_perp_page=_fetch_perp,
+            fetch_funding_page=_fetch_funding,
+        )
+    except MarketTailError as exc:
+        parser.error(str(exc))
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Compare the exact Gate C fixture across two source revisions without mutation."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+import math
+import os
+import runpy
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+from dataclasses import fields, is_dataclass
+from enum import Enum
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+
+def _canonical_json(payload: Any) -> str:
+    return json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False)
+
+
+def _sha256_bytes(payload: bytes) -> str:
+    return f"sha256:{hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()}"
+
+
+def _semantic(value: Any) -> Any:
+    if is_dataclass(value) and not isinstance(value, type):
+        return {field.name: _semantic(getattr(value, field.name)) for field in fields(value)}
+    if isinstance(value, Enum):
+        return value.value
+    if isinstance(value, dict):
+        return {str(key): _semantic(item) for key, item in sorted(value.items(), key=lambda pair: str(pair[0]))}
+    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
+        return [_semantic(item) for item in value]
+    if isinstance(value, Path):
+        return str(value)
+    if isinstance(value, float) and not math.isfinite(value):
+        raise ValueError(f"non-finite semantic value: {value!r}")
+    return value
+
+
+def _accounting_state(backtest: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    overlay = backtest.risk_overlay
+    snapshots = backtest._risk_snapshots
+    return {
+        "cash": float(overlay._cash),
+        "equity": float(overlay._equity),
+        "high_water_mark": float(overlay._high_water_mark),
+        "positions": {key: float(value) for key, value in sorted(overlay._actual_positions.items())},
+        "marks": {key: float(value) for key, value in sorted(overlay._last_price.items())},
+        "latest_risk_snapshot": _semantic(snapshots[-1]) if snapshots else None,
+    }
+
+
+def _fixture_payload(namespace: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[dict[str, list[Any]], dict[str, Any]]:
+    rows = {
+        "daily": namespace["_daily_rows"](),
+        "four_hour": namespace["_four_hour_rows"](),
+        "funding": namespace["_funding_rows"](),
+        "open_interest": namespace["_open_interest_rows"](),
+    }
+    config = {
+        "symbol": "BTCUSDT",
+        "portfolio_symbol": "BTCUSDT_PERP",
+        "starting_equity": 100_000.0,
+        "execution_timeframe": "4h",
+        "bias_timeframe": "1d",
+        "direction_timeframe": "4h",
+        "profile_path": None,
+        "macro_dir": "<fixture_root>/macro",
+        "options_dir": "<fixture_root>/deribit_options",
+        "cot_path": "<fixture_root>/cftc/cot_btc.parquet",
+        "liquidation_dir": "<fixture_root>/liquidations/aggregated",
+    }
+    canonical_rows = {key: _semantic(value) for key, value in rows.items()}
+    identity_payload = {"config": config, "rows": canonical_rows}
+    return rows, {
+        "input_sha256": _sha256_bytes(_canonical_json(identity_payload).encode("utf-8")),
+        "config": config,
+        "row_counts": {key: len(value) for key, value in rows.items()},
+        "row_sha256": {
+            key: _sha256_bytes(_canonical_json(canonical_rows[key]).encode("utf-8")) for key in sorted(canonical_rows)
+        },
+    }
+
+
+def _source_revision(source_root: Path) -> str:
+    result = subprocess.run(
+        ["git", "-C", str(source_root), "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
+        check=True,
+        capture_output=True,
+        text=True,
+    )
+    return result.stdout.strip()
+
+
+def _run_worker(source_root: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    source_root = source_root.resolve()
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(source_root))
+    fixture_path = source_root / "tests" / "test_golden_output.py"
+    fixture_bytes = fixture_path.read_bytes()
+    namespace = runpy.run_path(str(fixture_path), run_name="golden_fixture_probe")
+    rows, fixture = _fixture_payload(namespace)
+    fixture["test_source_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(fixture_bytes).hexdigest()
+
+    from zenquant.historical import (
+        HistoricalBacktest,
+        HistoricalBacktestConfig,
+        HistoricalDatasetLayout,
+        write_parquet_rows,
+    )
+
+    fees: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    original_cwd = Path.cwd()
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
+        root = Path(tmp)
+        layout = HistoricalDatasetLayout(root_dir=root)
+        write_parquet_rows(layout.kline_path("BTCUSDT", "1d", "2024-01"), rows["daily"])
+        write_parquet_rows(layout.kline_path("BTCUSDT", "4h", "2024-01"), rows["four_hour"])
+        write_parquet_rows(layout.funding_path("BTCUSDT", "2024-01"), rows["funding"])
+        write_parquet_rows(
+            layout.open_interest_path("BTCUSDT", "4h", "2024-01"),
+            rows["open_interest"],
+        )
+        try:
+            os.chdir(root)
+            backtest = HistoricalBacktest(
+                HistoricalBacktestConfig(
+                    root_dir=root,
+                    symbol="BTCUSDT",
+                    macro_dir=root / "macro",
+                    options_dir=root / "deribit_options",
+                    cot_path=root / "cftc" / "cot_btc.parquet",
+                    liquidation_dir=root / "liquidations" / "aggregated",
+                    profile_path=None,
+                )
+            )
+
+            def record_fee_transition(report: Any, before: dict[str, Any], after: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+                semantic_report = _semantic(report)
+                fee = float(report.fee)
+                fees.append(
+                    {
+                        "index": len(fees),
+                        "report": semantic_report,
+                        "fee": fee,
+                        "clamp_condition": before["cash"] - fee < 0.0,
+                        "expected_signed_cash_after": before["cash"] - fee,
+                        "before": before,
+                        "after": after,
+                    }
+                )
+
+            original_apply_execution_report = getattr(backtest.risk_overlay, "apply_execution_report", None)
+            if original_apply_execution_report is not None:
+
+                def traced_apply_execution_report(report: Any) -> bool:
+                    atomic_before = _accounting_state(backtest)
+                    applied = original_apply_execution_report(report)
+                    if applied is not False:
+                        after = _accounting_state(backtest)
+                        fee = float(report.fee)
+                        equity_before_fee = after["equity"] + fee
+                        before = {
+                            **after,
+                            "cash": after["cash"] + fee,
+                            "equity": equity_before_fee,
+                            "high_water_mark": max(atomic_before["high_water_mark"], equity_before_fee),
+                        }
+                        record_fee_transition(report, before, after)
+                    return bool(applied)
+
+                backtest.risk_overlay.apply_execution_report = traced_apply_execution_report
+            else:
+                original_apply_fee = backtest.risk_overlay.apply_fee
+
+                def traced_apply_fee(fee: float) -> None:
+                    before = _accounting_state(backtest)
+                    report = backtest._reports[-1] if backtest._reports else None
+                    original_apply_fee(fee)
+                    if report is not None:
+                        record_fee_transition(report, before, _accounting_state(backtest))
+
+                backtest.risk_overlay.apply_fee = traced_apply_fee
+            result = backtest.run()
+            fixture["cwd_isolated"] = Path.cwd().resolve() == root.resolve()
+        finally:
+            os.chdir(original_cwd)
+
+    return {
+        "schema_version": "golden-accounting-source-trace.v1",
+        "source_root": str(source_root),
+        "source_revision": _source_revision(source_root),
+        "fixture": fixture,
+        "fees": fees,
+        "risk_snapshots": _semantic(backtest._risk_snapshots),
+        "targets": _semantic(backtest._targets),
+        "reports": _semantic(backtest._reports),
+        "exits": _semantic(backtest._exits),
+        "semantic_result": {
+            "metrics": _semantic(result.metrics),
+            "diagnostics": _semantic(result.diagnostics),
+            "total_indicator_packs": result.total_indicator_packs,
+            "total_targets": result.total_targets,
+            "total_reports": result.total_reports,
+            "final_equity": result.final_equity,
+            "cycle_context": _semantic(result.cycle_context),
+            "terminated_early": result.terminated_early,
+            "termination_reason": result.termination_reason,
+            "processed_event_ratio": result.processed_event_ratio,
+            "position_episodes": _semantic(result.position_episodes),
+            "decision_snapshots": _semantic(result.decision_snapshots),
+            "options_state_sidecar": _semantic(result.options_state_sidecar),
+            "options_state_links": _semantic(result.options_state_links),
+        },
+    }

+def run_source_probe(source_root: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Run one source tree in an isolated interpreter and return its trace."""
+    command = [
+        sys.executable,
+        str(Path(__file__).resolve()),
+        "--worker",
+        "--source-root",
+        str(source_root.resolve()),
+    ]
+    result = subprocess.run(command, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
+    return json.loads(result.stdout)

+
+def _first_divergence(baseline: list[Any], repaired: list[Any]) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
+    for index, (baseline_item, repaired_item) in enumerate(zip(baseline, repaired, strict=False)):
+        if baseline_item != repaired_item:
+            return {"index": index, "baseline": baseline_item, "repaired": repaired_item}
+    if len(baseline) == len(repaired):
+        return None
+    index = min(len(baseline), len(repaired))
+    return {
+        "index": index,
+        "baseline": baseline[index] if index < len(baseline) else None,
+        "repaired": repaired[index] if index < len(repaired) else None,
+    }
+
+
+def _fee_clamp_is_first_divergence(
+    baseline: dict[str, Any],
+    repaired: dict[str, Any],
+    fee_divergence: dict[str, Any] | None,
+) -> bool:
+    if baseline["fixture"] != repaired["fixture"] or fee_divergence is None:
+        return False
+    legacy_fee = fee_divergence["baseline"]
+    repaired_fee = fee_divergence["repaired"]
+    if legacy_fee is None or repaired_fee is None:
+        return False
+    if legacy_fee["report"] != repaired_fee["report"] or legacy_fee["fee"] != repaired_fee["fee"]:
+        return False
+    if legacy_fee["before"] != repaired_fee["before"]:
+        return False
+    before_cash = float(legacy_fee["before"]["cash"])
+    fee = float(legacy_fee["fee"])
+    legacy_cash_after = float(legacy_fee["after"]["cash"])
+    repaired_cash_after = float(repaired_fee["after"]["cash"])
+    return (
+        before_cash - fee < 0.0
+        and math.isclose(legacy_cash_after, max(0.0, before_cash - fee), rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=1e-9)
+        and math.isclose(repaired_cash_after, before_cash - fee, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=1e-9)
+        and not math.isclose(legacy_cash_after, repaired_cash_after, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=1e-9)
+    )
+
+
+def _divergence_time_ns(divergence: dict[str, Any] | None) -> int | None:
+    if divergence is None:
+        return None
+    for side in ("baseline", "repaired"):
+        item = divergence.get(side)
+        if not isinstance(item, dict):
+            continue
+        for field in ("transaction_time_ns", "cutoff_time_ns", "ts_ns"):
+            value = item.get(field)
+            if isinstance(value, int):
+                return value
+    return None
+
+
+def _accounting_mark_state_is_first_divergence(
+    baseline: dict[str, Any],
+    repaired: dict[str, Any],
+    fee_divergence: dict[str, Any] | None,
+    downstream_divergences: tuple[dict[str, Any] | None, ...],
+) -> bool:
+    if baseline["fixture"] != repaired["fixture"] or fee_divergence is None:
+        return False
+    legacy_fee = fee_divergence["baseline"]
+    repaired_fee = fee_divergence["repaired"]
+    if legacy_fee is None or repaired_fee is None:
+        return False
+    if legacy_fee["report"] != repaired_fee["report"] or legacy_fee["fee"] != repaired_fee["fee"]:
+        return False
+    if legacy_fee.get("clamp_condition", False) or repaired_fee.get("clamp_condition", False):
+        return False
+
+    for phase in ("before", "after"):
+        legacy_state = legacy_fee[phase]
+        repaired_state = repaired_fee[phase]
+        for stable_field in ("cash", "high_water_mark", "positions", "latest_risk_snapshot"):
+            if legacy_state.get(stable_field) != repaired_state.get(stable_field):
+                return False
+        if legacy_state.get("marks") == repaired_state.get("marks"):
+            return False
+        if legacy_state.get("equity") == repaired_state.get("equity"):
+            return False
+
+    fee_time_ns = legacy_fee["report"].get("transaction_time_ns")
+    if not isinstance(fee_time_ns, int):
+        return False
+    return all(
+        divergence_time is None or divergence_time >= fee_time_ns
+        for divergence_time in map(_divergence_time_ns, downstream_divergences)
+    )
+
+
+def compare_source_traces(baseline: dict[str, Any], repaired: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Return a compact first-divergence comparison for two source traces."""
+    fee_divergence = _first_divergence(baseline["fees"], repaired["fees"])
+    risk_divergence = _first_divergence(baseline["risk_snapshots"], repaired["risk_snapshots"])
+    target_divergence = _first_divergence(baseline["targets"], repaired["targets"])
+    report_divergence = _first_divergence(baseline["reports"], repaired["reports"])
+    exit_divergence = _first_divergence(baseline["exits"], repaired["exits"])
+    fee_clamp_first = _fee_clamp_is_first_divergence(baseline, repaired, fee_divergence)
+    accounting_mark_first = _accounting_mark_state_is_first_divergence(
+        baseline,
+        repaired,
+        fee_divergence,
+        (risk_divergence, target_divergence, report_divergence, exit_divergence),
+    )
+    if fee_clamp_first:
+        causal_verdict = "FEE_CLAMP_IS_FIRST_DIVERGENCE"
+    elif accounting_mark_first:
+        causal_verdict = "ACCOUNTING_MARK_STATE_IS_FIRST_DIVERGENCE"
+    else:
+        causal_verdict = "CAUSALITY_NOT_PROVEN"
+    return {
+        "schema_version": "golden-accounting-causal-comparison.v1",
+        "causal_verdict": causal_verdict,
+        "fixture_identity_equal": baseline["fixture"] == repaired["fixture"],
+        "baseline_revision": baseline.get("source_revision"),
+        "repaired_revision": repaired.get("source_revision"),
+        "first_fee_divergence": fee_divergence,
+        "first_risk_divergence": risk_divergence,
+        "first_target_divergence": target_divergence,
+        "first_report_divergence": report_divergence,
+        "first_exit_divergence": exit_divergence,
+        "semantic_result": {
+            "baseline": baseline["semantic_result"],
+            "repaired": repaired["semantic_result"],
+            "equal": baseline["semantic_result"] == repaired["semantic_result"],
+        },
+        "trace_counts": {
+            name: {"baseline": len(baseline[name]), "repaired": len(repaired[name])}
+            for name in ("fees", "risk_snapshots", "targets", "reports", "exits")
+        },
+    }
+
+
+def _parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--baseline-root", type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--current-root", type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--worker", action="store_true", help=argparse.SUPPRESS)
+    parser.add_argument("--source-root", type=Path, help=argparse.SUPPRESS)
+    return parser.parse_args()
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    args = _parse_args()
+    if args.worker:
+        if args.source_root is None:
+            raise SystemExit("--worker requires --source-root")
+        print(_canonical_json(_run_worker(args.source_root)))
+        return 0
+    if args.baseline_root is None or args.current_root is None or args.output is None:
+        raise SystemExit("comparison requires --baseline-root, --current-root and --output")
+    comparison = compare_source_traces(
+        run_source_probe(args.baseline_root),
+        run_source_probe(args.current_root),
+    )
+    args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    args.output.write_text(json.dumps(comparison, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    print(f"{comparison['causal_verdict']}: {args.output}")
+    proven_verdicts = {
+        "FEE_CLAMP_IS_FIRST_DIVERGENCE",
+        "ACCOUNTING_MARK_STATE_IS_FIRST_DIVERGENCE",
+    }
+    return 0 if comparison["causal_verdict"] in proven_verdicts else 1
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
