+def _run_frozen_matrix(
+    *,
+    root: Path,
+    manifest: ArchitectureExperimentManifest,
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    runs: list[Any] = []
+    expected_count = len(manifest.expected_run_keys)
+    for index, window in enumerate(manifest.windows):
+        for seed_index, seed in enumerate(manifest.seeds):
+            run_number = index * len(manifest.seeds) + seed_index + 1
+            print(
+                f"Running frozen matrix entry {run_number}/{expected_count}: window={window.label} seed={seed}",
+                flush=True,
+            )
+            runs.append(
+                run_frozen_matrix_entry(
+                    root=root,
+                    manifest=manifest,
+                    window=window,
+                    seed=seed,
+                )
+            )
+    report = build_architecture_attribution_report(
+        runs,
+        manifest=manifest,
+        fixed_notional=FIXED_NOTIONAL,
+    )
+    if not isinstance(report, dict):
+        raise ValueError("frozen architecture runner returned a non-object report")
+    return report
+
+
+def _validate_repaired_report(
+    report: Mapping[str, Any],
+    *,
+    manifest: ArchitectureExperimentManifest,
+) -> tuple[list[str], str]:
+    constraints = report.get("constraints")
+    if not isinstance(constraints, Mapping) or constraints.get("parameter_search") is not False:
+        raise ValueError("repaired report must explicitly set parameter_search=false")
+    report_manifest = report.get("manifest")
+    if not isinstance(report_manifest, Mapping):
+        raise ValueError("repaired report is missing its frozen manifest identity")
+    exact_manifest_fields = {
+        "sha256": manifest.sha256,
+        "candidate_params_sha256": manifest.candidate_params_sha256,
+        "profile_sha256": manifest.profile_sha256,
+        "windows": [
+            {
+                "label": window.label,
+                "start_ns": window.start_ns,
+                "end_ns": window.end_ns,
+                "role": window.role,
+            }
+            for window in manifest.windows
+        ],
+        "seeds": list(manifest.seeds),
+        "cost_stress_bps": list(manifest.cost_stress_bps),
+    }
+    for field, expected in exact_manifest_fields.items():
+        if report_manifest.get(field) != expected:
+            raise ValueError(f"repaired report manifest identity mismatch: {field}")
+
+    raw_runs = report.get("runs")
+    if not isinstance(raw_runs, list) or not all(isinstance(run, Mapping) for run in raw_runs):
+        raise ValueError("repaired report runs must be a list of objects")
+    observed_keys: list[tuple[str, int]] = []
+    expected_accounting_kernel_sha256 = build_accounting_kernel_identity()["sha256"]
+    for index, run in enumerate(raw_runs):
+        window = run.get("window")
+        seed = run.get("seed")
+        if not isinstance(window, str) or not window:
+            raise ValueError(f"repaired run {index} requires an exact window string")
+        if isinstance(seed, bool) or not isinstance(seed, int):
+            raise ValueError(f"repaired run {index} requires an integer seed")
+        identities = run.get("identities")
+        if (
+            not isinstance(identities, Mapping)
+            or identities.get("accounting_kernel_sha256") != expected_accounting_kernel_sha256
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("repaired run is missing or mismatches the accounting kernel identity")
+        observed_keys.append((window, seed))
+    if observed_keys != list(manifest.expected_run_keys):
+        raise ValueError("repaired report does not contain the exact frozen matrix")
+    formula_hashes = sorted({formula_hash for run in raw_runs for formula_hash in _formula_hashes_from_run(run)})
+    if formula_hashes != [EXPECTED_REPAIRED_FORMULA_HASH]:
+        raise ValueError("repaired report does not use the frozen repaired formula hash")
+    return formula_hashes, expected_accounting_kernel_sha256
+
+
+def _formula_hashes_from_run(run: Mapping[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
+    identities = run.get("identities")
+    if not isinstance(identities, Mapping):
+        raise ValueError("repaired run is missing identities")
+    value = identities.get("formula_hashes")
+    if (
+        not isinstance(value, list)
+        or len(value) != 1
+        or not isinstance(value[0], str)
+        or _SHA256_IDENTITY_PATTERN.fullmatch(value[0]) is None
+        or value[0] != EXPECTED_REPAIRED_FORMULA_HASH
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("repaired run does not contain the exact frozen repaired formula hash")
+    return value
+
+
+def _stream_stage_validity(
+    *,
+    legacy_input: Path,
+    repaired_report: Mapping[str, Any],
+    manifest: ArchitectureExperimentManifest,
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    repaired_runs = repaired_report["runs"]
+    repaired_by_key = {(str(run["window"]), int(run["seed"])): run for run in repaired_runs}
+    remaining = dict(repaired_by_key)
+    records: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    observed_legacy_keys: set[tuple[str, int]] = set()
+    expected_keys = set(manifest.expected_run_keys)
+
+    for legacy_run in _iter_legacy_runs(legacy_input):
+        key = _run_key(legacy_run, label="legacy")
+        if key in observed_legacy_keys:
+            raise ValueError(f"legacy report contains duplicate run key {key!r}")
+        if key not in expected_keys:
+            raise ValueError(f"legacy report contains unexpected run key {key!r}")
+        observed_legacy_keys.add(key)
+        repaired_run = remaining.pop(key, None)
+        compared = audit_stage_provenance(
+            {"runs": [legacy_run]},
+            {"runs": [repaired_run]} if repaired_run is not None else {"runs": []},
+        )
+        records.extend(compared["records"])
+
+    for key in manifest.expected_run_keys:
+        if key in observed_legacy_keys:
+            continue
+        repaired_run = remaining.pop(key, None)
+        compared = audit_stage_provenance(
+            {"runs": [{"window": key[0], "seed": key[1], "stages": {}}]},
+            (
+                {"runs": [repaired_run]}
+                if repaired_run is not None
+                else {"runs": [{"window": key[0], "seed": key[1], "stages": {}}]}
+            ),
+        )
+        records.extend(compared["records"])
+
+    if remaining:
+        raise ValueError(f"repaired report contains unexpected run keys {sorted(remaining)!r}")
+    expected_stage_keys = {
+        (window, seed, stage.value) for window, seed in manifest.expected_run_keys for stage in ArchitectureStage
+    }
+    observed_stage_keys = {(str(record["window"]), int(record["seed"]), str(record["stage"])) for record in records}
+    if len(records) != len(expected_stage_keys) or observed_stage_keys != expected_stage_keys:
+        raise ValueError("stage validity does not contain the exact frozen 30x7 provenance matrix")
+    records.sort(key=_stage_record_sort_key)
+    counts = {state.value: 0 for state in ValidityState}
+    for record in records:
+        counts[record["state"]] += 1
+    return {
+        "schema_version": STAGE_PROVENANCE_SCHEMA_VERSION,
+        "records": records,
+        "counts": counts,
+    }
+
+
+def _iter_legacy_runs(
+    path: Path,
+    *,
+    _envelope_output: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
+) -> Iterator[dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Decode one pretty-printed top-level run at a time, never the 1GB report."""
+    structure = _JsonStructure()
+    found_runs = False
+    closed_runs = False
+    collecting = False
+    array_state = "initial"
+    fragments: list[str] = []
+    envelope_fragments: list[str] = []
+    with path.open(encoding="utf-8") as source:
+        for line in source:
+            if not found_runs:
+                if (
+                    _RUNS_DECLARATION_PATTERN.fullmatch(line.rstrip("\r\n")) is not None
+                    and structure.stack == ["}"]
+                    and not structure.in_string
+                ):
+                    found_runs = True
+                    structure.consume(line)
+                    if structure.stack != ["}", "]"]:
+                        raise ValueError("legacy top-level runs key must open an array")
+                    declaration = line.rstrip("\r\n")
+                    envelope_fragments.append(f"{declaration[: declaration.rfind('[')]}[]\n")
+                    continue
+                envelope_fragments.append(line)
+                structure.consume(line)
+                continue
+            if not closed_runs and not collecting:
+                stripped = line.strip()
+                if structure.stack == ["}", "]"] and stripped in {"]", "],"}:
+                    if array_state == "value_after_comma":
+                        raise ValueError("legacy report runs array contains a trailing comma")
+                    structure.consume(line)
+                    closed_runs = True
+                    envelope_fragments.append(",\n" if stripped.endswith(",") else "\n")
+                    continue
+                if not stripped:
+                    structure.consume(line)
+                    continue
+                if stripped.startswith("{") and array_state == "close_after_value":
+                    raise ValueError("legacy report runs array requires a comma between run objects")
+                if structure.stack != ["}", "]"] or not stripped.startswith("{"):
+                    raise ValueError("legacy report runs array contains an unexpected separator or empty entry")
+                collecting = True
+            if not closed_runs and collecting:
+                fragments.append(line)
+                structure.consume(line)
+            else:
+                if (
+                    _RUNS_DECLARATION_PATTERN.fullmatch(line.rstrip("\r\n")) is not None
+                    and structure.stack == ["}"]
+                    and not structure.in_string
+                ):
+                    raise ValueError("legacy report contains duplicate top-level runs keys")
+                envelope_fragments.append(line)
+                structure.consume(line)
+            if collecting and structure.stack == ["}", "]"] and not structure.in_string:
+                encoded = "".join(fragments).rstrip()
+                has_separator = encoded.endswith(",")
+                if has_separator:
+                    encoded = encoded[:-1]
+                try:
+                    value = json.loads(encoded)
+                except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
+                    raise ValueError("legacy report runs array contains a malformed run object") from exc
+                if not isinstance(value, dict):
+                    raise ValueError("legacy report run must be an object")
+                yield value
+                array_state = "value_after_comma" if has_separator else "close_after_value"
+                fragments.clear()
+                collecting = False
+    if not found_runs:
+        raise ValueError("legacy report is missing its top-level runs array")
+    if collecting or not closed_runs:
+        raise ValueError("legacy report runs array is incomplete")
+    if not structure.root_closed or structure.stack or structure.in_string:
+        raise ValueError("legacy top-level JSON object is incomplete")
+    try:
+        envelope = json.loads("".join(envelope_fragments))
+    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
+        raise ValueError("legacy top-level JSON is malformed outside the streamed runs array") from exc
+    if not isinstance(envelope, dict) or not isinstance(envelope.get("runs"), list):
+        raise ValueError("legacy report is missing its top-level runs array")
+    if _envelope_output is not None:
+        _envelope_output.append(envelope)
+
+
+class _JsonStructure:
+    __slots__ = ("escaped", "in_string", "root_closed", "root_started", "stack")
+
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self.stack: list[str] = []
+        self.in_string = False
+        self.escaped = False
+        self.root_started = False
+        self.root_closed = False
+
+    def consume(self, text: str) -> None:
+        for character in text:
+            if self.root_closed:
+                if not character.isspace():
+                    raise ValueError("legacy report contains trailing content after top-level JSON object")
+                continue
+            if not self.root_started:
+                if character.isspace():
+                    continue
+                if character != "{":
+                    raise ValueError("legacy report top-level JSON value must be an object")
+                self.root_started = True
+                self.stack.append("}")
+                continue
+            if self.in_string:
+                if self.escaped:
+                    self.escaped = False
+                elif character == "\\":
+                    self.escaped = True
+                elif character == '"':
+                    self.in_string = False
+                continue
+            if character == '"':
+                self.in_string = True
+            elif character == "{":
+                self.stack.append("}")
+            elif character == "[":
+                self.stack.append("]")
+            elif character in "}]":
+                if not self.stack or self.stack[-1] != character:
+                    raise ValueError("legacy report contains mismatched JSON delimiters")
+                self.stack.pop()
+                if not self.stack:
+                    self.root_closed = True
+
+
+def _run_key(run: Mapping[str, Any], *, label: str) -> tuple[str, int]:
+    window = run.get("window")
+    seed = run.get("seed")
+    if not isinstance(window, str) or not window:
+        raise ValueError(f"{label} run requires a window")
+    if isinstance(seed, bool) or not isinstance(seed, int):
+        raise ValueError(f"{label} run requires an integer seed")
+    return window, seed
+
+
+def build_full_system_comparison(records: list[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    ordered = sorted(records, key=_stage_record_sort_key)
+    first_confirmed = next(
+        (record for record in ordered if record.get("state") == ValidityState.CONFIRMED_AFFECTED.value),
+        None,
+    )
+    first_unverified = next(
+        (record for record in ordered if record.get("state") == ValidityState.UNVERIFIED_LEGACY.value),
+        None,
+    )
+    if first_confirmed is not None:
+        status = ValidityState.CONFIRMED_AFFECTED.value
+    elif first_unverified is not None:
+        status = ValidityState.UNVERIFIED_LEGACY.value
+    else:
+        status = ValidityState.PROVEN_UNAFFECTED.value
+    return {
+        "status": status,
+        "first_confirmed_divergence": _stage_key_payload(first_confirmed),
+        "first_unverified_comparison": _stage_key_payload(first_unverified),
+        "reason": (
+            _unverified_comparison_reason(first_unverified)
+            if status == ValidityState.UNVERIFIED_LEGACY.value
+            else "first_exact_stage_payload_change"
+            if status == ValidityState.CONFIRMED_AFFECTED.value
+            else "all_extracted_stage_payloads_match"
+        ),
+    }
+
+
+def _unverified_comparison_reason(record: Mapping[str, Any] | None) -> str:
+    if record is None:
+        return "stage_comparison_unverified"
+    legacy_incomplete = bool(record.get("legacy_error"))
+    repaired_incomplete = bool(record.get("repaired_error"))
+    if legacy_incomplete and repaired_incomplete:
+        return "legacy_and_repaired_stage_provenance_incomplete"
+    if legacy_incomplete:
+        return "legacy_stage_provenance_incomplete"
+    if repaired_incomplete:
+        return "repaired_stage_provenance_incomplete"
+    return "stage_comparison_unverified"
+
+
+def _stage_key_payload(record: Mapping[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
+    if record is None:
+        return None
+    return {field: record[field] for field in ("window", "seed", "stage")}
+
+
+def _stage_record_sort_key(record: Mapping[str, Any]) -> tuple[int, int, int, str]:
+    window_order = {
+        "train_full": 0,
+        "2020": 1,
+        "2021": 2,
+        "2022": 3,
+        "2023": 4,
+        "late_dev_2025": 5,
+    }
+    stage_order = {stage.value: index for index, stage in enumerate(ArchitectureStage)}
+    window = str(record.get("window"))
+    stage = str(record.get("stage"))
+    seed = record.get("seed")
+    seed_value = seed if isinstance(seed, int) and not isinstance(seed, bool) else sys.maxsize
+    return (
+        window_order.get(window, sys.maxsize),
+        seed_value,
+        stage_order.get(stage, sys.maxsize),
+        stage,
+    )
+
+
+def _build_fixed_event_attribution(
+    *,
+    manifest: ArchitectureExperimentManifest,
+    formula_hashes: list[str],
+    accounting_kernel_sha256: str,
+    rerun_contract_sha256: str,
+    frozen_inputs: Mapping[str, Any],
+    legacy_source: Mapping[str, Any],
+    repaired_source: Mapping[str, Any],
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    return {
+        "schema_version": _FIXED_EVENT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
+        "status": "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE",
+        "legacy_state": ValidityState.UNVERIFIED_LEGACY.value,
+        "reason": "legacy_artifact_has_no_replayable_fixed_event_ledger",
+        "parameter_search": False,
+        "manifest_sha256": manifest.sha256,
+        "formula_hashes": formula_hashes,
+        "accounting_kernel_sha256": accounting_kernel_sha256,
+        "rerun_contract_sha256": rerun_contract_sha256,
+        "legacy_envelope_sha256": frozen_inputs["legacy_envelope_sha256"],
+        "replay_input_parquet_corpus": dict(frozen_inputs["replay_input_parquet_corpus"]),
+        "sources": {"legacy": dict(legacy_source), "repaired_full_system": dict(repaired_source)},
+        "event_stream_identity": None,
+        "first_affected_fee": None,
+        "fills_marks_and_fees_identical": None,
+        "accounting_delta": None,
+        "funding_and_financing": "OUT_OF_SCOPE_NOT_EQUITY_INTEGRATED",
+    }
+
+
+def _build_summary(
+    *,
+    manifest: ArchitectureExperimentManifest,
+    formula_hashes: list[str],
+    accounting_kernel_sha256: str,
+    rerun_contract_sha256: str,
+    frozen_inputs: Mapping[str, Any],
+    legacy_source: Mapping[str, Any],
+    repaired_source: Mapping[str, Any],
+    stage_validity: Mapping[str, Any],
+    fixed_event: Mapping[str, Any],
+    full_system_comparison: Mapping[str, Any],
+    observed_runs: int,
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    has_evidence_gap = (
+        fixed_event["status"] == "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE"
+        or full_system_comparison["status"] == ValidityState.UNVERIFIED_LEGACY.value
+    )
+    return {
+        "schema_version": _RERUN_SUMMARY_SCHEMA_VERSION,
+        "status": "COMPLETED_WITH_EVIDENCE_GAPS" if has_evidence_gap else "COMPLETED",
+        "constraints": {"parameter_search": False},
+        "matrix": {
+            "expected_runs": len(manifest.expected_run_keys),
+            "observed_runs": observed_runs,
+        },
+        "identities": {
+            "manifest_sha256": manifest.sha256,
+            "candidate_params_sha256": manifest.candidate_params_sha256,
+            "profile_sha256": manifest.profile_sha256,
+            "formula_hashes": formula_hashes,
+            "accounting_kernel_sha256": accounting_kernel_sha256,
+            "rerun_contract_sha256": rerun_contract_sha256,
+            "legacy_envelope_sha256": frozen_inputs["legacy_envelope_sha256"],
+            "replay_input_parquet_corpus": dict(frozen_inputs["replay_input_parquet_corpus"]),
+        },
+        "sources": {"legacy": dict(legacy_source), "repaired": dict(repaired_source)},
+        "fixed_event": {
+            "status": fixed_event["status"],
+            "legacy_state": fixed_event["legacy_state"],
+            "reason": fixed_event["reason"],
+        },
+        "full_system_comparison": dict(full_system_comparison),
+        "stage_validity_counts": dict(stage_validity["counts"]),
+        "resource_behavior": {
+            "legacy_sha256_stream_passes": 2,
+            "legacy_stage_stream_passes": 1,
+            "legacy_full_json_load_count": 0,
+            "legacy_peak_loaded_scope": "single_run",
+            "sha256_chunk_bytes": _JSON_HASH_CHUNK_BYTES,
+            "publication": "temporary_sibling_directory_then_atomic_noreplace_directory_rename",
+        },
+    }
+
+
+def _source_identity(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    size_bytes = path.stat().st_size
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as source:
+        for chunk in iter(lambda: source.read(_JSON_HASH_CHUNK_BYTES), b""):
+            digest.update(chunk)
+    return {
+        "path": str(path),
+        "sha256": digest.hexdigest(),
+        "size_bytes": size_bytes,
+    }
+
+
+def _legacy_envelope_identity(path: Path) -> str:
+    envelopes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for _run in _iter_legacy_runs(path, _envelope_output=envelopes):
+        pass
+    if len(envelopes) != 1:
+        raise ValueError("legacy report did not produce exactly one canonical envelope")
+    encoded = json.dumps(
+        envelopes[0],
+        allow_nan=False,
+        sort_keys=True,
+        separators=(",", ":"),
+    ).encode("utf-8")
+    return f"sha256:{hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest()}"
+
+
+def _parquet_corpus_identity(root: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    resolved_root = root.resolve()
+    paths = sorted(path for path in resolved_root.rglob("*.parquet") if path.is_file())
+    if not paths:
+        raise ValueError(f"raw Parquet corpus is empty:{root}")
+    entries: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    total_size_bytes = 0
+    for path in paths:
+        source = _source_identity(path)
+        size_bytes = int(source["size_bytes"])
+        total_size_bytes += size_bytes
+        entries.append(
+            {
+                "path": path.relative_to(resolved_root).as_posix(),
+                "sha256": source["sha256"],
+                "size_bytes": size_bytes,
+            }
+        )
+    payload = {
+        "schema_version": _REPLAY_INPUT_PARQUET_CORPUS_SCHEMA_VERSION,
+        "files": entries,
+    }
+    encoded = json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")
+    return {
+        "schema_version": _REPLAY_INPUT_PARQUET_CORPUS_SCHEMA_VERSION,
+        "sha256": f"sha256:{hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest()}",
+        "file_count": len(entries),
+        "total_size_bytes": total_size_bytes,
+    }
+
+
+def _assert_read_only_parquet_corpus(root: Path) -> None:
+    resolved_root = root.resolve()
+    mutable_paths = [
+        path
+        for path in (resolved_root, *resolved_root.rglob("*"))
+        if (path.is_dir() or (path.is_file() and path.suffix == ".parquet")) and path.stat().st_mode & 0o222
+    ]
+    if mutable_paths:
+        examples = [str(path.relative_to(resolved_root)) for path in mutable_paths[:3]]
+        raise ValueError(f"replay input Parquet corpus must be read-only before rerun: mutable_paths={examples!r}")
+
+
+def _frozen_input_identities(*, legacy_input: Path, root: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    replay_data_root = _resolve_replay_data_root(root)
+    _assert_read_only_parquet_corpus(replay_data_root)
+    return {
+        "legacy_source": _source_identity(legacy_input),
+        "legacy_envelope_sha256": _legacy_envelope_identity(legacy_input),
+        "replay_input_parquet_corpus": _parquet_corpus_identity(replay_data_root),
+    }
+
+
+def _resolve_replay_data_root(root: Path) -> Path:
+    root_parent = root.resolve().parent
+    cwd_data_root = Path("data/raw").resolve()
+    if root_parent != cwd_data_root:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "--root parent and cwd data/raw must resolve to the same replay data root: "
+            f"root_parent={root_parent}, cwd_data_root={cwd_data_root}"
+        )
+    return cwd_data_root
+
+
+def _preflight_first_frozen_donor(
+    *,
+    root: Path,
+    manifest: ArchitectureExperimentManifest,
+    contract: Mapping[str, Any],
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    expected_availability = contract.get("required_replay_store_availability")
+    if expected_availability != {"macro": True, "options": True}:
+        raise ValueError("rerun contract replay store availability identity mismatch")
+    first_window = manifest.windows[0]
+    first_seed = manifest.seeds[0]
+    donor_config, _donor_config_hash = build_causal_donor_backtest_config(
+        root=root,
+        manifest=manifest,
+        window=first_window,
+        seed=first_seed,
+    )
+    donor_runner = HistoricalBacktest(donor_config)
+    actual_availability = {
+        "macro": bool(donor_runner._macro_store.loaded),
+        "options": bool(donor_runner.options_store.loaded),
+    }
+    if actual_availability != expected_availability:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "first frozen donor replay store availability mismatch: "
+            f"expected={expected_availability}, actual={actual_availability}"
+        )
+    actual_formula_hash = donor_runner.indicator_engine._formula_hash
+    expected_formula_hash = contract.get("indicator_formula_hash")
+    if actual_formula_hash != expected_formula_hash or actual_formula_hash != EXPECTED_REPAIRED_FORMULA_HASH:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "first frozen donor indicator formula identity mismatch: "
+            f"expected={expected_formula_hash}, actual={actual_formula_hash}"
+        )
+    return {
+        "indicator_formula_hash": actual_formula_hash,
+        "replay_store_availability": actual_availability,
+    }
+
+
+def _load_frozen_rerun_contract() -> dict[str, Any]:
+    try:
+        raw = FROZEN_RERUN_CONTRACT_PATH.read_bytes()
+    except OSError as exc:
+        raise ValueError(f"unable to read frozen rerun contract:{FROZEN_RERUN_CONTRACT_PATH}") from exc
+    actual_sha256 = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
+    if actual_sha256 != FROZEN_RERUN_CONTRACT_SHA256:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"frozen rerun contract SHA-256 mismatch: expected {FROZEN_RERUN_CONTRACT_SHA256}, got {actual_sha256}"
+        )
+    try:
+        payload = json.loads(raw)
+    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
+        raise ValueError("frozen rerun contract must be valid JSON") from exc
+    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
+        raise ValueError("frozen rerun contract must be a JSON object")
+    return payload
+
+
+def _assert_frozen_input_contract(
+    contract: Mapping[str, Any],
+    *,
+    observed: Mapping[str, Any],
+    manifest: ArchitectureExperimentManifest,
+) -> None:
+    if contract.get("schema_version") != _RERUN_CONTRACT_SCHEMA_VERSION:
+        raise ValueError("rerun contract schema version mismatch")
+    if contract.get("architecture_manifest_sha256") != manifest.sha256:
+        raise ValueError("rerun contract architecture manifest identity mismatch")
+    if contract.get("indicator_formula_hash") != EXPECTED_REPAIRED_FORMULA_HASH:
+        raise ValueError("rerun contract indicator formula identity mismatch")
+    if contract.get("accounting_kernel_sha256") != build_accounting_kernel_identity()["sha256"]:
+        raise ValueError("rerun contract accounting kernel identity mismatch")
+    expected_legacy = contract.get("legacy_source")
+    actual_legacy = observed.get("legacy_source")
+    if not isinstance(expected_legacy, Mapping) or not isinstance(actual_legacy, Mapping):
+        raise ValueError("legacy source identity mismatch")
+    for field in ("sha256", "size_bytes"):
+        if expected_legacy.get(field) != actual_legacy.get(field):
+            raise ValueError("legacy source identity mismatch")
+    if contract.get("legacy_envelope_sha256") != observed.get("legacy_envelope_sha256"):
+        raise ValueError("legacy envelope identity mismatch")
+    if contract.get("required_replay_store_availability") != {"macro": True, "options": True}:
+        raise ValueError("rerun contract replay store availability identity mismatch")
+    if contract.get("replay_input_mode") != "read_only_snapshot":
+        raise ValueError("rerun contract replay input mode mismatch")
+    expected_corpus = contract.get("replay_input_parquet_corpus")
+    actual_corpus = observed.get("replay_input_parquet_corpus")
+    if not isinstance(expected_corpus, Mapping) or not isinstance(actual_corpus, Mapping):
+        raise ValueError("replay input Parquet corpus identity mismatch")
+    for field in ("schema_version", "sha256", "file_count", "total_size_bytes"):
+        if expected_corpus.get(field) != actual_corpus.get(field):
+            raise ValueError("replay input Parquet corpus identity mismatch")
+
+
+def _write_json(path: Path, payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> None:
+    with path.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as output:
+        json.dump(payload, output, allow_nan=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
+        output.flush()
+        os.fsync(output.fileno())
+
+
+def _publish_staged_outputs(*, staging_dir: Path, output_dir: Path) -> None:
+    missing = [name for name in OUTPUT_FILENAMES if not (staging_dir / name).is_file()]
+    if missing:
+        raise ValueError(f"staged rerun is incomplete: missing={missing!r}")
+    _assert_new_output_directory(output_dir)
+    try:
+        _atomic_rename_directory_noreplace(staging_dir, output_dir)
+    except OSError as exc:
+        if exc.errno in {errno.EEXIST, errno.ENOTEMPTY}:
+            raise _output_dir_exists_error(output_dir) from None
+        raise
+    _fsync_directory(output_dir.parent)
+
+
+def _atomic_rename_directory_noreplace(source: Path, destination: Path) -> None:
+    """Atomically rename a directory only when the destination is absent."""
+    if sys.platform == "darwin":
+        function_name = "renameatx_np"
+        at_fdcwd = _DARWIN_AT_FDCWD
+        flag = _DARWIN_RENAME_EXCL
+    elif sys.platform.startswith("linux"):
+        function_name = "renameat2"
+        at_fdcwd = _LINUX_AT_FDCWD
+        flag = _LINUX_RENAME_NOREPLACE
+    else:
+        raise OSError(errno.ENOTSUP, "atomic no-replace directory rename is unsupported on this platform")
+
+    libc = ctypes.CDLL(None, use_errno=True)
+    try:
+        rename_noreplace = getattr(libc, function_name)
+    except AttributeError as exc:
+        raise OSError(
+            errno.ENOTSUP,
+            f"atomic no-replace directory rename primitive {function_name} is unavailable",
+        ) from exc
+    rename_noreplace.argtypes = [
+        ctypes.c_int,
+        ctypes.c_char_p,
+        ctypes.c_int,
+        ctypes.c_char_p,
+        ctypes.c_uint,
+    ]
+    rename_noreplace.restype = ctypes.c_int
+    ctypes.set_errno(0)
+    result = rename_noreplace(
+        at_fdcwd,
+        os.fsencode(source),
+        at_fdcwd,
+        os.fsencode(destination),
+        flag,
+    )
+    if result != 0:
+        error_number = ctypes.get_errno() or errno.EIO
+        raise OSError(error_number, os.strerror(error_number), os.fspath(destination))
+
+
+def _fsync_directory(path: Path) -> None:
+    descriptor = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY)
+    try:
+        os.fsync(descriptor)
+    finally:
+        os.close(descriptor)
+
+
+def _assert_safe_paths(legacy_input: Path, output_dir: Path) -> None:
+    if _paths_alias(legacy_input, output_dir):
+        raise ValueError("legacy-input must not alias output-dir")
+    for name in OUTPUT_FILENAMES:
+        if _paths_alias(legacy_input, output_dir / name):
+            raise ValueError("legacy-input cannot alias a generated output")
+
+
+def _paths_alias(first: Path, second: Path) -> bool:
+    if os.path.lexists(first) and os.path.lexists(second):
+        try:
+            if os.path.samefile(first, second):
+                return True
+        except OSError:
+            pass
+    return str(first.resolve(strict=False)).casefold() == str(second.resolve(strict=False)).casefold()
+
+
+def _assert_new_output_directory(output_dir: Path) -> None:
+    if os.path.lexists(output_dir):
+        raise _output_dir_exists_error(output_dir)
+
+
+def _output_dir_exists_error(output_dir: Path) -> FileExistsError:
+    return FileExistsError(
+        errno.EEXIST,
+        f"output-dir already exists; choose a new versioned output directory: {output_dir}",
+        output_dir,
+    )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(cli())

+def _sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as source:
+        for chunk in iter(lambda: source.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
+            digest.update(chunk)
+    return digest.hexdigest()

 def _utc_ns(year: int, month: int = 1, day: int = 1) -> int:
     return int(datetime(year, month, day, tzinfo=UTC).timestamp() * 1_000_000_000)

+def run_time_space_shadow(
+    args: RunArgs,
+    *,
+    provider_fetcher: Callable[[str, int], Mapping[str, Any]] | None = None,
+) -> RunResult:
+    """Validate, compute, re-hash, and atomically publish one shadow run."""
+
+    if type(args) is not RunArgs:
+        raise TypeError("args must be RunArgs")
+    output_dir = Path(args.output_dir)
+    if output_dir.exists() or output_dir.is_symlink():
+        raise FileExistsError("output directory already exists")
+    as_of_ns = _parse_literal_as_of(args.as_of)
+    hypothesis = load_hypothesis_manifest(Path(args.hypothesis_manifest))
+    execution = load_execution_manifest(Path(args.execution_manifest))
+    if hypothesis.layer != "time_space_shadow" or execution.layer != "time_space_shadow":
+        raise ValueError("runner accepts only the time_space_shadow layer")
+
+    registration_input = _load_json(Path(args.registration_envelope), "registration envelope")
+    trust = _load_registration_trust()
+    _validate_retained_registration(registration_input, trust=trust)
+    receipt_payload: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    receipts: tuple[Any, ...] = ()
+    forward_start_ns: int | None = None
+    registration_status = "REGISTRATION_UNVERIFIED"
+    try:
+        receipt_payload, receipts, forward_start_ns = _verify_registration_pair(
+            registration_input,
+            hypothesis=hypothesis,
+            execution=execution,
+            trust=trust,
+            provider_fetcher=provider_fetcher or _fetch_github_provider_run,
+        )
+        registration_status = "REGISTRATION_VERIFIED"
+    except ValueError:
+        if as_of_ns != hypothesis.reused_end_ns:
+            raise ValueError("REGISTRATION_UNVERIFIED") from None
+
+    if as_of_ns == hypothesis.reused_end_ns:
+        role = EvidenceRole.TEST_REUSED_DIAGNOSTIC
+        observation_start_ns = hypothesis.reused_start_ns
+        observation_end_ns = hypothesis.reused_end_ns
+    else:
+        if forward_start_ns is None:
+            raise ValueError("REGISTRATION_UNVERIFIED")
+        role, observation_start_ns, observation_end_ns = _resolve_role_window(
+            as_of_ns=as_of_ns,
+            reused_start_ns=hypothesis.reused_start_ns,
+            reused_end_ns=hypothesis.reused_end_ns,
+            forward_start_ns=forward_start_ns,
+        )
+    before_source_sha256 = _hash_bound_sources(execution)
+    export_payload = _load_json(Path(args.frozen_export), "frozen export")
+    export_trust = "REUSED_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY"
+    if role is EvidenceRole.FORWARD_CONFIRMATION:
+        if args.export_provenance is None or args.export_checkpoint is None or args.export_receipt is None:
+            raise ValueError("EXPORT_REGISTRATION_REQUIRED")
+        provenance_payload = _load_json(Path(args.export_provenance), "export provenance")
+        checkpoint_payload = _load_json(Path(args.export_checkpoint), "export checkpoint")
+        export_receipt_payload = _load_json(Path(args.export_receipt), "export receipt")
+        export_trust = validate_registered_time_space_export(
+            export_payload,
+            provenance_payload,
+            checkpoint_payload,
+            export_receipt_payload,
+            provider_fetcher=provider_fetcher or _fetch_github_provider_run,
+        )
+        if export_trust != VERIFIED:
+            raise ValueError("EXPORT_REGISTRATION_REQUIRED")
+    export_sha256 = canonical_sha256(export_payload)
+    canonical_path, perturbation_paths, transition_events, market_state_transitions = _load_export(
+        export_payload,
+        as_of_ns=as_of_ns,
+        execution=execution,
+        observation_start_ns=observation_start_ns,
+        observation_end_ns=observation_end_ns,
+    )
+

+        and observation_start_ns <= flip.cutoff_time_ns < observation_end_ns
+    )

+            "frozen_export_sha256": export_sha256,
+            "evidence_role": role.value,
+            "registration_status": registration_status,
+            "observation_window": [observation_start_ns, observation_end_ns],
+            "as_of_ns": as_of_ns,
+        }
+    )

+        manifest_id=manifest_id,
+        hypothesis_sha256=hypothesis.sha256,
+        observation_start_ns=observation_start_ns,
+        observation_end_ns=observation_end_ns,
+        market_state_transition_count=market_state_transitions,
+        primary_flips=primary_flips,
+        perturbation_paths=perturbation_paths,
+    )
+    acceptance = evaluate_time_space_shadow(canonical_path.labels, acceptance_manifest, role)
+    if (
+        role is not EvidenceRole.FORWARD_CONFIRMATION
+        and acceptance.status is AcceptanceStatus.ELIGIBLE_FOR_SEPARATE_ACTIVATION_REVIEW
+    ):
+        raise AssertionError("non-forward evidence cannot be eligible")
+
+    after_source_sha256 = _hash_bound_sources(execution)
+    if after_source_sha256 != before_source_sha256:
+        raise RuntimeError("source corpus changed during run")
+
+    hypothesis_payload = _plain_json(hypothesis.payload)
+    execution_payload = _plain_json(execution.payload)
+    normalized_registration = {
+        "schema_version": "time-space-shadow-registration-envelope.v1",
+        "layer": "time_space_shadow",
+        "hypothesis_sha256": hypothesis.sha256,
+        "execution_sha256": execution.sha256,
+        "receipts": receipt_payload,
+        "registration_status": registration_status,
+        "registration_received_at_ns": max((item.received_at_ns for item in receipts), default=None),
+        "forward_start_ns": forward_start_ns,
+    }
+    registration_sha256 = canonical_sha256(normalized_registration)
+    acceptance_payload = _plain_json(acceptance)
+    acceptance_payload.pop("blocks_order", None)
+    canonical_evidence = {
+        "states": [_without_shadow_authority_fields(item) for item in canonical_path.states],
+        "flips": [_plain_json(item) for item in canonical_path.flips],
+        "labels": [_plain_json(item) for item in canonical_path.labels],
+        "market_state_transition_events": transition_events,
+    }
+    perturbation_evidence = [
+        {
+            "seed": item.seed,
+            "flips": [_plain_json(flip) for flip in item.flips],
+            "labels": [_plain_json(label) for label in item.labels],
+        }
+        for item in perturbation_paths
+    ]
+    attribution = {
+        "schema_version": "time-space-shadow-attribution.v1",
+        "layer": "time_space_shadow",
+        "manifest_id": manifest_id,
+        "hypothesis_sha256": hypothesis.sha256,
+        "execution_sha256": execution.sha256,
+        "registration_envelope_sha256": registration_sha256,
+        "frozen_export_sha256": export_sha256,
+        "source_set_sha256_before": before_source_sha256,
+        "source_set_sha256_after": after_source_sha256,
+        "as_of_ns": as_of_ns,
+        "evidence_role": role.value,
+        "registration_status": registration_status,
+        "observation_window": [observation_start_ns, observation_end_ns],
+        "forward_start_ns": forward_start_ns,
+        "forward_evidence": role is EvidenceRole.FORWARD_CONFIRMATION,
+        "forward_eligible": role is EvidenceRole.FORWARD_CONFIRMATION,
+        "export_trust": export_trust,
+        "state_count": len(canonical_path.states),
+        "flip_count_by_kind": {
+            kind.value: sum(flip.kind is kind for flip in canonical_path.flips) for kind in FlipKind
+        },
+        "mature_label_count": sum(not label.right_censored for label in canonical_path.labels),
+        "canonical_evidence": canonical_evidence,
+        "perturbation_evidence": perturbation_evidence,
+        "acceptance": acceptance_payload,
+        "status": acceptance.status.value,
+    }
+    _reject_forbidden_authority_tokens(attribution)
+
+    payloads = dict(
+        zip(
+            _ARTIFACT_NAMES,
+            (hypothesis_payload, execution_payload, normalized_registration, attribution),
+            strict=True,
+        )
+    )
+    paths = _write_artifacts_transactionally(payloads, output_dir)
+    attribution_path = output_dir / "time_space_shadow_attribution.json"
+    return RunResult(
+        output_dir=output_dir,
+        paths=paths,
+        attribution_path=attribution_path,
+        attribution_sha256=_sha256_file(attribution_path),
+    )
+
+
+def _verify_registration_pair(
+    registration: dict[str, Any],
+    *,
+    hypothesis,
+    execution,
+    trust: dict[str, Any],
+    provider_fetcher: Callable[[str, int], Mapping[str, Any]],
+):
+    _validate_retained_registration(registration, trust=trust)
+    verified = []
+    normalized = []
+    for name in ("hypothesis", "execution"):
+        item = registration[name]
+        pinned = trust[name]
+        try:
+            provider = provider_fetcher(trust["remote_identity"], int(pinned["provider_run_id"]))
+        except Exception as exc:
+            raise ValueError(f"cannot fetch authoritative {name} provider receipt") from exc
+        try:
+            receipt = verify_github_receipt(item, provider)
+        except RegistrationError as exc:
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} receipt is unverified") from exc
+        if item["received_at_ns"] != receipt.received_at_ns:
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} retained receipt timestamp does not match provider")
+        verified.append(receipt)
+        normalized.append(
+            {
+                "kind": name,
+                "provider_run_id": receipt.provider_run_id,
+                "commit_sha": receipt.commit_sha,
+                "remote_identity": receipt.remote_identity,
+                "manifest_sha256": receipt.manifest_sha256,
+                "received_at_ns": receipt.received_at_ns,
+            }
+        )
+    try:
+        forward_start_ns = derive_forward_start_ns(
+            hypothesis,
+            execution,
+            verified,
+            expected_remote_identity=trust["remote_identity"],
+            expected_hypothesis_provider_run_id=trust["hypothesis"]["provider_run_id"],
+            expected_hypothesis_commit_sha=trust["hypothesis"]["commit_sha"],
+            expected_execution_provider_run_id=trust["execution"]["provider_run_id"],
+            expected_execution_commit_sha=trust["execution"]["commit_sha"],
+        )
+    except (KeyError, RegistrationError) as exc:
+        raise ValueError("receipt pair is unverified or role-swapped") from exc
+    return normalized, tuple(verified), forward_start_ns
+
+
+def _validate_retained_registration(registration: dict[str, Any], *, trust: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    if set(registration) != {"schema_version", "layer", "hypothesis", "execution"}:
+        raise ValueError("registration envelope keys are invalid")
+    if registration["schema_version"] != "trend-registration-pair.v1" or registration["layer"] != "time_space_shadow":
+        raise ValueError("registration envelope identity is invalid")
+    for name in ("hypothesis", "execution"):
+        item = registration[name]
+        if not isinstance(item, dict) or set(item) != {
+            "provider_run_id",
+            "commit_sha",
+            "remote_identity",
+            "manifest_sha256",
+            "received_at_ns",
+        }:
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} registration descriptor is invalid")
+        pinned = trust[name]
+        expected = {
+            "provider_run_id": pinned["provider_run_id"],
+            "commit_sha": pinned["commit_sha"],
+            "remote_identity": trust["remote_identity"],
+            "manifest_sha256": pinned["manifest_sha256"],
+        }
+        if any(item.get(key) != value for key, value in expected.items()):
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} does not match trusted registration")
+
+
+def _resolve_role_window(*, as_of_ns: int, reused_start_ns: int, reused_end_ns: int, forward_start_ns: int):
+    if reused_end_ns > forward_start_ns:
+        raise ValueError("reused and forward evidence roles overlap")
+    if as_of_ns == reused_end_ns:
+        return EvidenceRole.TEST_REUSED_DIAGNOSTIC, reused_start_ns, reused_end_ns
+    if as_of_ns < forward_start_ns:
+        raise ValueError("as_of falls in excluded embargo and has no evidence role")
+    if as_of_ns <= forward_start_ns:
+        raise ValueError("forward evidence window is empty")
+    return EvidenceRole.FORWARD_CONFIRMATION, forward_start_ns, as_of_ns
+
+
+def _load_registration_trust() -> dict[str, Any]:
+    trust = _load_json(_TRUST_RECORD_PATH, "registration trust record")
+    if set(trust) != {"schema_version", "layer", "remote_identity", "hypothesis", "execution"}:
+        raise ValueError("registration trust record keys are invalid")
+    if (
+        trust["schema_version"] != "time-space-shadow-registration-trust.v1"
+        or trust["layer"] != "time_space_shadow"
+        or trust["remote_identity"] != _TRUSTED_REMOTE
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("registration trust record identity is invalid")
+    for name in ("hypothesis", "execution"):
+        item = trust[name]
+        if not isinstance(item, dict) or set(item) != {"provider_run_id", "commit_sha", "manifest_sha256"}:
+            raise ValueError(f"trusted {name} descriptor is invalid")
+        if (
+            item["provider_run_id"] != _TRUSTED_RUNS[name]
+            or item["commit_sha"] != _TRUSTED_COMMITS[name]
+            or item["manifest_sha256"] != _TRUSTED_MANIFESTS[name]
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(f"trusted {name} provider identity is invalid")
+    return trust
+
+
+def _fetch_github_provider_run(remote_identity: str, provider_run_id: int) -> Mapping[str, Any]:
+    if remote_identity != _TRUSTED_REMOTE or str(provider_run_id) not in set(_TRUSTED_RUNS.values()):
+        raise ValueError("provider fetch is outside the pinned trust root")
+    url = f"https://api.github.com/repos/{remote_identity}/actions/runs/{provider_run_id}"
+    headers = {"Accept": "application/vnd.github+json", "User-Agent": "zenquant-time-space-shadow/1"}
+    token = os.environ.get("GITHUB_TOKEN") or os.environ.get("GH_TOKEN")
+    if token:
+        headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {token}"
+    request = urllib.request.Request(
+        url,
+        headers=headers,
+    )
+    opener = urllib.request.build_opener(_NoRedirectHandler())
+    with opener.open(request, timeout=30) as response:
+        payload = json.loads(response.read().decode("utf-8"))
+    if not isinstance(payload, Mapping):
+        raise ValueError("GitHub provider response is not an object")
+    return payload
+
+
+def _validate_transition_events(raw_events: Any, states: tuple[Any, ...]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    if not isinstance(raw_events, list):
+        raise ValueError("market state transition events must be a list")
+    state_index = {state.cutoff_time_ns: index for index, state in enumerate(states)}
+    validated: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    previous_cutoff: int | None = None
+    for event in raw_events:
+        if not isinstance(event, dict) or set(event) not in (
+            {"cutoff_time_ns", "prior_state_id", "state_id"},
+            {"cutoff_time_ns", "prior_state_id", "state_id", "transition_id"},
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("transition event schema is invalid")
+        cutoff = event["cutoff_time_ns"]
+        if (
+            isinstance(cutoff, bool)
+            or not isinstance(cutoff, int)
+            or cutoff < 0
+            or cutoff % (4 * 60 * 60 * 1_000_000_000)
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("transition cutoff must use the canonical UTC 4h grid")
+        if previous_cutoff is not None and cutoff <= previous_cutoff:
+            raise ValueError("transition cutoffs must be unique and strictly increasing")
+        index = state_index.get(cutoff)
+        if index is None or index == 0:
+            raise ValueError("transition event is missing an adjacent prior state")
+        prior = states[index - 1]
+        current = states[index]
+        if event["prior_state_id"] != prior.state_id or event["state_id"] != current.state_id:
+            raise ValueError("transition event state identity mismatch")
+        if prior.market_structure_side == current.market_structure_side:
+            raise ValueError("transition event does not change market state")
+        if "transition_id" in event:
+            expected_transition_id = canonical_sha256(
+                {key: event[key] for key in ("cutoff_time_ns", "prior_state_id", "state_id")}
+            )
+            if event["transition_id"] != expected_transition_id:
+                raise ValueError("transition event identity mismatch")
+        validated.append(dict(event))
+        previous_cutoff = cutoff
+    return validated
+
+
+def _load_export(
+    payload: dict[str, Any],
+    *,
+    as_of_ns: int,
+    execution,
+    observation_start_ns: int,
+    observation_end_ns: int,
+):
+    if set(payload) not in (_EXPECTED_EXPORT_KEYS, _REGISTERED_EXPORT_KEYS):
+        raise ValueError("frozen export keys are invalid")
+    if payload["schema_version"] != "time-space-shadow-export.v1" or payload["layer"] != "time_space_shadow":
+        raise ValueError("frozen export identity is invalid")
+    expected_identities = {
+        "hypothesis_sha256": execution.hypothesis_sha256,
+        "execution_sha256": execution.sha256,
+        "formula_sha256": execution.payload["formula_sha256"],
+        "config_sha256": execution.payload["config_sha256"],
+        "source_set_sha256": execution.payload["source_set_sha256"],
+    }
+    for field, expected in expected_identities.items():
+        if payload[field] != expected:
+            raise ValueError(f"frozen export {field} does not bind registered execution")
+    if payload["as_of_ns"] != as_of_ns:
+        raise ValueError("frozen export as_of_ns does not match literal as_of")
+    if set(payload) == _REGISTERED_EXPORT_KEYS:
+        if payload["seeds"] != list(_EXPECTED_SEEDS):
+            raise ValueError("frozen export seeds do not match the registered matrix")
+        windows = payload["windows"]
+        if (
+            not isinstance(windows, dict)
+            or set(windows) != {"reused", "embargo", "forward"}
+            or windows["reused"] != list(execution.payload["reused_window"])
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("frozen export windows do not bind registered execution")
+    canonical = _build_path(payload["rows"], as_of_ns=as_of_ns, identities=expected_identities)
+    transition_events = _validate_transition_events(payload["market_state_transition_events"], canonical.states)
+    transition_count = sum(
+        observation_start_ns <= event["cutoff_time_ns"] < observation_end_ns for event in transition_events
+    )
+    perturbations = payload["perturbation_paths"]
+    if not isinstance(perturbations, dict) or set(perturbations) != {str(seed) for seed in _EXPECTED_SEEDS}:
+        raise ValueError("perturbation paths must use the five frozen seeds in canonical order")
+    path_evidence = []
+    for seed in _EXPECTED_SEEDS:
+        path = _build_path(perturbations[str(seed)], as_of_ns=as_of_ns, identities=expected_identities)
+        path_evidence.append(PerturbationPathEvidence(seed=seed, flips=path.flips, labels=path.labels))
+    return canonical, tuple(path_evidence), transition_events, transition_count
+
+
+def _build_path(raw_rows: Any, *, as_of_ns: int, identities: dict[str, str]) -> _LoadedPath:
+    if not isinstance(raw_rows, list) or not raw_rows:
+        raise ValueError("frozen export rows must be a non-empty list")
+    state_inputs = []
+    alpha_rows = []
+    approved_rows = []
+    filled_rows = []
+    for raw in raw_rows:
+        if not isinstance(raw, dict) or set(raw) not in (_EXPECTED_ROW_KEYS, _REGISTERED_ROW_KEYS):
+            raise ValueError("frozen export row keys are invalid")
+        if "row_id" in raw:
+            expected_row_id = canonical_sha256({key: value for key, value in raw.items() if key != "row_id"})
+            if raw["row_id"] != expected_row_id:
+                raise ValueError("frozen export row identity mismatch")
+        if (
+            raw["formula_hash"] != identities["formula_sha256"]
+            or raw["config_hash"] != identities["config_sha256"]
+            or raw["source_data_hash"] != identities["source_set_sha256"]
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("frozen export row identity does not bind registered execution")
+        decisions = raw["decision_id_by_stage"]
+        if not isinstance(decisions, dict):
+            raise ValueError("decision_id_by_stage must be an object")
+        if set(decisions) != _REQUIRED_DECISION_STAGES:
+            raise ValueError("decision stages must be exactly A1_SIGN, A5_SHADOW, FILLED_POSITION")
+        _reject_forbidden_authority_tokens(decisions)
+        state_input = TimeSpaceInputRow(
+            **{
+                key: raw[key]
+                for key in _EXPECTED_ROW_KEYS
+                - {"alpha_sign", "approved_target", "filled_position", "decision_id_by_stage"}
+            },
+            decision_id_by_stage=tuple(sorted(decisions.items())),
+        )
+        if state_input.cutoff_time_ns > as_of_ns:
+            raise ValueError("frozen export contains a row beyond as_of")
+        state_inputs.append(state_input)
+    states = build_time_space_states(tuple(state_inputs))
+    for raw, state in zip(raw_rows, states, strict=True):
+        decisions = dict(state.decision_id_by_stage)
+        for kind, value_key, stage, destination in (
+            (FlipKind.ALPHA, "alpha_sign", "A1_SIGN", alpha_rows),
+            (FlipKind.APPROVED, "approved_target", "A5_SHADOW", approved_rows),
+            (FlipKind.FILLED, "filled_position", "FILLED_POSITION", filled_rows),
+        ):
+            identity = decisions.get(stage)
+            if identity is None:
+                raise ValueError(f"frozen export is missing {stage} identity")
+            destination.append(
+                FlipPopulationInputRow(
+                    kind=kind,
+                    alpha_id=state.alpha_id,
+                    cutoff_time_ns=state.cutoff_time_ns,
+                    value=raw[value_key],
+                    source_identity=identity,
+                )
+            )
+    populations = (tuple(alpha_rows), tuple(approved_rows), tuple(filled_rows))
+    flips = build_flip_observations(
+        states=states,
+        alpha_rows=populations[0],
+        approved_rows=populations[1],
+        filled_rows=populations[2],
+    )
+    labels = mature_flip_labels(
+        flips,
+        states,
+        alpha_rows=populations[0],
+        approved_rows=populations[1],
+        filled_rows=populations[2],
+        as_of_ns=as_of_ns,
+    )
+    if any(label.right_censored for label in labels):
+        raise ValueError("unavailable label in selected frozen export")
+    return _LoadedPath(states, populations[0], populations[1], populations[2], flips, labels)
+
+
+def _parse_literal_as_of(value: str) -> int:
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or len(value) != 20 or not value.endswith("Z"):
+        raise ValueError("as_of must be a literal canonical UTC 4h cutoff")
+    try:
+        parsed = datetime.strptime(value, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ").replace(tzinfo=UTC)
+    except ValueError as exc:
+        raise ValueError("as_of must be a literal canonical UTC 4h cutoff") from exc
+    ns = int(parsed.timestamp()) * 1_000_000_000
+    if ns % (4 * 60 * 60 * 1_000_000_000):
+        raise ValueError("as_of must be a literal canonical UTC 4h cutoff")
+    return ns
+
+
+def _hash_bound_sources(execution) -> str:
+    bound_files: dict[str, str] = {}
+    for source_id, descriptor in sorted(execution.payload["sources"].items()):
+        path_value = descriptor.get("normalized_path", descriptor.get("path"))
+        expected = descriptor.get("normalized_sha256", descriptor.get("sha256"))
+        if not isinstance(path_value, str) or not isinstance(expected, str):
+            raise ValueError(f"source {source_id} lacks a bound path or digest")
+        _add_bound_file(bound_files, path_value, expected, source_id)
+        for raw in descriptor.get("raw_sha256", ()):
+            _add_bound_file(bound_files, raw["path"], raw["sha256"], source_id)
+        provenance = descriptor.get("market_tail_provenance")
+        if provenance is not None:
+            _add_bound_file(bound_files, provenance["path"], provenance["sha256"], source_id)
+    identities = []
+    for path_value, expected in sorted(bound_files.items()):
+        observed = _sha256_file(Path(path_value))
+        if observed != expected:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"bound source digest mismatch: {path_value}")
+        identities.append({"path": path_value, "sha256": observed})
+    return f"sha256:{canonical_sha256({'files': identities})}"
+
+
+def _add_bound_file(bound_files: dict[str, str], path: Any, sha256: Any, source_id: str) -> None:
+    if not isinstance(path, str) or not isinstance(sha256, str):
+        raise ValueError(f"source {source_id} contains an invalid file identity")
+    prior = bound_files.setdefault(path, sha256)
+    if prior != sha256:
+        raise ValueError(f"source {source_id} assigns conflicting digests to {path}")
+
+
+def _load_json(path: Path, label: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    def pairs(items):
+        result = {}
+        for key, value in items:
+            if key in result:
+                raise ValueError(f"{label} contains duplicate JSON keys")
+            result[key] = value
+        return result
+
+    try:
+        payload = json.loads(
+            path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"),
+            object_pairs_hook=pairs,
+            parse_constant=lambda value: (_ for _ in ()).throw(ValueError(f"non-finite JSON constant: {value}")),
+        )
+    except (OSError, UnicodeError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
+        raise ValueError(f"cannot load {label}") from exc
+    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
+        raise ValueError(f"{label} must be a JSON object")
+    return payload
+
+
+def _plain_json(value: Any) -> Any:
+    if dataclasses.is_dataclass(value) and not isinstance(value, type):
+        return {field.name: _plain_json(getattr(value, field.name)) for field in dataclasses.fields(value)}
+    if isinstance(value, dict) or hasattr(value, "items"):
+        return {str(key): _plain_json(item) for key, item in value.items()}
+    if isinstance(value, tuple | list):
+        return [_plain_json(item) for item in value]
+    if isinstance(value, Enum):
+        return value.value
+    if isinstance(value, float) and not math.isfinite(value):
+        raise ValueError("artifact cannot contain non-finite numbers")
+    return value
+
+
+def _without_shadow_authority_fields(value: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    payload = _plain_json(value)
+    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
+        raise TypeError("shadow evidence row must serialize to an object")
+    payload.pop("blocks_order", None)
+    return payload
+
+
+def _reject_forbidden_authority_tokens(value: Any) -> None:
+    if isinstance(value, dict):
+        for key, item in value.items():
+            _reject_authority_token(key)
+            _reject_forbidden_authority_tokens(item)
+    elif isinstance(value, list | tuple):
+        for item in value:
+            _reject_forbidden_authority_tokens(item)
+    elif isinstance(value, str):
+        _reject_authority_token(value)
+
+
+def _reject_authority_token(value: Any) -> None:
+    if isinstance(value, str) and value.lower() in _FORBIDDEN_AUTHORITY_TOKENS:
+        raise ValueError(f"shadow artifact contains authority token: {value.lower()}")
+
+
+def _canonical_bytes(payload: dict[str, Any]) -> bytes:
+    return (
+        json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n"
+    ).encode("utf-8")
+
+
+def _write_artifacts_transactionally(payloads: dict[str, dict[str, Any]], output_dir: Path) -> tuple[Path, ...]:
+    if tuple(payloads) != _ARTIFACT_NAMES:
+        raise ValueError("artifact set is not canonical")
+    output_dir.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    try:
+        output_dir.mkdir()
+    except FileExistsError as exc:
+        raise FileExistsError("output directory already exists") from exc
+    _fsync_directory(output_dir.parent)
+    try:
+        artifact_hashes = {}
+        for name, payload in payloads.items():
+            path = output_dir / name
+            _write_canonical_file(path, payload)
+            artifact_hashes[name] = _sha256_file(path)
+        marker = {
+            "schema_version": "time-space-shadow-complete.v1",
+            "layer": "time_space_shadow",
+            "artifacts": artifact_hashes,
+        }
+        _write_canonical_file(output_dir / _COMPLETE_MARKER, marker)
+        _fsync_directory(output_dir)
+        _fsync_directory(output_dir.parent)
+        paths = validate_completed_output(output_dir)
+    except Exception:
+        shutil.rmtree(output_dir, ignore_errors=True)
+        _fsync_directory(output_dir.parent)
+        raise
+    return paths
+
+
+def _write_canonical_file(path: Path, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    with path.open("xb") as handle:
+        handle.write(_canonical_bytes(payload))
+        handle.flush()
+        os.fsync(handle.fileno())
+
+
+def validate_completed_output(output_dir: Path) -> tuple[Path, ...]:
+    marker_path = output_dir / _COMPLETE_MARKER
+    if not marker_path.is_file():
+        raise ValueError("time-space shadow output is incomplete")
+    marker = _load_json(marker_path, "completion marker")
+    if set(marker) != {"schema_version", "layer", "artifacts"} or (marker["schema_version"], marker["layer"]) != (
+        "time-space-shadow-complete.v1",
+        "time_space_shadow",
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("completion marker identity is invalid")
+    artifacts = marker["artifacts"]
+    if not isinstance(artifacts, dict) or set(artifacts) != set(_ARTIFACT_NAMES):
+        raise ValueError("completion marker artifact set is invalid")
+    expected_entries = set(_ARTIFACT_NAMES) | {_COMPLETE_MARKER}
+    if {path.name for path in output_dir.iterdir()} != expected_entries:
+        raise ValueError("completed output contains unexpected or missing files")
+    paths = tuple(output_dir / name for name in _ARTIFACT_NAMES)
+    for path in paths:
+        payload = _load_json(path, f"artifact {path.name}")
+        if path.read_bytes() != _canonical_bytes(payload) or _sha256_file(path) != artifacts[path.name]:
+            raise ValueError(f"completed artifact is invalid: {path.name}")
+    return paths
+
+
+def _fsync_directory(path: Path) -> None:
+    try:
+        descriptor = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY)
+    except OSError:
+        return
+    try:
+        os.fsync(descriptor)
+    except OSError:
+        pass
+    finally:
+        os.close(descriptor)
+
+
+def _sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as handle:
+        for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
+            digest.update(chunk)
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def _parse_args() -> RunArgs:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--hypothesis-manifest",
+        type=Path,
+        default=Path("config/research/time_space_shadow_hypothesis_v1.json"),
+    )
+    parser.add_argument("--execution-manifest", required=True, type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--registration-envelope", required=True, type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--frozen-export", required=True, type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--export-provenance", type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--export-checkpoint", type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--export-receipt", type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--as-of", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", required=True, type=Path)
+    return RunArgs(**vars(parser.parse_args()))
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    result = run_time_space_shadow(_parse_args())
+    print(result.attribution_path)
+    print(f"sha256={result.attribution_sha256}")
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Fail closed until independent GitHub workflow protection is pinned."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import sys
+from collections.abc import Sequence
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+CANONICAL_REPOSITORY = "infdahai/zenQuant"
+DEFAULT_BRANCH = "main"
+VERIFIED = "VERIFIED"
+PROTECTION_KEYS = {
+    "schema_version",
+    "layer",
+    "registration_status",
+    "remote_identity",
+    "default_branch",
+    "authority_type",
+    "authority_id",
+    "required_check",
+    "evidence_sha256",
+    "provider_observed_at_ns",
+}
+
+
+def validate_external_protection(path: Path) -> None:
+    """Require one canonical pin for externally enforced workflow authority."""
+
+    payload = _canonical_object(path)
+    if set(payload) != PROTECTION_KEYS:
+        raise ValueError("external workflow protection schema is incomplete")
+    if (
+        payload.get("schema_version") != "time-space-export-external-protection.v1"
+        or payload.get("layer") != "time_space_shadow"
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("external workflow protection identity is invalid")
+    if payload.get("remote_identity") != CANONICAL_REPOSITORY:
+        raise ValueError("external workflow protection is not pinned to the canonical repository")
+    if payload.get("default_branch") != DEFAULT_BRANCH:
+        raise ValueError("external workflow protection is not pinned to the default branch")
+    if payload.get("registration_status") != VERIFIED:
+        raise ValueError("external workflow protection is not VERIFIED")
+    if payload.get("authority_type") not in {"required_workflow", "branch_ruleset"}:
+        raise ValueError("external workflow protection authority type is invalid")
+    _positive_int(payload.get("authority_id"), "authority id")
+    required_check = payload.get("required_check")
+    if not isinstance(required_check, str) or not required_check or required_check.strip() != required_check:
+        raise ValueError("external workflow protection required check is invalid")
+    evidence_sha256 = payload.get("evidence_sha256")
+    if (
+        not isinstance(evidence_sha256, str)
+        or len(evidence_sha256) != 64
+        or any(character not in "0123456789abcdef" for character in evidence_sha256)
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("external workflow protection evidence digest is invalid")
+    _positive_int(payload.get("provider_observed_at_ns"), "provider observed timestamp")
+
+
+def _canonical_object(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    try:
+        content = Path(path).read_bytes()
+        payload = json.loads(content.decode("utf-8"))
+    except (OSError, UnicodeError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
+        raise ValueError("external workflow protection evidence is not JSON") from exc
+    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
+        raise ValueError("external workflow protection evidence must be an object")
+    canonical = (json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False) + "\n").encode()
+    if content != canonical:
+        raise ValueError("external workflow protection evidence bytes are not canonical")
+    return payload
+
+
+def _positive_int(value: Any, name: str) -> int:
+    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int) or value <= 0:
+        raise ValueError(f"external workflow protection {name} is invalid")
+    return value
+
+
+def _main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--config", required=True, type=Path)
+    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
+    try:
+        validate_external_protection(args.config)
+    except (OSError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
+        print(f"external workflow protection validation failed: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 1
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(_main())

+"""Validate one canonical, durable TimeSpace export registration transaction."""

+def validate_persisted_registration(
+    *,
+    checkpoint_path: Path,
+    receipt_path: Path,
+    trust_path: Path,
+    export_path: Path,
+    provenance_path: Path,
+    provider: dict[str, Any],
+    generator_provider: dict[str, Any],
+) -> None:
+    checkpoint, checkpoint_bytes = _canonical_object(checkpoint_path, "checkpoint")
+    receipt, receipt_bytes = _canonical_object(receipt_path, "receipt")
+    trust, _trust_bytes = _canonical_object(trust_path, "trust")
+    export, export_bytes = _canonical_object(export_path, "export")
+    provenance, provenance_bytes = _canonical_object(provenance_path, "provenance")
+    if set(checkpoint) != CHECKPOINT_KEYS or set(receipt) != RECEIPT_KEYS or set(trust) != TRUST_KEYS:
+        raise ValueError("checkpoint, receipt, or trust schema is incomplete")
+    if (
+        checkpoint.get("schema_version") != "time-space-export-checkpoint.v1"
+        or checkpoint.get("layer") != "time_space_shadow"
+        or checkpoint.get("registration_status") != "PENDING"
+        or checkpoint.get("receipt") is not None
+        or receipt.get("schema_version") != "time-space-export-registration-receipt.v1"
+        or trust.get("schema_version") != "time-space-export-registration-trust.v1"
+        or trust.get("layer") != "time_space_shadow"
+        or trust.get("registration_status") != "VERIFIED"
+        or export.get("schema_version") != "time-space-shadow-export.v1"
+        or export.get("layer") != "time_space_shadow"
+        or provenance.get("schema_version") != "time-space-shadow-export-provenance.v1"
+        or provenance.get("layer") != "time_space_shadow"
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("persisted registration identity is invalid")
+    if (
+        trust.get("remote_identity") != CANONICAL_REPOSITORY
+        or receipt.get("remote_identity") != CANONICAL_REPOSITORY
+        or provenance.get("repository_identity") != CANONICAL_REPOSITORY
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("persisted registration is not pinned to the canonical repository")
+    as_of_ns = _positive_int(checkpoint.get("as_of_ns"), "checkpoint as_of")
+    if export.get("as_of_ns") != as_of_ns or provenance.get("as_of_ns") != as_of_ns:
+        raise ValueError("persisted export cutoff does not match checkpoint")
+    export_sha = _payload_sha(export_bytes)
+    provenance_sha = _payload_sha(provenance_bytes)
+    source_slice_sha = _canonical_sha(provenance.get("source_files"))
+    manifest_sha = hashlib.sha256(checkpoint_bytes).hexdigest()
+    receipt_sha = hashlib.sha256(receipt_bytes).hexdigest()
+    if (
+        checkpoint.get("export_sha256") != export_sha
+        or checkpoint.get("provenance_sha256") != provenance_sha
+        or checkpoint.get("source_slice_sha256") != source_slice_sha
+        or receipt.get("manifest_sha256") != manifest_sha
+        or receipt.get("export_sha256") != export_sha
+        or receipt.get("provenance_sha256") != provenance_sha
+        or trust.get("checkpoint_manifest_sha256") != manifest_sha
+        or trust.get("receipt_artifact_sha256") != receipt_sha
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("persisted registration digest binding is invalid")
+    _validate_checkpoint_authority(receipt, trust, provider, as_of_ns)
+    _validate_generator_authority(receipt, trust, provenance, checkpoint, generator_provider, as_of_ns)
