+def _validate_checkpoint_authority(
+    receipt: dict[str, Any], trust: dict[str, Any], provider: dict[str, Any], as_of_ns: int
+) -> None:
+    workflow_id = _positive_int(trust.get("checkpoint_workflow_id"), "checkpoint workflow id")
+    artifact_id = _positive_int(trust.get("checkpoint_artifact_id"), "checkpoint artifact id")
+    provider_created = _nonnegative_int(trust.get("provider_created_at_ns"), "provider created at")
+    provider_run = _digits(trust.get("provider_run_id"), "provider run id")
+    commit = _sha(trust.get("commit_sha"), 40, "checkpoint commit")
+    expected_artifact_name = f"time-space-export-checkpoint-{as_of_ns}-{provider_run}"
+    if (
+        trust.get("remote_identity") != receipt.get("remote_identity")
+        or trust.get("checkpoint_workflow_path") != CHECKPOINT_WORKFLOW_PATH
+        or trust.get("checkpoint_branch") != CHECKPOINT_BRANCH
+        or trust.get("checkpoint_artifact_name") != expected_artifact_name
+        or receipt.get("provider_run_id") != provider_run
+        or receipt.get("provider_created_at_ns") != provider_created
+        or receipt.get("commit_sha") != commit
+        or receipt.get("workflow") != {"id": workflow_id, "path": CHECKPOINT_WORKFLOW_PATH}
+        or receipt.get("event") != "push"
+        or receipt.get("ref") != f"refs/heads/{CHECKPOINT_BRANCH}"
+        or receipt.get("artifact") != {"id": artifact_id, "name": expected_artifact_name}
+        or provider.get("id") != int(provider_run)
+        or provider.get("head_sha") != commit
+        or provider.get("conclusion") != "success"
+        or provider.get("event") != "push"
+        or provider.get("head_branch") != CHECKPOINT_BRANCH
+        or provider.get("path") != CHECKPOINT_WORKFLOW_PATH
+        or provider.get("workflow_id") != workflow_id
+        or _provider_created_at_ns(provider.get("created_at")) != provider_created
+        or not isinstance(provider.get("repository"), dict)
+        or provider["repository"].get("full_name") != CANONICAL_REPOSITORY
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("persisted trust checkpoint provider fields are not fully bound")
+
+
+def _validate_generator_authority(
+    receipt: dict[str, Any],
+    trust: dict[str, Any],
+    provenance: dict[str, Any],
+    checkpoint: dict[str, Any],
+    provider: dict[str, Any],
+    as_of_ns: int,
+) -> None:
+    workflow_id = _positive_int(trust.get("generator_workflow_id"), "generator workflow id")
+    artifact_id = _positive_int(trust.get("generator_artifact_id"), "generator artifact id")
+    _nonnegative_int(trust.get("generator_created_at_ns"), "generator created at")
+    generator_run = _digits(trust.get("generator_provider_run_id"), "generator provider run id")
+    generator_commit = _sha(trust.get("generator_commit_sha"), 40, "generator commit")
+    generator_branch = trust.get("generator_branch")
+    if not isinstance(generator_branch, str) or not generator_branch or generator_branch.strip() != generator_branch:
+        raise ValueError("persisted trust generator branch is invalid")
+    expected_name = f"time-space-export-{as_of_ns}-{generator_run}"
+    generator_artifact = receipt.get("generator_artifact")
+    if (
+        trust.get("generator_workflow_path") != GENERATOR_WORKFLOW_PATH
+        or trust.get("generator_event") != GENERATOR_EVENT
+        or trust.get("generator_artifact_name") != expected_name
+        or provenance.get("repository_identity") != trust.get("remote_identity")
+        or provenance.get("commit_sha") != generator_commit
+        or provenance.get("provider_run_id") != generator_run
+        or checkpoint.get("generator_provider_run_id") != generator_run
+        or not isinstance(generator_artifact, dict)
+        or generator_artifact.get("id") != artifact_id
+        or generator_artifact.get("name") != expected_name
+        or generator_artifact.get("export_sha256") != checkpoint.get("export_sha256")
+        or generator_artifact.get("provenance_sha256") != checkpoint.get("provenance_sha256")
+        or generator_artifact.get("source_slice_sha256") != checkpoint.get("source_slice_sha256")
+        or provider.get("id") != int(generator_run)
+        or provider.get("head_sha") != generator_commit
+        or provider.get("conclusion") != "success"
+        or provider.get("event") != GENERATOR_EVENT
+        or provider.get("head_branch") != generator_branch
+        or provider.get("path") != GENERATOR_WORKFLOW_PATH
+        or provider.get("workflow_id") != workflow_id
+        or _provider_created_at_ns(provider.get("created_at")) != trust.get("generator_created_at_ns")
+        or not isinstance(provider.get("repository"), dict)
+        or provider["repository"].get("full_name") != CANONICAL_REPOSITORY
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("persisted trust generator provider fields are not fully bound")
+
+
+def _canonical_object(path: Path, name: str) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], bytes]:
+    content = Path(path).read_bytes()
+    try:
+        value = json.loads(content.decode("utf-8"))
+    except (UnicodeError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
+        raise ValueError(f"persisted {name} is not JSON") from exc
+    if not isinstance(value, dict):
+        raise ValueError(f"persisted {name} must be an object")
+    canonical = (json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False) + "\n").encode()
+    if content != canonical:
+        raise ValueError(f"persisted {name} bytes are not canonical")
+    return value, content
+
+
+def _json_object(path: Path, name: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    try:
+        value = json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    except (OSError, UnicodeError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} provider payload is not JSON") from exc
+    if not isinstance(value, dict):
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} provider payload must be an object")
+    return value
+
+
+def _provider_created_at_ns(value: Any) -> int:
+    if not isinstance(value, str):
+        raise ValueError("provider created_at is invalid")
+    try:
+        parsed = datetime.strptime(value, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ").replace(tzinfo=UTC)
+    except ValueError as exc:
+        raise ValueError("provider created_at is invalid") from exc
+    return int(parsed.timestamp()) * 1_000_000_000
+
+
+def _payload_sha(content: bytes) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(content[:-1]).hexdigest()
+
+
+def _canonical_sha(value: Any) -> str:
+    encoded = json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False).encode()
+    return hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest()
+
+
+def _positive_int(value: Any, name: str) -> int:
+    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int) or value <= 0:
+        raise ValueError(f"persisted trust {name} is invalid")
+    return value
+
+
+def _nonnegative_int(value: Any, name: str) -> int:
+    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int) or value < 0:
+        raise ValueError(f"persisted trust {name} is invalid")
+    return value
+
+
+def _digits(value: Any, name: str) -> str:
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.isdigit() or value.startswith("0"):
+        raise ValueError(f"persisted trust {name} is invalid")
+    return value
+
+
+def _sha(value: Any, length: int, name: str) -> str:
+    if (
+        not isinstance(value, str)
+        or len(value) != length
+        or any(character not in "0123456789abcdef" for character in value)
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(f"persisted trust {name} is invalid")
+    return value
+
+
+def _main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--checkpoint", required=True, type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--receipt", required=True, type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--trust", required=True, type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--export", required=True, type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--provenance", required=True, type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--provider-run-json", required=True, type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--generator-provider-run-json", required=True, type=Path)
+    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
+    try:
+        validate_persisted_registration(
+            checkpoint_path=args.checkpoint,
+            receipt_path=args.receipt,
+            trust_path=args.trust,
+            export_path=args.export,
+            provenance_path=args.provenance,
+            provider=_json_object(args.provider_run_json, "checkpoint"),
+            generator_provider=_json_object(args.generator_provider_run_json, "generator"),
+        )
+    except (OSError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
+        print(f"persisted registration trust validation failed: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 1
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(_main())

+"""Validate append-only TimeSpace registration changes across one complete push."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import re
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from collections.abc import Sequence
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Literal
+
+REGISTRATION_ROOT = "config/research/registrations/time_space_exports"
+CHECKPOINT_NAME = "time_space_shadow_export_checkpoint_v1.json"
+RECEIPT_NAME = "time_space_export_registration_receipt_v1.json"
+TRUST_NAME = "time_space_export_registration_trust_v1.json"
+EXPORT_NAME = "time_space_shadow_export.json"
+PROVENANCE_NAME = "time_space_shadow_export_provenance.json"
+FOUR_HOURS_NS = 4 * 60 * 60 * 1_000_000_000
+_SHA_PATTERN = re.compile(r"[0-9a-f]{40}")
+_PROTECTED_ENFORCEMENT_PATHS = (
+    ".github/workflows/time-space-export-checkpoint.yml",
+    ".github/workflows/time-space-export-generate.yml",
+    ".github/workflows/time-space-export-persist.yml",
+    ".github/workflows/time-space-export-receipt.yml",
+    "config/research/time_space_export_external_protection_v1.json",
+    "config/research/time_space_export_registration_trust_v1.json",
+    "scripts/build_time_space_export_receipt.py",
+    "scripts/validate_time_space_external_protection.py",
+    "scripts/validate_time_space_persisted_registration.py",
+    "scripts/validate_time_space_registration_push.py",
+    "zenquant/research/time_space_export.py",
+)
+
+
+def validate_registration_push(
+    repository: Path,
+    *,
+    before: str,
+    after: str,
+    phase: Literal["checkpoint", "persist"],
+) -> dict[str, str]:
+    """Return exact new registration paths or reject the complete push range."""
+
+    root = Path(repository).resolve()
+    _validate_commit(root, before, "before")
+    _validate_commit(root, after, "after")
+    _validate_append_only_history(root, before, after)
+    changes = _registration_changes(root, before, after)
+    if not changes:
+        raise ValueError("append-only registration push contains no registration changes")
+    rewritten = [(status, path) for status, path in changes if status != "A"]
+    if rewritten:
+        status, path = rewritten[0]
+        raise ValueError(f"registration tree is append-only; observed {status} for {path}")
+    added = [path for _status, path in changes]
+    if phase == "checkpoint":
+        return _validate_checkpoint_addition(root, before, added)
+    return _validate_persist_additions(root, before, added)
+
+
+def _validate_commit(repository: Path, value: str, label: str) -> None:
+    if value == "0" * 40:
+        raise ValueError(f"append-only {label} baseline is unavailable")
+    if _SHA_PATTERN.fullmatch(value) is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"append-only {label} commit is invalid")
+    _git(repository, "cat-file", "-e", f"{value}^{{commit}}")
+
+
+def _registration_changes(repository: Path, before: str, after: str) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
+    output = _git(
+        repository,
+        "diff",
+        "--name-status",
+        "--no-renames",
+        before,
+        after,
+        "--",
+        REGISTRATION_ROOT,
+    )
+    changes: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
+    for line in output.splitlines():
+        parts = line.split("\t")
+        if len(parts) != 2:
+            raise ValueError("append-only registration diff is malformed")
+        changes.append((parts[0], parts[1]))
+    return changes
+
+
+def _validate_append_only_history(repository: Path, before: str, after: str) -> None:
+    try:
+        _git(repository, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", before, after)
+    except subprocess.CalledProcessError as exc:
+        raise ValueError("append-only registration push must extend its exact before commit") from exc
+    commits = _git(repository, "rev-list", "--reverse", f"{before}..{after}").splitlines()
+    if not commits:
+        raise ValueError("append-only registration push contains no new commits")
+    for commit in commits:
+        commit_and_parents = _git(repository, "rev-list", "--parents", "-n", "1", commit).split()
+        if len(commit_and_parents) != 2:
+            raise ValueError("append-only registration push history must be linear")
+        parent = commit_and_parents[1]
+        protected_changes = _git(
+            repository,
+            "diff",
+            "--name-only",
+            parent,
+            commit,
+            "--",
+            *_PROTECTED_ENFORCEMENT_PATHS,
+        )
+        if protected_changes:
+            raise ValueError(f"protected registration enforcement changed: {protected_changes.splitlines()[0]}")
+        for status, path in _registration_changes(repository, parent, commit):
+            if status != "A":
+                raise ValueError(f"registration tree is append-only; observed {status} for {path}")
+
+
+def _validate_checkpoint_addition(repository: Path, before: str, added: list[str]) -> dict[str, str]:
+    if len(added) != 1:
+        raise ValueError("checkpoint push must add exactly one registration manifest")
+    path = added[0]
+    cutoff, directory = _registration_path(path, CHECKPOINT_NAME)
+    if _git(repository, "ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", before, "--", directory):
+        raise ValueError("checkpoint push cannot add to an existing registration cutoff")
+    return {"CHECKPOINT_MANIFEST": path, "CHECKPOINT_CUTOFF": str(cutoff)}
+
+
+def _validate_persist_additions(repository: Path, before: str, added: list[str]) -> dict[str, str]:
+    if len(added) != 4:
+        raise ValueError("persist push must add exactly receipt, trust, export, and provenance")
+    receipt_paths = [path for path in added if path.endswith(f"/{RECEIPT_NAME}")]
+    trust_paths = [path for path in added if path.endswith(f"/{TRUST_NAME}")]
+    export_paths = [path for path in added if path.endswith(f"/{EXPORT_NAME}")]
+    provenance_paths = [path for path in added if path.endswith(f"/{PROVENANCE_NAME}")]
+    if any(len(paths) != 1 for paths in (receipt_paths, trust_paths, export_paths, provenance_paths)):
+        raise ValueError("persist push additions are not the exact durable registration transaction")
+    receipt = receipt_paths[0]
+    trust = trust_paths[0]
+    export = export_paths[0]
+    provenance = provenance_paths[0]
+    cutoff, directory = _registration_path(receipt, RECEIPT_NAME)
+    trust_cutoff, trust_directory = _registration_path(trust, TRUST_NAME)
+    export_cutoff, export_directory = _registration_path(export, EXPORT_NAME)
+    provenance_cutoff, provenance_directory = _registration_path(provenance, PROVENANCE_NAME)
+    if (
+        len(
+            {
+                (cutoff, directory),
+                (trust_cutoff, trust_directory),
+                (export_cutoff, export_directory),
+                (provenance_cutoff, provenance_directory),
+            }
+        )
+        != 1
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("persisted registration artifacts do not share one cutoff")
+    checkpoint = f"{directory}/{CHECKPOINT_NAME}"
+    _git(repository, "cat-file", "-e", f"{before}:{checkpoint}")
+    prior_paths = _git(repository, "ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", before, "--", directory).splitlines()
+    if prior_paths != [checkpoint]:
+        raise ValueError("persist push requires one previously registered immutable checkpoint")
+    return {
+        "REGISTRATION_CHECKPOINT": checkpoint,
+        "REGISTRATION_RECEIPT": receipt,
+        "REGISTRATION_TRUST": trust,
+        "REGISTRATION_EXPORT": export,
+        "REGISTRATION_PROVENANCE": provenance,
+    }
+
+
+def _registration_path(path: str, expected_name: str) -> tuple[int, str]:
+    pattern = re.compile(rf"{re.escape(REGISTRATION_ROOT)}/([1-9][0-9]*)/{re.escape(expected_name)}")
+    match = pattern.fullmatch(path)
+    if match is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"registration path is not canonical: {path}")
+    cutoff = int(match.group(1))
+    if cutoff % FOUR_HOURS_NS:
+        raise ValueError("registration cutoff is not on the confirmed 4h grid")
+    return cutoff, path.rsplit("/", 1)[0]
+
+
+def _git(repository: Path, *args: str) -> str:
+    result = subprocess.run(
+        ["git", "-C", str(repository), *args],
+        check=True,
+        capture_output=True,
+        text=True,
+    )
+    return result.stdout.strip()
+
+
+def _main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--repository", type=Path, default=Path.cwd())
+    parser.add_argument("--before", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--after", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--phase", choices=("checkpoint", "persist"), required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--github-env", type=Path)
+    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
+    try:
+        values = validate_registration_push(
+            args.repository,
+            before=args.before,
+            after=args.after,
+            phase=args.phase,
+        )
+        if args.github_env is not None:
+            with args.github_env.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
+                for name, value in values.items():
+                    handle.write(f"{name}={value}\n")
+    except (OSError, subprocess.CalledProcessError, ValueError) as exc:
+        print(f"append-only registration validation failed: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 1
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(_main())

+def _write_kernel_fixture(root: Path, *, fee_operator: str = "+") -> None:
+    domain = root / "zenquant/domain"
+    risk = root / "zenquant/risk"
+    execution = root / "zenquant/execution"
+    domain.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    risk.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    execution.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    (domain / "accounting.py").write_text(
+        "def validate_execution_fee(fee):\n"
+        "    if fee < 0:\n"
+        "        raise ValueError('fee')\n\n"
+        "def execution_report_identity(report):\n"
+        "    return report.symbol, report.client_order_id, report.transaction_time_ns\n",
+        encoding="utf-8",
+    )
+    (risk / "guard.py").write_text(
+        "class RiskOverlay:\n"
+        "    def __init__(self, bus, starting_equity):\n"
+        "        self._bus = bus\n"
+        "        self._cash = starting_equity\n"
+        "        self._bus.subscribe('exec.order.report', self._on_execution_report)\n\n"
+        "    def _on_mark_price(self, payload):\n"
+        "        self._last_price[payload.symbol] = payload.mark_price\n"
+        "        self._revalue_equity()\n\n"
+        "    def prime_indicator(self, pack):\n"
+        "        self._last_price[pack.symbol] = pack.last_price\n"
+        "        self._revalue_equity()\n\n"
+        "    def _on_execution_report(self, payload):\n"
+        "        return self.apply_execution_report(payload)\n\n"
+        "    def apply_execution_report(self, payload):\n"
+        f"        self._cash = self._cash - payload.notional {fee_operator} payload.fee\n"
+        "        self._revalue_equity()\n\n"
+        "    def apply_fee(self, fee):\n"
+        "        self._cash -= fee\n"
+        "        self._revalue_equity()\n\n"
+        "    def _revalue_equity(self):\n"
+        "        self._equity = self._cash + sum(self._positions.values())\n",
+        encoding="utf-8",
+    )
+    (execution / "router.py").write_text(
+        "class ExecutionKernel:\n"
+        "    def __init__(self, bus):\n"
+        "        self._bus = bus\n"
+        "        self._bus.subscribe('intent.target_position.final.>', self._on_target)\n\n"
+        "    def _on_target(self, report):\n"
+        "        self._apply_report_accounting(report)\n\n"
+        "    def _apply_report_accounting(self, report):\n"
+        "        self._risk_overlay.apply_execution_report(report)\n",
+        encoding="utf-8",
+    )

+def _write_daily_range_csv(path: Path, open_times_ns: tuple[int, ...]) -> None:
+    pd.DataFrame(
+        {
+            "open_time": [value // 1_000_000 for value in open_times_ns],

 from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
 from pathlib import Path

 from zenquant.data.deribit_block_flow import DeribitBlockFlowRow, save_block_flow_rows, write_deribit_block_flow_status

@@ -33,6 +35,40 @@ def _ts(year: int, month: int, day: int, hour: int) -> int:
     return int(datetime(year, month, day, hour, tzinfo=UTC).timestamp() * 1_000_000_000)
 
 
+DAY_NS = 86_400_000_000_000
+TREND_WARMUP_START_NS = _ts(2025, 10, 8, 0)
+TREND_REUSED_START_NS = _ts(2026, 1, 1, 0)
+TREND_REUSED_END_NS = _ts(2026, 8, 24, 0)
+
+
+def _write_trend_spot(
+    path: Path,
+    *,
+    missing_open_ns: tuple[int, ...] = (),
+    duplicate_open_ns: int | None = None,
+    post_end_count: int = 0,
+    pre_start_count: int = 0,
+    close: float = 100_000.0,
+) -> Path:
+    opens = [
+        value for value in range(TREND_WARMUP_START_NS, TREND_REUSED_END_NS, DAY_NS) if value not in missing_open_ns
+    ]
+    opens.extend(TREND_REUSED_END_NS + index * DAY_NS for index in range(post_end_count))
+    opens.extend(TREND_WARMUP_START_NS - (index + 1) * DAY_NS for index in range(pre_start_count))
+    if duplicate_open_ns is not None:
+        opens.append(duplicate_open_ns)
+    frame = pd.DataFrame(
+        {
+            "open_time_ns": opens,
+            "close_time_ns": [value + DAY_NS - 1 for value in opens],
+            "close": [close] * len(opens),
+        }
+    )
+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    frame.to_parquet(path, index=False)
+    return path
+

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import importlib.util
+import json
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pytest

+from zenquant.research.legacy_accounting_validity import InvalidPerformanceEvidenceError
+
+GOVERNANCE_FIELDS = {
+    "ledger_formula_hash": "sha256:" + "c" * 64,
+    "decision_at": "2026-08-23T00:00:00Z",
+    "approving_decision": "legacy-accounting-integrity-plan-task-3",
+}

+
+def _load_rescore_script():
+    path = Path("scripts/run_gate_v2_rescore.py")
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("gate_v2_rescore_validity_script", path)
+    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"unable to load {path}")
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    sys.modules[spec.name] = module
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+

+def test_august_candidate_is_rejected_before_parameter_json_load(
+    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
+) -> None:
+    script = _load_rescore_script()
+    source = Path("results/remediation_20260821/train_dev_smoke_daily_switch_policy/framework_optimization.json")
+    absolute_source = tmp_path / source
+    absolute_source.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
+    source_bytes = b'{"parameters":"must not be parsed"}'
+    absolute_source.write_bytes(source_bytes)
+    manifest = tmp_path / "manifest.json"
+    manifest.write_text(
+        json.dumps(
+            {
+                "candidates": [
+                    {
+                        "name": "august_rank1",
+                        "kind": "ranked_params",
+                        "source": str(source),
+                        "selector": "train_candidate_diagnostics.top_train_trial_diagnostics",
+                        "rank": 1,
+                    }
+                ]
+            }
+        ),
+        encoding="utf-8",
+    )
+    registry = tmp_path / "registry.json"
+    registry.write_text(
+        json.dumps(
+            {
+                "schema_version": "legacy-accounting-validity.v1",
+                "records": [
+                    {
+                        "artifact_path": source.as_posix(),
+                        "source_sha256": hashlib.sha256(source_bytes).hexdigest(),
+                        "selector": "train_candidate_diagnostics.top_train_trial_diagnostics[0].params",
+                        "state": "CONFIRMED_AFFECTED",
+                        "reason": "legacy_fee_cash_floor_can_create_equity",
+                        "metric_families": ["promotion_gate"],
+                        "stages": ["A0"],
+                        "superseding_artifact": None,
+                        **GOVERNANCE_FIELDS,
+                    }
+                ],
+            }
+        ),
+        encoding="utf-8",
+    )
+    real_read_json = script._read_json
+
+    def guarded_read_json(path: Path):
+        if path == absolute_source.resolve():
+            pytest.fail("candidate parameter JSON was loaded before validity rejection")
+        return real_read_json(path)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(script, "_read_json", guarded_read_json)
+    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
+
+    with pytest.raises(InvalidPerformanceEvidenceError, match="CONFIRMED_AFFECTED"):
+        script.load_candidate_manifest(
+            manifest,
+            validity_registry_path=registry,
+            repository_root=tmp_path,
+        )
+

+def _write_ranked_source(tmp_path: Path) -> tuple[Path, bytes]:
+    source = tmp_path / "ranked.json"
+    source_bytes = json.dumps(
+        {
+            "train_candidate_diagnostics": {
+                "top_train_trial_diagnostics": [
+                    {"params": {"max_leverage": 1.0}},
+                    {"params": {"max_leverage": 2.0}},
+                ]
+            }
+        }
+    ).encode("utf-8")
+    source.write_bytes(source_bytes)
+    return source, source_bytes
+
+
+def _write_manifest(tmp_path: Path, *, source: str, rank: int) -> Path:
+    manifest = tmp_path / f"manifest-{rank}.json"
+    manifest.write_text(
+        json.dumps(
+            {
+                "candidates": [
+                    {
+                        "name": f"rank-{rank}",
+                        "kind": "ranked_params",
+                        "source": source,
+                        "selector": "train_candidate_diagnostics.top_train_trial_diagnostics",
+                        "rank": rank,
+                    }
+                ]
+            }
+        ),
+        encoding="utf-8",
+    )
+    return manifest
+
+
+def _write_registry(tmp_path: Path, *, artifact_path: str, source_sha256: str, records: list[dict]) -> Path:
+    registry = tmp_path / "registry.json"
+    registry.write_text(
+        json.dumps(
+            {
+                "schema_version": "legacy-accounting-validity.v1",
+                "records": [
+                    {
+                        "artifact_path": artifact_path,
+                        "source_sha256": source_sha256,
+                        "reason": "reviewed",
+                        "metric_families": ["promotion_gate"],
+                        "stages": ["A0"],
+                        "superseding_artifact": None,
+                        **GOVERNANCE_FIELDS,
+                        **record,
+                    }
+                    for record in records
+                ],
+            }
+        ),
+        encoding="utf-8",
+    )
+    return registry
+

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("alias_kind", ["dotdot", "symlink", "copy"])
+def test_governed_candidate_cannot_bypass_policy_through_path_alias(
+    tmp_path: Path,
+    alias_kind: str,
+) -> None:
+    source, source_bytes = _write_ranked_source(tmp_path)
+    governed_path = source
+    candidate_path: Path
+    if alias_kind == "dotdot":
+        candidate_path = source.parent / "alias" / ".." / source.name
+    elif alias_kind == "symlink":
+        candidate_path = tmp_path / "alias.json"
+        candidate_path.symlink_to(source)
+    else:
+        candidate_path = tmp_path / "copy.json"
+        candidate_path.write_bytes(source_bytes)
+    registry = _write_registry(
+        tmp_path,
+        artifact_path=str(governed_path),
+        source_sha256=hashlib.sha256(source_bytes).hexdigest(),
+        records=[
+            {
+                "selector": "train_candidate_diagnostics.top_train_trial_diagnostics[0].params",
+                "state": "CONFIRMED_AFFECTED",
+            }
+        ],
+    )
+
+    with pytest.raises(InvalidPerformanceEvidenceError, match="CONFIRMED_AFFECTED"):
+        _load_rescore_script().load_candidate_manifest(
+            _write_manifest(tmp_path, source=str(candidate_path), rank=1),
+            validity_registry_path=registry,
+        )

+def _resolve_from_import_targets(filepath: Path, node: ast.ImportFrom, *, project_root: Path) -> list[str]:
+    """Return absolute module targets for an AST ``from`` import and its aliases."""
+    try:
+        relative_path = filepath.relative_to(project_root).with_suffix("")
+    except ValueError:
+        return []
+    package_parts = list(relative_path.parts[:-1])
+    if node.level:
+        prefix_length = len(package_parts) - node.level + 1
+        if prefix_length < 1:
+            return []
+        target_parts = package_parts[:prefix_length]
+    else:
+        target_parts = []
+    if node.module:
+        target_parts.extend(node.module.split("."))
+    targets = [".".join(target_parts)] if target_parts else []
+    targets.extend(".".join([*target_parts, alias.name]) for alias in node.names if alias.name != "*")
+    return targets
+

+def _complete_raw_report(
+    *,
+    direction_hit_rate: float = 0.6,
+    a1_sign_15bp: float = 105.0,
+    regime_localized_seed_count: int = 5,
+) -> dict[str, object]:
+    """Build a complete frozen matrix from the checked-in manifest.
+
+    The stage payloads are intentionally literal rather than borrowed from
+    another test module: this fixture tests the envelope, not strategy logic.
+    """
+    manifest = load_architecture_experiment_manifest()
+    stage_order = [stage.value for stage in ArchitectureStage]
+    runs: list[dict[str, object]] = []
+    for window in manifest.windows:
+        for seed in manifest.seeds:
+            runs.append(
+                {
+                    "window": window.label,
+                    "start_ns": window.start_ns,
+                    "end_ns": window.end_ns,
+                    "seed": seed,
+                    "identities": {
+                        "formula_hashes": ["formula-v1"],
+                        "alpha_config_hashes": ["alpha-v1"],
+                    },
+                    "stages": {
+                        stage: (
+                            _cost_stage(
+                                stage,
+                                include_episodes=stage
+                                in {
+                                    ArchitectureStage.A2.value,
+                                    ArchitectureStage.A3.value,
+                                    ArchitectureStage.A4.value,
+                                    ArchitectureStage.A5_SHADOW.value,
+                                },
+                                include_execution=stage
+                                in {
+                                    ArchitectureStage.A2.value,
+                                    ArchitectureStage.A3.value,
+                                    ArchitectureStage.A4.value,
+                                    ArchitectureStage.A5_SHADOW.value,
+                                },
+                            )
+                            if stage != ArchitectureStage.A0.value
+                            else {"stage": stage, "literal": True}
+                        )
+                        for stage in stage_order
+                    },
+                }
+            )
+    report: dict[str, object] = {
+        "schema_version": "architecture_attribution.v4",
+        "stages": stage_order,
+        "manifest": {
+            "sha256": manifest.sha256,
+            "candidate_source_sha256": manifest.candidate_source_sha256,
+            "candidate_params_sha256": manifest.candidate_params_sha256,
+            "profile_sha256": manifest.profile_sha256,
+            "windows": [
+                {
+                    "label": window.label,
+                    "start_ns": window.start_ns,
+                    "end_ns": window.end_ns,
+                    "role": window.role,
+                }
+                for window in manifest.windows
+            ],
+            "seeds": list(manifest.seeds),
+            "cost_stress_bps": list(manifest.cost_stress_bps),
+        },
+        "runs": runs,
+    }
+    late_dev_runs = [run for run in runs if run["window"] == "late_dev_2025"]
+    for index, run in enumerate(late_dev_runs):
+        a1_sign = run["stages"][ArchitectureStage.A1_SIGN.value]  # type: ignore[index]
+        a1_sign["direction_hit_rate"] = direction_hit_rate
+        a1_sign["cost_stress"]["15"]["net_pnl"] = a1_sign_15bp
+        a1_sign["turnover_notional"] = (120.0 - a1_sign_15bp) * 10_000.0 / 15.0
+        if index >= regime_localized_seed_count:
+            a5_rows = run["stages"][ArchitectureStage.A5_SHADOW.value]["attribution_rows"]  # type: ignore[index]
+            a5_rows[1]["gross_pnl"] = -20.0
+    return report
+
+
+def _build(report: dict[str, object]) -> dict[str, object]:
+    return build_late_dev_cost_attribution(
+        report,
+        source_artifact="architecture_attribution.json",
+        source_sha256="a" * 64,
+        source_size_bytes=123,
+    )
+
+

+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("field", "expected_error"),
+    [
+        ("stage_turnover", "turnover"),
+        ("attribution_cost", "execution cost"),
+        ("episode_count", "fill_count"),
+        ("episode_duration", "holding_duration"),
+        ("run_duration", "duration"),
+        ("filled_qty", "filled quantity"),
+        ("actual_fee", "actual fee"),
+        ("actual_slippage", "actual slippage"),
+        ("actual_shortfall", "implementation shortfall"),
+        ("switch_cadence", "position switches"),
+        ("estimated_fee", "estimated fee"),
+        ("breakeven", "breakeven"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_diagnostic_nonnegative_domains_fail_closed(field: str, expected_error: str):
+    report = _complete_raw_report()
+    late_dev = next(run for run in report["runs"] if run["window"] == "late_dev_2025")  # type: ignore[index]
+    a2 = late_dev["stages"][ArchitectureStage.A2.value]  # type: ignore[index]
+    a5 = late_dev["stages"][ArchitectureStage.A5_SHADOW.value]  # type: ignore[index]
+    if field == "stage_turnover":
+        a2["turnover_notional"] = -1.0
+    elif field == "attribution_cost":
+        a2["attribution_rows"][0]["baseline_execution_cost"] = -1.0
+    elif field == "episode_count":
+        a2["position_episodes"][0]["fill_count"] = -1
+    elif field == "episode_duration":
+        a2["position_episodes"][0]["holding_duration_ns"] = -1
+    elif field == "run_duration":
+        late_dev["end_ns"] = late_dev["start_ns"]
+    elif field == "filled_qty":
+        a2["attribution_rows"][0]["execution"]["filled_qty"] = -1.0
+    elif field == "actual_fee":
+        a2["attribution_rows"][0]["execution"]["fee"] = -1.0
+    elif field == "actual_slippage":
+        a2["attribution_rows"][0]["execution"]["actual_slippage"] = -1.0
+    elif field == "actual_shortfall":
+        a2["attribution_rows"][0]["execution"]["actual_implementation_shortfall"] = -1.0
+    elif field == "switch_cadence":
+        a2["execution_metrics"]["position_switches_per_day"] = -1.0
+    elif field == "estimated_fee":
+        a5["attribution_rows"][0]["cost_shadow"]["estimated_fee"] = -1.0
+    elif field == "breakeven":
+        a5["attribution_rows"][0]["cost_shadow"]["breakeven_move"] = -1.0
+
+    with pytest.raises(LateDevAttributionValidationError, match=expected_error):
+        _build(report)
+

+def test_cli_read_input_hashes_and_decodes_the_same_single_byte_sequence(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch):
+    """The source identity must describe precisely the bytes decoded into the report."""
+    cli_module = _load_cli_module()
+    source_bytes = json.dumps(_complete_raw_report()).encode("utf-8")
+    calls = 0
+
+    def read_bytes_once(_: Path) -> bytes:
+        nonlocal calls
+        calls += 1
+        return source_bytes
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(Path, "read_bytes", read_bytes_once)
+
+    report, source_sha256, source_size_bytes = cli_module._read_input(Path("ignored-by-controlled-read.json"))
+
+    assert calls == 1
+    assert report == json.loads(source_bytes)
+    assert source_sha256 == hashlib.sha256(source_bytes).hexdigest()
+    assert source_size_bytes == len(source_bytes)
+
+
+def test_cli_atomic_publish_cleans_partial_temp_file_after_write_error(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch):
+    """A failed temp write must not leave a partial artifact beside a report."""
+    cli_module = _load_cli_module()
+    original_write_bytes = Path.write_bytes
+
+    def write_partial_temp_then_fail(path: Path, content: bytes) -> int:
+        if path.suffix == ".tmp":
+            original_write_bytes(path, b"partial")
+            raise OSError("simulated partial temporary write")
+        return original_write_bytes(path, content)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(Path, "write_bytes", write_partial_temp_then_fail)
+
+    with pytest.raises(OSError, match="partial temporary write"):
+        cli_module._publish_atomically(tmp_path / "out", {"late_dev_cost_attribution.json": b"complete"})
+
+    assert not list((tmp_path / "out").glob("*.tmp"))
+
+
+def test_cli_publication_rolls_back_first_replace_when_second_replace_fails(
+    tmp_path: Path,
+    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
+):
+    cli_module = _load_cli_module()
+    output_dir = tmp_path / "out"
+    output_dir.mkdir()
+    report_path = output_dir / "late_dev_cost_attribution.json"
+    markdown_path = output_dir / "late_dev_cost_attribution.md"
+    report_path.write_bytes(b"old-json")
+    original_replace = Path.replace
+    replace_calls = 0
+
+    def fail_second_replace(path: Path, target: Path) -> Path:
+        nonlocal replace_calls
+        if path.suffix == ".tmp":
+            replace_calls += 1
+            if replace_calls == 2:
+                raise OSError("simulated second replace failure")
+        return original_replace(path, target)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(Path, "replace", fail_second_replace)
+
+    with pytest.raises(OSError, match="second replace failure"):
+        cli_module._publish_atomically(
+            output_dir,
+            {
+                "late_dev_cost_attribution.json": b"new-json",
+                "late_dev_cost_attribution.md": b"new-markdown",
+            },
+        )
+
+    assert report_path.read_bytes() == b"old-json"
+    assert not markdown_path.exists()
+    assert not list(output_dir.glob("*.tmp"))
+
+
+def test_cli_publication_rolls_back_reports_when_stale_hypothesis_unlink_fails(
+    tmp_path: Path,
+    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
+):
+    cli_module = _load_cli_module()
+    output_dir = tmp_path / "out"
+    output_dir.mkdir()
+    previous = {
+        "late_dev_cost_attribution.json": b"old-json",
+        "late_dev_cost_attribution.md": b"old-markdown",
+        "regime_objective_redesign_from_late_dev.json": b"old-hypothesis",
+    }
+    for filename, content in previous.items():
+        (output_dir / filename).write_bytes(content)
+    original_unlink = Path.unlink
+
+    def fail_stale_hypothesis_unlink(path: Path, missing_ok: bool = False) -> None:
+        if path.name == "regime_objective_redesign_from_late_dev.json":
+            raise OSError("simulated stale hypothesis unlink failure")
+        original_unlink(path, missing_ok=missing_ok)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(Path, "unlink", fail_stale_hypothesis_unlink)
+
+    with pytest.raises(OSError, match="stale hypothesis unlink failure"):
+        cli_module._publish_atomically(
+            output_dir,
+            {
+                "late_dev_cost_attribution.json": b"new-json",
+                "late_dev_cost_attribution.md": b"new-markdown",
+            },
+        )
+
+    assert {filename: (output_dir / filename).read_bytes() for filename in previous} == previous
+    assert not list(output_dir.glob("*.tmp"))
+

+def _canonical_sha256(payload: object) -> str:
+    encoded = json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")
+    return f"sha256:{hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest()}"
+
+
+def _risk_donor(*, flags: list[str] | None = None) -> dict[str, object]:
+    return {
+        "ts_ns": 100,
+        "equity": 100_000.0,
+        "high_water_mark": 101_000.0,
+        "drawdown": 0.009900990099009901,
+        "lev_cap": 1.0,
+        "reduce_only_mode": False,
+        "flags": sorted(flags or []),
+    }
+
+
+def _input_row(stage: str, donor: dict[str, object], donor_sha256: str) -> dict[str, object]:
+    return {
+        "alpha_id": f"{stage}-alpha-100",
+        "cutoff_time_ns": 100,
+        "regime": "TREND",
+        "raw_score": 0.5,
+        "frozen_confidence": 0.5,
+        "forward_return": 0.01,
+        "formula_hash": "formula-v1",
+        "alpha_config_hash": "alpha-v1",
+        "forward_return_available_at_ns": 200,
+        "available_at_ns": 100,
+        "annualized_volatility": 0.2,
+        "risk_regime": "TRADABLE",
+        "frozen_regime_multiplier": 1.0,
+        "exchange_min_quantity": 0.001,
+        "reduce_only": False,
+        "safety_reasons": [],
+        "risk_snapshot_status": "ASOF",
+        "risk_snapshot_ts_ns": 100,
+        "risk_donor": donor,
+        "risk_donor_sha256": donor_sha256,
+        "estimated_fee_bps": 4.0,
+        "estimated_slippage_bps": 1.5,
+        "reference_price": 100.0,
+        "actual_fill_price": None,
+        "forward_return_3": 0.02,
+        "forward_return_6": 0.03,
+        "directional_state": "UPTREND",
+        "volatility_state": "NORMAL",
+        "positioning_state": "HEALTHY",
+        "quality_state": "TRADABLE",
+        "quality_flags": [],
+    }
+
+
+def _execution(stage: str) -> dict[str, object]:
+    return {
+        "cutoff_time_ns": 100,
+        "decision_id": f"{stage}-decision-100",
+        "approved_exposure": 0.5,
+        "approved_target_qty": 5.0,
+        "filled_exposure_before": 0.2,
+        "filled_exposure_after": 0.4,
+        "filled_position_before": 2.0,
+        "filled_position_after": 4.0,
+        "target_delta_exposure": 0.3,
+        "reference_price": 100.0,
+        "actual_fill_price": 100.1,
+        "filled_qty": 2.0,
+        "fee": 0.08,
+        "actual_slippage": 0.2,
+        "actual_implementation_shortfall": 0.28,
+        "funding_pnl": 0.25,
+        "target_tracking_error": 0.1,
+        "time_to_target_bars": 0,
+        "reduce_only": False,
+        "safety_reasons": [],
+        "forward_return_1": 0.01,
+        "forward_return_3": 0.02,
+        "forward_return_6": 0.03,
+        "forward_return_1_available_at_ns": 200,
+    }
+
+
+def _episode(stage: str) -> dict[str, object]:
+    return {
+        "episode_id": f"{stage}-episode-1",
+        "symbol": "BTCUSDT_PERP",
+        "side": 1,
+        "opened_at_ns": 100,

+        "net_pnl": 4.17,
+        "mfe_pnl": 5.0,
+        "mae_pnl": -1.0,
+        "unrealized_pnl": 0.0,
+        "fill_count": 2,
+        "closed": True,
+        "add_count": 0,
+        "reduce_count": 1,
+        "holding_duration_ns": 100,
+    }

+def _stage(stage: str) -> dict[str, object]:
+    donor = _risk_donor()
+    donor_sha256 = _canonical_sha256(donor)
+    input_row = _input_row(stage, donor, donor_sha256)
+    attribution_row: dict[str, object] = {
+        "alpha_id": f"{stage}-alpha-100",
+        "cutoff_time_ns": 100,
+        "regime": "TREND",
+        "input_row": input_row,
+        "input_row_sha256": _canonical_sha256(input_row),
+        "risk_donor_sha256": donor_sha256,
+        "risk_donor": donor,
+        "safety_reasons": [],
+        "approved_exposure": 0.5,
+        "exposure": 0.4,
+        "forward_return": 0.01,
+        "gross_pnl": 4.0,
+        "approved_target_gross_pnl": 5.0,
+        "turnover_notional": 200.2,
+        "funding_pnl": 0.25,
+        "baseline_execution_cost": 0.28,
+        "execution_net_pnl": 3.97,
+        "risk_snapshot_status": "ASOF",
+        "risk_snapshot_ts_ns": 100,
+        "execution": _execution(stage),
+    }
+    if stage == ArchitectureStage.A5_SHADOW.value:
+        attribution_row["cost_shadow"] = {
+            "target_delta": 0.3,
+            "estimated_fee": 0.12,
+            "estimated_slippage": 0.045,
+            "round_trip_cost": 0.33,
+            "breakeven_move": 0.0011,
+            "actual_implementation_shortfall": 0.28,
+            "forward_return_1": 0.01,
+            "forward_return_3": 0.02,
+            "forward_return_6": 0.03,
+            "blocks_order": False,
+        }
+    return {
+        "stage": stage,
+        "pnl_basis": "ACTUAL_FILLED_EXPOSURE",
+        "gross_pnl": 12.0,
+        "turnover_notional": 200.2,
+        "cost_stress": {
+            "0": {"net_pnl": 11.0},
+            "15": {"net_pnl": 9.5},
+        },
+        "attribution_rows": [attribution_row],
+        "position_episodes": [_episode(stage)],
+        "episode_ledger": {
+            "status": "OBSERVED",
+            "closed_episode_count": 1,
+            "open_episode_count": 0,
+            "episode_profit_factor": None,
+            "episode_profit_factor_status": "NO_LOSSES",
+            "gross_profit": 4.17,
+            "gross_loss": 0.0,
+        },
+    }
+
+
+def _report() -> dict[str, object]:
+    stages = {stage.value: _stage(stage.value) for stage in ArchitectureStage}
+    return {
+        "schema_version": "architecture_attribution.v4",
+        "manifest": {"sha256": "sha256:frozen-manifest"},
+        "validity": {"state": "legacy-envelope"},
+        "runs": [{"window": "late_dev_2025", "seed": 42, "stages": stages}],
+    }
+
+
+def _states(audit: dict[str, object]) -> dict[tuple[str, int, str], str]:
+    return {(record["window"], record["seed"], record["stage"]): record["state"] for record in audit["records"]}
+
+
+def _replace_donor(row: dict[str, object], donor: dict[str, object], *, donor_sha256: str | None = None) -> None:
+    resolved_sha256 = donor_sha256 or _canonical_sha256(donor)
+    row["risk_donor"] = donor
+    row["risk_donor_sha256"] = resolved_sha256
+    input_row = row["input_row"]
+    input_row["risk_donor"] = donor
+    input_row["risk_donor_sha256"] = resolved_sha256
+    row["input_row_sha256"] = _canonical_sha256(input_row)
+
+
+def _replace_snapshot_identity(row: dict[str, object], *, status: str, ts_ns: object) -> None:
+    row["risk_snapshot_status"] = status
+    row["risk_snapshot_ts_ns"] = ts_ns
+    input_row = row["input_row"]
+    input_row["risk_snapshot_status"] = status
+    input_row["risk_snapshot_ts_ns"] = ts_ns
+    row["input_row_sha256"] = _canonical_sha256(input_row)
+
+
+def test_identical_extracted_stage_payloads_are_proven_unaffected_despite_envelope_change():
+    legacy = _report()
+    repaired = deepcopy(legacy)
+    repaired["schema_version"] = "architecture_attribution.repaired"
+    repaired["manifest"] = {"sha256": "sha256:repaired-envelope"}
+    repaired["validity"] = {"state": "repaired-envelope"}
+
+    states = _states(audit_stage_provenance(legacy, repaired))
+
+    assert states == {
+        ("late_dev_2025", 42, stage.value): ValidityState.PROVEN_UNAFFECTED.value for stage in ArchitectureStage
+    }
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("stage", "path", "changed_value"),
+    [
+        pytest.param(
+            "A5_SHADOW",
+            ("attribution_rows", 0, "cost_shadow", "blocks_order"),
+            0,
+            id="false-to-zero",
+        ),
+        pytest.param("A4", ("position_episodes", 0, "closed"), 1, id="true-to-one"),
+        pytest.param("A3", ("position_episodes", 0, "fill_count"), 2.0, id="integer-to-equal-float"),
+        pytest.param("A2", ("position_episodes", 0, "add_count"), False, id="zero-to-false"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_canonical_bool_numeric_payload_difference_is_confirmed_affected(stage, path, changed_value):
+    legacy = _report()
+    repaired = deepcopy(legacy)
+    target = repaired["runs"][0]["stages"][stage]
+    for key in path[:-1]:
+        target = target[key]
+    target[path[-1]] = changed_value
+
+    states = _states(audit_stage_provenance(legacy, repaired))
+
+    assert states[("late_dev_2025", 42, stage)] == ValidityState.CONFIRMED_AFFECTED.value
+
+
+def test_snapshot_timestamp_must_exactly_match_validated_donor_timestamp():
+    legacy = _report()
+    repaired = deepcopy(legacy)
+    for report in (legacy, repaired):
+        row = report["runs"][0]["stages"]["A2"]["attribution_rows"][0]
+        _replace_snapshot_identity(row, status="ASOF", ts_ns=999)
+
+    states = _states(audit_stage_provenance(legacy, repaired))
+
+    assert states[("late_dev_2025", 42, "A2")] == ValidityState.UNVERIFIED_LEGACY.value
+
+

+    states = _states(audit_stage_provenance(legacy, repaired))

+    assert states[("late_dev_2025", 42, "A2")] == ValidityState.UNVERIFIED_LEGACY.value

+def test_python_equal_input_attribution_and_execution_identities_are_unverified():
+    legacy = _report()
+    repaired = deepcopy(legacy)

+        row["cutoff_time_ns"] = False
+        row["input_row"]["cutoff_time_ns"] = 0
+        row["execution"]["cutoff_time_ns"] = 0

+def test_changed_risk_donor_flags_confirm_the_dependent_stage_is_affected():
+    legacy = _report()
+    repaired = deepcopy(legacy)
+    repaired_row = repaired["runs"][0]["stages"]["A2"]["attribution_rows"][0]
+    _replace_donor(repaired_row, _risk_donor(flags=["PORTFOLIO_KILL"]))
+
+    states = _states(audit_stage_provenance(legacy, repaired))
+
+    assert states[("late_dev_2025", 42, "A2")] == ValidityState.CONFIRMED_AFFECTED.value
+    assert states[("late_dev_2025", 42, "A1_SCORE")] == ValidityState.PROVEN_UNAFFECTED.value

+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("field", "changed_value"),
+    [
+        ("approved_exposure", 0.75),
+        ("filled_exposure_after", 0.75),
+        ("gross_pnl", -4.0),
+    ],
+)
+def test_changed_approved_filled_or_pnl_value_is_confirmed_affected(field, changed_value):
+    legacy = _report()
+    repaired = deepcopy(legacy)
+    repaired_row = repaired["runs"][0]["stages"]["A3"]["attribution_rows"][0]
+    if field == "approved_exposure":
+        repaired_row["approved_exposure"] = changed_value
+        repaired_row["execution"]["approved_exposure"] = changed_value
+    elif field == "filled_exposure_after":
+        repaired_row["exposure"] = changed_value
+        repaired_row["execution"]["filled_exposure_after"] = changed_value
+    else:
+        repaired_row[field] = changed_value
+
+    states = _states(audit_stage_provenance(legacy, repaired))
+
+    assert states[("late_dev_2025", 42, "A3")] == ValidityState.CONFIRMED_AFFECTED.value
+

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("collection", ["attribution_rows", "position_episodes"])

+def _load_cli_module():
+    path = Path(__file__).parent.parent / "scripts" / "rerun_legacy_accounting_baseline.py"
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("rerun_legacy_accounting_baseline", path)

+def _minimal_report(manifest, entries: list[tuple[str, int]]) -> dict[str, object]:
+    return {
+        "schema_version": "architecture_attribution.v4",
+        "constraints": {"parameter_search": False},
+        "manifest": {
+            "sha256": manifest.sha256,
+            "candidate_params_sha256": manifest.candidate_params_sha256,
+            "profile_sha256": manifest.profile_sha256,
+            "windows": [
+                {
+                    "label": window.label,
+                    "start_ns": window.start_ns,
+                    "end_ns": window.end_ns,
+                    "role": window.role,
+                }
+                for window in manifest.windows
+            ],
+            "seeds": list(manifest.seeds),
+            "cost_stress_bps": list(manifest.cost_stress_bps),
+        },
+        "runs": [
+            {
+                "window": window,
+                "seed": seed,
+                "identities": {
+                    "formula_hashes": [FORMULA_HASH],
+                    "accounting_kernel_sha256": ACCOUNTING_KERNEL_SHA256,
+                },
+                "stages": {stage.value: {"stage": stage.value} for stage in ArchitectureStage},
+            }
+            for window, seed in entries
+        ],
+    }

+def _install_fast_frozen_runner(monkeypatch, module) -> None:
+    def fake_run_frozen_matrix_entry(*, root, manifest, window, seed):
+        del root, manifest
+        return window.label, seed
+
+    def fake_build_architecture_attribution_report(entries, *, manifest, fixed_notional):
+        assert fixed_notional == 100_000.0
+        return _minimal_report(manifest, entries)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(module, "run_frozen_matrix_entry", fake_run_frozen_matrix_entry)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        module,
+        "build_architecture_attribution_report",
+        fake_build_architecture_attribution_report,
+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr(module, "_load_frozen_rerun_contract", lambda: {})
+    monkeypatch.setattr(module, "_preflight_first_frozen_donor", lambda **kwargs: None)
+
+    def fake_input_identities(*, legacy_input, root):
+        del root
+        return {
+            "legacy_source": module._source_identity(legacy_input),
+            "legacy_envelope_sha256": "sha256:" + "e" * 64,
+            "replay_input_parquet_corpus": {
+                "schema_version": "replay-input-parquet-corpus.v1",
+                "sha256": "sha256:" + "f" * 64,
+                "file_count": 1,
+                "total_size_bytes": 1,
+            },
+        }
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(module, "_frozen_input_identities", fake_input_identities)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(module, "_assert_frozen_input_contract", lambda *args, **kwargs: None)
+

+def test_rerun_preserves_legacy_and_publishes_frozen_identities(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    module = _load_cli_module()
+    _install_fast_frozen_runner(monkeypatch, module)
+    manifest = module.load_architecture_experiment_manifest(module.FROZEN_MANIFEST_PATH)
+    entries = list(manifest.expected_run_keys)
+    legacy_input = tmp_path / "legacy.json"
+    legacy_bytes = json.dumps(_minimal_report(manifest, entries), indent=2, sort_keys=True).encode()
+    legacy_input.write_bytes(legacy_bytes)
+    output_dir = tmp_path / "accounting"
+
+    exit_code = module.main(
+        [
+            "--root",
+            str(tmp_path / "data"),
+            "--legacy-input",
+            str(legacy_input),
+            "--output-dir",
+            str(output_dir),
+        ]
+    )
+
+    assert exit_code == 0
+    assert legacy_input.read_bytes() == legacy_bytes
+    assert {path.name for path in output_dir.iterdir()} == {
+        "fixed_event_attribution.json",
+        "full_system_attribution.json",
+        "stage_validity.json",
+        "summary.json",
+    }
+    full_system = json.loads((output_dir / "full_system_attribution.json").read_bytes())
+    fixed_event = json.loads((output_dir / "fixed_event_attribution.json").read_bytes())
+    stage_validity = json.loads((output_dir / "stage_validity.json").read_bytes())
+    summary = json.loads((output_dir / "summary.json").read_bytes())
+
+    assert len(full_system["runs"]) == 30
+    assert full_system["constraints"]["parameter_search"] is False
+    assert fixed_event["status"] == "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE"
+    assert fixed_event["legacy_state"] == ValidityState.UNVERIFIED_LEGACY.value
+    assert stage_validity["counts"][ValidityState.UNVERIFIED_LEGACY.value] == 30 * len(ArchitectureStage)
+    assert summary["constraints"] == {"parameter_search": False}
+    assert summary["matrix"] == {"expected_runs": 30, "observed_runs": 30}
+    assert summary["identities"]["manifest_sha256"] == manifest.sha256
+    assert summary["identities"]["formula_hashes"] == [FORMULA_HASH]
+    assert summary["identities"]["accounting_kernel_sha256"] == ACCOUNTING_KERNEL_SHA256
+    assert stage_validity["accounting_kernel_sha256"] == ACCOUNTING_KERNEL_SHA256
+    assert fixed_event["accounting_kernel_sha256"] == ACCOUNTING_KERNEL_SHA256
+    assert full_system["accounting_rerun"]["accounting_kernel_sha256"] == ACCOUNTING_KERNEL_SHA256
+    assert summary["full_system_comparison"]["status"] == ValidityState.UNVERIFIED_LEGACY.value
+    assert summary["full_system_comparison"]["first_confirmed_divergence"] is None
+    assert summary["resource_behavior"]["legacy_full_json_load_count"] == 0
+    assert summary["resource_behavior"]["legacy_peak_loaded_scope"] == "single_run"
+    assert summary["resource_behavior"]["legacy_sha256_stream_passes"] == 2
+    assert summary["resource_behavior"]["publication"] == (
+        "temporary_sibling_directory_then_atomic_noreplace_directory_rename"
+    )

+def test_existing_output_dir_fails_before_compute_and_preserves_last_good_outputs(tmp_path, monkeypatch):

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("collision_errno", [errno.EEXIST, errno.ENOTEMPTY])
+def test_publisher_race_preserves_concurrently_created_destination(tmp_path, monkeypatch, collision_errno):
+    module = _load_cli_module()
+    output_dir = tmp_path / "accounting"
+    staging_dir = tmp_path / ".accounting.rerun-ready"
+    staging_dir.mkdir()
+    for name in module.OUTPUT_FILENAMES:
+        (staging_dir / name).write_bytes(f"new:{name}".encode())
+
+    def race_at_atomic_boundary(source, destination):
+        assert source == staging_dir
+        assert destination == output_dir
+        destination.mkdir()
+        (destination / "concurrent-last-good").write_bytes(b"preserve-me")
+        raise OSError(collision_errno, "destination exists", destination)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(module, "_atomic_rename_directory_noreplace", race_at_atomic_boundary)
+
+    with pytest.raises(FileExistsError, match="new versioned output directory") as exc_info:
+        module._publish_staged_outputs(staging_dir=staging_dir, output_dir=output_dir)
+
+    assert exc_info.value.errno == errno.EEXIST
+    assert (output_dir / "concurrent-last-good").read_bytes() == b"preserve-me"
+    assert {path.name for path in staging_dir.iterdir()} == set(module.OUTPUT_FILENAMES)
+

+def test_publisher_uses_controlled_atomic_noreplace_primitive(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    module = _load_cli_module()
+    output_dir = tmp_path / "accounting"
+    staging_dir = tmp_path / ".accounting.rerun-ready"
+    staging_dir.mkdir()
+    for name in module.OUTPUT_FILENAMES:
+        (staging_dir / name).write_bytes(f"new:{name}".encode())
+    calls = []
+
+    def controlled_atomic_noreplace(source, destination):
+        calls.append((source, destination))
+        os.rename(source, destination)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(module, "_atomic_rename_directory_noreplace", controlled_atomic_noreplace)
+
+    module._publish_staged_outputs(staging_dir=staging_dir, output_dir=output_dir)
+
+    assert calls == [(staging_dir, output_dir)]
+    assert not staging_dir.exists()
+    assert {path.name for path in output_dir.iterdir()} == set(module.OUTPUT_FILENAMES)
+

+def test_atomic_noreplace_fails_closed_on_unsupported_platform(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    module = _load_cli_module()
+    source = tmp_path / "source"
+    destination = tmp_path / "destination"
+    source.mkdir()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(module.sys, "platform", "unsupported")
+
+    def unsafe_fallback(*args, **kwargs):
+        raise AssertionError("must not fall back to unsafe os.rename")
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(module.os, "rename", unsafe_fallback)
+
+    with pytest.raises(OSError) as exc_info:
+        module._atomic_rename_directory_noreplace(source, destination)
+
+    assert exc_info.value.errno == errno.ENOTSUP
+    assert source.is_dir()
+    assert not destination.exists()

+            contract=contract,

+def _write_frozen_rerun_contract(module, tmp_path, payload, monkeypatch):

+    monkeypatch.setattr(module, "FROZEN_RERUN_CONTRACT_PATH", path)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(module, "FROZEN_RERUN_CONTRACT_SHA256", hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest())
+

+def test_replay_input_corpus_mutation_during_rerun_aborts_publication(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    module = _load_cli_module()
+    manifest = module.load_architecture_experiment_manifest(module.FROZEN_MANIFEST_PATH)
+    entries = list(manifest.expected_run_keys)
+    legacy_input = tmp_path / "legacy.json"
+    legacy_input.write_text(json.dumps(_minimal_report(manifest, entries), indent=2, sort_keys=True), encoding="utf-8")
+    repo_root = tmp_path / "repo"
+    root = repo_root / "data" / "raw" / "binance"
+    parquet = root / "klines/BTCUSDT/5m/2025-01.parquet"
+    parquet.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
+    parquet.write_bytes(b"frozen")
+    _freeze_test_corpus(repo_root / "data" / "raw")
+    monkeypatch.chdir(repo_root)
+    observed = module._frozen_input_identities(legacy_input=legacy_input, root=root)
+    contract = {
+        "schema_version": "legacy-accounting-rerun-contract.v3",
+        "architecture_manifest_sha256": manifest.sha256,
+        "indicator_formula_hash": FORMULA_HASH,
+        "accounting_kernel_sha256": ACCOUNTING_KERNEL_SHA256,
+        "legacy_source": observed["legacy_source"],
+        "legacy_envelope_sha256": observed["legacy_envelope_sha256"],
+        "replay_input_parquet_corpus": observed["replay_input_parquet_corpus"],
+        "required_replay_store_availability": {"macro": True, "options": True},
+        "replay_input_mode": "read_only_snapshot",
+    }
+    _write_frozen_rerun_contract(module, tmp_path, contract, monkeypatch)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(module, "_preflight_first_frozen_donor", lambda **kwargs: None)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(module, "_run_frozen_matrix", lambda **kwargs: _minimal_report(manifest, entries))
+    real_stream = module._stream_stage_validity
+
+    def mutate_after_stream(*, legacy_input, repaired_report, manifest):
+        result = real_stream(
+            legacy_input=legacy_input,
+            repaired_report=repaired_report,
+            manifest=manifest,
+        )
+        parquet.chmod(parquet.stat().st_mode | 0o200)
+        parquet.write_bytes(b"changed-during-rerun")
+        parquet.chmod(parquet.stat().st_mode & ~0o222)
+        return result
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(module, "_stream_stage_validity", mutate_after_stream)
+    output_dir = tmp_path / "output"
+
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="replay input Parquet corpus changed during rerun"):
+        module.main(
+            [
+                "--root",
+                str(root),
+                "--legacy-input",
+                str(legacy_input),
+                "--output-dir",
+                str(output_dir),
+            ]
+        )
+
+    assert not output_dir.exists()

+def _record(
+    *,
+    state: str = "CONFIRMED_AFFECTED",
+    artifact_path: str = "results/source.json",
+    source_sha256: str = "a" * 64,
+    selector: str = "train_candidate_diagnostics.top_train_trial_diagnostics[0].params",
+    metric_families: list[str] | None = None,
+    stages: list[str] | None = None,
+    reason: str = "legacy_fee_cash_floor_can_create_equity",
+    superseding_artifact: str | None = None,
+    ledger_formula_hash: str = "sha256:" + "c" * 64,
+    decision_at: str = "2026-08-23T00:00:00Z",
+    approving_decision: str = "legacy-accounting-integrity-plan-task-3",
+) -> dict[str, object]:
+    return {
+        "artifact_path": artifact_path,
+        "source_sha256": source_sha256,
+        "selector": selector,
+        "state": state,
+        "reason": reason,
+        "metric_families": metric_families or ["promotion_gate"],
+        "stages": stages or ["A0"],
+        "superseding_artifact": superseding_artifact,
+        "ledger_formula_hash": ledger_formula_hash,
+        "decision_at": decision_at,
+        "approving_decision": approving_decision,
+    }
+
+
+def _write_registry(tmp_path: Path, records: list[dict[str, object]]) -> Path:
+    path = tmp_path / "registry.json"
+    path.write_text(
+        json.dumps({"schema_version": "legacy-accounting-validity.v1", "records": records}),
+        encoding="utf-8",
+    )
+    return path
+

+        load_accounting_validity_registry(path)

+def _load_audit_script():
+    path = Path("scripts/audit_legacy_accounting_integrity.py")
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("audit_legacy_accounting_integrity_script", path)
+    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"unable to load {path}")
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    sys.modules[spec.name] = module
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+
+
+def test_audit_cli_writes_canonical_sidecar_without_mutating_source(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    cli = _load_audit_script()
+    source = tmp_path / "source.json"
+    source_bytes = b'{"raw":"legacy evidence"}\n'
+    source.write_bytes(source_bytes)
+    registry_path = _write_registry(
+        tmp_path,
+        [
+            _record(
+                artifact_path=str(source),
+                source_sha256=hashlib.sha256(source_bytes).hexdigest(),
+            )
+        ],
+    )
+    output = tmp_path / "source.validity.json"
+
+    exit_code = cli.main(["--source", str(source), "--registry", str(registry_path), "--output", str(output)])
+
+    sidecar = json.loads(output.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    assert exit_code == 0
+    assert source.read_bytes() == source_bytes
+    assert sidecar["schema_version"] == "legacy-accounting-audit.v1"
+    assert sidecar["source"] == {
+        "artifact_path": str(source),
+        "sha256": hashlib.sha256(source_bytes).hexdigest(),
+        "size_bytes": len(source_bytes),
+    }
+    assert sidecar["records"][0]["state"] == "CONFIRMED_AFFECTED"
+    assert sidecar["records"][0]["ledger_formula_hash"] == "sha256:" + "c" * 64
+    assert sidecar["records"][0]["decision_at"] == "2026-08-23T00:00:00Z"
+    assert sidecar["records"][0]["approving_decision"] == "legacy-accounting-integrity-plan-task-3"
+    assert output.read_bytes() == json.dumps(sidecar, allow_nan=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True).encode("utf-8")
+    assert not list(tmp_path.glob("*.tmp"))
+
+

+def _fixed_event_fill(*, quantity: float, price: float, fee: float, sequence: int) -> ExecutionReport:
+    return ExecutionReport(
+        client_order_id=f"fixed-event-{sequence}",
+        symbol="BTCUSDT_PERP",
+        side=1 if quantity > 0 else -1,
+        status="FILLED",
+        filled_qty=abs(quantity),
+        avg_price=price,
+        fee=fee,
+        transaction_time_ns=sequence,
+    )
+
+
+def _fixed_event_mark(*, price: float, sequence: int) -> MarkPriceUpdate:
+    return MarkPriceUpdate(
+        meta=EventMeta(
+            event_time_ns=sequence,
+            ingest_time_ns=sequence,
+            venue="BINANCE",
+            symbol="BTCUSDT_PERP",
+            stream_seq=sequence,
+        ),
+        mark_price=price,
+    )
+

+class TestFixedEventMarkToMarketParity(unittest.TestCase):
+    def _run_fixed_events(self) -> tuple[RiskOverlay, float, float, float]:
+        bus = InMemoryJetStream()
+        overlay = RiskOverlay(bus=bus, config=RiskOverlayConfig(starting_equity=100_000.0))
+
+        bus.publish(
+            "exec.order.report",
+            _fixed_event_fill(quantity=2.0, price=100_000.0, fee=80.0, sequence=1),
+        )
+        equity_before_first_mark = overlay.equity
+        bus.publish("md.mark.BINANCE.BTCUSDT_PERP", _fixed_event_mark(price=101_000.0, sequence=2))
+        first_mark_change = overlay.equity - equity_before_first_mark
+
+        equity_before_partial_sell = overlay.equity
+        bus.publish(
+            "exec.order.report",
+            _fixed_event_fill(quantity=-1.0, price=100_500.0, fee=40.2, sequence=3),
+        )
+        partial_sell_change = overlay.equity - equity_before_partial_sell
+        equity_before_final_mark = overlay.equity
+        bus.publish("md.mark.BINANCE.BTCUSDT_PERP", _fixed_event_mark(price=99_000.0, sequence=4))
+        final_mark_change = overlay.equity - equity_before_final_mark
+
+        return overlay, first_mark_change, partial_sell_change, final_mark_change
+
+    def test_same_fixed_events_have_identical_mark_to_market_accounting(self) -> None:
+        left, left_first_mark_change, left_partial_sell_change, _ = self._run_fixed_events()
+        right, right_first_mark_change, right_partial_sell_change, _ = self._run_fixed_events()
+
+        self.assertEqual(left.cash, right.cash)
+        self.assertEqual(left.positions, right.positions)
+        self.assertEqual(left.equity, right.equity)
+        self.assertEqual(left.high_water_mark, right.high_water_mark)
+        self.assertEqual(left._drawdown(), right._drawdown())
+        self.assertEqual(left_first_mark_change, 2 * 1_000)
+        self.assertEqual(right_first_mark_change, 2 * 1_000)
+        self.assertAlmostEqual(left_partial_sell_change, -1 * (101_000 - 100_500) - 40.2)
+        self.assertAlmostEqual(right_partial_sell_change, -1 * (101_000 - 100_500) - 40.2)
+
+    def test_final_canonical_mark_revalues_one_remaining_unit(self) -> None:
+        overlay, _, _, final_mark_change = self._run_fixed_events()
+
+        self.assertEqual(overlay.positions, {"BTCUSDT_PERP": 1.0})
+        self.assertAlmostEqual(final_mark_change, -1 * (101_000 - 99_000))
+

+def test_absolute_switch_ceiling_accepts_exactly_five_switches_per_day():
+    report = _complete_raw_report()
+    report["runs"][0]["stages"]["A5_SHADOW"]["execution_metrics"]["position_switches_per_day"] = 5.0
+

+        "severity": "HARD",
+        "absolute_over_5_count": 0,
+    }
+    assert summary["gates"]["absolute_switch_ceiling"] == {
+        "passed": True,
+        "limit": 5.0,
+        "violations": [],
+        "count": 0,
+        "range": [0.5, 5.0],
+    }
+    assert "switch_cadence_above_2_per_day" in summary["blocked_by"]
+    assert "absolute_switch_ceiling_above_5_per_day" not in summary["blocked_by"]

+    assert (dict(overlay.positions), overlay.cash, overlay.equity, overlay.high_water_mark) == before

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+from dataclasses import FrozenInstanceError
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pandas as pd
+import pytest
+
+from zenquant.data.spot_daily import (
+    DAY_NS,
+    SpotDailyError,
+    audit_spot_daily,
+    normalize_spot_daily_csvs,
+)
+
+START_NS = 1_767_225_600_000_000_000
+
+
+def _write_daily_csv(
+    path: Path,
+    *,
+    open_time: int,
+    close_time: int,
+    close: float = 105.0,
+    high: float = 110.0,
+    low: float = 90.0,
+) -> None:
+    path.write_text(
+        "open_time,open,high,low,close,volume,close_time,quote_volume,trade_count,"
+        "taker_buy_base,taker_buy_quote,ignore\n"
+        f"{open_time},100,{high},{low},{close},10,{close_time},1000,5,6,600,0\n",
+        encoding="utf-8",
+    )
+
+
+def _write_parquet(path: Path, open_times: tuple[int, ...]) -> None:
+    pd.DataFrame(
+        {
+            "open_time_ns": open_times,
+            "close_time_ns": tuple(value + DAY_NS - 1_000_000 for value in open_times),
+        }
+    ).to_parquet(path, index=False)
+
+
+def test_exact_archive_overlap_deduplicates_and_records_ordered_source_digests(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    first = tmp_path / "b.csv"
+    second = tmp_path / "a.csv"
+    _write_daily_csv(
+        first,
+        open_time=START_NS // 1_000_000,
+        close_time=(START_NS + DAY_NS) // 1_000_000 - 1,
+    )
+    _write_daily_csv(
+        second,
+        open_time=START_NS // 1_000,
+        close_time=(START_NS + DAY_NS) // 1_000 - 1,
+    )
+
+    result = normalize_spot_daily_csvs((first, second), tmp_path / "data.parquet")
+
+    assert result.row_count == 1
+    assert result.first_open_ns == START_NS
+    assert result.last_close_ns == START_NS + DAY_NS - 1
+    assert result.raw_source_sha256 == (
+        ("a.csv", hashlib.sha256(second.read_bytes()).hexdigest()),
+        ("b.csv", hashlib.sha256(first.read_bytes()).hexdigest()),
+    )
+    assert result.normalized_sha256 == hashlib.sha256((tmp_path / "data.parquet").read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+    normalized_audit = audit_spot_daily(tmp_path / "data.parquet", START_NS, START_NS + DAY_NS)
+    assert normalized_audit.last_close_ns == START_NS + DAY_NS - 1
+    with pytest.raises(FrozenInstanceError):
+        result.row_count = 2  # type: ignore[misc]
+    assert result.__slots__
+

+def test_conflicting_archive_overlap_fails_without_publishing_output(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    first = tmp_path / "a.csv"
+    second = tmp_path / "b.csv"
+    for path, close in ((first, 105.0), (second, 106.0)):
+        _write_daily_csv(
+            path,
+            open_time=START_NS // 1_000_000,
+            close_time=(START_NS + DAY_NS) // 1_000_000 - 1,
+            close=close,
+        )
+
+    output = tmp_path / "data.parquet"
+    with pytest.raises(SpotDailyError, match="conflicting duplicate"):
+        normalize_spot_daily_csvs((first, second), output)
+
+    assert not output.exists()
+

+def test_normalization_validates_raw_then_filters_exact_half_open_window(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    raw = tmp_path / "monthly.csv"
+    for index, open_ns in enumerate((START_NS - DAY_NS, START_NS, START_NS + DAY_NS)):
+        path = tmp_path / f"row-{index}.csv"
+        _write_daily_csv(
+            path,
+            open_time=open_ns // 1_000_000,
+            close_time=(open_ns + DAY_NS) // 1_000_000 - 1,
+        )
+        if index == 0:
+            raw.write_text(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), encoding="utf-8")
+        else:
+            with raw.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
+                stream.write(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()[1] + "\n")
+
+    result = normalize_spot_daily_csvs(
+        (raw,),
+        tmp_path / "bounded.parquet",
+        start_open_ns=START_NS,
+        end_open_ns=START_NS + DAY_NS,
+    )
+
+    assert result.row_count == 1
+    assert pd.read_parquet(result.output_path)["open_time_ns"].tolist() == [START_NS]
+
+    conflicting = tmp_path / "conflicting.csv"
+    _write_daily_csv(
+        conflicting,
+        open_time=(START_NS - DAY_NS) // 1_000_000,
+        close_time=START_NS // 1_000_000 - 1,
+        close=106.0,
+    )
+    with pytest.raises(SpotDailyError, match="conflicting duplicate"):
+        normalize_spot_daily_csvs(
+            (raw, conflicting),
+            tmp_path / "must-not-publish.parquet",
+            start_open_ns=START_NS,
+            end_open_ns=START_NS + DAY_NS,
+        )
+

+SEEDS = (42, 123, 456, 789, 1024)
+CANONICAL_REPOSITORY = "infdahai/zenQuant"
+ATTACKER_REPOSITORY = "attacker/forged-zenquant"

+
+def _canonical_bytes(value: object) -> bytes:
+    return (json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False) + "\n").encode()
+
+
+def test_registered_frozen_five_min_schema_aggregates_without_fabricated_trade_counts() -> None:
+    import pandas as pd
+
+    frame = pd.DataFrame(
+        [
+            {
+                "open_time_ns": index * 300_000_000_000,
+                "close_time_ns": (index + 1) * 300_000_000_000 - 1_000_000,
+                "open": 100.0 + index,
+                "high": 101.0 + index,
+                "low": 99.0 + index,
+                "close": 100.5 + index,
+                "volume": 1.0,
+            }
+            for index in range(12)
+        ]
+    )
+    normalized = _normalize_frozen_five_min(frame)
+    aggregated = _aggregate_candles(normalized, "1h")
+
+    assert normalized["symbol"].unique().tolist() == ["BTCUSDT"]
+    assert normalized["trade_count"].eq(0).all()
+    assert normalized["trade_count_available"].eq(False).all()
+    assert aggregated["trade_count"].tolist() == [0]

+def test_generator_identity_changes_when_previously_omitted_behavior_module_changes() -> None:
+    files, before = _generator_dependency_identity()
+    assert any(item["path"] == "zenquant/strategy/engine.py" for item in files)
+
+    def tampered(path: Path) -> bytes:
+        content = path.read_bytes()
+        if path == ROOT / "zenquant/strategy/engine.py":
+            return content + b"\n# tampered behavior dependency\n"
+        return content
+
+    _files, after = _generator_dependency_identity(read_bytes=tampered)
+    assert after != before

+def test_forward_slice_is_append_only_and_excludes_rows_after_literal_cutoff() -> None:
+    import pandas as pd
+
+    baseline = pd.DataFrame([{"close_time_ns": AS_OF_NS - 1, "close": 100.0}])
+    forward = pd.DataFrame(
+        [
+            {"close_time_ns": AS_OF_NS + FOUR_HOURS_NS - 1, "close": 101.0},
+            {"close_time_ns": AS_OF_NS + 2 * FOUR_HOURS_NS - 1, "close": 999.0},
+        ]
+    )
+    combined, identity = _append_forward_rows(
+        baseline,
+        forward,
+        time_column="close_time_ns",
+        reused_end_ns=AS_OF_NS,
+        as_of_ns=AS_OF_NS + FOUR_HOURS_NS,
+        source_id="TEST:forward_slice",
+        source_path=ROOT / "data/raw/binance/klines/BTCUSDT/5m/data.parquet",
+    )
+    changed_future = forward.copy()
+    changed_future.loc[1, "close"] = 555.0
+    _combined, changed_identity = _append_forward_rows(
+        baseline,
+        changed_future,
+        time_column="close_time_ns",
+        reused_end_ns=AS_OF_NS,
+        as_of_ns=AS_OF_NS + FOUR_HOURS_NS,
+        source_id="TEST:forward_slice",
+        source_path=ROOT / "data/raw/binance/klines/BTCUSDT/5m/data.parquet",
+    )
+
+    assert combined["close"].tolist() == [100.0, 101.0]
+    assert changed_identity["sha256"] == identity["sha256"]
+    assert identity["path"].endswith(f"#through={AS_OF_NS + FOUR_HOURS_NS}")

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("timestamps", [[1, 3], [1, 2, 2, 3]])
+def test_forward_five_min_grid_rejects_gap_or_duplicate(timestamps: list[int]) -> None:
+    import pandas as pd

+def _candle_frame(*, interval_ns: int, shifted_open_ns: int = 0, **changes):
+    import pandas as pd
+
+    row = {
+        "open_time_ns": AS_OF_NS + shifted_open_ns,
+        "close_time_ns": AS_OF_NS + interval_ns - 1_000_000,
+        "open": 100.0,
+        "high": 102.0,
+        "low": 99.0,
+        "close": 101.0,
+        "volume": 10.0,
+    }
+    row.update(changes)
+    return pd.DataFrame([row])
+
+
+def test_forward_five_min_rejects_shifted_open_with_valid_close_grid() -> None:
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=r"5m.*open|open.*5m"):
+        _normalize_forward_five_min(_candle_frame(interval_ns=5 * 60 * 1_000_000_000, shifted_open_ns=1_000_000))
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("column", ["open", "high", "low", "close", "volume"])
+def test_forward_five_min_rejects_nonfinite_ohlcv(column: str) -> None:
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="finite"):
+        _normalize_forward_five_min(_candle_frame(interval_ns=5 * 60 * 1_000_000_000, **{column: float("nan")}))

+        {"high": 100.5},

+def test_forward_five_min_rejects_invalid_ohlcv_relationships(changes: dict[str, float]) -> None:
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="OHLCV"):
+        _normalize_forward_five_min(_candle_frame(interval_ns=5 * 60 * 1_000_000_000, **changes))
