+def _write_complete_sources(tmp_path: Path) -> tuple[Path, tuple[Path, ...], Path, Path, Path, Path, Path]:
+    tmp_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    raw = tmp_path / "BTCUSDT-1d.csv"
+    spot_open = tuple(range(REUSED_START_NS - 85 * DAY_NS, REUSED_END_NS, DAY_NS))
+    pd.DataFrame(
+        {
+            "open_time": tuple(value // 1_000_000 for value in spot_open),
+            "open": tuple(100.0 + index for index in range(len(spot_open))),
+            "high": tuple(110.0 + index for index in range(len(spot_open))),
+            "low": tuple(90.0 + index for index in range(len(spot_open))),
+            "close": tuple(100.0 + index for index in range(len(spot_open))),
+            "volume": tuple(10.0 for _ in spot_open),
+            "close_time": tuple((value + DAY_NS) // 1_000_000 - 1 for value in spot_open),
+            "quote_volume": tuple(1000.0 for _ in spot_open),
+            "trade_count": tuple(5 for _ in spot_open),
+            "taker_buy_base": tuple(6.0 for _ in spot_open),
+            "taker_buy_quote": tuple(600.0 for _ in spot_open),
+            "ignore": tuple(0 for _ in spot_open),
+        }
+    ).to_csv(raw, index=False)
+    spot = tmp_path / "spot.parquet"
+    normalize_spot_daily_csvs((raw,), spot)
+
+    canonical_perp = tmp_path / "canonical-perp.parquet"
+    perp_open = tuple(range(REUSED_START_NS, REUSED_END_NS, FIVE_MINUTES_NS))
+    missing_perp_ns = perp_open[5]
+    pd.DataFrame(
+        {
+            "open_time_ns": tuple(value for value in perp_open if value != missing_perp_ns),
+            "open": tuple(100.0 for value in perp_open if value != missing_perp_ns),
+            "high": tuple(110.0 for value in perp_open if value != missing_perp_ns),
+            "low": tuple(90.0 for value in perp_open if value != missing_perp_ns),
+            "close": tuple(105.0 for value in perp_open if value != missing_perp_ns),
+            "volume": tuple(10.0 for value in perp_open if value != missing_perp_ns),
+            "close_time_ns": tuple(
+                value + FIVE_MINUTES_NS - 1_000_000 for value in perp_open if value != missing_perp_ns
+            ),
+        }
+    ).to_parquet(canonical_perp, index=False)
+
+    canonical_funding = tmp_path / "canonical-funding.parquet"
+    funding_times = tuple(range(REUSED_START_NS, REUSED_END_NS, EIGHT_HOURS_NS))
+    missing_funding_ns = funding_times[-1]
+    pd.DataFrame(
+        {
+            "symbol": tuple("BTCUSDT" for value in funding_times if value != missing_funding_ns),
+            "funding_time_ns": tuple(value for value in funding_times if value != missing_funding_ns),
+            "funding_rate": tuple(0.0001 for value in funding_times if value != missing_funding_ns),
+        }
+    ).to_parquet(canonical_funding, index=False)
+    market_inputs = MarketTailInputs(
+        perp_source_path=canonical_perp,
+        funding_source_path=canonical_funding,
+        output_root=tmp_path / "derived/BTCUSDT",
+        start_ns=REUSED_START_NS,
+        end_ns=REUSED_END_NS,
+        repository_root=Path.cwd(),
+    )
+    rest_row = [
+        missing_perp_ns // 1_000_000,
+        "100.0",
+        "110.0",
+        "90.0",
+        "105.0",
+        "10.0",
+        (missing_perp_ns + FIVE_MINUTES_NS - 1_000_000) // 1_000_000,
+        "1000.0",
+        5,
+        "6.0",
+        "600.0",
+        "0",
+    ]
+    prepare_market_tail(
+        market_inputs,
+        fetch_perp_page=lambda *_: [rest_row],
+        fetch_funding_page=lambda *_: [
+            {
+                "symbol": "BTCUSDT",
+                "fundingTime": missing_funding_ns // 1_000_000,
+                "fundingRate": "0.0001",
+            }
+        ],
+    )
+    return (
+        spot,
+        (raw,),
+        canonical_perp,
+        canonical_funding,
+        market_inputs.perp_output_path,
+        market_inputs.funding_output_path,
+        market_inputs.provenance_path,
+    )

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("mutation", ["missing", "gap", "zero", "nan"])
+def test_freeze_requires_exact_85_close_spot_warmup(tmp_path: Path, mutation: str) -> None:
+    inputs = _inputs(tmp_path)
+    normalized = pd.read_parquet(inputs.spot_1d_path)
+    warmup_start = REUSED_START_NS - 85 * DAY_NS
+    if mutation == "missing":
+        normalized = normalized[normalized["open_time_ns"] != warmup_start]
+    elif mutation == "gap":
+        normalized = normalized[normalized["open_time_ns"] != warmup_start + 40 * DAY_NS]
+    elif mutation == "zero":
+        normalized.loc[normalized["open_time_ns"] == warmup_start, "close"] = 0.0
+    else:
+        normalized.loc[normalized["open_time_ns"] == warmup_start, "close"] = float("nan")
+    normalized.to_parquet(inputs.spot_1d_path, index=False)
+
+    with pytest.raises(module.InputFreezeError, match=r"REQUIRED.*BINANCE_SPOT_BTCUSDT_1D"):
+        module.build_execution_manifest(inputs)

+def test_freeze_rehashes_every_input_and_rejects_mutation(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch) -> None:
+    inputs = _inputs(tmp_path)
+    original = module._sha256_file
+    calls: dict[Path, int] = {}
+
+    def changing_digest(path: Path) -> str:
+        resolved = Path(path).resolve()
+        calls[resolved] = calls.get(resolved, 0) + 1
+        digest = original(Path(path))
+        if resolved == inputs.funding_path.resolve() and calls[resolved] > 1:
+            return "f" * 64
+        return digest
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(module, "_sha256_file", changing_digest)
+
+    with pytest.raises(module.InputFreezeError, match="input mutated during freeze"):
+        module.build_execution_manifest(inputs)
+
+    assert all(calls[path.resolve()] >= 2 for path in inputs.all_input_paths())
+

+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "mutation",
+    [
+        "output_sha",
+        "output_content_and_sha",
+        "output_row_count",
+        "window",
+        "source_id",
+        "source_path",

+        "source_contract",

+        "query_bounds",

+def test_freeze_rejects_market_tail_provenance_mismatch(tmp_path: Path, mutation: str) -> None:
+    inputs = _inputs(tmp_path)
+    payload = json.loads(inputs.market_tail_provenance_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    if mutation == "output_sha":
+        payload["outputs"]["BINANCE_PERPETUAL_BTCUSDT_5M"]["sha256"] = "f" * 64
+    elif mutation == "output_content_and_sha":
+        output = pd.read_parquet(inputs.perp_5m_path)
+        output.loc[5, "close"] = 106.0
+        output.to_parquet(inputs.perp_5m_path, index=False)
+        payload["outputs"]["BINANCE_PERPETUAL_BTCUSDT_5M"]["sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(
+            inputs.perp_5m_path.read_bytes()
+        ).hexdigest()
+    elif mutation == "output_row_count":
+        payload["outputs"]["BINANCE_PERPETUAL_BTCUSDT_5M"]["row_count"] -= 1
+    elif mutation == "window":
+        payload["window"][1] -= FIVE_MINUTES_NS
+    elif mutation == "source_id":
+        payload["outputs"]["WRONG"] = payload["outputs"].pop("BINANCE_PERPETUAL_BTCUSDT_5M")
+    elif mutation == "source_path":
+        payload["sources"]["BINANCE_PERPETUAL_BTCUSDT_5M"]["path"] = str(inputs.funding_source_path)
+    elif mutation == "source_sha":
+        payload["sources"]["BINANCE_PERPETUAL_BTCUSDT_5M"]["sha256"] = "f" * 64
+    elif mutation == "source_contract":
+        payload["sources"]["BINANCE_PERPETUAL_BTCUSDT_5M"]["contract"]["instrument"] = "ETHUSDT"
+    elif mutation == "query_symbol":
+        payload["rest_pages"][0]["query"]["params"]["symbol"] = "ETHUSDT"
+    elif mutation == "query_endpoint":
+        payload["rest_pages"][0]["query"]["endpoint"] = "/fapi/v1/fundingRate"
+    elif mutation == "query_interval":
+        payload["rest_pages"][0]["query"]["params"]["interval"] = "1m"
+    elif mutation == "query_bounds":
+        payload["rest_pages"][0]["query"]["params"]["endTime"] -= 1
+    elif mutation == "query_limit":
+        payload["rest_pages"][0]["query"]["params"]["limit"] = 2
+    elif mutation == "page_order":
+        payload["rest_pages"].reverse()
+    elif mutation == "inserted_gap":
+        payload["rest_pages"][0]["inserted_event_ns"][0] += FIVE_MINUTES_NS
+    elif mutation == "payload":
+        page = payload["rest_pages"][0]
+        page["payload"][0][4] = "106.0"
+        page["payload_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(
+            (json.dumps(page["payload"], separators=(",", ":"), sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode()
+        ).hexdigest()
+    elif mutation == "repo_head":
+        payload["repository"]["head"] = "f" * 40
+    elif mutation == "normalizer_sha":
+        payload["normalizer"]["sha256"] = "f" * 64
+    else:
+        inputs.market_tail_provenance_path.write_text("not json\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    if mutation != "provenance_bytes":
+        inputs.market_tail_provenance_path.write_text(json.dumps(payload) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+    with pytest.raises(module.InputFreezeError, match="market-tail provenance"):
+        module.build_execution_manifest(inputs)
+

+def test_freeze_rejects_construction_code_mutation(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch) -> None:
+    inputs = _inputs(tmp_path)
+    freezer_path = (inputs.repository_root / "scripts/freeze_trend_research_inputs.py").resolve()
+    original = module._sha256_file
+    calls = 0
+
+    def changing_digest(path: Path) -> str:
+        nonlocal calls
+        digest = original(Path(path))
+        if Path(path).resolve() == freezer_path:
+            calls += 1
+            if calls > 2:
+                return "f" * 64
+        return digest
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(module, "_sha256_file", changing_digest)
+
+    with pytest.raises(module.InputFreezeError, match="input mutated during freeze"):
+        module.build_execution_manifest(inputs)

+def test_workspace_identity_binds_head_and_dirty_untracked_content(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    repository = tmp_path / "repository"
+    repository.mkdir()
+    subprocess.run(["git", "init", "-q"], cwd=repository, check=True)
+    subprocess.run(["git", "config", "user.email", "test@example.com"], cwd=repository, check=True)
+    subprocess.run(["git", "config", "user.name", "Test"], cwd=repository, check=True)
+    tracked = repository / "tracked.txt"
+    tracked.write_text("before\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    subprocess.run(["git", "add", "tracked.txt"], cwd=repository, check=True)
+    subprocess.run(["git", "commit", "-q", "-m", "initial"], cwd=repository, check=True)
+    tracked.write_text("after\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    untracked = repository / "untracked.txt"
+    untracked.write_text("new\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+    identity = module._workspace_state(repository)
+    entries = {entry["path"]: entry for entry in identity["entries"]}
+
+    assert (
+        identity["head"]
+        == subprocess.run(
+            ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=repository, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True
+        ).stdout.strip()
+    )
+    assert entries["tracked.txt"]["content_sha256"] == hashlib.sha256(tracked.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+    assert entries["untracked.txt"]["content_sha256"] == hashlib.sha256(untracked.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+

+def _all_keys(value: object) -> set[str]:
+    if isinstance(value, dict):
+        return set(value).union(*(tuple(_all_keys(item) for item in value.values())))
+    if isinstance(value, list):
+        return set().union(*(tuple(_all_keys(item) for item in value)))
+    return set()

+_COMMIT_B = "d" * 40

+def _receipt(
+    received_at_ns: int,
+    *,
+    manifest_sha256: str = "a" * 64,
+    provider_run_id: int | str = 17,
+    commit_sha: str = _COMMIT_A,
+    remote_identity: str = "example/repo",
+) -> RegistrationReceipt:
+    return RegistrationReceipt(
+        manifest_sha256,
+        provider_run_id,
+        commit_sha,
+        remote_identity,
+        received_at_ns,
+    )
+
+
+def _manifest_payload() -> dict[str, object]:
+    return {
+        "schema_version": "trend-research-hypothesis.v1",
+        "layer": "time_space_shadow",
+        "asset": "BTC",
+        "active_signal_source": "BINANCE_SPOT_BTCUSDT_1D",
+        "reused_window": [1767225600000000000, 1787529600000000000],
+        "source_requirements": [
+            {
+                "id": "BINANCE_SPOT_BTCUSDT_1D",
+                "requirement": "REQUIRED",
+                "fallback": "NONE",
+            },
+            {
+                "id": "BINANCE_PERPETUAL_BTCUSDT_5M",
+                "requirement": "REQUIRED",
+                "fallback": "NONE",
+            },
+            {
+                "id": "BINANCE_PERPETUAL_BTCUSDT_FUNDING",
+                "requirement": "REQUIRED",
+                "fallback": "NONE",
+            },
+        ],
+        "fallback": "NONE",
+        "seeds": [42, 123, 456, 789, 1024],
+        "training": False,
+        "parameter_search": False,
+        "policy": {"formula": "frozen"},
+    }

+def _github_run(
+    *,
+    run_id: int = 17,
+    head_sha: str = _COMMIT_A,
+    remote_identity: str = "example/repo",
+    created_at: str = "2026-08-24T08:00:00Z",
+) -> dict[str, object]:
+    return {
+        "id": run_id,
+        "head_sha": head_sha,
+        "repository": {"full_name": remote_identity},
+        "created_at": created_at,
+    }

+def test_dependency_free_cli_builds_receipt(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    manifest_path = _write_manifest(tmp_path)
+    provider_path = tmp_path / "provider-run.json"
+    provider_path.write_text(json.dumps(_github_run()), encoding="utf-8")
+    output_path = tmp_path / "registration-receipt.json"
+    result = subprocess.run(
+        [
+            sys.executable,
+            "-S",
+            "scripts/build_trend_registration_receipt.py",
+            "build",
+            "--manifest-path",
+            str(manifest_path),
+            "--commit-sha",
+            _COMMIT_A,
+            "--provider-run-json",
+            str(provider_path),
+            "--output",
+            str(output_path),
+        ],
+        check=False,
+        capture_output=True,
+        text=True,
+    )
+    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr
+    assert json.loads(output_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["received_at_ns"] == 1787558400000000000
+

+def _write_manifest(tmp_path: Path, payload: dict[str, object] | None = None) -> Path:
+    path = tmp_path / "hypothesis.json"
+    path.write_text(json.dumps(payload or _manifest_payload()), encoding="utf-8")
+    return path
+
+
+def _descriptor_pair(
+    tmp_path: Path,
+    *,
+    execution_layer: str = "time_space_shadow",
+    execution_hypothesis_sha256: str | None = None,
+    execution_formula_sha256: str | None = None,
+) -> tuple[object, object]:
+    hypothesis = load_hypothesis_manifest(_write_manifest(tmp_path))
+    payload = json.loads(
+        Path("config/research/registrations/time_space_shadow_execution_v1.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    )
+    payload["layer"] = execution_layer
+    payload["hypothesis_sha256"] = execution_hypothesis_sha256 or hypothesis.sha256
+    payload["config_sha256"] = f"sha256:{payload['hypothesis_sha256']}"
+    formula_fields = ("formula", "thresholds", "costs", "robustness", "gates", "policy", "authority")
+    formula_payload = {key: _manifest_payload()[key] for key in formula_fields if key in _manifest_payload()}
+    payload["formula_sha256"] = execution_formula_sha256 or f"sha256:{canonical_sha256(formula_payload)}"
+    path = tmp_path / "execution.json"
+    path.write_text(json.dumps(payload), encoding="utf-8")
+    execution = registration_contracts.load_execution_manifest(path)
+    return hypothesis, execution
+
+
+def test_canonical_sha256_is_stable_for_mapping_order() -> None:
+    assert canonical_sha256({"b": 2, "a": 1}) == canonical_sha256({"a": 1, "b": 2})
+
+
+def test_hypothesis_descriptor_rejects_unknown_layer(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    payload = _manifest_payload()
+    payload["layer"] = "arbitrary"
+    with pytest.raises(RegistrationError, match="unsupported hypothesis layer"):
+        load_hypothesis_manifest(_write_manifest(tmp_path, payload))
+

+def test_execution_descriptor_is_built_from_validated_local_manifest(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    source = Path("config/research/registrations/time_space_shadow_execution_v1.json")
+    path = tmp_path / "execution.json"
+    path.write_bytes(source.read_bytes())
+    execution = registration_contracts.load_execution_manifest(path)
+    assert execution.schema_version == "trend-research-execution-manifest.v1"
+    assert execution.layer == "time_space_shadow"
+    assert execution.sha256 == canonical_sha256(json.loads(path.read_text()))

+def test_execution_descriptor_rejects_arbitrary_or_wrong_kind_manifest(

+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "mutation",
+    [
+        "unknown_top_level",
+        "wrong_window",
+        "wrong_checkpoint_rule",
+        "missing_source",
+        "source_not_ready",
+        "source_not_required",
+        "source_fallback",
+        "source_set_hash",
+        "formula_hash",
+        "config_hash",
+        "construction_shape",
+        "construction_hash",
+        "accounting_shape",
+        "accounting_hash",
+        "workspace_shape",
+        "workspace_hash",
+        "recursive_sha",
+        "forbidden_result_key",
+    ],
+)
+def test_execution_descriptor_rejects_schema_and_identity_mutations(tmp_path: Path, mutation: str) -> None:
+    source = Path("config/research/registrations/time_space_shadow_execution_v1.json")
+    payload = deepcopy(json.loads(source.read_text(encoding="utf-8")))
+    if mutation == "unknown_top_level":
+        payload["unexpected"] = 1
+    elif mutation == "wrong_window":
+        payload["reused_window"][1] -= 1
+    elif mutation == "wrong_checkpoint_rule":
+        payload["forward_checkpoint_rule"] = "self_asserted"
+    elif mutation == "missing_source":
+        payload["sources"].pop("BINANCE_PERPETUAL_BTCUSDT_FUNDING")
+    elif mutation == "source_not_ready":
+        payload["sources"]["BINANCE_SPOT_BTCUSDT_1D"]["status"] = "MISSING"
+    elif mutation == "source_not_required":
+        payload["sources"]["BINANCE_SPOT_BTCUSDT_1D"]["requirement"] = "OPTIONAL"
+    elif mutation == "source_fallback":
+        payload["sources"]["BINANCE_SPOT_BTCUSDT_1D"]["fallback"] = "PROXY"
+    elif mutation == "source_set_hash":
+        payload["source_set_sha256"] = "sha256:" + "0" * 64
+    elif mutation == "formula_hash":
+        payload["formula_sha256"] = "0" * 64
+    elif mutation == "config_hash":
+        payload["config_sha256"] = "sha256:" + "0" * 64
+    elif mutation == "construction_shape":
+        payload["construction_identity"].pop("files")
+    elif mutation == "construction_hash":
+        payload["construction_identity"]["sha256"] = "sha256:" + "0" * 64
+    elif mutation == "accounting_shape":
+        payload["accounting_kernel"]["schema_version"] = "arbitrary"
+    elif mutation == "accounting_hash":
+        payload["accounting_kernel"]["sha256"] = "sha256:" + "0" * 64
+    elif mutation == "workspace_shape":
+        payload["workspace_state"].pop("head")
+    elif mutation == "workspace_hash":
+        payload["workspace_state"]["sha256"] = "sha256:" + "0" * 64
+    elif mutation == "recursive_sha":
+        payload["sources"]["BINANCE_SPOT_BTCUSDT_1D"]["raw_sha256"][0]["sha256"] = "bad"
+    elif mutation == "forbidden_result_key":
+        payload["sources"]["BINANCE_SPOT_BTCUSDT_1D"]["pnl"] = 1
+    path = tmp_path / "execution.json"
+    path.write_text(json.dumps(payload), encoding="utf-8")
+    with pytest.raises(RegistrationError):
+        registration_contracts.load_execution_manifest(path)
+
+
+def test_forward_start_uses_later_receipt_plus_24h_and_ceil_4h(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    hypothesis, execution = _descriptor_pair(tmp_path)
+    receipts = (
+        _receipt(100, manifest_sha256=hypothesis.sha256, provider_run_id=17),
+        _receipt(
+            200,
+            manifest_sha256=execution.sha256,
+            provider_run_id=18,
+            commit_sha=_COMMIT_B,
+        ),
+    )
+    expected = ((200 + DAY_NS + FOUR_HOURS_NS - 1) // FOUR_HOURS_NS) * FOUR_HOURS_NS
+    assert (
+        derive_forward_start_ns(
+            hypothesis,
+            execution,
+            receipts,
+            expected_remote_identity="example/repo",
+            expected_hypothesis_provider_run_id=17,
+            expected_hypothesis_commit_sha=_COMMIT_A,
+            expected_execution_provider_run_id=18,
+            expected_execution_commit_sha=_COMMIT_B,
+        )
+        == expected
+    )
+

+def test_forward_start_requires_exactly_two_receipts(tmp_path: Path) -> None:

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("mutation", ["sha", "field", "payload"])
+def test_registration_pair_rejects_forged_execution_descriptor(tmp_path: Path, mutation: str) -> None:
+    hypothesis, execution = _descriptor_pair(tmp_path)
+    if mutation == "sha":
+        execution = replace(execution, sha256="f" * 64)
+    elif mutation == "field":
+        execution = replace(execution, hypothesis_sha256="f" * 64)
+    else:
+        payload = dict(execution.payload)
+        payload["forward_checkpoint_rule"] = "forged"
+        execution = replace(execution, payload=MappingProxyType(payload))
+    with pytest.raises(RegistrationError, match="execution descriptor"):
+        derive_forward_start_ns(
+            hypothesis,
+            execution,
+            (),
+            expected_remote_identity="example/repo",
+            expected_hypothesis_provider_run_id=17,
+            expected_hypothesis_commit_sha=_COMMIT_A,
+            expected_execution_provider_run_id=18,
+            expected_execution_commit_sha=_COMMIT_B,
+        )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("mutation", ["sha", "field", "payload"])
+def test_registration_pair_rejects_forged_hypothesis_descriptor(tmp_path: Path, mutation: str) -> None:
+    hypothesis, execution = _descriptor_pair(tmp_path)
+    if mutation == "sha":
+        hypothesis = replace(hypothesis, sha256="f" * 64)
+    elif mutation == "field":
+        hypothesis = replace(hypothesis, layer="trend_participation")
+    else:
+        payload = dict(hypothesis.payload)
+        payload["fallback"] = "PROXY"
+        hypothesis = replace(hypothesis, payload=MappingProxyType(payload))
+    with pytest.raises(RegistrationError, match="hypothesis descriptor"):
+        derive_forward_start_ns(
+            hypothesis,
+            execution,
+            (),
+            expected_remote_identity="example/repo",
+            expected_hypothesis_provider_run_id=17,
+            expected_hypothesis_commit_sha=_COMMIT_A,
+            expected_execution_provider_run_id=18,
+            expected_execution_commit_sha=_COMMIT_B,

+    }
+    if trend_spot_path is None:

+        warmup_missing = list(range(TREND_WARMUP_START_NS, TREND_REUSED_START_NS, DAY_NS))
+        reused_missing = list(range(TREND_REUSED_START_NS, TREND_REUSED_END_NS, DAY_NS))
+        missing_open_ns = [*warmup_missing, *reused_missing]
+        return {
+            **base,
+            "status": "INSUFFICIENT_DATA_SPOT_DAILY_MISSING",
+            "warmup_missing_open_ns": warmup_missing,
+            "warmup_missing_count": len(warmup_missing),
+            "reused_missing_open_ns": reused_missing,
+            "reused_missing_count": len(reused_missing),
+            "missing_open_ns": missing_open_ns,
+            "missing_count": len(missing_open_ns),
+            "next_action": "download_and_normalize_trend_spot_daily",
+        }
+
+    try:
+        frame = pd.read_parquet(path, columns=["open_time_ns", "close_time_ns", "close"])
+        if not pd.api.types.is_integer_dtype(frame["open_time_ns"].dtype):
+            raise SpotDailyError("open_time_ns must be integer nanoseconds")
+        if not pd.api.types.is_integer_dtype(frame["close_time_ns"].dtype):
+            raise SpotDailyError("close_time_ns must be integer nanoseconds")
+        if frame.empty:
+            raise SpotDailyError("spot daily corpus is empty")
+        opens = frame["open_time_ns"].astype("int64")
+        closes = frame["close_time_ns"].astype("int64")
+        if not (closes == opens + DAY_NS - 1).all():
+            raise SpotDailyError("daily close cutoffs are malformed")
+        close_values = pd.to_numeric(frame["close"], errors="coerce")
+        if close_values.isna().any() or not all(
+            math.isfinite(float(value)) and float(value) > 0 for value in close_values
+        ):
+            raise SpotDailyError("spot daily closes must be positive and finite")
+        full_audit = audit_spot_daily(path, TREND_WARMUP_START_NS, TREND_REUSED_END_NS)
+        warmup_audit = audit_spot_daily(path, TREND_WARMUP_START_NS, TREND_REUSED_START_NS)
+        reused_audit = audit_spot_daily(path, TREND_REUSED_START_NS, TREND_REUSED_END_NS)
+    except (OSError, KeyError, TypeError, ValueError, SpotDailyError):
+        return {
+            **base,
+            "status": "INSUFFICIENT_DATA_SPOT_DAILY_MALFORMED",
+            "next_action": "normalize_trend_spot_daily_from_raw_archives",
+        }
+
+    pre_start_count = int((opens < TREND_WARMUP_START_NS).sum())
+    post_end_count = int((opens >= TREND_REUSED_END_NS).sum())
+    first_open_ns = int(opens.min())
+    last_open_ns = int(opens.max())
+    last_close_ns = int(closes.max())
+    observed_required = opens[(opens >= TREND_WARMUP_START_NS) & (opens < TREND_REUSED_END_NS)]
+    last_required_open_ns = int(observed_required.max()) if not observed_required.empty else None
+    duplicate_open_ns = list(full_audit.duplicate_open_ns)
+    warmup_missing = list(warmup_audit.missing_open_ns)
+    reused_missing = list(reused_audit.missing_open_ns)
+    missing_open_ns = sorted((*warmup_missing, *reused_missing))
+
+    if pre_start_count:
+        status = "INSUFFICIENT_DATA_SPOT_DAILY_PRE_START"
+        next_action = "crop_and_renormalize_trend_spot_daily"
+    elif post_end_count:
+        status = "INSUFFICIENT_DATA_SPOT_DAILY_POST_END"
+        next_action = "remove_post_end_rows_and_renormalize_trend_spot_daily"
+    elif last_required_open_ns != TREND_REUSED_END_NS - DAY_NS:
+        status = "INSUFFICIENT_DATA_SPOT_DAILY_STALE"
+        next_action = "download_missing_tail_and_renormalize_trend_spot_daily"
+    elif full_audit.status != "READY":
+        status = "INSUFFICIENT_DATA_SPOT_DAILY_GAPS"
+        next_action = "repair_gaps_and_renormalize_trend_spot_daily"
+    else:
+        status = "READY"
+        next_action = "freeze_trend_research_inputs"
+
+    return {
+        **base,
+        "status": status,
+        "ready": status == "READY",
+        "first_open_ns": first_open_ns,
+        "last_close_ns": last_close_ns,
+        "first_cutoff_ns": first_open_ns + DAY_NS,
+        "last_cutoff_ns": last_open_ns + DAY_NS,
+        "warmup_missing_open_ns": warmup_missing,
+        "warmup_missing_count": len(warmup_missing),
+        "reused_missing_open_ns": reused_missing,
+        "reused_missing_count": len(reused_missing),
+        "missing_open_ns": missing_open_ns,

+        "duplicate_open_ns": duplicate_open_ns,
+        "duplicate_count": len(duplicate_open_ns),
+        "pre_start_count": pre_start_count,
+        "post_end_count": post_end_count,
+        "row_count": len(frame),
+        "next_action": next_action,
+    }

+"""Strict, deterministic normalization for Binance BTC spot daily archives."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import math
+import os
+import tempfile
+from collections.abc import Sequence
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Final
+
+import pandas as pd
+
+DAY_NS: Final = 86_400_000_000_000
+
+_KLINE_COLUMNS: Final = (
+    "open_time",
+    "open",
+    "high",
+    "low",
+    "close",
+    "volume",
+    "close_time",
+    "quote_volume",
+    "trade_count",
+    "taker_buy_base",
+    "taker_buy_quote",
+    "ignore",
+)
+_PRICE_COLUMNS: Final = ("open", "high", "low", "close")
+_VALUE_COLUMNS: Final = (
+    "open_time_ns",
+    "open",
+    "high",
+    "low",
+    "close",
+    "volume",
+    "close_time_ns",
+    "quote_volume",
+    "trade_count",
+    "taker_buy_base",
+    "taker_buy_quote",
+    "ignore",
+)
+
+
+class SpotDailyError(ValueError):
+    """Raised when spot-daily source data violates the frozen contract."""
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class SpotDailyNormalizationResult:
+    """Identity and bounds of one atomically published normalized corpus."""
+
+    output_path: Path
+    row_count: int
+    first_open_ns: int | None
+    last_close_ns: int | None
+    raw_source_sha256: tuple[tuple[str, str], ...]
+    normalized_sha256: str
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class SpotDailyAudit:
+    """Daily-grid coverage audit for a normalized spot corpus."""
+
+    status: str
+    row_count: int
+    first_open_ns: int | None
+    last_close_ns: int | None
+    missing_open_ns: tuple[int, ...]
+    duplicate_open_ns: tuple[int, ...]
+    sha256: str
+
+
+def normalize_spot_daily_csvs(
+    paths: Sequence[Path],
+    output_path: Path,
+    *,
+    start_open_ns: int | None = None,
+    end_open_ns: int | None = None,
+) -> SpotDailyNormalizationResult:
+    """Normalize Binance millisecond/microsecond daily archives fail-closed."""
+    _validate_bounds(start_open_ns, end_open_ns)
+    ordered_paths = tuple(sorted((Path(path) for path in paths), key=lambda path: str(path)))
+    if not ordered_paths:
+        raise SpotDailyError("at least one spot daily CSV is required")
+
+    source_digests = tuple((path.name, _sha256_file(path)) for path in ordered_paths)
+    frames = tuple(_read_daily_csv(path) for path in ordered_paths)
+    combined = pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True)
+    _reject_conflicting_duplicates(combined)
+    normalized = (
+        combined.sort_values(["open_time_ns"], kind="mergesort")
+        .drop_duplicates(subset=["open_time_ns"], keep="first")
+        .loc[:, _VALUE_COLUMNS]
+        .reset_index(drop=True)
+    )
+    if start_open_ns is not None and end_open_ns is not None:
+        normalized = normalized[
+            (normalized["open_time_ns"] >= start_open_ns) & (normalized["open_time_ns"] < end_open_ns)
+        ].reset_index(drop=True)
+        if normalized.empty:
+            raise SpotDailyError("explicit spot daily bounds contain no rows")
+
+    output_path = Path(output_path)
+    output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    temporary_path = _temporary_sibling(output_path)
+    try:
+        normalized.to_parquet(temporary_path, index=False)
+        os.replace(temporary_path, output_path)
+    finally:
+        temporary_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
+
+    return SpotDailyNormalizationResult(
+        output_path=output_path,
+        row_count=len(normalized),
+        first_open_ns=int(normalized["open_time_ns"].iloc[0]) if not normalized.empty else None,
+        last_close_ns=int(normalized["close_time_ns"].iloc[-1]) if not normalized.empty else None,
+        raw_source_sha256=source_digests,
+        normalized_sha256=_sha256_file(output_path),
+    )
+
+
+def _validate_bounds(start_open_ns: int | None, end_open_ns: int | None) -> None:
+    if (start_open_ns is None) != (end_open_ns is None):
+        raise SpotDailyError("start_open_ns and end_open_ns must both be provided")
+    if start_open_ns is None or end_open_ns is None:
+        return
+    if start_open_ns % DAY_NS or end_open_ns % DAY_NS:
+        raise SpotDailyError("spot daily bounds must be UTC daily open timestamps")
+    if start_open_ns >= end_open_ns:
+        raise SpotDailyError("spot daily bounds must form a non-empty half-open interval")
+
+
+def audit_spot_daily(path: Path, start_ns: int, end_ns: int) -> SpotDailyAudit:
+    """Audit half-open UTC daily coverage without filling or hiding gaps."""
+    if start_ns >= end_ns or start_ns % DAY_NS or end_ns % DAY_NS:
+        raise SpotDailyError("audit window must be a non-empty UTC daily half-open interval")
+    path = Path(path)
+    digest = _sha256_file(path)
+    frame = pd.read_parquet(path)
+    required = {"open_time_ns", "close_time_ns"}
+    missing_columns = sorted(required - set(frame.columns))
+    if missing_columns:
+        raise SpotDailyError(f"normalized parquet missing columns: {missing_columns}")
+
+    open_times = tuple(int(value) for value in frame["open_time_ns"])
+    counts = pd.Series(open_times, dtype="int64").value_counts()
+    duplicate_open_ns = tuple(sorted(int(value) for value in counts[counts > 1].index))
+    expected = set(range(start_ns, end_ns, DAY_NS))
+    observed = set(open_times)
+    missing_open_ns = tuple(sorted(expected - observed))
+    invalid_grid = any(value % DAY_NS for value in open_times)
+    status = (
+        "READY"
+        if not missing_open_ns and not duplicate_open_ns and not invalid_grid
+        else "INSUFFICIENT_DATA_SPOT_DAILY_GAPS"
+    )
+    ordered = frame.sort_values("open_time_ns", kind="mergesort")
+    return SpotDailyAudit(
+        status=status,
+        row_count=len(frame),
+        first_open_ns=int(ordered["open_time_ns"].iloc[0]) if not ordered.empty else None,
+        last_close_ns=int(ordered["close_time_ns"].iloc[-1]) if not ordered.empty else None,
+        missing_open_ns=missing_open_ns,
+        duplicate_open_ns=duplicate_open_ns,
+        sha256=digest,
+    )
+
+
+def _read_daily_csv(path: Path) -> pd.DataFrame:
+    try:
+        frame = pd.read_csv(path)
+    except Exception as exc:
+        raise SpotDailyError(f"unable to read spot daily CSV {path.name}: {exc}") from exc
+    frame.columns = [str(column).strip().lower() for column in frame.columns]
+    if not set(_KLINE_COLUMNS).issubset(frame.columns):
+        try:
+            frame = pd.read_csv(path, names=_KLINE_COLUMNS, header=None)
+        except Exception as exc:
+            raise SpotDailyError(f"unable to read spot daily CSV {path.name}: {exc}") from exc
+    missing = sorted(set(_KLINE_COLUMNS) - set(frame.columns))
+    if missing:
+        raise SpotDailyError(f"spot daily CSV {path.name} missing columns: {missing}")
+    if frame.empty:
+        raise SpotDailyError(f"spot daily CSV {path.name} is empty")
+
+    for column in _KLINE_COLUMNS:
+        frame[column] = pd.to_numeric(frame[column], errors="coerce")
+    if frame[list(_PRICE_COLUMNS)].isna().any().any():
+        raise SpotDailyError(f"spot daily CSV {path.name} requires positive finite OHLC")
+    non_price_columns = [column for column in _KLINE_COLUMNS if column not in _PRICE_COLUMNS]
+    if frame[non_price_columns].isna().any().any():
+        raise SpotDailyError(f"spot daily CSV {path.name} contains non-numeric values")
+
+    parsed_open = frame["open_time"].map(_exchange_timestamp_to_ns_and_unit)
+    parsed_close = frame["close_time"].map(_exchange_timestamp_to_ns_and_unit)
+    frame["open_time_ns"] = parsed_open.map(lambda item: item[0])
+    open_units_ns = parsed_open.map(lambda item: item[1])
+    raw_close_ns = parsed_close.map(lambda item: item[0])
+    close_units_ns = parsed_close.map(lambda item: item[1])
+    if not open_units_ns.equals(close_units_ns):
+        raise SpotDailyError(f"spot daily CSV {path.name} contains mixed timestamp units")
+    if open_units_ns.nunique(dropna=False) != 1:
+        raise SpotDailyError(f"spot daily CSV {path.name} archive mixes timestamp units")
+    if any(value % DAY_NS for value in frame["open_time_ns"]):
+        raise SpotDailyError(f"spot daily CSV {path.name} open_time is not a UTC day")
+    expected_end = frame["open_time_ns"] + DAY_NS
+    expected_raw_close_ns = expected_end - open_units_ns
+    if not raw_close_ns.equals(expected_raw_close_ns):
+        raise SpotDailyError(f"spot daily CSV {path.name} close_time must be the exact daily close")
+    frame["close_time_ns"] = expected_end - 1
+
+    for row_index, row in frame.iterrows():
+        prices = tuple(float(row[column]) for column in _PRICE_COLUMNS)
+        if not all(math.isfinite(value) and value > 0 for value in prices):
+            raise SpotDailyError(f"spot daily CSV {path.name} row {row_index} requires positive finite OHLC")
+        open_price, high, low, close = prices
+        if high < max(open_price, close) or low > min(open_price, close) or high < low:
+            raise SpotDailyError(f"spot daily CSV {path.name} row {row_index} violates candle bounds")
+    return frame.loc[:, _VALUE_COLUMNS]
+
+
+def _reject_conflicting_duplicates(frame: pd.DataFrame) -> None:
+    for open_time_ns, group in frame.groupby("open_time_ns", sort=True):
+        if len(group) < 2:
+            continue
+        first = group.iloc[0]
+        if not all(_rows_equal(first, group.iloc[index]) for index in range(1, len(group))):
+            raise SpotDailyError(f"conflicting duplicate open_time_ns={int(open_time_ns)}")
+
+
+def _rows_equal(left: pd.Series, right: pd.Series) -> bool:
+    return all(left[column] == right[column] for column in _VALUE_COLUMNS)
+
+
+def _exchange_timestamp_to_ns_and_unit(value: object) -> tuple[int, int]:
+    numeric = float(value)
+    if not math.isfinite(numeric) or not numeric.is_integer():
+        raise SpotDailyError("exchange timestamp must be a finite integer")
+    parsed = int(numeric)
+    if parsed < 1_000_000_000_000 or parsed >= 1_000_000_000_000_000_000:
+        raise SpotDailyError("exchange timestamp must use milliseconds or microseconds")
+    unit_ns = 1_000 if parsed >= 1_000_000_000_000_000 else 1_000_000
+    return parsed * unit_ns, unit_ns
+
+
+def _temporary_sibling(output_path: Path) -> Path:
+    descriptor, name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=f".{output_path.name}.", suffix=".tmp", dir=output_path.parent)
+    os.close(descriptor)
+    return Path(name)
+
+
+def _sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

+EIGHT_HOURS_NS: Final = 28_800_000_000_000
+FUNDING_TOLERANCE_NS: Final = 60_000_000_000
+PERP_SOURCE_ID: Final = "BINANCE_PERPETUAL_BTCUSDT_5M"

+SOURCE_CONTRACTS: Final = {

+        "market": "PERPETUAL_FUNDING",

+PageFetcher = Callable[[int, int, int], Sequence[object]]

+class MarketTailError(ValueError):
+    """Raised when the fixed market tail cannot be prepared exactly."""
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class MarketTailInputs:
+    """Explicit immutable inputs for one isolated market-tail publication."""
+
+    perp_source_path: Path
+    funding_source_path: Path
+    output_root: Path
+    start_ns: int
+    end_ns: int
+    repository_root: Path
+    symbol: str = "BTCUSDT"
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        object.__setattr__(self, "perp_source_path", Path(self.perp_source_path))
+        object.__setattr__(self, "funding_source_path", Path(self.funding_source_path))
+        object.__setattr__(self, "output_root", Path(self.output_root))
+        object.__setattr__(self, "repository_root", Path(self.repository_root).resolve())
+        if self.symbol != "BTCUSDT":
+            raise MarketTailError("only the frozen BTCUSDT research symbol is supported")
+        if self.end_ns <= self.start_ns:
+            raise MarketTailError("market-tail window must be increasing")
+        if self.start_ns % EIGHT_HOURS_NS or self.end_ns % EIGHT_HOURS_NS:
+            raise MarketTailError("market-tail window must align to 8h funding anchors")
+
+    @property
+    def perp_output_path(self) -> Path:
+        return self.output_root / "5m/data.parquet"
+
+    @property
+    def funding_output_path(self) -> Path:
+        return self.output_root / "funding/data.parquet"
+
+    @property
+    def provenance_path(self) -> Path:
+        return self.output_root / "market_tail_provenance.json"
+
+    @property
+    def transaction_marker_path(self) -> Path:
+        return self.output_root / ".market_tail_transaction.json"
+

+def prepare_market_tail(
+    inputs: MarketTailInputs,
+    *,
+    fetch_perp_page: PageFetcher,
+    fetch_funding_page: PageFetcher,
+    page_limit: int = 1000,
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Prepare exact grids and atomically publish them with immutable provenance."""
+
+    if not 0 < page_limit <= 1000:
+        raise MarketTailError("page_limit must be in [1, 1000]")
+    for source_id, source_path in (
+        (PERP_SOURCE_ID, inputs.perp_source_path),
+        (FUNDING_SOURCE_ID, inputs.funding_source_path),
+    ):
+        if source_path.is_symlink():
+            raise MarketTailError(f"canonical source file may not be a symlink: {source_id}")
+    _recover_orphaned_publication(inputs)
+    publication_targets = (inputs.perp_output_path.parent, inputs.funding_output_path.parent, inputs.provenance_path)
+    existing_targets = [str(path) for path in publication_targets if path.exists()]
+    if existing_targets:
+        raise MarketTailError(f"immutable market-tail output already exists: {existing_targets}")
+    source_before = {
+        PERP_SOURCE_ID: _sha256_file(inputs.perp_source_path),
+        FUNDING_SOURCE_ID: _sha256_file(inputs.funding_source_path),
+    }
+    rest_pages: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    perp = _prepare_perp(inputs, fetch_perp_page, page_limit, rest_pages)
+    funding = _prepare_funding(inputs, fetch_funding_page, page_limit, rest_pages)
+    source_after = {
+        PERP_SOURCE_ID: _sha256_file(inputs.perp_source_path),
+        FUNDING_SOURCE_ID: _sha256_file(inputs.funding_source_path),
+    }
+    if source_before != source_after:
+        raise MarketTailError("canonical source mutated during market-tail preparation")
+
+    inputs.output_root.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    staging = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=f".{inputs.output_root.name}.", dir=inputs.output_root.parent))
+    try:
+        perp_path = staging / "5m/data.parquet"
+        funding_path = staging / "funding/data.parquet"
+        perp_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
+        funding_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
+        perp.to_parquet(perp_path, index=False)
+        funding.to_parquet(funding_path, index=False)
+        _validate_perp_grid(perp, inputs.start_ns, inputs.end_ns)
+        _validate_funding_grid(funding, inputs.start_ns, inputs.end_ns)
+        sources = {
+            PERP_SOURCE_ID: {
+                "path": str(inputs.perp_source_path),
+                "resolved_path": str(inputs.perp_source_path.resolve()),
+                "sha256": source_before[PERP_SOURCE_ID],
+                "contract": SOURCE_CONTRACTS[PERP_SOURCE_ID],
+            },
+            FUNDING_SOURCE_ID: {
+                "path": str(inputs.funding_source_path),
+                "resolved_path": str(inputs.funding_source_path.resolve()),
+                "sha256": source_before[FUNDING_SOURCE_ID],
+                "contract": SOURCE_CONTRACTS[FUNDING_SOURCE_ID],
+            },
+        }
+        outputs = {
+            PERP_SOURCE_ID: {
+                "path": str(inputs.perp_output_path),
+                "sha256": _sha256_file(perp_path),
+                "row_count": len(perp),
+                "expected_row_count": (inputs.end_ns - inputs.start_ns) // FIVE_MINUTES_NS,
+                "columns": list(PERP_COLUMNS),
+            },
+            FUNDING_SOURCE_ID: {
+                "path": str(inputs.funding_output_path),
+                "sha256": _sha256_file(funding_path),
+                "row_count": len(funding),
+                "expected_row_count": (inputs.end_ns - inputs.start_ns) // EIGHT_HOURS_NS,
+                "columns": list(FUNDING_COLUMNS),
+            },
+        }
+        module_path = inputs.repository_root / "zenquant/data/trend_market_tail.py"
+        provenance: dict[str, Any] = {
+            "schema_version": "trend-market-tail-provenance.v1",
+            "symbol": inputs.symbol,
+            "window": [inputs.start_ns, inputs.end_ns],
+            "page_limit": page_limit,
+            "sources": sources,
+            "outputs": outputs,
+            "rest_pages": rest_pages,
+            "normalizer": {
+                "callable": "zenquant.data.trend_market_tail.prepare_market_tail",
+                "sha256": _sha256_file(module_path),
+            },
+            "repository": {"head": _repository_head(inputs.repository_root)},
+        }
+        (staging / "market_tail_provenance.json").write_text(_canonical_json(provenance), encoding="utf-8")
+        marker = _transaction_marker(inputs, staging, outputs)
+        (staging / ".market_tail_transaction.json").write_text(_canonical_json(marker), encoding="utf-8")
+        inputs.output_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        published: list[Path] = []
+        try:
+            for source, target in (
+                (staging / ".market_tail_transaction.json", inputs.transaction_marker_path),
+                (staging / "5m", inputs.perp_output_path.parent),
+                (staging / "funding", inputs.funding_output_path.parent),
+                (staging / "market_tail_provenance.json", inputs.provenance_path),
+            ):
+                os.replace(source, target)
+                published.append(target)
+            inputs.transaction_marker_path.unlink()
+        except Exception:
+            for target in reversed(published):
+                if target.is_dir():
+                    shutil.rmtree(target)
+                elif target.exists():
+                    target.unlink()
+            try:
+                inputs.output_root.rmdir()
+            except OSError:
+                pass
+            raise
+        return provenance
+    except Exception:
+        if staging.exists():
+            shutil.rmtree(staging)
+        raise
+
+
+def _transaction_marker(
+    inputs: MarketTailInputs, staging: Path, outputs: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, Any]]
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    return {
+        "schema_version": "trend-market-tail-transaction.v1",
+        "window": [inputs.start_ns, inputs.end_ns],
+        "staging_path": str(staging.resolve()),
+        "targets": {
+            "5m/data.parquet": outputs[PERP_SOURCE_ID]["sha256"],
+            "funding/data.parquet": outputs[FUNDING_SOURCE_ID]["sha256"],
+        },
+    }
+
+
+def _recover_orphaned_publication(inputs: MarketTailInputs) -> None:
+    marker_path = inputs.transaction_marker_path
+    if not marker_path.exists():
+        return
+    try:
+        marker = json.loads(marker_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+        if marker.get("schema_version") != "trend-market-tail-transaction.v1":
+            raise ValueError("transaction schema mismatch")
+        if marker.get("window") != [inputs.start_ns, inputs.end_ns]:
+            raise ValueError("transaction window mismatch")
+        expected_targets = {
+            "5m/data.parquet": inputs.perp_output_path,
+            "funding/data.parquet": inputs.funding_output_path,
+        }
+        targets = marker.get("targets")
+        if not isinstance(targets, dict) or set(targets) != set(expected_targets):
+            raise ValueError("transaction targets mismatch")
+        if inputs.provenance_path.exists():
+            marker_path.unlink()
+            return
+        for relative, target in expected_targets.items():
+            if target.parent.exists():
+                if not target.is_file() or set(target.parent.iterdir()) != {target}:
+                    raise ValueError(f"orphan target directory is unsafe: {relative}")
+                if targets[relative] != _sha256_file(target):
+                    raise ValueError(f"orphan target digest mismatch: {relative}")
+        for target in expected_targets.values():
+            if target.parent.exists():
+                shutil.rmtree(target.parent)
+        staging = Path(str(marker.get("staging_path"))).resolve()
+        parent = inputs.output_root.parent.resolve()
+        if staging.parent != parent or not staging.name.startswith(f".{inputs.output_root.name}."):
+            raise ValueError("transaction staging path mismatch")
+        if staging.exists():
+            shutil.rmtree(staging)
+        marker_path.unlink()
+    except (OSError, TypeError, ValueError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
+        raise MarketTailError(f"unsafe orphaned market-tail publication: {exc}") from exc
+
+
+def _prepare_perp(
+    inputs: MarketTailInputs,
+    fetch_page: PageFetcher,
+    page_limit: int,
+    rest_pages: list[dict[str, Any]],
+) -> pd.DataFrame:
+    try:
+        frame = pd.read_parquet(inputs.perp_source_path)
+    except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
+        raise MarketTailError(f"cannot read canonical perpetual source: {exc}") from exc
+    required = set(PERP_COLUMNS)
+    if not required.issubset(frame.columns):
+        raise MarketTailError(f"canonical perpetual source missing columns: {sorted(required - set(frame.columns))}")
+    frame = frame[(frame["open_time_ns"] >= inputs.start_ns) & (frame["open_time_ns"] < inputs.end_ns)].copy()
+    _validate_perp_rows(frame)
+    frame = _project_perp(frame)
+    expected = list(range(inputs.start_ns, inputs.end_ns, FIVE_MINUTES_NS))
+    missing = sorted(set(expected).difference(int(value) for value in frame["open_time_ns"]))
+    repair_rows: list[dict[str, int | float]] = []
+    for chunk in _consecutive_chunks(missing, FIVE_MINUTES_NS, page_limit):
+        start_ms = chunk[0] // 1_000_000
+        end_ms = (chunk[-1] + FIVE_MINUTES_NS) // 1_000_000
+        payload = list(fetch_page(start_ms, end_ms, len(chunk)))
+        try:
+            rows = [_parse_perp_rest_row(item) for item in payload]
+        except (IndexError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
+            raise MarketTailError(f"invalid perpetual REST page: {exc}") from exc
+        inserted = [int(row["open_time_ns"]) for row in rows]
+        if inserted != chunk:
+            raise MarketTailError("perpetual REST page does not exactly match the missing grid")
+        _record_page(rest_pages, PERP_SOURCE_ID, start_ms, end_ms, len(chunk), payload, inserted)
+        repair_rows.extend(rows)
+    if repair_rows:
+        frame = pd.concat((frame, _project_perp(pd.DataFrame(repair_rows))), ignore_index=True)
+    frame = frame.sort_values("open_time_ns", kind="stable").reset_index(drop=True)
+    _validate_perp_grid(frame, inputs.start_ns, inputs.end_ns)
+    return frame
+
+
+def _prepare_funding(
+    inputs: MarketTailInputs,
+    fetch_page: PageFetcher,
+    page_limit: int,
+    rest_pages: list[dict[str, Any]],
+) -> pd.DataFrame:
+    try:
+        raw = pd.read_parquet(inputs.funding_source_path)
+    except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
+        raise MarketTailError(f"cannot read canonical funding source: {exc}") from exc
+    if not {"funding_time_ns", "funding_rate"}.issubset(raw.columns):
+        raise MarketTailError("canonical funding source missing funding_time_ns or funding_rate")
+    rows = _normalize_funding_rows(raw.to_dict("records"), inputs.start_ns, inputs.end_ns)
+    expected = list(range(inputs.start_ns, inputs.end_ns, EIGHT_HOURS_NS))
+    missing = sorted(set(expected).difference(int(row["funding_time_ns"]) for row in rows))
+    repair_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for chunk in _consecutive_chunks(missing, EIGHT_HOURS_NS, page_limit):
+        start_ms = chunk[0] // 1_000_000
+        end_ms = (chunk[-1] + EIGHT_HOURS_NS) // 1_000_000
+        payload = list(fetch_page(start_ms, end_ms, len(chunk)))
+        try:
+            page_rows = _normalize_funding_rows(payload, inputs.start_ns, inputs.end_ns)
+        except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
+            raise MarketTailError(f"invalid funding REST page: {exc}") from exc
+        inserted = [int(row["funding_time_ns"]) for row in page_rows]
+        if inserted != chunk:
+            raise MarketTailError("funding REST page does not exactly match the missing grid")
+        _record_page(rest_pages, FUNDING_SOURCE_ID, start_ms, end_ms, len(chunk), payload, inserted)
+        repair_rows.extend(page_rows)
+    rows.extend(repair_rows)
+    frame = pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("funding_time_ns", kind="stable").reset_index(drop=True)
+    frame = _project_funding(frame)
+    _validate_funding_grid(frame, inputs.start_ns, inputs.end_ns)
+    return frame
+
+
+def _normalize_funding_rows(rows: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]], start_ns: int, end_ns: int) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    normalized: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for row in rows:
+        if not isinstance(row, Mapping):
+            raise MarketTailError("funding REST page element must be an object")
+        if row.get("symbol") != "BTCUSDT":
+            raise MarketTailError("funding row must identify BTCUSDT")
+        if "funding_time_ns" in row:
+            raw_ns = int(row["funding_time_ns"])
+        else:
+            raw_ms = row.get("fundingTime", row.get("funding_time"))
+            if raw_ms is None:
+                raise ValueError("funding timestamp is missing")
+            raw_ns = int(raw_ms) * 1_000_000
+        anchor = raw_ns - raw_ns % EIGHT_HOURS_NS
+        if not (start_ns <= anchor < end_ns):
+            continue
+        if not 0 <= raw_ns - anchor <= FUNDING_TOLERANCE_NS:
+            raise MarketTailError("funding timestamp must be within 60 seconds after its 8h anchor")
+        rate = float(row.get("funding_rate", row.get("fundingRate")))
+        mark = float(row.get("mark_price", row.get("markPrice", 0.0)))
+        normalized.append(
+            {
+                "symbol": str(row.get("symbol", "BTCUSDT")),
+                "funding_time_ns": anchor,
+                "raw_funding_time_ns": raw_ns,
+                "funding_rate": rate,
+                "mark_price": mark,
+            }
+        )
+    return normalized
+
+
+def _project_perp(frame: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
+    projected = frame.loc[:, PERP_COLUMNS].copy()
+    projected["open_time_ns"] = pd.to_numeric(projected["open_time_ns"], errors="raise").astype("int64")
+    for column in ("open", "high", "low", "close", "volume"):
+        projected[column] = pd.to_numeric(projected[column], errors="raise").astype("float64")
+    projected["close_time_ns"] = projected["open_time_ns"] + FIVE_MINUTES_NS - 1_000_000
+    return projected
+
+
+def _project_funding(frame: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
+    projected = frame.loc[:, FUNDING_COLUMNS].copy()
+    projected["symbol"] = projected["symbol"].astype("string")
+    projected["funding_time_ns"] = pd.to_numeric(projected["funding_time_ns"], errors="raise").astype("int64")
+    projected["raw_funding_time_ns"] = pd.to_numeric(projected["raw_funding_time_ns"], errors="raise").astype("int64")
+    projected["funding_rate"] = pd.to_numeric(projected["funding_rate"], errors="raise").astype("float64")
+    projected["mark_price"] = pd.to_numeric(projected["mark_price"], errors="raise").astype("float64")
+    return projected
+
+
+def _parse_perp_rest_row(item: object) -> dict[str, int | float]:
+    if not isinstance(item, Sequence) or isinstance(item, str | bytes) or len(item) < 11:
+        raise ValueError("row must be a Binance kline array")
+    open_ms = int(item[0])
+    close_ms = int(item[6])
+    return {
+        "open_time": open_ms,
+        "open": float(item[1]),
+        "high": float(item[2]),
+        "low": float(item[3]),
+        "close": float(item[4]),
+        "volume": float(item[5]),
+        "close_time": close_ms,
+        "quote_volume": float(item[7]),
+        "trade_count": int(item[8]),
+        "taker_buy_base": float(item[9]),
+        "taker_buy_quote": float(item[10]),
+        "ignore": int(float(item[11])) if len(item) > 11 else 0,
+        "open_time_ns": open_ms * 1_000_000,
+        "close_time_ns": close_ms * 1_000_000,
+    }
+
+
+def replay_market_tail_provenance(
+    payload: Mapping[str, Any],
+    inputs: MarketTailInputs,
+) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
+    """Rebuild both derived frames solely from bound sources and stored REST pages."""
+
+    if payload.get("schema_version") != "trend-market-tail-provenance.v1":
+        raise MarketTailError("provenance schema mismatch")
+    if payload.get("symbol") != "BTCUSDT" or payload.get("window") != [inputs.start_ns, inputs.end_ns]:
+        raise MarketTailError("provenance instrument or window mismatch")
+    page_limit = payload.get("page_limit")
+    if not isinstance(page_limit, int) or not 0 < page_limit <= 1000:
+        raise MarketTailError("provenance page_limit is invalid")
+    sources = payload.get("sources")
+    if not isinstance(sources, Mapping) or set(sources) != {PERP_SOURCE_ID, FUNDING_SOURCE_ID}:
+        raise MarketTailError("provenance source set mismatch")
+    for source_id, source_path in (
+        (PERP_SOURCE_ID, inputs.perp_source_path),
+        (FUNDING_SOURCE_ID, inputs.funding_source_path),
+    ):
+        envelope = sources[source_id]
+        if not isinstance(envelope, Mapping):
+            raise MarketTailError(f"invalid source envelope: {source_id}")
+        if source_path.is_symlink():
+            raise MarketTailError(f"canonical source file may not be a symlink: {source_id}")
+        if envelope.get("path") != str(source_path) or envelope.get("resolved_path") != str(source_path.resolve()):
+            raise MarketTailError(f"canonical source path mismatch: {source_id}")
+        if envelope.get("sha256") != _sha256_file(source_path):
+            raise MarketTailError(f"canonical source digest mismatch: {source_id}")
+        if envelope.get("contract") != SOURCE_CONTRACTS[source_id]:
+            raise MarketTailError(f"canonical source contract mismatch: {source_id}")
+    repository = payload.get("repository")
+    if not isinstance(repository, Mapping) or repository.get("head") != _repository_head(inputs.repository_root):
+        raise MarketTailError("provenance repository HEAD mismatch")
+
+    pages = payload.get("rest_pages")
+    if not isinstance(pages, list):
+        raise MarketTailError("provenance REST page ledger is missing")
+    page_index = 0
+
+    perp = pd.read_parquet(inputs.perp_source_path)
+    if not set(PERP_COLUMNS).issubset(perp.columns):
+        raise MarketTailError("canonical perpetual source schema mismatch")
+    perp = perp[(perp["open_time_ns"] >= inputs.start_ns) & (perp["open_time_ns"] < inputs.end_ns)].copy()
+    _validate_perp_rows(perp)
+    perp = _project_perp(perp)
+    expected_perp = list(range(inputs.start_ns, inputs.end_ns, FIVE_MINUTES_NS))
+    missing_perp = sorted(set(expected_perp).difference(int(value) for value in perp["open_time_ns"]))
+    perp_repairs: list[dict[str, int | float]] = []
+    for chunk in _consecutive_chunks(missing_perp, FIVE_MINUTES_NS, page_limit):
+        page = _checked_page(pages, page_index, PERP_SOURCE_ID, chunk, FIVE_MINUTES_NS)
+        page_index += 1
+        rows = [_parse_perp_rest_row(item) for item in page["payload"]]
+        if [int(row["open_time_ns"]) for row in rows] != chunk:
+            raise MarketTailError("perpetual REST payload does not match missing events")
+        perp_repairs.extend(rows)
+    if perp_repairs:
+        perp = pd.concat((perp, _project_perp(pd.DataFrame(perp_repairs))), ignore_index=True)
+    perp = perp.sort_values("open_time_ns", kind="stable").reset_index(drop=True)
+    _validate_perp_grid(perp, inputs.start_ns, inputs.end_ns)
+
+    funding_raw = pd.read_parquet(inputs.funding_source_path)
+    if not {"symbol", "funding_time_ns", "funding_rate"}.issubset(funding_raw.columns):
+        raise MarketTailError("canonical funding source schema mismatch")
+    funding_rows = _normalize_funding_rows(funding_raw.to_dict("records"), inputs.start_ns, inputs.end_ns)
+    expected_funding = list(range(inputs.start_ns, inputs.end_ns, EIGHT_HOURS_NS))
+    missing_funding = sorted(set(expected_funding).difference(int(row["funding_time_ns"]) for row in funding_rows))
+    for chunk in _consecutive_chunks(missing_funding, EIGHT_HOURS_NS, page_limit):
+        page = _checked_page(pages, page_index, FUNDING_SOURCE_ID, chunk, EIGHT_HOURS_NS)
+        page_index += 1
+        rows = _normalize_funding_rows(page["payload"], inputs.start_ns, inputs.end_ns)
+        if [int(row["funding_time_ns"]) for row in rows] != chunk:
+            raise MarketTailError("funding REST payload does not match missing events")
+        funding_rows.extend(rows)
+    if page_index != len(pages):
+        raise MarketTailError("provenance contains unexpected REST pages")
+    funding = (
+        _project_funding(pd.DataFrame(funding_rows))
+        .sort_values("funding_time_ns", kind="stable")
+        .reset_index(drop=True)
+    )
+    _validate_funding_grid(funding, inputs.start_ns, inputs.end_ns)
+    return {PERP_SOURCE_ID: perp, FUNDING_SOURCE_ID: funding}
+
+
+def _checked_page(
+    pages: Sequence[object],
+    index: int,
+    source_id: str,
+    chunk: Sequence[int],
+    interval_ns: int,
+) -> Mapping[str, Any]:
+    if index >= len(pages) or not isinstance(pages[index], Mapping):
+        raise MarketTailError(f"missing provenance REST page for {source_id}")
+    page = pages[index]
+    start_ms = chunk[0] // 1_000_000
+    end_ms = (chunk[-1] + interval_ns) // 1_000_000
+    endpoint = "/fapi/v1/klines" if source_id == PERP_SOURCE_ID else "/fapi/v1/fundingRate"
+    params: dict[str, int | str] = {
+        "symbol": "BTCUSDT",
+        "startTime": start_ms,
+        "endTime": end_ms - 1,
+        "limit": len(chunk),
+    }
+    if source_id == PERP_SOURCE_ID:
+        params["interval"] = "5m"
+    payload = page.get("payload")
+    if (
+        page.get("source_id") != source_id
+        or page.get("query") != {"endpoint": endpoint, "params": params}
+        or page.get("inserted_event_ns") != list(chunk)
+        or not isinstance(payload, list)
+        or page.get("payload_sha256") != hashlib.sha256(_canonical_json_value(payload).encode()).hexdigest()
+    ):
+        raise MarketTailError(f"provenance REST page mismatch for {source_id}")
+    return page
+
+
+def _validate_perp_grid(frame: pd.DataFrame, start_ns: int, end_ns: int) -> None:
+    if tuple(frame.columns) != PERP_COLUMNS:
+        raise MarketTailError("perpetual output schema is not canonical")
+    expected_dtypes = {
+        "open_time_ns": "int64",
+        "open": "float64",
+        "high": "float64",
+        "low": "float64",
+        "close": "float64",
+        "volume": "float64",
+        "close_time_ns": "int64",
+    }
+    if frame.dtypes.astype(str).to_dict() != expected_dtypes:
+        raise MarketTailError("perpetual output dtypes are not canonical")
+    times = [int(value) for value in frame["open_time_ns"]]
+    if times != list(range(start_ns, end_ns, FIVE_MINUTES_NS)):
+        raise MarketTailError("perpetual output is not the exact 5m grid")
+    _validate_perp_rows(frame)
+
+
+def _validate_perp_rows(frame: pd.DataFrame) -> None:
+    numeric = frame[["open", "high", "low", "close", "volume"]].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce")
+    for open_ns, cutoff_value, values in zip(
+        frame["open_time_ns"], frame["close_time_ns"], numeric.itertuples(index=False, name=None), strict=True
+    ):
+        open_price, high, low, close, volume = (float(value) for value in values)
+        cutoff = int(cutoff_value)
+        open_time = int(open_ns)
+        if cutoff not in {open_time + FIVE_MINUTES_NS - 1, open_time + FIVE_MINUTES_NS - 1_000_000}:
+            raise MarketTailError("perpetual close cutoff is invalid")
+        if (
+            not all(math.isfinite(value) for value in (open_price, high, low, close, volume))
+            or min(open_price, high, low, close) <= 0
+            or volume < 0
+            or high < max(open_price, close)
+            or low > min(open_price, close)
+            or high < low
+        ):
+            raise MarketTailError("perpetual OHLCV value contract failed")
+
+
+def _validate_funding_grid(frame: pd.DataFrame, start_ns: int, end_ns: int) -> None:
+    if tuple(frame.columns) != FUNDING_COLUMNS:
+        raise MarketTailError("funding output lacks canonical and raw timestamps")
+    times = [int(value) for value in frame["funding_time_ns"]]
+    if times != list(range(start_ns, end_ns, EIGHT_HOURS_NS)):
+        raise MarketTailError("funding output must contain exactly one event per 8h anchor")
+    for anchor, raw_ns, rate in zip(
+        frame["funding_time_ns"], frame["raw_funding_time_ns"], frame["funding_rate"], strict=True
+    ):
+        if not 0 <= int(raw_ns) - int(anchor) <= FUNDING_TOLERANCE_NS:
+            raise MarketTailError("funding timestamp must be within 60 seconds after its 8h anchor")
+        if not math.isfinite(float(rate)):
+            raise MarketTailError("funding rate must be finite")
+    if set(frame["symbol"].astype(str)) != {"BTCUSDT"}:
+        raise MarketTailError("funding output must identify BTCUSDT")
+
+
+def _consecutive_chunks(values: Sequence[int], interval_ns: int, limit: int) -> list[list[int]]:
+    chunks: list[list[int]] = []
+    for value in values:
+        if not chunks or len(chunks[-1]) >= limit or value != chunks[-1][-1] + interval_ns:
+            chunks.append([value])
+        else:
+            chunks[-1].append(value)
+    return chunks
+
+
+def _record_page(
+    pages: list[dict[str, Any]],
+    source_id: str,
+    start_ms: int,
+    end_ms: int,
+    limit: int,
+    payload: Sequence[object],
+    inserted_event_ns: Sequence[int],
+) -> None:
+    endpoint = "/fapi/v1/klines" if source_id == PERP_SOURCE_ID else "/fapi/v1/fundingRate"
+    params: dict[str, int | str] = {
+        "symbol": "BTCUSDT",
+        "startTime": start_ms,
+        "endTime": end_ms - 1,
+        "limit": limit,
+    }
+    if source_id == PERP_SOURCE_ID:
+        params["interval"] = "5m"
+    pages.append(
+        {
+            "source_id": source_id,
+            "query": {"endpoint": endpoint, "params": params},
+            "inserted_event_ns": list(inserted_event_ns),
+            "payload": list(payload),
+            "payload_sha256": hashlib.sha256(_canonical_json_value(payload).encode()).hexdigest(),
+        }
+    )
+
+
+def _canonical_json(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
+    return _canonical_json_value(payload)
+
+
+def _canonical_json_value(payload: object) -> str:
+    return json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, separators=(",", ":"), sort_keys=True) + "\n"
+
+
+def _sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with Path(path).open("rb") as stream:
+        for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
+            digest.update(chunk)
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def _repository_head(root: Path) -> str:
+    try:
+        return subprocess.run(
+            ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=root, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True
+        ).stdout.strip()
+    except (OSError, subprocess.CalledProcessError) as exc:
+        raise MarketTailError("repository identity is unavailable") from exc

+"""Shared accounting validation contracts."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import math
+
+from .models import ExecutionOrder, ExecutionReport
+
+ExecutionReportIdentity = tuple[str, str, int]
+
+
+def validate_execution_fee(fee: float) -> None:
+    """Reject fee values that cannot be safely applied to cash."""
+    if not math.isfinite(fee) or fee < 0.0:
+        raise ValueError("fee must be finite and non-negative")
+
+
+def validate_execution_report_accounting(report: ExecutionReport) -> None:
+    """Reject report fields that cannot enter deterministic fill accounting."""
+    validate_execution_fee(report.fee)
+    if report.side not in {-1, 1}:
+        raise ValueError("side must be -1 or 1")
+    if not math.isfinite(report.filled_qty) or report.filled_qty < 0.0:
+        raise ValueError("filled_qty must be finite and non-negative")
+    if report.filled_qty == 0.0:
+        return
+    if not math.isfinite(report.avg_price) or report.avg_price <= 0.0:
+        raise ValueError("avg_price must be finite and positive for a fill")
+    if not report.client_order_id:
+        raise ValueError("client_order_id must be non-empty for a fill")
+
+
+def validate_execution_report_for_order(report: ExecutionReport, order: ExecutionOrder) -> None:
+    """Validate accounting fields and bind a report to its submitted order."""
+    validate_execution_report_accounting(report)
+    if report.client_order_id != order.client_order_id or report.symbol != order.symbol or report.side != order.side:
+        raise ValueError("execution report does not match submitted order")
+
+
+def execution_report_identity(report: ExecutionReport) -> ExecutionReportIdentity:
+    """Return the stable business identity shared by direct and routed reports."""
+    return (report.symbol, report.client_order_id, report.transaction_time_ns)

+def _architecture_risk_donor_payload(snapshot: RiskSnapshot | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Return the complete legacy risk state visible to one V2 cutoff."""
+    if snapshot is None:
+        return {
+            "ts_ns": None,
+            "equity": None,
+            "high_water_mark": None,
+            "drawdown": None,
+            "lev_cap": None,
+            "reduce_only_mode": None,
+            "flags": [],
+        }
+    return {
+        "ts_ns": snapshot.ts_ns,
+        "equity": snapshot.equity,
+        "high_water_mark": snapshot.high_water_mark,
+        "drawdown": snapshot.drawdown,
+        "lev_cap": snapshot.lev_cap,
+        "reduce_only_mode": snapshot.reduce_only_mode,
+        "flags": sorted(snapshot.flags),
+    }
+
+
+def _canonical_architecture_payload_sha256(payload: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
+    encoded = json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")
+    return f"sha256:{hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest()}"

+"""Verifiable semantic identity for the runtime portfolio-accounting kernel."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import ast
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+ACCOUNTING_KERNEL_IDENTITY_SCHEMA_VERSION = "accounting-kernel-identity.v1"
+REPOSITORY_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+_DOMAIN_ACCOUNTING_PATH = Path("zenquant/domain/accounting.py")
+_RISK_GUARD_PATH = Path("zenquant/risk/guard.py")
+_EXECUTION_ROUTER_PATH = Path("zenquant/execution/router.py")
+_RISK_METHODS = (
+    "_on_mark_price",
+    "prime_indicator",
+    "_on_execution_report",
+    "apply_execution_report",
+    "apply_fee",
+    "_revalue_equity",
+)
+_EXECUTION_ACCOUNTING_HOOK = "_apply_report_accounting"
+
+
+def build_accounting_kernel_identity(
+    *,
+    repository_root: Path = REPOSITORY_ROOT,
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Hash normalized AST for every runtime transition that books or marks equity."""
+    root = repository_root.resolve()
+    components: list[dict[str, str]] = []
+
+    domain_tree = _parse_module(root / _DOMAIN_ACCOUNTING_PATH)
+    components.append(_component(_DOMAIN_ACCOUNTING_PATH, "<module>", domain_tree))
+
+    risk_tree = _parse_module(root / _RISK_GUARD_PATH)
+    risk_class = _required_class(risk_tree, "RiskOverlay", path=_RISK_GUARD_PATH)
+    for method_name in _RISK_METHODS:
+        _required_method(risk_class, method_name, path=_RISK_GUARD_PATH)
+    components.append(_component(_RISK_GUARD_PATH, "<module>", risk_tree))
+
+    execution_tree = _parse_module(root / _EXECUTION_ROUTER_PATH)
+    execution_class = _required_class(execution_tree, "ExecutionKernel", path=_EXECUTION_ROUTER_PATH)
+    _required_method(execution_class, _EXECUTION_ACCOUNTING_HOOK, path=_EXECUTION_ROUTER_PATH)
+    components.append(_component(_EXECUTION_ROUTER_PATH, "<module>", execution_tree))
+
+    components.sort(key=lambda item: item["identity"])
+    payload = {
+        "schema_version": ACCOUNTING_KERNEL_IDENTITY_SCHEMA_VERSION,
+        "components": components,
+    }
+    return {
+        **payload,
+        "sha256": f"sha256:{hashlib.sha256(_canonical_json_bytes(payload)).hexdigest()}",
+    }
+
+
+def _parse_module(path: Path) -> ast.Module:
+    try:
+        source = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    except (OSError, UnicodeError) as exc:
+        raise ValueError(f"unable to read accounting kernel source:{path}") from exc
+    try:
+        return ast.parse(source, filename=str(path))
+    except SyntaxError as exc:
+        raise ValueError(f"unable to parse accounting kernel source:{path}") from exc
+
+
+def _required_class(tree: ast.Module, name: str, *, path: Path) -> ast.ClassDef:
+    node = next((item for item in tree.body if isinstance(item, ast.ClassDef) and item.name == name), None)
+    if node is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"accounting kernel component missing:{path}::{name}")
+    return node
+
+
+def _required_method(class_node: ast.ClassDef, name: str, *, path: Path) -> ast.AST:
+    node = next(
+        (
+            item
+            for item in class_node.body
+            if isinstance(item, ast.FunctionDef | ast.AsyncFunctionDef) and item.name == name
+        ),
+        None,
+    )
+    if node is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"accounting kernel component missing:{path}::{class_node.name}.{name}")
+    return node
+
+
+def _component(path: Path, qualname: str, node: ast.AST) -> dict[str, str]:
+    semantic_ast = ast.dump(node, annotate_fields=True, include_attributes=False)
+    return {
+        "identity": f"{path.as_posix()}::{qualname}",
+        "semantic_sha256": f"sha256:{hashlib.sha256(semantic_ast.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()}",
+    }
+
+
+def _canonical_json_bytes(payload: object) -> bytes:
+    return json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")
