+"""Validation and canonical envelope for late-development attribution inputs.
+
+This module deliberately performs no replay or strategy computation.  It
+freezes the identity and ordering of the existing architecture experiment so
+later diagnostic layers can only consume a complete, point-in-time artifact.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import math
+from collections.abc import Mapping, Sequence
+from enum import StrEnum
+from typing import Any
+
+from .architecture_experiment import (
+    ARCHITECTURE_ATTRIBUTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
+    ArchitectureStage,
+    load_architecture_experiment_manifest,
+)
+
+LATE_DEV_ATTRIBUTION_SCHEMA_VERSION = "quant-v2-late-dev-cost-attribution.v2"
+BLOCKED_PROMOTION_STATE = "BLOCKED_PAUSE_PROMOTION_AND_TRAINING"
+
+_BRIDGE_STAGES = (
+    ArchitectureStage.A1_SIGN.value,
+    ArchitectureStage.A1_SCORE.value,
+    ArchitectureStage.A2.value,
+    ArchitectureStage.A3.value,
+    ArchitectureStage.A4.value,
+    ArchitectureStage.A5_SHADOW.value,
+)
+_EXECUTION_STAGES = (
+    ArchitectureStage.A2.value,
+    ArchitectureStage.A3.value,
+    ArchitectureStage.A4.value,
+    ArchitectureStage.A5_SHADOW.value,
+)
+_COST_STRESS_KEYS = {"0", "5", "15"}
+
+
+class EvidenceStatus(StrEnum):
+    """Evidence completeness labels used by later attribution layers."""
+
+    CONSISTENT = "CONSISTENT"
+    MIXED = "MIXED"
+    INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE = "INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE"
+    UNATTRIBUTABLE = "UNATTRIBUTABLE"
+
+
+class LateDevAttributionValidationError(ValueError):
+    """The raw architecture report is incomplete or not frozen."""
+
+
+def build_late_dev_cost_attribution(
+    report: Mapping[str, Any],
+    *,
+    source_artifact: str,
+    source_sha256: str,
+    source_size_bytes: int,
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Validate a frozen report and return deterministic accounting diagnostics."""
+    if not isinstance(report, Mapping):
+        raise LateDevAttributionValidationError("raw report must be a JSON object")
+    try:
+        manifest = load_architecture_experiment_manifest()
+        _validate_source_identity(source_sha256=source_sha256, source_size_bytes=source_size_bytes)
+        runs = _validate_report_envelope(report, manifest=manifest)
+        late_dev_runs = [run for run in runs if run["window"] == "late_dev_2025"]
+        for run in late_dev_runs:
+            _validate_required_stage_values(run)
+        required_inputs_incomplete = any(_required_seed_inputs_incomplete(run) for run in late_dev_runs)
+        seed_stage_bridges = [
+            _build_seed_stage_bridge(run, stage_name)
+            for run in late_dev_runs
+            for stage_name in _BRIDGE_STAGES
+            if _has_cost_structure(run, stage_name)
+        ]
+        episode_attribution = []
+        for run in late_dev_runs:
+            for stage_name in _EXECUTION_STAGES:
+                if not _has_episode_inputs(run, stage_name):
+                    continue
+                summary = _summarize_episodes(_stage(run, stage_name))
+                summary["seed"] = run["seed"]
+                summary["stage"] = stage_name
+                episode_attribution.append(summary)
+        execution_attribution = [
+            _summarize_execution(run, stage_name)
+            for run in late_dev_runs
+            for stage_name in _EXECUTION_STAGES
+            if _has_execution_inputs(run, stage_name)
+        ]
+        seed_evidence = _build_seed_evidence(late_dev_runs, seed_stage_bridges, episode_attribution)
+        evidence = (
+            _insufficient_sample_evidence(seed_evidence)
+            if required_inputs_incomplete
+            else _classify_evidence(seed_evidence)
+        )
+        terminal_recommendation = _terminal_recommendation(
+            required_inputs_incomplete=required_inputs_incomplete,
+            evidence=evidence,
+        )
+    except LateDevAttributionValidationError:
+        raise
+    except (KeyError, OverflowError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
+        raise LateDevAttributionValidationError("raw report contains an invalid or incomplete nested value") from exc
+
+    return {
+        "schema_version": LATE_DEV_ATTRIBUTION_SCHEMA_VERSION,
+        "source": {
+            "artifact": source_artifact,
+            "sha256": source_sha256,
+            "size_bytes": source_size_bytes,
+        },
+        "manifest_sha256": manifest.sha256,
+        "validated_run_count": len(runs),
+        "seed_stage_bridges": seed_stage_bridges,
+        "episode_attribution": episode_attribution,
+        "execution_attribution": execution_attribution,
+        "seed_evidence": seed_evidence,
+        "evidence": {
+            "required_inputs_incomplete": required_inputs_incomplete,
+            **evidence,
+        },
+        "terminal_recommendation": terminal_recommendation,
+        "research_only_non_promotable": True,
+        "promotion_state": BLOCKED_PROMOTION_STATE,
+    }
+
+
+def canonical_late_dev_attribution_bytes(report: Mapping[str, Any]) -> bytes:
+    """Return the deterministic JSON representation of an attribution report."""
+    return json.dumps(report, allow_nan=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True).encode("utf-8")
+
+
+def build_late_dev_cost_attribution_markdown(report: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
+    """Render an auditable Markdown view of an already-built attribution report."""
+    source = _mapping(report.get("source"), "attribution source")
+    evidence = _mapping(report.get("evidence"), "attribution evidence")
+    lines = [
+        "# Quant V2 late-development cost attribution",
+        "",
+        "## Identities",
+        "",
+        f"- Schema version: `{report['schema_version']}`",
+        f"- Source artifact: `{source['artifact']}`",
+        f"- Source SHA-256: `{source['sha256']}`",
+        f"- Source size bytes: `{source['size_bytes']}`",
+        f"- Manifest SHA-256: `{report['manifest_sha256']}`",
+        f"- Validated run count: `{report['validated_run_count']}`",
+        "",
+        "## Five-seed bridges",
+        "",
+        "| Seed | Stage | Baseline net PnL | Turnover notional | Additional 15bp cost | 15bp net PnL | Reconciliation error |",
+        "| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |",
+    ]
+    for bridge in report["seed_stage_bridges"]:
+        item = _mapping(bridge, "seed stage bridge")
+        lines.append(
+            "| {seed} | {stage} | {baseline} | {turnover} | {cost} | {stressed} | {error} |".format(
+                seed=item["seed"],
+                stage=item["stage"],
+                baseline=item["baseline_net_pnl"],
+                turnover=item["turnover_notional"],
+                cost=item["additional_15bp_cost"],
+                stressed=item["extra_15bp_net_pnl"],
+                error=item["reconciliation_error"],
+            )
+        )
+
+    lines.extend(
+        [
+            "",
+            "## Evidence",
+            "",
+            "| Family | Status | Supporting seeds | Insufficient-sample seeds | Inapplicable seeds |",
+            "| --- | --- | ---: | --- | --- |",
+        ]
+    )
+    for family in (
+        "directional_edge",
+        "confidence_failed_to_rescue",
+        "cost_flip",
+        "regime_localization",
+        "episode_tail",
+        "execution_shortfall",
+    ):
+        item = _mapping(evidence[family], f"{family} evidence")
+        lines.append(
+            "| {family} | {status} | {count} | {insufficient} | {inapplicable} |".format(
+                family=family,
+                status=item["status"],
+                count=item["supporting_seed_count"],
+                insufficient=", ".join(str(seed) for seed in item["insufficient_sample_seeds"]) or "-",
+                inapplicable=", ".join(str(seed) for seed in item["inapplicable_seeds"]) or "-",
+            )
+        )
+
+    confidence = _mapping(evidence["confidence_failed_to_rescue"], "confidence rescue evidence")
+    lines.extend(
+        [
+            "",
+            "## Confidence rescue diagnostics",
+            "",
+            f"- Improving seeds: `{confidence['improving_seed_count']}`; rescued seeds: `{confidence['rescued_seed_count']}`.",
+            "",
+            "| Seed | A1_SIGN 15bp PnL | A1_SCORE 15bp PnL | A1_SCORE - A1_SIGN 15bp PnL | Hit rates equal |",
+            "| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- |",
+        ]
+    )
+    for row in report["seed_evidence"]:
+        item = _mapping(row, "seed evidence")
+        if not item.get("required_inputs_complete"):
+            continue
+        lines.append(
+            "| {seed} | {sign} | {score} | {delta} | {equal} |".format(
+                seed=item["seed"],
+                sign=item["a1_sign_15bp_net_pnl"],
+                score=item["a1_score_15bp_net_pnl"],
+                delta=item["confidence_pnl_delta_15bp"],
+                equal=item["confidence_hit_rate_equal"],
+            )
+        )
+
+    lines.extend(
+        [
+            "",
+            "## A2-A5 execution, cost, and cadence",
+            "",
+            "| Seed | Stage | Status | Rows | Execution observations | Positive fills | Fills/day | Position switches/day | Actual fee | Actual slippage | Actual shortfall |",
+            "| --- | --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |",
+        ]
+    )
+    for row in report["execution_attribution"]:
+        item = _mapping(row, "execution attribution")
+        lines.append(
+            "| {seed} | {stage} | {status} | {rows} | {observations} | {fills} | {fills_per_day} | {switches} | {fee} | {slippage} | {shortfall} |".format(
+                seed=item["seed"],
+                stage=item["stage"],
+                status=item["execution_status"],
+                rows=item["attribution_row_count"],
+                observations=item["execution_observation_count"],
+                fills=item["positive_fill_count"],
+                fills_per_day=item["fills_per_day"],
+                switches=item["position_switches_per_day"],
+                fee=item["actual_fee_sum"],
+                slippage=item["actual_slippage_sum"],
+                shortfall=item["actual_implementation_shortfall_sum"],
+            )
+        )
+    lines.extend(["", "### A5 cost-shadow summaries", ""])
+    for row in report["execution_attribution"]:
+        item = _mapping(row, "execution attribution")
+        if item["cost_shadow"] is not None:
+            lines.append(f"- Seed {item['seed']}: `{json.dumps(item['cost_shadow'], sort_keys=True)}`.")
+
+    lines.extend(["", "## Regime, action, and episode summaries", ""])
+    for summary in report["episode_attribution"]:
+        item = _mapping(summary, "episode attribution")
+        lines.extend(
+            [
+                f"### Seed {item['seed']} / {item['stage']}",
+                "",
+                f"- Episode ledger: `{item['episode_ledger_status']}`; closed `{item['closed_episode_count']}`, open `{item['open_episode_count']}`.",
+                f"- Closed net PnL: `{item['closed_net_pnl']}`; open unrealized PnL: `{item['open_unrealized_pnl']}`.",
+                f"- Regime summary: `{json.dumps(item['regime_groups'], sort_keys=True)}`.",
+                f"- Execution-action summary: `{json.dumps(item['execution_actions'], sort_keys=True)}`.",
+            ]
+        )
+
+    lines.extend(
+        [
+            "",
+            "## Limitations",
+            "",
+            f"- Required inputs incomplete: `{evidence['required_inputs_incomplete']}`.",
+            f"- Research-only non-promotable: `{report['research_only_non_promotable']}`.",
+            f"- Promotion state: `{report['promotion_state']}`.",
+            "",
+            "## Recommendation",
+            "",
+            f"`{report['terminal_recommendation']}`",
+            "",
+        ]
+    )
+    return "\n".join(lines)
+
+
+def _validate_source_identity(*, source_sha256: str, source_size_bytes: int) -> None:
+    if (
+        not isinstance(source_sha256, str)
+        or len(source_sha256) != 64
+        or any(character not in "0123456789abcdef" for character in source_sha256)
+    ):
+        raise LateDevAttributionValidationError("source SHA-256 must be a lowercase hexadecimal digest")
+    if isinstance(source_size_bytes, bool) or not isinstance(source_size_bytes, int) or source_size_bytes <= 0:
+        raise LateDevAttributionValidationError("source artifact must not be empty")
+
+
+def _validate_report_envelope(report: Mapping[str, Any], *, manifest: Any) -> list[Mapping[str, Any]]:
+    if report.get("schema_version") != ARCHITECTURE_ATTRIBUTION_SCHEMA_VERSION:
+        raise LateDevAttributionValidationError(
+            f"raw report schema must be {ARCHITECTURE_ATTRIBUTION_SCHEMA_VERSION!r}"
+        )
+
+    payload = _mapping(report.get("manifest"), "manifest")
+    expected_windows = [
+        {
+            "label": window.label,
+            "start_ns": window.start_ns,
+            "end_ns": window.end_ns,
+            "role": window.role,
+        }
+        for window in manifest.windows
+    ]
+    expected_manifest = {
+        "sha256": manifest.sha256,
+        "candidate_source_sha256": manifest.candidate_source_sha256,
+        "candidate_params_sha256": manifest.candidate_params_sha256,
+        "profile_sha256": manifest.profile_sha256,
+        "windows": expected_windows,
+        "seeds": list(manifest.seeds),
+        "cost_stress_bps": list(manifest.cost_stress_bps),
+    }
+    for key, expected in expected_manifest.items():
+        if payload.get(key) != expected:
+            raise LateDevAttributionValidationError(f"raw report manifest identity mismatch: {key}")
+
+    oos_windows = [window["label"] for window in expected_windows if window["role"] == "OOS"]
+    if oos_windows != ["late_dev_2025"]:
+        raise LateDevAttributionValidationError("frozen report requires exactly one OOS window named late_dev_2025")
+
+    expected_stages = [stage.value for stage in ArchitectureStage]
+    if report.get("stages") != expected_stages:
+        raise LateDevAttributionValidationError("raw report stage order does not match the frozen architecture")
+
+    raw_runs = report.get("runs")
+    if not isinstance(raw_runs, list) or not all(isinstance(run, Mapping) for run in raw_runs):
+        raise LateDevAttributionValidationError("raw report runs must be a list of objects")
+    runs = list(raw_runs)
+    observed = []
+    expected_window_bounds = {window["label"]: (window["start_ns"], window["end_ns"]) for window in expected_windows}
+    for run in runs:
+        window = run.get("window")
+        seed = run.get("seed")
+        if not isinstance(window, str) or isinstance(seed, bool) or not isinstance(seed, int):
+            raise LateDevAttributionValidationError("raw report matrix mismatch")
+        start_ns = _exact_int(run.get("start_ns"), "run start_ns")
+        end_ns = _exact_int(run.get("end_ns"), "run end_ns")
+        if end_ns <= start_ns:
+            raise LateDevAttributionValidationError("run duration must be positive")
+        if expected_window_bounds.get(window) != (start_ns, end_ns):
+            raise LateDevAttributionValidationError("raw report run window bounds mismatch")
+        observed.append((window, seed))
+    expected = list(manifest.expected_run_keys)
+    if observed != expected or len(observed) != len(set(observed)):
+        raise LateDevAttributionValidationError("raw report matrix mismatch")
+    for run in runs:
+        stages = _mapping(run.get("stages"), "run stages")
+        if len(stages) != len(expected_stages) or set(stages) != set(expected_stages):
+            raise LateDevAttributionValidationError("run stage keys do not match the frozen architecture")
+        for expected_stage in expected_stages:
+            stage_payload = stages[expected_stage]
+            if not isinstance(stage_payload, Mapping):
+                raise LateDevAttributionValidationError("run stage payloads must be JSON objects")
+            if stage_payload.get("stage") != expected_stage:
+                raise LateDevAttributionValidationError("run stage payload declaration does not match its key")
+    return runs
+
+
+def _exact_int(value: Any, name: str) -> int:
+    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int):
+        raise LateDevAttributionValidationError(f"{name} must be an exact integer")
+    return value
+
+
+def _mapping(value: Any, name: str) -> Mapping[str, Any]:
+    if not isinstance(value, Mapping):
+        raise LateDevAttributionValidationError(f"raw report {name} must be a JSON object")
+    return value
+
+
+def _build_seed_stage_bridge(run: Mapping[str, Any], stage_name: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Reconcile a frozen seed-stage baseline against its extra-15bp result."""
+    stage = _stage(run, stage_name)
+    baseline = _finite(stage["cost_stress"]["0"]["net_pnl"], "baseline net PnL")
+    stressed = _finite(stage["cost_stress"]["15"]["net_pnl"], "15bp net PnL")
+    turnover = _nonnegative_finite(stage["turnover_notional"], "turnover notional")
+    additional_cost = turnover * 15.0 / 10_000.0
+    error = stressed - (baseline - additional_cost)
+    if not math.isclose(error, 0.0, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=1e-6):
+        raise LateDevAttributionValidationError("15bp bridge does not reconcile")
+    return {
+        "seed": run["seed"],
+        "stage": stage_name,
+        "baseline_net_pnl": baseline,
+        "turnover_notional": turnover,
+        "additional_15bp_cost": additional_cost,
+        "extra_15bp_net_pnl": stressed,
+        "reconciliation_error": error,
+    }
+
+
+def _required_seed_inputs_incomplete(run: Mapping[str, Any]) -> bool:
+    """Return whether a required diagnostic collection is structurally absent."""
+    if any(not _has_cost_structure(run, stage_name) for stage_name in _BRIDGE_STAGES):
+        return True
+    return any(
+        not _has_episode_inputs(run, stage_name) or not _has_execution_inputs(run, stage_name)
+        for stage_name in _EXECUTION_STAGES
+    )
+
+
+def _has_cost_structure(run: Mapping[str, Any], stage_name: str) -> bool:
+    stage = _stage(run, stage_name)
+    if "cost_stress" not in stage:
+        return False
+    costs = _mapping(stage["cost_stress"], f"{stage_name} cost stress")
+    if set(costs) != _COST_STRESS_KEYS:
+        raise LateDevAttributionValidationError(
+            f"{stage_name} cost stress must contain exactly {sorted(_COST_STRESS_KEYS)!r}"
+        )
+    for stress_bps in ("0", "5", "15"):
+        cost_row = _mapping(costs[stress_bps], f"{stage_name} cost stress {stress_bps}")
+        if "net_pnl" not in cost_row:
+            raise LateDevAttributionValidationError(
+                f"{stage_name} cost stress {stress_bps} must include net_pnl when present"
+            )
+        _finite(cost_row["net_pnl"], f"{stage_name} cost stress {stress_bps} net PnL")
+    return True
+
+
+def _has_episode_inputs(run: Mapping[str, Any], stage_name: str) -> bool:
+    stage = _stage(run, stage_name)
+    return "attribution_rows" in stage and "position_episodes" in stage and "episode_ledger" in stage
+
+
+def _has_execution_inputs(run: Mapping[str, Any], stage_name: str) -> bool:
+    stage = _stage(run, stage_name)
+    required = {"attribution_rows", "execution_metrics"}
+    if stage_name == ArchitectureStage.A5_SHADOW.value:
+        required.add("cost_shadow")
+    return required.issubset(stage)
+
+
+def _validate_required_stage_values(run: Mapping[str, Any]) -> None:
+    for stage_name in _BRIDGE_STAGES:
+        stage = _stage(run, stage_name)
+        rate = _finite(stage.get("direction_hit_rate"), f"{stage_name} direction hit rate")
+        if not 0.0 <= rate <= 1.0:
+            raise LateDevAttributionValidationError(f"{stage_name} direction hit rate must be between zero and one")
+        _nonnegative_finite(stage.get("turnover_notional"), f"{stage_name} turnover notional")
+        _has_cost_structure(run, stage_name)
+
+
+def _build_seed_evidence(
+    runs: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]],
+    bridges: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]],
+    episode_attribution: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]],
+) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Serialize only factual inputs and frozen per-family predicates for each seed."""
+    bridge_by_seed_stage = {(bridge["seed"], bridge["stage"]): bridge for bridge in bridges}
+    episode_by_seed_stage = {(summary["seed"], summary["stage"]): summary for summary in episode_attribution}
+    evidence: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for run in runs:
+        seed = run["seed"]
+        sign_hit_rate = _finite(
+            _stage(run, ArchitectureStage.A1_SIGN.value)["direction_hit_rate"], "A1_SIGN direction hit rate"
+        )
+        score_hit_rate = _finite(
+            _stage(run, ArchitectureStage.A1_SCORE.value)["direction_hit_rate"], "A1_SCORE direction hit rate"
+        )
+        sign_bridge = bridge_by_seed_stage.get((seed, ArchitectureStage.A1_SIGN.value))
+        score_bridge = bridge_by_seed_stage.get((seed, ArchitectureStage.A1_SCORE.value))
+        a5_bridge = bridge_by_seed_stage.get((seed, ArchitectureStage.A5_SHADOW.value))
+        summary = episode_by_seed_stage.get((seed, ArchitectureStage.A5_SHADOW.value))
+        if (
+            _required_seed_inputs_incomplete(run)
+            or sign_bridge is None
+            or score_bridge is None
+            or a5_bridge is None
+            or summary is None
+        ):
+            evidence.append({"seed": seed, "required_inputs_complete": False})
+            continue
+        regime_groups = _mapping(summary["regime_groups"], "regime groups")
+        closed_episode_count = _nonnegative_int(summary["closed_episode_count"], "closed episode count")
+        negative_tail_share = summary["negative_tail_share"]
+        if negative_tail_share is not None:
+            negative_tail_share = _finite(negative_tail_share, "negative tail share")
+        execution_actions = _mapping(summary["execution_actions"], "execution actions")
+        shortfall_count = _nonnegative_int(
+            execution_actions["implementation_shortfall_observation_count"],
+            "implementation shortfall observation count",
+        )
+        shortfall = _finite(execution_actions["implementation_shortfall"], "implementation shortfall")
+        sign_pnl = _finite(sign_bridge["extra_15bp_net_pnl"], "A1_SIGN 15bp net PnL")
+        score_pnl = _finite(score_bridge["extra_15bp_net_pnl"], "A1_SCORE 15bp net PnL")
+        baseline_pnl = _finite(a5_bridge["baseline_net_pnl"], "A5 baseline net PnL")
+        a5_15bp_pnl = _finite(a5_bridge["extra_15bp_net_pnl"], "A5 15bp net PnL")
+        evidence.append(
+            {
+                "seed": seed,
+                "required_inputs_complete": True,
+                "a1_sign_hit_rate": sign_hit_rate,
+                "a1_sign_15bp_net_pnl": sign_pnl,
+                "a1_score_hit_rate": score_hit_rate,
+                "a1_score_15bp_net_pnl": score_pnl,
+                "confidence_pnl_delta_15bp": score_pnl - sign_pnl,
+                "confidence_hit_rate_equal": math.isclose(
+                    score_hit_rate,
+                    sign_hit_rate,
+                    rel_tol=0.0,
+                    abs_tol=1e-12,
+                ),
+                "a5_baseline_net_pnl": baseline_pnl,
+                "a5_15bp_net_pnl": a5_15bp_pnl,
+                "regime_groups": regime_groups,
+                "closed_episode_count": closed_episode_count,
+                "negative_tail_share": negative_tail_share,
+                "implementation_shortfall_observation_count": shortfall_count,
+                "implementation_shortfall": shortfall,
+                "directional_edge_support": sign_pnl <= 0.0 and sign_hit_rate < 0.50,
+                "confidence_failed_to_rescue_support": score_pnl <= 0.0,
+                "cost_flip_support": baseline_pnl > 0.0 and a5_15bp_pnl <= 0.0,
+                "regime_localization_support": _regime_localization_support(regime_groups),
+                "episode_tail_support": (
+                    closed_episode_count >= 20 and negative_tail_share is not None and negative_tail_share >= 0.60
+                ),
+                "execution_shortfall_support": (
+                    shortfall_count >= 20 and baseline_pnl < 0.0 and shortfall >= 0.25 * abs(baseline_pnl)
+                ),
+            }
+        )
+    return evidence
+
+
+def _regime_localization_support(regime_groups: Mapping[str, Any]) -> bool:
+    """Apply the frozen single-regime loss concentration rule."""
+    net_pnls = {
+        regime: _finite(_mapping(values, "regime group")["net_pnl_15bp"], "regime net PnL")
+        for regime, values in regime_groups.items()
+    }
+    negative = {regime: -pnl for regime, pnl in net_pnls.items() if pnl < 0.0}
+    total_negative = sum(negative.values())
+    if total_negative == 0.0:
+        return False
+    return any(
+        contribution / total_negative >= 0.60
+        and all(other_pnl > 0.0 for other_regime, other_pnl in net_pnls.items() if other_regime != regime)
+        for regime, contribution in negative.items()
+    )
+
+
+def _classify_evidence(seed_evidence: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Apply fixed four-of-five evidence classification to serialized seed facts."""
+    families = (
+        ("directional_edge", "directional_edge_support"),
+        ("confidence_failed_to_rescue", "confidence_failed_to_rescue_support"),
+        ("cost_flip", "cost_flip_support"),
+        ("regime_localization", "regime_localization_support"),
+    )
+    classified = {name: _classify_family(seed_evidence, support_key=support_key) for name, support_key in families}
+    classified["confidence_failed_to_rescue"].update(_confidence_counts(seed_evidence))
+    classified["episode_tail"] = _classify_family(
+        seed_evidence,
+        support_key="episode_tail_support",
+        sample_floor_key="closed_episode_count",
+        sample_floor=20,
+    )
+    classified["execution_shortfall"] = _classify_family(
+        seed_evidence,
+        support_key="execution_shortfall_support",
+        sample_floor_key="implementation_shortfall_observation_count",
+        sample_floor=20,
+        inapplicable=lambda row: float(row["a5_baseline_net_pnl"]) >= 0.0,
+    )
+    return classified
+
+
+def _classify_family(
+    seed_evidence: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]],
+    *,
+    support_key: str,
+    sample_floor_key: str | None = None,
+    sample_floor: int | None = None,
+    inapplicable: Any = None,
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    inapplicable_seeds = [int(row["seed"]) for row in seed_evidence if inapplicable is not None and inapplicable(row)]
+    applicable_evidence = [row for row in seed_evidence if int(row["seed"]) not in inapplicable_seeds]
+    supporting_seeds = [int(row["seed"]) for row in applicable_evidence if row.get(support_key) is True]
+    insufficient_sample_seeds = (
+        [int(row["seed"]) for row in applicable_evidence if int(row.get(sample_floor_key, 0)) < sample_floor]
+        if sample_floor_key is not None and sample_floor is not None
+        else []
+    )
+    if len(supporting_seeds) >= 4:
+        status = EvidenceStatus.CONSISTENT.value
+    elif insufficient_sample_seeds:
+        status = EvidenceStatus.INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE.value
+    elif supporting_seeds:
+        status = EvidenceStatus.MIXED.value
+    else:
+        status = EvidenceStatus.UNATTRIBUTABLE.value
+    return {
+        "status": status,
+        "supporting_seed_count": len(supporting_seeds),
+        "supporting_seeds": supporting_seeds,
+        "insufficient_sample_seeds": insufficient_sample_seeds,
+        "inapplicable_seeds": inapplicable_seeds,
+    }
+
+
+def _insufficient_sample_evidence(seed_evidence: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Fail closed when a required diagnostic collection is absent."""
+    families = (
+        "directional_edge",
+        "confidence_failed_to_rescue",
+        "cost_flip",
+        "regime_localization",
+        "episode_tail",
+        "execution_shortfall",
+    )
+    incomplete_seeds = [int(row["seed"]) for row in seed_evidence if not row.get("required_inputs_complete")]
+    evidence = {
+        family: {
+            "status": EvidenceStatus.INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE.value,
+            "supporting_seed_count": 0,
+            "supporting_seeds": [],
+            "insufficient_sample_seeds": incomplete_seeds,
+            "inapplicable_seeds": [],
+        }
+        for family in families
+    }
+    evidence["confidence_failed_to_rescue"].update(_confidence_counts(seed_evidence))
+    return evidence
+
+
+def _confidence_counts(seed_evidence: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    complete = [
+        row
+        for row in seed_evidence
+        if row.get("required_inputs_complete", True)
+        and "confidence_pnl_delta_15bp" in row
+        and "a1_score_15bp_net_pnl" in row
+    ]
+    improving_seeds = [int(row["seed"]) for row in complete if float(row["confidence_pnl_delta_15bp"]) > 0.0]
+    rescued_seeds = [int(row["seed"]) for row in complete if float(row["a1_score_15bp_net_pnl"]) > 0.0]
+    return {
+        "improving_seed_count": len(improving_seeds),
+        "improving_seeds": improving_seeds,
+        "rescued_seed_count": len(rescued_seeds),
+        "rescued_seeds": rescued_seeds,
+    }
+
+
+def _terminal_recommendation(*, required_inputs_incomplete: bool, evidence: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
+    if required_inputs_incomplete:
+        return "insufficient_evidence_no_strategy_change"
+    if evidence["directional_edge"]["supporting_seed_count"] >= 4:
+        return "stop_donor_training"
+    if evidence["regime_localization"]["supporting_seed_count"] >= 4:
+        return "prepare_regime_objective_redesign"
+    return "insufficient_evidence_no_strategy_change"
+
+
+def build_regime_objective_hypothesis(attribution: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
+    """Return a non-promotable regime hypothesis only for a localized failure."""
+    if attribution.get("terminal_recommendation") != "prepare_regime_objective_redesign":
+        return None
+    return {
+        "schema_version": "quant-v2-regime-objective-hypothesis.v1",
+        "research_only_non_promotable": True,
+        "promotion_state": BLOCKED_PROMOTION_STATE,
+        "failure_family": "regime_localization",
+        "market_behavior_hypothesis": (
+            "Late-development loss is concentrated in one observed regime while the other observed regimes "
+            "remain net positive after the fixed 15bp turnover cost allocation."
+        ),
+        "excluded_prior_exploration_families": [
+            "threshold sweeping",
+            "leverage expansion",
+            "donor continuation",
+        ],
+        "oos_only_falsification_gate": (
+            "A separately authorized out-of-sample-only evaluation falsifies this hypothesis unless the same "
+            "localized loss pattern recurs in at least four of five perturbation seeds."
+        ),
+    }
+
+
+def _summarize_execution(run: Mapping[str, Any], stage_name: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Aggregate only serialized execution and cost-shadow observations."""
+    stage = _stage(run, stage_name)
+    rows = stage.get("attribution_rows")
+    if not isinstance(rows, list) or not all(isinstance(row, Mapping) for row in rows):
+        raise LateDevAttributionValidationError("attribution rows must be a list of objects")
+    metrics = _mapping(stage.get("execution_metrics"), f"{stage_name} execution metrics")
+    status = metrics.get("status")
+    if status not in {"OBSERVED", "NOT_OBSERVED"}:
+        raise LateDevAttributionValidationError("execution metrics status must be OBSERVED or NOT_OBSERVED")
+    position_switches_per_day = None
+    if status == "OBSERVED":
+        position_switches_per_day = _nonnegative_finite(
+            metrics.get("position_switches_per_day"),
+            "position switches per day",
+        )
+
+    actions = {action: 0 for action in ("entry", "exit", "flip", "add", "reduce", "unchanged")}
+    execution_rows = []
+    for row in rows:
+        _nonnegative_finite(row.get("turnover_notional"), "attribution turnover notional")
+        _nonnegative_finite(row.get("baseline_execution_cost"), "attribution baseline execution cost")
+        execution = row.get("execution")
+        if execution is None:
+            continue
+        execution_row = _mapping(execution, "attribution execution")
+        filled_qty = _nonnegative_finite(execution_row.get("filled_qty"), "filled quantity")
+        fee = _nonnegative_finite(execution_row.get("fee"), "actual fee")
+        slippage = _nonnegative_finite(execution_row.get("actual_slippage"), "actual slippage")
+        shortfall = _nonnegative_finite(
+            execution_row.get("actual_implementation_shortfall"),
+            "actual implementation shortfall",
+        )
+        action = _derive_execution_action(execution_row)
+        actions[action] += 1
+        execution_rows.append(
+            {
+                "filled_qty": filled_qty,
+                "fee": fee,
+                "slippage": slippage,
+                "shortfall": shortfall,
+            }
+        )
+    if status == "OBSERVED" and len(execution_rows) != len(rows):
+        raise LateDevAttributionValidationError("observed execution rows must cover every attribution row")
+    if status == "NOT_OBSERVED" and execution_rows:
+        raise LateDevAttributionValidationError("not observed execution metrics cannot contain execution rows")
+
+    duration_days = (_exact_int(run.get("end_ns"), "run end_ns") - _exact_int(run.get("start_ns"), "run start_ns")) / (
+        86_400 * 1_000_000_000
+    )
+    if not math.isfinite(duration_days) or duration_days <= 0.0:
+        raise LateDevAttributionValidationError("run duration must be positive and finite")
+    positive_fill_count = sum(1 for row in execution_rows if row["filled_qty"] > 0.0)
+    summary: dict[str, Any] = {
+        "seed": run["seed"],
+        "stage": stage_name,
+        "execution_status": status,
+        "attribution_row_count": len(rows),
+        "execution_observation_count": len(execution_rows),
+        "positive_fill_count": positive_fill_count,
+        "fills_per_day": positive_fill_count / duration_days,
+        "position_switches_per_day": position_switches_per_day,
+        "action_counts": actions,
+        "actual_fee_observation_count": len(execution_rows),
+        "actual_fee_sum": sum(row["fee"] for row in execution_rows),
+        "actual_slippage_observation_count": len(execution_rows),
+        "actual_slippage_sum": sum(row["slippage"] for row in execution_rows),
+        "actual_implementation_shortfall_observation_count": len(execution_rows),
+        "actual_implementation_shortfall_sum": sum(row["shortfall"] for row in execution_rows),
+        "cost_shadow": None,
+    }
+    if stage_name == ArchitectureStage.A5_SHADOW.value:
+        summary["cost_shadow"] = _summarize_cost_shadow(stage, rows)
+    return summary
+
+
+def _summarize_cost_shadow(stage: Mapping[str, Any], rows: list[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    _mapping(stage.get("cost_shadow"), "A5 cost shadow")
+    observations = []
+    for row in rows:
+        shadow = _mapping(row.get("cost_shadow"), "A5 attribution cost shadow")
+        estimated_fee = _nonnegative_finite(shadow.get("estimated_fee"), "estimated fee")
+        estimated_slippage = _nonnegative_finite(shadow.get("estimated_slippage"), "estimated slippage")
+        round_trip_cost = _nonnegative_finite(shadow.get("round_trip_cost"), "estimated round-trip cost")
+        breakeven = _nonnegative_finite(shadow.get("breakeven_move"), "breakeven move")
+        for horizon in (1, 3, 6):
+            _optional_finite(shadow.get(f"forward_return_{horizon}"), f"forward return {horizon}")
+        observations.append(
+            {
+                "estimated_fee": estimated_fee,
+                "estimated_slippage": estimated_slippage,
+                "round_trip_cost": round_trip_cost,
+                "breakeven": breakeven,
+                "forward_labels": {
+                    str(horizon): shadow.get(f"forward_return_{horizon}") is not None for horizon in (1, 3, 6)
+                },
+            }
+        )
+    return {
+        "observation_count": len(observations),
+        "estimated_fee_sum": sum(row["estimated_fee"] for row in observations),
+        "estimated_slippage_sum": sum(row["estimated_slippage"] for row in observations),
+        "estimated_round_trip_cost_sum": sum(row["round_trip_cost"] for row in observations),
+        "breakeven_observation_count": len(observations),
+        "breakeven_mean": sum(row["breakeven"] for row in observations) / len(observations) if observations else None,
+        "forward_label_counts": {
+            str(horizon): sum(1 for row in observations if row["forward_labels"][str(horizon)]) for horizon in (1, 3, 6)
+        },
+    }
+
+
+def _summarize_episodes(stage: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Summarize serialized later-stage episodes and explicit attribution rows only."""
+    episodes = stage.get("position_episodes")
+    if not isinstance(episodes, list) or not all(isinstance(episode, Mapping) for episode in episodes):
+        raise LateDevAttributionValidationError("position episodes must be a list of objects")
+    closed = [episode for episode in episodes if _closed(episode)]
+    open_episodes = [episode for episode in episodes if not _closed(episode)]
+    episode_ledger = _mapping(stage.get("episode_ledger"), "episode ledger")
+    episode_ledger_status = episode_ledger.get("status")
+    if episode_ledger_status not in {"OBSERVED", "NOT_OBSERVED"}:
+        raise LateDevAttributionValidationError("episode ledger status must be OBSERVED or NOT_OBSERVED")
+    ledger_closed_count = _nonnegative_int(
+        episode_ledger.get("closed_episode_count"), "episode ledger closed episode count"
+    )
+    ledger_open_count = _nonnegative_int(episode_ledger.get("open_episode_count"), "episode ledger open episode count")
+    if ledger_closed_count != len(closed):
+        raise LateDevAttributionValidationError("episode ledger closed episode count mismatch")
+    if ledger_open_count != len(open_episodes):
+        raise LateDevAttributionValidationError("episode ledger open episode count mismatch")
+    if episode_ledger_status == "NOT_OBSERVED" and (episodes or ledger_closed_count or ledger_open_count):
+        raise LateDevAttributionValidationError("not observed episode ledger must be empty")
+    closed_totals = _episode_totals(closed)
+    by_side = {
+        side: {"closed_episode_count": len(items), **_episode_totals(items)}
+        for side, items in (
+            ("LONG", [episode for episode in closed if _side(episode) == "LONG"]),
+            ("SHORT", [episode for episode in closed if _side(episode) == "SHORT"]),
+        )
+        if items
+    }
+    rows = stage.get("attribution_rows")
+    if not isinstance(rows, list) or not all(isinstance(row, Mapping) for row in rows):
+        raise LateDevAttributionValidationError("attribution rows must be a list of objects")
+    return {
+        "episode_ledger_status": episode_ledger_status,
+        "closed_episode_count": len(closed),
+        "open_episode_count": len(open_episodes),
+        "closed_net_pnl": closed_totals["net_pnl"],
+        "open_unrealized_pnl": sum(
+            _finite(episode["unrealized_pnl"], "open episode unrealized PnL") for episode in open_episodes
+        ),
+        "closed_totals": closed_totals,
+        "by_side": by_side,
+        "negative_tail_share": _negative_tail_share(closed),
+        "regime_groups": _attribution_groups(rows, field="regime"),
+        "playbook_groups": _playbook_groups(rows),
+        "execution_actions": _execution_actions(rows),
+    }
+
+
+def _derive_execution_action(row: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
+    """Classify a serialized filled-position transition without market inference."""
+    before = _finite(row["filled_position_before"], "filled position before")
+    after = _finite(row["filled_position_after"], "filled position after")
+    if before == 0.0 and after != 0.0:
+        return "entry"
+    if after == 0.0:
+        return "exit"
+    if before * after < 0.0:
+        return "flip"
+    if abs(after) > abs(before):
+        return "add"
+    if abs(after) < abs(before):
+        return "reduce"
+    return "unchanged"
+
+
+def _stage(run: Mapping[str, Any], stage_name: str) -> Mapping[str, Any]:
+    stages = _mapping(run.get("stages"), "run stages")
+    return _mapping(stages.get(stage_name), f"{stage_name} stage")
+
+
+def _finite(value: Any, name: str) -> float:
+    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float)):
+        raise LateDevAttributionValidationError(f"{name} must be finite")
+    numeric = float(value)
+    if not math.isfinite(numeric):
+        raise LateDevAttributionValidationError(f"{name} must be finite")
+    return numeric
+
+
+def _nonnegative_finite(value: Any, name: str) -> float:
+    numeric = _finite(value, name)
+    if numeric < 0.0:
+        raise LateDevAttributionValidationError(f"{name} must be non-negative")
+    return numeric
+
+
+def _optional_finite(value: Any, name: str) -> float | None:
+    return None if value is None else _finite(value, name)
+
+
+def _closed(episode: Mapping[str, Any]) -> bool:
+    closed = episode.get("closed")
+    if not isinstance(closed, bool):
+        raise LateDevAttributionValidationError("episode closed flag must be boolean")
+    return closed
+
+
+def _side(episode: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
+    side = episode.get("side")
+    if isinstance(side, bool) or side not in {-1, 1}:
+        raise LateDevAttributionValidationError("episode side must be -1 or 1")
+    return "LONG" if side == 1 else "SHORT"
+
+
+def _episode_totals(episodes: list[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, float | int]:
+    signed_fields = (
+        "gross_realized_pnl",
+        "funding_pnl",
+        "net_pnl",
+        "mfe_pnl",
+        "mae_pnl",
+    )
+    totals: dict[str, float | int] = {
+        field: sum(_finite(episode[field], f"episode {field}") for episode in episodes) for field in signed_fields
+    }
+    totals["fees"] = sum(_nonnegative_finite(episode["fees"], "episode fees") for episode in episodes)
+    for field in ("holding_duration_ns", "fill_count", "add_count", "reduce_count"):
+        totals[field] = sum(_nonnegative_int(episode[field], f"episode {field}") for episode in episodes)
+    return totals
+
+
+def _nonnegative_int(value: Any, name: str) -> int:
+    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int) or value < 0:
+        raise LateDevAttributionValidationError(f"{name} must be a non-negative integer")
+    return value
+
+
+def _negative_tail_share(closed: list[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> float | None:
+    if not closed:
+        return None
+    losses = sorted(
+        (_finite(episode["net_pnl"], "episode net PnL") for episode in closed),
+        key=lambda pnl: max(0.0, -pnl),
+        reverse=True,
+    )
+    losses = [max(0.0, -pnl) for pnl in losses]
+    total_loss = sum(losses)
+    if total_loss == 0.0:
+        return 0.0
+    tail_count = max(1, math.ceil(0.10 * len(closed)))
+    return sum(losses[:tail_count]) / total_loss
+
+
+def _attribution_groups(rows: list[Mapping[str, Any]], *, field: str) -> dict[str, dict[str, float | int]]:
+    grouped: dict[str, list[Mapping[str, Any]]] = {}
+    for row in rows:
+        value = row.get(field)
+        if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
+            raise LateDevAttributionValidationError(f"attribution row {field} must be explicit")
+        grouped.setdefault(value, []).append(row)
+    return {value: _attribution_totals(grouped[value]) for value in sorted(grouped)}
+
+
+def _attribution_totals(rows: list[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, float | int]:
+    gross_pnl = sum(_finite(row["gross_pnl"], "attribution gross PnL") for row in rows)
+    turnover = sum(_nonnegative_finite(row["turnover_notional"], "attribution turnover notional") for row in rows)
+    baseline_cost = sum(
+        _nonnegative_finite(row["baseline_execution_cost"], "attribution baseline execution cost") for row in rows
+    )
+    funding_pnl = sum(_finite(row["funding_pnl"], "attribution funding PnL") for row in rows)
+    additional_cost = turnover * 15.0 / 10_000.0
+    return {
+        "row_count": len(rows),
+        "gross_pnl": gross_pnl,
+        "turnover_notional": turnover,
+        "baseline_execution_cost": baseline_cost,
+        "funding_pnl": funding_pnl,
+        "additional_15bp_cost": additional_cost,
+        "net_pnl_15bp": gross_pnl + funding_pnl - baseline_cost - additional_cost,
+    }
+
+
+def _playbook_groups(rows: list[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    if not any("playbook_id" in row for row in rows):
+        return {"status": EvidenceStatus.INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE.value, "groups": {}}
+    return {"status": EvidenceStatus.CONSISTENT.value, "groups": _attribution_groups(rows, field="playbook_id")}
+
+
+def _execution_actions(rows: list[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, float | int]:
+    actions = {action: 0 for action in ("entry", "exit", "flip", "add", "reduce", "unchanged")}
+    shortfall_count = 0
+    shortfall = 0.0
+    for row in rows:
+        execution = row.get("execution")
+        if execution is None:
+            continue
+        execution_row = _mapping(execution, "attribution execution")
+        actions[_derive_execution_action(execution_row)] += 1
+        shortfall_count += 1
+        shortfall += _finite(execution_row["actual_implementation_shortfall"], "actual implementation shortfall")
+    return {
+        **actions,
+        "implementation_shortfall_observation_count": shortfall_count,
+        "implementation_shortfall": shortfall,
+    }

+_StageKey = tuple[str, int, str]

+def audit_stage_provenance(
+    legacy_report: Mapping[str, Any],
+    repaired_report: Mapping[str, Any],
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Classify exact window/seed/stage evidence without assuming independence."""
+    legacy_stages, legacy_run_keys = _index_stages(legacy_report, label="legacy")
+    repaired_stages, repaired_run_keys = _index_stages(repaired_report, label="repaired")
+    run_keys = legacy_run_keys | repaired_run_keys
+    if not run_keys:
+        raise ValueError("expected provenance universe cannot be empty")
+    expected_keys = {(window, seed, stage.value) for window, seed in run_keys for stage in ArchitectureStage}
+    records = [_audit_stage(key, legacy_stages.get(key), repaired_stages.get(key)) for key in sorted(expected_keys)]
+    counts = {state.value: 0 for state in ValidityState}
+    for record in records:
+        counts[record["state"]] += 1
+    return {
+        "schema_version": STAGE_PROVENANCE_SCHEMA_VERSION,
+        "records": records,
+        "counts": counts,
+    }
+
+
+def _audit_stage(
+    key: _StageKey,
+    legacy_stage: Mapping[str, Any] | None,
+    repaired_stage: Mapping[str, Any] | None,
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    legacy_payload, legacy_error = _try_extract_stage_payload(legacy_stage, stage=key[2])
+    repaired_payload, repaired_error = _try_extract_stage_payload(repaired_stage, stage=key[2])
+    legacy_sha256 = _canonical_payload_sha256(legacy_payload) if legacy_payload is not None else None
+    repaired_sha256 = _canonical_payload_sha256(repaired_payload) if repaired_payload is not None else None
+
+    if legacy_stage is None or repaired_stage is None:
+        state = ValidityState.UNVERIFIED_LEGACY
+        reason = "stage_key_missing"
+    elif legacy_error is not None or repaired_error is not None:
+        state = ValidityState.UNVERIFIED_LEGACY
+        reason = "stage_provenance_incomplete"
+    elif legacy_sha256 == repaired_sha256:
+        state = ValidityState.PROVEN_UNAFFECTED
+        reason = "exact_extracted_stage_payload_match"
+    else:
+        state = ValidityState.CONFIRMED_AFFECTED
+        reason = "extracted_stage_payload_changed"
+
+    return {
+        "window": key[0],
+        "seed": key[1],
+        "stage": key[2],
+        "state": state.value,
+        "reason": reason,
+        "legacy_stage_payload_sha256": legacy_sha256,
+        "repaired_stage_payload_sha256": repaired_sha256,
+        "legacy_error": legacy_error,
+        "repaired_error": repaired_error,
+    }
+
+
+def _index_stages(
+    report: Mapping[str, Any],
+    *,
+    label: str,
+) -> tuple[dict[_StageKey, Mapping[str, Any]], set[tuple[str, int]]]:
+    runs = report.get("runs")
+    if not isinstance(runs, list):
+        raise ValueError(f"{label} report runs must be a list")
+    indexed: dict[_StageKey, Mapping[str, Any]] = {}
+    run_keys: set[tuple[str, int]] = set()
+    expected_stages = {stage.value for stage in ArchitectureStage}
+    for run_index, run in enumerate(runs):
+        if not isinstance(run, Mapping):
+            raise ValueError(f"{label} report run {run_index} must be an object")
+        window = run.get("window")
+        seed = run.get("seed")
+        stages = run.get("stages")
+        if not isinstance(window, str) or not window:
+            raise ValueError(f"{label} report run {run_index} requires a window")
+        if isinstance(seed, bool) or not isinstance(seed, int):
+            raise ValueError(f"{label} report run {run_index} requires an integer seed")
+        if not isinstance(stages, Mapping):
+            raise ValueError(f"{label} report run {run_index} stages must be an object")
+        run_key = (window, seed)
+        if run_key in run_keys:
+            raise ValueError(f"{label} report contains duplicate run key {run_key!r}")
+        run_keys.add(run_key)
+        for stage, payload in stages.items():
+            if not isinstance(stage, str) or not stage or not isinstance(payload, Mapping):
+                raise ValueError(f"{label} report run {run_index} contains an invalid stage payload")
+            if stage not in expected_stages:
+                raise ValueError(f"{label} report run {run_index} contains unexpected stage {stage!r}")
+            key = (window, seed, stage)
+            if key in indexed:
+                raise ValueError(f"{label} report contains duplicate stage key {key!r}")
+            indexed[key] = payload
+    return indexed, run_keys
+
+
+def _try_extract_stage_payload(
+    stage_payload: Mapping[str, Any] | None,
+    *,
+    stage: str,
+) -> tuple[dict[str, Any] | None, str | None]:
+    if stage_payload is None:
+        return None, "missing_stage_key"
+    try:
+        return _extract_stage_payload(stage_payload, stage=stage), None
+    except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
+        return None, str(exc)
+
+
+def _extract_stage_payload(stage_payload: Mapping[str, Any], *, stage: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    if stage_payload.get("stage") != stage:
+        raise ValueError("stage declaration does not match its key")
+    _require_fields(
+        stage_payload,
+        ("pnl_basis", "gross_pnl", "turnover_notional", "cost_stress", "position_episodes", "episode_ledger"),
+        label=f"{stage} stage",
+    )
+    rows = stage_payload.get("attribution_rows")
+    if not isinstance(rows, list) or not rows:
+        raise ValueError("attribution_rows must be a non-empty list")
+    extracted_rows = [_extract_attribution_row(row, index=index, stage=stage) for index, row in enumerate(rows)]
+    episodes = stage_payload["position_episodes"]
+    if not isinstance(episodes, list) or not episodes:
+        raise ValueError("position_episodes must be a non-empty list")
+    episode_ledger = stage_payload["episode_ledger"]
+    if not isinstance(episode_ledger, Mapping):
+        raise ValueError("episode_ledger must be an object")
+    _require_fields(episode_ledger, _EPISODE_LEDGER_FIELDS, label="episode_ledger")
+    return {
+        "stage": stage,
+        "rows": extracted_rows,
+        "pnl_basis": stage_payload["pnl_basis"],
+        "gross_pnl": stage_payload["gross_pnl"],
+        "turnover_notional": stage_payload["turnover_notional"],
+        "cost_stress": stage_payload["cost_stress"],
+        "episodes": [_extract_episode(episode, index=index) for index, episode in enumerate(episodes)],
+        "episode_ledger": {field: episode_ledger[field] for field in _EPISODE_LEDGER_FIELDS},
+    }
+
+
+def _extract_attribution_row(row: object, *, index: int, stage: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    if not isinstance(row, Mapping):
+        raise ValueError(f"attribution row {index} must be an object")
+    _require_fields(row, _ATTRIBUTION_ROW_FIELDS, label=f"attribution row {index}")
+    donor = row.get("risk_donor")
+    if not isinstance(donor, Mapping):
+        raise ValueError(f"attribution row {index} risk_donor must be an object")
+    donor_payload = _validated_risk_donor(
+        donor,
+        declared_sha256=row["risk_donor_sha256"],
+        label=f"attribution row {index}",
+    )
+    input_row = row["input_row"]
+    if not isinstance(input_row, Mapping):
+        raise ValueError(f"attribution row {index} input_row must be an object")
+    _require_exact_fields(input_row, _INPUT_ROW_FIELDS, label=f"attribution row {index} input_row")
+    input_row_sha256 = _validated_sha256(row["input_row_sha256"], label=f"attribution row {index} input row")
+    if _canonical_payload_sha256(input_row) != input_row_sha256:
+        raise ValueError(f"attribution row {index} input_row_sha256 does not match input_row")
+    input_donor = input_row["risk_donor"]
+    if (
+        not isinstance(input_donor, Mapping)
+        or not _canonical_values_equal(input_donor, donor_payload)
+        or input_row["risk_donor_sha256"] != row["risk_donor_sha256"]
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(f"attribution row {index} input donor provenance does not match attribution row")
+    if (
+        row["risk_snapshot_status"] != _RISK_SNAPSHOT_ASOF_STATUS
+        or input_row["risk_snapshot_status"] != _RISK_SNAPSHOT_ASOF_STATUS
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(f"attribution row {index} risk_snapshot_status must be ASOF")
+    snapshot_ts_ns = row["risk_snapshot_ts_ns"]
+    if (
+        isinstance(snapshot_ts_ns, bool)
+        or not isinstance(snapshot_ts_ns, int)
+        or not _canonical_values_equal(snapshot_ts_ns, donor_payload["ts_ns"])
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(f"attribution row {index} risk_snapshot_ts_ns does not match risk_donor ts_ns")
+    execution = row.get("execution")
+    if not isinstance(execution, Mapping):
+        raise ValueError(f"attribution row {index} execution must be an object")
+    _require_fields(execution, _EXECUTION_FIELDS, label=f"attribution row {index} execution")
+    row_safety_reasons = _sorted_strings(
+        row["safety_reasons"],
+        f"attribution row {index} safety_reasons",
+    )
+    execution_safety_reasons = _sorted_strings(
+        execution["safety_reasons"],
+        f"attribution row {index} execution safety_reasons",
+    )
+    mirrored_values = (
+        ("alpha_id", row["alpha_id"], input_row["alpha_id"]),
+        ("cutoff_time_ns", row["cutoff_time_ns"], input_row["cutoff_time_ns"]),
+        ("execution cutoff_time_ns", row["cutoff_time_ns"], execution["cutoff_time_ns"]),
+        ("approved_exposure", row["approved_exposure"], execution["approved_exposure"]),
+        ("filled_exposure_after", row["exposure"], execution["filled_exposure_after"]),
+        ("funding_pnl", row["funding_pnl"], execution["funding_pnl"]),
+        ("risk_snapshot_status", row["risk_snapshot_status"], input_row["risk_snapshot_status"]),
+        ("risk_snapshot_ts_ns", row["risk_snapshot_ts_ns"], input_row["risk_snapshot_ts_ns"]),
+        ("safety_reasons", row_safety_reasons, execution_safety_reasons),
+    )
+    for field, row_value, source_value in mirrored_values:
+        if not _canonical_values_equal(row_value, source_value):
+            raise ValueError(f"attribution row {index} {field} does not match its source evidence")
+    extracted = {
+        field: row[field] for field in _ATTRIBUTION_ROW_FIELDS if field not in {"input_row", "risk_donor", "execution"}
+    }
+    extracted.update(
+        {
+            "input_row": {field: input_row[field] for field in _INPUT_ROW_FIELDS},
+            "risk_donor": donor_payload,
+            "safety_reasons": row_safety_reasons,
+            "execution": {field: execution[field] for field in _EXECUTION_FIELDS},
+        }
+    )
+    extracted["execution"]["safety_reasons"] = execution_safety_reasons
+    if stage == "A5_SHADOW":
+        cost_shadow = row.get("cost_shadow")
+        if not isinstance(cost_shadow, Mapping):
+            raise ValueError(f"attribution row {index} cost_shadow must be an object")
+        _require_fields(cost_shadow, _COST_SHADOW_FIELDS, label=f"attribution row {index} cost_shadow")
+        extracted["cost_shadow"] = {field: cost_shadow[field] for field in _COST_SHADOW_FIELDS}
+    return extracted
+
+
+def _validated_risk_donor(
+    donor: Mapping[str, Any],
+    *,
+    declared_sha256: object,
+    label: str,
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    _require_exact_fields(donor, _RISK_DONOR_FIELDS, label=f"{label} risk_donor")
+    ts_ns = donor["ts_ns"]
+    if isinstance(ts_ns, bool) or not isinstance(ts_ns, int):
+        raise ValueError(f"{label} risk_donor ts_ns must be an integer")
+    for field in ("equity", "high_water_mark", "drawdown", "lev_cap"):
+        value = donor[field]
+        if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int | float) or not math.isfinite(float(value)):
+            raise ValueError(f"{label} risk_donor {field} must be a finite number")
+    if not isinstance(donor["reduce_only_mode"], bool):
+        raise ValueError(f"{label} risk_donor reduce_only_mode must be a boolean")
+    flags = _sorted_strings(donor["flags"], f"{label} risk_donor flags")
+    if donor["flags"] != flags:
+        raise ValueError(f"{label} risk_donor flags must be sorted")
+    payload = {
+        "ts_ns": ts_ns,
+        "equity": donor["equity"],
+        "high_water_mark": donor["high_water_mark"],
+        "drawdown": donor["drawdown"],
+        "lev_cap": donor["lev_cap"],
+        "reduce_only_mode": donor["reduce_only_mode"],
+        "flags": flags,
+    }
+    digest = _validated_sha256(declared_sha256, label=f"{label} risk donor")
+    if _canonical_payload_sha256(payload) != digest:
+        raise ValueError(f"{label} risk_donor_sha256 does not match risk_donor")
+    return payload
+
+
+def _extract_episode(episode: object, *, index: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    if not isinstance(episode, Mapping):
+        raise ValueError(f"position episode {index} must be an object")
+    _require_fields(episode, _EPISODE_FIELDS, label=f"position episode {index}")
+    return {field: episode[field] for field in _EPISODE_FIELDS}
+
+
+def _require_fields(value: Mapping[str, Any], fields: tuple[str, ...], *, label: str) -> None:
+    missing = [field for field in fields if field not in value]
+    if missing:
+        raise ValueError(f"{label} is missing required fields {missing!r}")
+
+
+def _require_exact_fields(value: Mapping[str, Any], fields: tuple[str, ...], *, label: str) -> None:
+    expected = set(fields)
+    actual = set(value)
+    if actual != expected:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"{label} fields mismatch: missing={sorted(expected - actual)!r} extra={sorted(actual - expected)!r}"
+        )
+
+
+def _validated_sha256(value: object, *, label: str) -> str:
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or _SHA256_PATTERN.fullmatch(value) is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{label} SHA-256 must be sha256:<64 lowercase hex>")
+    return value
+
+
+def _sorted_strings(value: object, label: str) -> list[str]:
+    if not isinstance(value, list | tuple) or any(not isinstance(item, str) for item in value):
+        raise ValueError(f"{label} must be a string list")
+    return sorted(value)
+
+
+def _canonical_values_equal(left: object, right: object) -> bool:
+    return _canonical_payload_bytes(left) == _canonical_payload_bytes(right)
+
+
+def _canonical_payload_bytes(payload: object) -> bytes:
+    return json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")
+
+
+def _canonical_payload_sha256(payload: object) -> str:
+    encoded = _canonical_payload_bytes(payload)
+    return f"sha256:{hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest()}"

+"""Fail-closed governance for performance evidence from legacy accounting."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import datetime
+from enum import StrEnum
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+ACCOUNTING_VALIDITY_SCHEMA_VERSION = "legacy-accounting-validity.v1"
+REPOSITORY_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+DEFAULT_ACCOUNTING_VALIDITY_REGISTRY = REPOSITORY_ROOT / "config/research/legacy_accounting_validity_v1.json"
+
+
+class ValidityState(StrEnum):
+    """Global validity states for historical performance evidence."""
+
+    CONFIRMED_AFFECTED = "CONFIRMED_AFFECTED"
+    UNVERIFIED_LEGACY = "UNVERIFIED_LEGACY"
+    PROVEN_UNAFFECTED = "PROVEN_UNAFFECTED"
+    SUPERSEDED_REPAIRED = "SUPERSEDED_REPAIRED"
+
+
+class AccountingValidityRegistryError(ValueError):
+    """The validity registry is malformed or internally ambiguous."""
+
+
+class InvalidPerformanceEvidenceError(ValueError):
+    """The requested performance evidence is not valid for use."""
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class AccountingValidityRecord:
+    """One immutable artifact validity classification."""
+
+    artifact_path: str
+    source_sha256: str
+    selector: str
+    state: ValidityState
+    reason: str
+    metric_families: tuple[str, ...]
+    stages: tuple[str, ...]
+    superseding_artifact: str | None
+    ledger_formula_hash: str
+    decision_at: str
+    approving_decision: str
+
+    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        """Return the canonical JSON-ready record representation."""
+        return {
+            "artifact_path": self.artifact_path,
+            "source_sha256": self.source_sha256,
+            "selector": self.selector,
+            "state": self.state.value,
+            "reason": self.reason,
+            "metric_families": list(self.metric_families),
+            "stages": list(self.stages),
+            "superseding_artifact": self.superseding_artifact,
+            "ledger_formula_hash": self.ledger_formula_hash,
+            "decision_at": self.decision_at,
+            "approving_decision": self.approving_decision,
+        }
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class AccountingValidityRegistry:
+    """Validated immutable collection of accounting validity records."""
+
+    schema_version: str
+    records: tuple[AccountingValidityRecord, ...]
+    repository_root: Path
+
+    def records_for_artifact(self, artifact_path: str) -> tuple[AccountingValidityRecord, ...]:
+        """Return records whose normalized artifact path matches the input."""
+        normalized = _canonical_artifact_identity(artifact_path, repository_root=self.repository_root)
+        return tuple(record for record in self.records if record.artifact_path == normalized)
+
+    def records_for_sha256(self, source_sha256: str) -> tuple[AccountingValidityRecord, ...]:
+        """Return every record governing the exact source bytes."""
+        return tuple(record for record in self.records if record.source_sha256 == source_sha256)
+
+
+def load_accounting_validity_registry(
+    path: Path = DEFAULT_ACCOUNTING_VALIDITY_REGISTRY,
+    *,
+    repository_root: Path = REPOSITORY_ROOT,
+) -> AccountingValidityRegistry:
+    """Load and strictly validate an accounting validity registry."""
+    try:
+        payload = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), parse_constant=_reject_json_constant)
+    except (json.JSONDecodeError, OSError, UnicodeError) as exc:
+        raise AccountingValidityRegistryError(f"unable to load accounting validity registry:{path}") from exc
+    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
+        raise AccountingValidityRegistryError("accounting validity registry must be a JSON object")
+    if payload.get("schema_version") != ACCOUNTING_VALIDITY_SCHEMA_VERSION:
+        raise AccountingValidityRegistryError(f"schema_version must be {ACCOUNTING_VALIDITY_SCHEMA_VERSION!r}")
+    raw_records = payload.get("records")
+    if not isinstance(raw_records, list) or not raw_records:
+        raise AccountingValidityRegistryError("records must be a non-empty list")
+
+    records: list[AccountingValidityRecord] = []
+    repository_root = repository_root.resolve()
+    validity_keys: set[tuple[str, str, str, str]] = set()
+    source_validity_keys: set[tuple[str, str, str, str]] = set()
+    artifact_digests: dict[str, str] = {}
+    for index, raw_record in enumerate(raw_records):
+        record = _parse_record(raw_record, index=index, repository_root=repository_root)
+        prior_digest = artifact_digests.setdefault(record.artifact_path, record.source_sha256)
+        if prior_digest != record.source_sha256:
+            raise AccountingValidityRegistryError(f"conflicting source_sha256 for artifact:{record.artifact_path}")
+        for stage in record.stages:
+            for metric_family in record.metric_families:
+                key = (record.artifact_path, record.selector, stage, metric_family)
+                if key in validity_keys:
+                    raise AccountingValidityRegistryError(
+                        f"duplicate validity key:{record.artifact_path}:{stage}:{metric_family}:"
+                        f"selector={record.selector}"
+                    )
+                validity_keys.add(key)
+                source_key = (record.source_sha256, record.selector, stage, metric_family)
+                if source_key in source_validity_keys:
+                    raise AccountingValidityRegistryError(
+                        f"duplicate source validity key:{record.source_sha256}:{stage}:{metric_family}:"
+                        f"selector={record.selector}"
+                    )
+                source_validity_keys.add(source_key)
+        records.append(record)
+    return AccountingValidityRegistry(
+        schema_version=ACCOUNTING_VALIDITY_SCHEMA_VERSION,
+        records=tuple(records),
+        repository_root=repository_root,
+    )
+
+
+def assert_metric_family_allowed(
+    registry: AccountingValidityRegistry,
+    *,
+    artifact_path: str,
+    source_sha256: str | None,
+    metric_family: str,
+    stage: str | None,
+    selector: str | None = None,
+) -> None:
+    """Reject explicitly invalid evidence or a changed registered source."""
+    path_records = registry.records_for_artifact(artifact_path)
+    if path_records and source_sha256 not in {record.source_sha256 for record in path_records}:
+        expected = sorted({record.source_sha256 for record in path_records})
+        raise InvalidPerformanceEvidenceError(
+            f"source_sha256_mismatch:{_canonical_artifact_identity(artifact_path, repository_root=registry.repository_root)}:"
+            f"expected={expected}:actual={source_sha256}"
+        )
+    digest_records = registry.records_for_sha256(source_sha256) if source_sha256 is not None else ()
+    records = tuple(dict.fromkeys((*path_records, *digest_records)))
+    if not records:
+        raise InvalidPerformanceEvidenceError(
+            f"artifact_unclassified:"
+            f"{_canonical_artifact_identity(artifact_path, repository_root=registry.repository_root)}:"
+            f"source_sha256={source_sha256}"
+        )
+    metric_records = [record for record in records if metric_family in record.metric_families]
+    if not metric_records:
+        raise InvalidPerformanceEvidenceError(
+            f"metric_family_unclassified:{artifact_path}:metric_family={metric_family}"
+        )
+    if selector is None:
+        selectors = {record.selector for record in metric_records}
+        if len(selectors) != 1:
+            raise InvalidPerformanceEvidenceError(
+                f"selector_required:"
+                f"{_canonical_artifact_identity(artifact_path, repository_root=registry.repository_root)}:"
+                f"metric_family={metric_family}"
+            )
+        selector = selectors.pop()
+    selector_records = [record for record in metric_records if record.selector == selector]
+    if not selector_records:
+        raise InvalidPerformanceEvidenceError(
+            f"selector_unclassified:{artifact_path}:selector={selector}:metric_family={metric_family}"
+        )
+    if stage is None:
+        raise InvalidPerformanceEvidenceError(
+            f"stage_required:{artifact_path}:selector={selector}:metric_family={metric_family}"
+        )
+    matching = [record for record in selector_records if stage in record.stages]
+    if not matching:
+        raise InvalidPerformanceEvidenceError(
+            f"stage_unclassified:{artifact_path}:stage={stage}:selector={selector}:metric_family={metric_family}"
+        )
+    record = matching[0]
+    if record.state in {ValidityState.CONFIRMED_AFFECTED, ValidityState.UNVERIFIED_LEGACY}:
+        raise InvalidPerformanceEvidenceError(
+            f"invalid_performance_evidence:{record.state.value}:{record.artifact_path}:"
+            f"stage={stage}:metric_family={metric_family}:reason={record.reason}"
+        )
+
+
+def _parse_record(
+    raw_record: object,
+    *,
+    index: int,
+    repository_root: Path,
+) -> AccountingValidityRecord:
+    if not isinstance(raw_record, dict):
+        raise AccountingValidityRegistryError(f"record {index} must be a JSON object")
+    artifact_path = _required_string(raw_record.get("artifact_path"), "artifact_path", index=index)
+    source_sha256 = _required_string(raw_record.get("source_sha256"), "source_sha256", index=index)
+    if not _is_sha256(source_sha256):
+        raise AccountingValidityRegistryError(f"record {index} source_sha256 must be lowercase hexadecimal")
+    selector = _required_string(raw_record.get("selector"), "selector", index=index)
+    reason = _required_string(raw_record.get("reason"), "reason", index=index)
+    try:
+        state = ValidityState(raw_record.get("state"))
+    except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
+        raise AccountingValidityRegistryError(f"record {index} has invalid validity state") from exc
+    metric_families = _required_string_tuple(raw_record.get("metric_families"), "metric_families", index=index)
+    stages = _required_string_tuple(raw_record.get("stages"), "stages", index=index)
+    ledger_formula_hash = _required_string(
+        raw_record.get("ledger_formula_hash"),
+        "ledger_formula_hash",
+        index=index,
+    )
+    if not _is_formula_hash(ledger_formula_hash):
+        raise AccountingValidityRegistryError(f"record {index} ledger_formula_hash must be sha256:<lowercase hex>")
+    decision_at = _required_string(raw_record.get("decision_at"), "decision_at", index=index)
+    _validate_decision_at(decision_at, index=index)
+    approving_decision = _required_string(
+        raw_record.get("approving_decision"),
+        "approving_decision",
+        index=index,
+    )
+    superseding_artifact = raw_record.get("superseding_artifact")
+    if superseding_artifact is not None and (
+        not isinstance(superseding_artifact, str) or not superseding_artifact.strip()
+    ):
+        raise AccountingValidityRegistryError(f"record {index} superseding_artifact must be null or non-empty")
+    if state is ValidityState.SUPERSEDED_REPAIRED and superseding_artifact is None:
+        raise AccountingValidityRegistryError(
+            f"record {index} superseding_artifact is required for SUPERSEDED_REPAIRED"
+        )
+    return AccountingValidityRecord(
+        artifact_path=_canonical_artifact_identity(artifact_path, repository_root=repository_root),
+        source_sha256=source_sha256,
+        selector=selector,
+        state=state,
+        reason=reason,
+        metric_families=metric_families,
+        stages=stages,
+        superseding_artifact=superseding_artifact,
+        ledger_formula_hash=ledger_formula_hash,
+        decision_at=decision_at,
+        approving_decision=approving_decision,
+    )
+
+
+def _required_string(value: object, field: str, *, index: int) -> str:
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
+        raise AccountingValidityRegistryError(f"record {index} {field} must be non-empty")
+    return value
+
+
+def _required_string_tuple(value: object, field: str, *, index: int) -> tuple[str, ...]:
+    if not isinstance(value, list) or not value:
+        raise AccountingValidityRegistryError(f"record {index} {field} must be a non-empty list")
+    if any(not isinstance(item, str) or not item.strip() for item in value):
+        raise AccountingValidityRegistryError(f"record {index} {field} entries must be non-empty strings")
+    return tuple(value)
+
+
+def _canonical_artifact_identity(value: str, *, repository_root: Path) -> str:
+    path = Path(value)
+    resolved = (path if path.is_absolute() else repository_root / path).resolve(strict=False)
+    try:
+        return resolved.relative_to(repository_root).as_posix()
+    except ValueError:
+        return resolved.as_posix()
+
+
+def _is_sha256(value: str) -> bool:
+    return len(value) == 64 and all(character in "0123456789abcdef" for character in value)
+
+
+def _is_formula_hash(value: str) -> bool:
+    return value.startswith("sha256:") and _is_sha256(value.removeprefix("sha256:"))
+
+
+def _validate_decision_at(value: str, *, index: int) -> None:
+    try:
+        parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(value.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
+    except ValueError as exc:
+        raise AccountingValidityRegistryError(f"record {index} decision_at must be an ISO-8601 timestamp") from exc
+    if parsed.tzinfo is None:
+        raise AccountingValidityRegistryError(f"record {index} decision_at must include a timezone")
+
+
+def _reject_json_constant(value: str) -> None:
+    raise AccountingValidityRegistryError(f"forbidden JSON constant:{value}")

+"""Fail-closed contracts for registering the two BTC trend research layers.
+
+The hypothesis manifest is deliberately a content-addressed, immutable input.
+Registration receipts are kept separate from it: provider timestamps and
+identities must never become part of the manifest hash.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import re
+from collections.abc import Mapping, Sequence
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+from enum import StrEnum
+from pathlib import Path
+from types import MappingProxyType
+from typing import Any
+
+DAY_NS = 86_400_000_000_000
+FOUR_HOURS_NS = 14_400_000_000_000
+REUSED_START_NS = 1_767_225_600_000_000_000
+REUSED_END_NS = 1_787_529_600_000_000_000
+EXPECTED_SEEDS = (42, 123, 456, 789, 1024)
+REQUIRED_SOURCE_IDS = (
+    "BINANCE_SPOT_BTCUSDT_1D",
+    "BINANCE_PERPETUAL_BTCUSDT_5M",
+    "BINANCE_PERPETUAL_BTCUSDT_FUNDING",
+)
+SUPPORTED_TREND_LAYERS = frozenset({"time_space_shadow", "trend_participation"})
+_SHA256_RE = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$")
+_PREFIXED_SHA256_RE = re.compile(r"^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$")
+_GIT_SHA_RE = re.compile(r"^(?:[0-9a-f]{40}|[0-9a-f]{64})$")
+_PROVIDER_RUN_ID_RE = re.compile(r"^[1-9][0-9]*$")
+_BOOTSTRAP_REGISTRATIONS = MappingProxyType(
+    {
+        "feature/trend-registration-time-space-hypothesis": (
+            "hypothesis",
+            "config/research/time_space_shadow_hypothesis_v1.json",
+        ),
+        "feature/trend-registration-trend-participation-hypothesis": (
+            "hypothesis",
+            "config/research/trend_participation_hypothesis_v1.json",
+        ),
+        "feature/trend-registration-time-space-execution": (
+            "execution",
+            "config/research/registrations/time_space_shadow_execution_v1.json",
+        ),
+        "feature/trend-registration-trend-participation-execution": (
+            "execution",
+            "config/research/registrations/trend_participation_execution_v1.json",
+        ),
+    }
+)
+_ALLOWED_REGISTRATION_SELECTIONS = frozenset(_BOOTSTRAP_REGISTRATIONS.values())
+_EXECUTION_MANIFEST_KEYS = frozenset(

+        "schema_version",
+        "layer",
+        "hypothesis_sha256",
+        "formula_sha256",
+        "config_sha256",
+        "reused_window",

+        "sources",
+        "source_set_sha256",
+        "accounting_kernel",
+        "construction_identity",
+        "forward_checkpoint_rule",
+        "workspace_state",
+    }
+)
+_FORBIDDEN_EXECUTION_KEYS = frozenset({"direction", "pnl", "signal"})

+
+class RegistrationError(ValueError):
+    """Raised when a research registration contract cannot be trusted."""
+
+
+class EvidenceRole(StrEnum):
+    """The mutually exclusive role of an event in research evidence."""
+
+    DISCOVERY_ONLY = "DISCOVERY_ONLY"
+    TEST_REUSED_DIAGNOSTIC = "TEST_REUSED_DIAGNOSTIC"
+    EXCLUDED_EMBARGO = "EXCLUDED_EMBARGO"
+    FORWARD_CONFIRMATION = "FORWARD_CONFIRMATION"
