+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class RegistrationReceipt:
+    """Trusted provider receipt for one immutable registration record."""
+
+    manifest_sha256: str
+    provider_run_id: int | str
+    commit_sha: str
+    remote_identity: str
+    received_at_ns: int
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if not isinstance(self.manifest_sha256, str) or not _SHA256_RE.fullmatch(self.manifest_sha256):
+            raise RegistrationError("receipt manifest hash is not canonical SHA-256")
+        provider_run_id = _canonical_provider_run_id(self.provider_run_id)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "provider_run_id", provider_run_id)
+        if not isinstance(self.commit_sha, str) or not _GIT_SHA_RE.fullmatch(self.commit_sha):
+            raise RegistrationError("receipt commit SHA is not canonical Git SHA")
+        if not isinstance(self.remote_identity, str) or not self.remote_identity:
+            raise RegistrationError("receipt remote identity is required")
+        if isinstance(self.received_at_ns, bool) or not isinstance(self.received_at_ns, int) or self.received_at_ns < 0:
+            raise RegistrationError("receipt timestamp must be a non-negative integer")
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class HypothesisManifest:
+    """Validated, frozen hypothesis policy and its canonical content digest."""
+
+    schema_version: str
+    layer: str
+    asset: str
+    active_signal_source: str
+    reused_start_ns: int
+    reused_end_ns: int
+    source_requirements: tuple[Mapping[str, Any], ...]
+    fallback: str
+    seeds: tuple[int, ...]
+    training: bool
+    parameter_search: bool
+    payload: Mapping[str, Any]
+    sha256: str
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class ExecutionManifest:
+    """Validated identity fields from one local execution manifest."""
+
+    schema_version: str
+    layer: str
+    hypothesis_sha256: str
+    payload: Mapping[str, Any]
+    sha256: str
+
+
+def _canonical_provider_run_id(value: Any) -> str:
+    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, str)):
+        raise RegistrationError("provider run id is invalid")
+    text = str(value)
+    if not _PROVIDER_RUN_ID_RE.fullmatch(text):
+        raise RegistrationError("provider run id is not canonical")
+    return text
+
+
+_ALLOWED_MANIFEST_KEYS = frozenset(
+    {
+        "schema_version",
+        "layer",
+        "asset",
+        "active_signal_source",
+        "reused_window",
+        "source_requirements",
+        "fallback",
+        "seeds",
+        "training",
+        "parameter_search",
+        # Research-specific formula and gate sections are frozen as opaque
+        # values here; later layers interpret them without changing identity.
+        "formula",
+        "thresholds",
+        "costs",
+        "robustness",
+        "gates",
+        "policy",
+        "authority",
+        "diagnostics",
+        "execution",
+        "formula_sha256",
+        "config_sha256",
+        "source_set_sha256",
+    }
+)
+_SOURCE_KEYS = frozenset({"id", "requirement", "fallback"})
+
+
+def canonical_sha256(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
+    """Return the SHA-256 of a deterministic JSON representation."""
+
+    if not isinstance(payload, Mapping):
+        raise TypeError("canonical SHA-256 requires a mapping")
+    try:
+        encoded = json.dumps(
+            payload,
+            ensure_ascii=False,
+            allow_nan=False,
+            separators=(",", ":"),
+            sort_keys=True,
+        ).encode("utf-8")
+    except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
+        raise RegistrationError("manifest payload is not canonical JSON") from exc
+    return hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest()
+
+
+def resolve_bootstrap_registration(branch_name: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
+    """Return the one manifest registration permitted for a bootstrap push."""
+
+    try:
+        return _BOOTSTRAP_REGISTRATIONS[branch_name]
+    except KeyError as exc:
+        raise RegistrationError("unmapped bootstrap branch") from exc
+
+
+def validate_registration_selection(manifest_kind: str, manifest_path: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
+    """Allow only the four immutable kind/path registrations."""
+
+    selection = (manifest_kind, manifest_path)
+    if selection not in _ALLOWED_REGISTRATION_SELECTIONS:
+        raise RegistrationError("unsupported registration manifest")
+    return selection
+
+
+def resolve_manual_registration(github_ref: str, manifest_kind: str, manifest_path: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
+    """Resolve a post-merge manual registration from the default branch only."""
+
+    if github_ref != "refs/heads/main":
+        raise RegistrationError("manual registration requires refs/heads/main")
+    return validate_registration_selection(manifest_kind, manifest_path)
+
+
+def iso8601_to_ns(value: str) -> int:
+    """Convert an offset-aware ISO-8601 provider timestamp to epoch nanoseconds."""
+
+    if not isinstance(value, str):
+        raise RegistrationError("provider timestamp must be an ISO-8601 string")
+    try:
+        parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(value.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
+    except ValueError as exc:
+        raise RegistrationError("provider timestamp must be ISO-8601") from exc
+    if parsed.tzinfo is None:
+        raise RegistrationError("provider timestamp must include a timezone")
+    epoch = datetime(1970, 1, 1, tzinfo=UTC)
+    delta = parsed.astimezone(UTC) - epoch
+    return (delta.days * 86_400 + delta.seconds) * 1_000_000_000 + delta.microseconds * 1_000
+
+
+def _provider_identity(provider: Mapping[str, Any]) -> tuple[str, str, str]:
+    try:
+        provider_run_id = provider["id"]
+        commit_sha = provider["head_sha"]
+        repository = provider["repository"]
+    except KeyError as exc:
+        raise RegistrationError("provider payload is missing required identity") from exc
+    provider_run_id = _canonical_provider_run_id(provider_run_id)
+    if not isinstance(commit_sha, str) or not _GIT_SHA_RE.fullmatch(commit_sha):
+        raise RegistrationError("provider head SHA is not canonical Git SHA")
+    if not isinstance(repository, Mapping):
+        raise RegistrationError("provider repository identity is required")
+    remote_identity = repository.get("full_name")
+    if not isinstance(remote_identity, str) or not remote_identity:
+        raise RegistrationError("provider repository identity is required")
+    return provider_run_id, commit_sha, remote_identity
+
+
+def build_registration_envelope(
+    manifest_path: Path | str,
+    commit_sha: str,
+    provider_run: Mapping[str, Any],
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Bind one checked-in manifest to its authoritative provider run identity."""
+
+    if not isinstance(commit_sha, str) or not _GIT_SHA_RE.fullmatch(commit_sha):
+        raise RegistrationError("commit SHA is not canonical Git SHA")
+    path = Path(manifest_path)
+    try:
+        manifest_payload = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    except (OSError, UnicodeError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
+        raise RegistrationError(f"cannot load registration manifest: {path}") from exc
+    if not isinstance(manifest_payload, Mapping):
+        raise RegistrationError("registration manifest must be a JSON object")
+
+    provider_run_id, provider_commit_sha, remote_identity = _provider_identity(provider_run)
+    if provider_commit_sha != commit_sha:
+        raise RegistrationError("provider identity mismatch")
+    received_at_ns = iso8601_to_ns(str(provider_run.get("created_at")))
+    manifest_sha256 = canonical_sha256(manifest_payload)
+    RegistrationReceipt(manifest_sha256, provider_run_id, provider_commit_sha, remote_identity, received_at_ns)
+    return {
+        "provider_run_id": provider_run_id,
+        "commit_sha": provider_commit_sha,
+        "remote_identity": remote_identity,
+        "manifest_sha256": manifest_sha256,
+        "received_at_ns": received_at_ns,
+    }
+
+
+def verify_github_receipt(envelope: Mapping[str, Any], provider_payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> RegistrationReceipt:
+    """Rebuild a trusted receipt from a GitHub run API payload, never local time."""
+
+    provider_run_id, provider_commit_sha, remote_identity = _provider_identity(provider_payload)
+    try:
+        expected = (
+            _canonical_provider_run_id(envelope["provider_run_id"]),
+            envelope["commit_sha"],
+            envelope["remote_identity"],
+        )
+        manifest_sha256 = str(envelope["manifest_sha256"])
+    except KeyError as exc:
+        raise RegistrationError("registration envelope is missing required identity") from exc
+    observed = (provider_run_id, provider_commit_sha, remote_identity)
+    if expected != observed:
+        raise RegistrationError("provider identity mismatch")
+    received_at_ns = iso8601_to_ns(str(provider_payload.get("created_at")))
+    return RegistrationReceipt(
+        manifest_sha256,
+        provider_run_id,
+        provider_commit_sha,
+        remote_identity,
+        received_at_ns,
+    )
+
+
+def _freeze(value: Any) -> Any:
+    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
+        return MappingProxyType({key: _freeze(item) for key, item in value.items()})
+    if isinstance(value, list):
+        return tuple(_freeze(item) for item in value)
+    return value
+
+
+def _plain_json(value: Any) -> Any:
+    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
+        return {str(key): _plain_json(item) for key, item in value.items()}
+    if isinstance(value, tuple | list):
+        return [_plain_json(item) for item in value]
+    return value
+
+
+def _validate_sha_fields(value: Any, *, path: str = "manifest") -> None:
+    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
+        for key, item in value.items():
+            key_text = str(key)
+            if "sha256" in key_text.lower() and not isinstance(item, Mapping | list | tuple):
+                if not isinstance(item, str) or not _SHA256_RE.fullmatch(item):
+                    raise RegistrationError(f"{path}.{key_text} is not canonical SHA-256")
+            _validate_sha_fields(item, path=f"{path}.{key_text}")
+    elif isinstance(value, list):
+        for index, item in enumerate(value):
+            _validate_sha_fields(item, path=f"{path}[{index}]")
+
+
+def _require_int(value: Any, field: str) -> int:
+    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int):
+        raise RegistrationError(f"{field} must be an integer")
+    return value
+
+
+def load_hypothesis_manifest(path: Path) -> HypothesisManifest:
+    """Load and validate one checked-in hypothesis manifest.
+
+    The manifest's digest is computed from its complete JSON payload.  A
+    self-embedded digest is intentionally not accepted, avoiding a circular
+    identity and making the returned ``sha256`` reproducible from file bytes.
+    """
+
+    try:
+        payload = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    except (OSError, UnicodeError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
+        raise RegistrationError(f"cannot load hypothesis manifest: {path}") from exc
+    return validate_hypothesis_manifest_payload(payload)
+
+
+def validate_hypothesis_manifest_payload(payload: Any) -> HypothesisManifest:
+    """Validate and freeze one in-memory hypothesis manifest payload."""
+
+    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
+        raise RegistrationError("hypothesis manifest must be a JSON object")
+
+    unknown = set(payload) - _ALLOWED_MANIFEST_KEYS
+    if unknown:
+        names = ", ".join(sorted(str(item) for item in unknown))
+        raise RegistrationError(f"unknown manifest key(s): {names}")
+    _validate_sha_fields(payload)
+
+    required = {
+        "schema_version",
+        "layer",
+        "asset",
+        "active_signal_source",
+        "reused_window",
+        "source_requirements",
+        "fallback",
+        "seeds",
+        "training",
+        "parameter_search",
+    }
+    missing = required - set(payload)
+    if missing:
+        names = ", ".join(sorted(missing))
+        raise RegistrationError(f"missing manifest key(s): {names}")
+
+    if payload["schema_version"] != "trend-research-hypothesis.v1":
+        raise RegistrationError("unsupported hypothesis manifest schema")
+    if not isinstance(payload["layer"], str) or payload["layer"] not in SUPPORTED_TREND_LAYERS:
+        raise RegistrationError("unsupported hypothesis layer")
+    if payload["asset"] != "BTC":
+        raise RegistrationError("asset must be BTC")
+    if payload["active_signal_source"] != "BINANCE_SPOT_BTCUSDT_1D":
+        raise RegistrationError("active signal source must be BINANCE_SPOT_BTCUSDT_1D")
+    if payload["fallback"] != "NONE":
+        raise RegistrationError("fallback must be NONE")
+    if payload["training"] is not False:
+        raise RegistrationError("training must be false")
+    if payload["parameter_search"] is not False:
+        raise RegistrationError("parameter_search must be false")
+
+    window = payload["reused_window"]
+    if not isinstance(window, list) or len(window) != 2:
+        raise RegistrationError("reused window must contain exactly two timestamps")
+    reused_start_ns = _require_int(window[0], "reused window start")
+    reused_end_ns = _require_int(window[1], "reused window end")
+    if (reused_start_ns, reused_end_ns) != (REUSED_START_NS, REUSED_END_NS):
+        raise RegistrationError("reused window is not the exact frozen window")
+
+    seeds = payload["seeds"]
+    if seeds != list(EXPECTED_SEEDS) or any(isinstance(seed, bool) or not isinstance(seed, int) for seed in seeds):
+        raise RegistrationError("seeds are frozen to (42, 123, 456, 789, 1024)")
+
+    source_requirements = payload["source_requirements"]
+    if not isinstance(source_requirements, list) or not source_requirements:
+        raise RegistrationError("source_requirements must be a non-empty list")
+    if any(not isinstance(item, dict) for item in source_requirements):
+        raise RegistrationError("source_requirements entries must be objects")
+    source_ids: list[str] = []
+    for item in source_requirements:
+        if set(item) != _SOURCE_KEYS:
+            raise RegistrationError("source schema keys must be exactly id, requirement, fallback")
+        source_id = item["id"]
+        if not isinstance(source_id, str) or source_id not in REQUIRED_SOURCE_IDS:
+            raise RegistrationError("unknown source requirement id")
+        if source_id in source_ids:
+            raise RegistrationError("duplicate source requirement id")
+        source_ids.append(source_id)
+        if item["requirement"] != "REQUIRED":
+            raise RegistrationError("source requirement must be REQUIRED")
+        if item["fallback"] != "NONE":
+            raise RegistrationError("source requirement fallback must be NONE")
+    missing_sources = set(REQUIRED_SOURCE_IDS) - set(source_ids)
+    if missing_sources:
+        missing = ", ".join(sorted(missing_sources))
+        raise RegistrationError(f"mandatory source inputs missing: {missing}")
+
+    manifest_sha256 = canonical_sha256(payload)
+    frozen_payload = _freeze(payload)
+    return HypothesisManifest(
+        schema_version=str(payload["schema_version"]),
+        layer=str(payload["layer"]),
+        asset=str(payload["asset"]),
+        active_signal_source=str(payload["active_signal_source"]),
+        reused_start_ns=reused_start_ns,
+        reused_end_ns=reused_end_ns,
+        source_requirements=tuple(_freeze(item) for item in source_requirements),
+        fallback=str(payload["fallback"]),
+        seeds=tuple(seeds),
+        training=False,
+        parameter_search=False,
+        payload=frozen_payload,
+        sha256=manifest_sha256,
+    )
+
+
+def _require_exact_keys(value: Any, expected: frozenset[str], label: str) -> Mapping[str, Any]:
+    if not isinstance(value, Mapping) or set(value) != expected:
+        raise RegistrationError(f"{label} keys do not match execution manifest schema")
+    return value
+
+
+def _require_prefixed_sha256(value: Any, label: str) -> str:
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not _PREFIXED_SHA256_RE.fullmatch(value):
+        raise RegistrationError(f"{label} is not canonical prefixed SHA-256")
+    return value
+
+
+def _prefixed_payload_sha256(value: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
+    return f"sha256:{canonical_sha256(value)}"
+
+
+def _all_mapping_keys(value: Any) -> set[str]:
+    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
+        return {str(key) for key in value} | set().union(*(_all_mapping_keys(item) for item in value.values()), set())
+    if isinstance(value, list | tuple):
+        return set().union(*(_all_mapping_keys(item) for item in value), set())
+    return set()
+
+
+def _validate_recursive_sha_fields(value: Any, *, path: str = "execution") -> None:
+    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
+        for key, item in value.items():
+            key_text = str(key)
+            if "sha256" in key_text.lower() and not isinstance(item, Mapping | list | tuple):
+                if item is None and key_text == "content_sha256":
+                    continue
+                if not isinstance(item, str) or not (_SHA256_RE.fullmatch(item) or _PREFIXED_SHA256_RE.fullmatch(item)):
+                    raise RegistrationError(f"{path}.{key_text} is not canonical SHA-256")
+            _validate_recursive_sha_fields(item, path=f"{path}.{key_text}")
+    elif isinstance(value, list | tuple):
+        for index, item in enumerate(value):
+            _validate_recursive_sha_fields(item, path=f"{path}[{index}]")
+
+
+def _validate_execution_sources(value: Any) -> Mapping[str, Any]:
+    sources = _require_exact_keys(value, frozenset(REQUIRED_SOURCE_IDS), "execution sources")
+    spot_keys = frozenset(
+        {
+            "coverage",
+            "fallback",
+            "last_cutoff_ns",
+            "lineage",
+            "normalized_path",
+            "normalized_sha256",
+            "normalizer_identity",
+            "raw_sha256",
+            "requirement",
+            "status",
+            "warmup",
+        }
+    )
+    derivative_keys = frozenset(
+        {"coverage", "fallback", "last_cutoff_ns", "market_tail_provenance", "path", "requirement", "sha256", "status"}
+    )
+    spot_coverage_keys = frozenset(
+        {
+            "duplicate_count",
+            "end_ns",
+            "first_open_ns",
+            "last_close_ns",
+            "missing_count",
+            "post_end_count",
+            "pre_start_count",
+            "row_count",
+            "start_ns",
+        }
+    )
+    derivative_coverage_keys = frozenset(
+        {
+            "duplicate_count",
+            "expected_row_count",
+            "first_event_ns",
+            "invalid_cutoff_count",
+            "invalid_value_count",
+            "last_event_ns",
+            "missing_count",
+            "off_grid_count",
+            "post_end_count",
+            "pre_start_count",
+            "row_count",
+            "window_row_count",
+        }
+    )
+    for source_id, item in sources.items():
+        source = _require_exact_keys(
+            item,
+            spot_keys if source_id == "BINANCE_SPOT_BTCUSDT_1D" else derivative_keys,
+            f"execution source {source_id}",
+        )
+        if (source["status"], source["requirement"], source["fallback"]) != ("READY", "REQUIRED", "NONE"):
+            raise RegistrationError(f"execution source {source_id} is not READY/REQUIRED/NONE")
+        _require_exact_keys(
+            source["coverage"],
+            spot_coverage_keys if source_id == "BINANCE_SPOT_BTCUSDT_1D" else derivative_coverage_keys,
+            f"execution source {source_id} coverage",
+        )
+        if source_id == "BINANCE_SPOT_BTCUSDT_1D":
+            _require_exact_keys(source["lineage"], frozenset({"reconstructed_sha256", "status"}), "spot lineage")
+            if source["lineage"]["status"] != "VERIFIED":
+                raise RegistrationError("spot lineage is not verified")
+            _require_exact_keys(source["normalizer_identity"], frozenset({"callable", "sha256"}), "spot normalizer")
+            _require_exact_keys(
+                source["warmup"],
+                frozenset({"end_ns", "observed_closes", "required_closes", "start_ns", "status"}),
+                "spot warmup",
+            )
+            if source["warmup"]["status"] != "READY":
+                raise RegistrationError("spot warmup is not ready")
+            if not isinstance(source["raw_sha256"], list) or not source["raw_sha256"]:
+                raise RegistrationError("spot raw identities are required")
+            for raw in source["raw_sha256"]:
+                _require_exact_keys(raw, frozenset({"path", "sha256"}), "spot raw identity")
+        else:
+            provenance = _require_exact_keys(
+                source["market_tail_provenance"],
+                frozenset({"normalizer", "path", "repository", "schema_version", "sha256"}),
+                "market-tail provenance",
+            )
+            if provenance["schema_version"] != "trend-market-tail-provenance.v1":
+                raise RegistrationError("market-tail provenance schema is unsupported")
+            _require_exact_keys(provenance["normalizer"], frozenset({"callable", "sha256"}), "market-tail normalizer")
+            repository = _require_exact_keys(provenance["repository"], frozenset({"head"}), "market-tail repository")
+            if not isinstance(repository["head"], str) or not _GIT_SHA_RE.fullmatch(repository["head"]):
+                raise RegistrationError("market-tail repository head is not canonical Git SHA")
+    return sources
+
+
+def _validate_identity_block(
+    value: Any,
+    *,
+    expected_keys: frozenset[str],
+    digest_keys: tuple[str, ...],
+    label: str,
+) -> Mapping[str, Any]:
+    block = _require_exact_keys(value, expected_keys, label)
+    expected_digest = _prefixed_payload_sha256({key: block[key] for key in digest_keys})
+    if block["sha256"] != expected_digest:
+        raise RegistrationError(f"{label} hash mismatch")
+    return block
+
+
+def validate_execution_manifest_payload(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> None:
+    """Validate the exact fail-closed execution-manifest v1 schema."""
+
+    _require_exact_keys(payload, _EXECUTION_MANIFEST_KEYS, "execution manifest")
+    if _FORBIDDEN_EXECUTION_KEYS.intersection(_all_mapping_keys(payload)):
+        raise RegistrationError("execution manifest contains forbidden result fields")
+    if payload["reused_window"] != [REUSED_START_NS, REUSED_END_NS]:
+        raise RegistrationError("execution reused window is not frozen")
+    if payload["fixed_end_cutoff_ns"] != REUSED_END_NS:
+        raise RegistrationError("execution manifest end cutoff is not frozen")
+    if payload["forward_checkpoint_rule"] != "later_trusted_receipt_plus_24h_ceil_confirmed_4h":
+        raise RegistrationError("execution forward checkpoint rule is not frozen")
+    for key in ("formula_sha256", "config_sha256", "source_set_sha256"):
+        _require_prefixed_sha256(payload[key], f"execution {key}")
+    if payload["config_sha256"] != f"sha256:{payload['hypothesis_sha256']}":
+        raise RegistrationError("execution config hash does not bind hypothesis")
+    sources = _validate_execution_sources(payload["sources"])
+    if payload["source_set_sha256"] != _prefixed_payload_sha256(sources):
+        raise RegistrationError("execution source set hash mismatch")
+    construction = _validate_identity_block(
+        payload["construction_identity"],
+        expected_keys=frozenset({"files", "sha256"}),
+        digest_keys=("files",),
+        label="construction identity",
+    )
+    if not isinstance(construction["files"], list) or not construction["files"]:
+        raise RegistrationError("construction identity files are required")
+    for item in construction["files"]:
+        _require_exact_keys(item, frozenset({"path", "sha256"}), "construction file")
+    accounting = _validate_identity_block(
+        payload["accounting_kernel"],
+        expected_keys=frozenset({"schema_version", "components", "sha256"}),
+        digest_keys=("schema_version", "components"),
+        label="accounting kernel",
+    )
+    if accounting["schema_version"] != "accounting-kernel-identity.v1":
+        raise RegistrationError("accounting kernel schema is unsupported")
+    if not isinstance(accounting["components"], list) or not accounting["components"]:
+        raise RegistrationError("accounting kernel components are required")
+    for item in accounting["components"]:
+        _require_exact_keys(item, frozenset({"identity", "semantic_sha256"}), "accounting component")
+    workspace = _validate_identity_block(
+        payload["workspace_state"],
+        expected_keys=frozenset({"head", "entries", "sha256"}),
+        digest_keys=("head", "entries"),
+        label="workspace state",
+    )
+    if not isinstance(workspace["head"], str) or not _GIT_SHA_RE.fullmatch(workspace["head"]):
+        raise RegistrationError("workspace head is not canonical Git SHA")
+    if not isinstance(workspace["entries"], list):
+        raise RegistrationError("workspace entries are invalid")
+    for item in workspace["entries"]:
+        if (
+            not isinstance(item, Mapping)
+            or not set(item).issubset({"status", "path", "content_sha256", "original_path"})
+            or not {"status", "path", "content_sha256"}.issubset(item)
+        ):
+            raise RegistrationError("workspace entry schema is invalid")
+    _validate_recursive_sha_fields(payload)
+
+
+def load_execution_manifest(path: Path) -> ExecutionManifest:
+    """Build a validated descriptor from one local execution manifest."""
+
+    try:
+        payload = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    except (OSError, UnicodeError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
+        raise RegistrationError(f"cannot load execution manifest: {path}") from exc
+    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
+        raise RegistrationError("execution manifest must be a JSON object")
+    validate_execution_manifest_payload(payload)
+    if payload["schema_version"] != "trend-research-execution-manifest.v1":
+        raise RegistrationError("unsupported execution manifest schema")
+    if not isinstance(payload["layer"], str) or payload["layer"] not in SUPPORTED_TREND_LAYERS:
+        raise RegistrationError("unsupported execution layer")
+    hypothesis_sha256 = payload["hypothesis_sha256"]
+    if not isinstance(hypothesis_sha256, str) or not _SHA256_RE.fullmatch(hypothesis_sha256):
+        raise RegistrationError("execution hypothesis hash is not canonical SHA-256")
+    return ExecutionManifest(
+        schema_version=payload["schema_version"],
+        layer=payload["layer"],
+        hypothesis_sha256=hypothesis_sha256,
+        payload=_freeze(payload),
+        sha256=canonical_sha256(payload),
+    )
+
+
+def validate_registration_receipt_pair(
+    hypothesis: HypothesisManifest,
+    execution: ExecutionManifest,
+    receipts: Sequence[RegistrationReceipt],
+    *,
+    expected_remote_identity: str,
+    expected_hypothesis_provider_run_id: int | str,
+    expected_hypothesis_commit_sha: str,
+    expected_execution_provider_run_id: int | str,
+    expected_execution_commit_sha: str,
+) -> tuple[RegistrationReceipt, RegistrationReceipt]:
+    """Bind validated local manifests to two distinct authoritative runs."""
+
+    if not isinstance(hypothesis, HypothesisManifest):
+        raise RegistrationError("hypothesis descriptor is invalid")
+    if not isinstance(execution, ExecutionManifest):
+        raise RegistrationError("execution descriptor is invalid")
+    try:
+        hypothesis_payload = _plain_json(hypothesis.payload)
+        validated_hypothesis = validate_hypothesis_manifest_payload(hypothesis_payload)
+    except (RegistrationError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
+        raise RegistrationError("hypothesis descriptor is invalid") from exc
+    if validated_hypothesis != hypothesis:
+        raise RegistrationError("hypothesis descriptor fields or hash are inconsistent")
+    try:
+        execution_payload = _plain_json(execution.payload)
+        if not isinstance(execution_payload, dict):
+            raise RegistrationError("execution payload is not an object")
+        validate_execution_manifest_payload(execution_payload)
+    except (RegistrationError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
+        raise RegistrationError("execution descriptor is invalid") from exc
+    expected_execution_fields = (
+        execution_payload["schema_version"],
+        execution_payload["layer"],
+        execution_payload["hypothesis_sha256"],
+        canonical_sha256(execution_payload),
+    )
+    observed_execution_fields = (
+        execution.schema_version,
+        execution.layer,
+        execution.hypothesis_sha256,
+        execution.sha256,
+    )
+    if observed_execution_fields != expected_execution_fields:
+        raise RegistrationError("execution descriptor fields or hash are inconsistent")
+    if hypothesis.layer != execution.layer:
+        raise RegistrationError("hypothesis and execution must describe the same layer")
+    if execution.hypothesis_sha256 != hypothesis.sha256:
+        raise RegistrationError("execution manifest does not bind hypothesis")
+    formula_fields = ("formula", "thresholds", "costs", "robustness", "gates", "policy", "authority")
+    formula_payload = {
+        field: _plain_json(hypothesis.payload[field]) for field in formula_fields if field in hypothesis.payload
+    }
+    if execution.payload["formula_sha256"] != _prefixed_payload_sha256(formula_payload):
+        raise RegistrationError("execution formula hash does not bind hypothesis")
+    if hypothesis.sha256 == execution.sha256:
+        raise RegistrationError("hypothesis and execution manifest hashes must be distinct")
+    if not isinstance(expected_remote_identity, str) or not expected_remote_identity:
+        raise RegistrationError("expected remote identity is required")
+    expected_runs = (
+        _canonical_provider_run_id(expected_hypothesis_provider_run_id),
+        _canonical_provider_run_id(expected_execution_provider_run_id),
+    )
+    expected_commits = (expected_hypothesis_commit_sha, expected_execution_commit_sha)
+    if any(not isinstance(value, str) or not _GIT_SHA_RE.fullmatch(value) for value in expected_commits):
+        raise RegistrationError("expected commit SHA is not canonical Git SHA")
+    if expected_runs[0] == expected_runs[1]:
+        raise RegistrationError("expected provider runs must be distinct")
+
+    bound = tuple(receipts)
+    if len(bound) != 2:
+        raise RegistrationError("two trusted receipts are required")
+    for role, receipt in zip(("hypothesis", "execution"), bound, strict=True):
+        if not isinstance(receipt, RegistrationReceipt):
+            raise RegistrationError(f"{role} registration receipt has an invalid type")
+    expected_hashes = (hypothesis.sha256, execution.sha256)
+    if (bound[0].manifest_sha256, bound[1].manifest_sha256) == tuple(reversed(expected_hashes)):
+        raise RegistrationError("registration receipts must be ordered hypothesis and execution")
+    if bound[0].provider_run_id == bound[1].provider_run_id:
+        raise RegistrationError("receipt provider runs must be distinct")
+    for role, receipt, expected_hash, expected_run, expected_commit in zip(
+        ("hypothesis", "execution"),
+        bound,
+        expected_hashes,
+        expected_runs,
+        expected_commits,
+        strict=True,
+    ):
+        if receipt.manifest_sha256 != expected_hash:
+            raise RegistrationError(f"{role} receipt manifest hash mismatch")
+        if receipt.remote_identity != expected_remote_identity:
+            raise RegistrationError(f"{role} receipt remote identity mismatch")
+        if (receipt.provider_run_id, receipt.commit_sha) != (expected_run, expected_commit):
+            raise RegistrationError(f"{role} receipt provider identity mismatch")
+    return bound
+
+
+def derive_forward_start_ns(
+    hypothesis: HypothesisManifest | None,
+    execution: ExecutionManifest | None,
+    receipts: Sequence[RegistrationReceipt],
+    *,
+    expected_remote_identity: str | None = None,
+    expected_hypothesis_provider_run_id: int | str | None = None,
+    expected_hypothesis_commit_sha: str | None = None,
+    expected_execution_provider_run_id: int | str | None = None,
+    expected_execution_commit_sha: str | None = None,
+) -> int:
+    """Return the first confirmed 4h cutoff after trusted registration + 24h."""
+
+    if (
+        hypothesis is None
+        or execution is None
+        or expected_remote_identity is None
+        or expected_hypothesis_provider_run_id is None
+        or expected_hypothesis_commit_sha is None
+        or expected_execution_provider_run_id is None
+        or expected_execution_commit_sha is None
+    ):
+        raise RegistrationError("receipt binding is required before deriving forward start")
+    bound_receipts = validate_registration_receipt_pair(
+        hypothesis,
+        execution,
+        receipts,
+        expected_remote_identity=expected_remote_identity,
+        expected_hypothesis_provider_run_id=expected_hypothesis_provider_run_id,
+        expected_hypothesis_commit_sha=expected_hypothesis_commit_sha,
+        expected_execution_provider_run_id=expected_execution_provider_run_id,
+        expected_execution_commit_sha=expected_execution_commit_sha,
+    )
+    candidate = max(item.received_at_ns for item in bound_receipts) + DAY_NS
+    return ((candidate + FOUR_HOURS_NS - 1) // FOUR_HOURS_NS) * FOUR_HOURS_NS
+
+
+def classify_evidence_role(
+    event_cutoff_ns: int,
+    reused_start_ns: int,
+    reused_end_ns: int,
+    forward_start_ns: int,
+) -> EvidenceRole:
+    """Classify by market-event cutoff, never by ingest/backfill timestamp."""
+
+    values = (event_cutoff_ns, reused_start_ns, reused_end_ns, forward_start_ns)
+    if any(isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int) for value in values):
+        raise RegistrationError("evidence cutoffs must be integers")
+    if reused_start_ns > reused_end_ns or reused_end_ns > forward_start_ns:
+        raise RegistrationError("evidence windows must be ordered")
+    if event_cutoff_ns < reused_start_ns:
+        return EvidenceRole.DISCOVERY_ONLY
+    if event_cutoff_ns < reused_end_ns:
+        return EvidenceRole.TEST_REUSED_DIAGNOSTIC
+    if event_cutoff_ns < forward_start_ns:
+        return EvidenceRole.EXCLUDED_EMBARGO
+    return EvidenceRole.FORWARD_CONFIRMATION

+        "ref",
+        "artifact",
+        "generator_artifact",
+    }
+)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class TimeSpaceExportBundle:
+    export: dict[str, Any]
+    provenance: dict[str, Any]
+    checkpoint: dict[str, Any]
+
+
+def recompute_time_space_export(
+    request: ReplayRequest,
+    *,
+    repository_identity: str,
+    commit_sha: str,
+    provider_run_id: str,
+    replay_producer=produce_frozen_architecture_replay,
+) -> TimeSpaceExportBundle:
+    """Recompute canonical evidence through the authoritative replay producer."""
+
+    if type(request) is not ReplayRequest:
+        raise TypeError("request must be ReplayRequest")
+    source = copy.deepcopy(_plain_mapping(replay_producer(request), "source replay"))
+    _validate_source(source)
+    execution = load_execution_manifest(Path(request.execution_manifest))
+    hypothesis = load_hypothesis_manifest(Path(request.hypothesis_manifest))
+    if execution.layer != "time_space_shadow" or hypothesis.layer != "time_space_shadow":
+        raise ValueError("TimeSpace exporter accepts only time_space_shadow manifests")
+    if execution.hypothesis_sha256 != hypothesis.sha256:
+        raise ValueError("execution and hypothesis manifests are not bound")
+    if source["windows"]["reused"] != [hypothesis.reused_start_ns, hypothesis.reused_end_ns]:
+        raise ValueError("source reused window does not match frozen hypothesis")
+    if source["as_of_ns"] != source["windows"]["reused"][1] and source["as_of_ns"] < source["windows"]["forward"][0]:
+        raise ValueError("source as_of is outside a permitted evidence window")
+    identities = {
+        "hypothesis_sha256": hypothesis.sha256,
+        "execution_sha256": execution.sha256,
+        "formula_sha256": execution.payload["formula_sha256"],
+        "config_sha256": execution.payload["config_sha256"],
+        "source_set_sha256": execution.payload["source_set_sha256"],
+    }
+    rows = _build_rows(source["canonical"], identities)
+    perturbations = {str(seed): _build_rows(source["perturbations"][str(seed)], identities) for seed in FROZEN_SEEDS}
+    transitions = _build_transitions(rows)
+    export = {
+        "schema_version": "time-space-shadow-export.v1",
+        "layer": "time_space_shadow",
+        **identities,
+        "as_of_ns": source["as_of_ns"],
+        "windows": source["windows"],
+        "seeds": list(FROZEN_SEEDS),
+        "market_state_transition_events": transitions,
+        "rows": rows,
+        "perturbation_paths": perturbations,
+    }
+    export_sha256 = canonical_sha256(export)
+    generator_code_sha256 = _sha256_file(_GENERATOR_PATH)
+    dependencies, generator_tree_sha256 = _generator_dependency_identity()
+    generator_semantic_sha256 = canonical_sha256(
+        {
+            "schema_version": "time-space-export-generator.v1",
+            "source_schema": "architecture-time-space-replay.v2",
+            "export_schema": "time-space-shadow-export.v1",
+            "decision_stages": list(DECISION_STAGES),
+            "seeds": list(FROZEN_SEEDS),
+            "row_keys": sorted(_ROW_KEYS),
+        }
+    )
+    provenance = {
+        "schema_version": "time-space-shadow-export-provenance.v1",
+        "layer": "time_space_shadow",
+        "generator_semantic_sha256": generator_semantic_sha256,
+        "generator_code_sha256": generator_code_sha256,
+        "generator_dependencies": dependencies,
+        "generator_tree_sha256": generator_tree_sha256,
+        "repository_identity": _required_string(repository_identity, "repository_identity"),
+        "commit_sha": _sha_string(commit_sha, 40, "commit_sha"),
+        "provider_run_id": _digits(provider_run_id, "provider_run_id"),
+        **identities,
+        "source_replay_sha256": canonical_sha256(source),
+        "source_files": source["source_files"],
+        "as_of_ns": source["as_of_ns"],
+        "windows": source["windows"],
+        "seeds": list(FROZEN_SEEDS),
+        "ordered_row_ids": [row["row_id"] for row in rows],
+        "ordered_perturbation_row_ids": {
+            str(seed): [row["row_id"] for row in perturbations[str(seed)]] for seed in FROZEN_SEEDS
+        },
+        "ordered_transition_ids": [event["transition_id"] for event in transitions],
+        "material_sha256": hash_execution_materials(source["execution_materials"]),
+        "export_sha256": export_sha256,
+    }
+    checkpoint = {
+        "schema_version": "time-space-export-checkpoint.v1",
+        "layer": "time_space_shadow",
+        "registration_status": "PENDING",
+        "export_sha256": export_sha256,
+        "provenance_sha256": canonical_sha256(provenance),
+        "receipt": None,
+        "as_of_ns": source["as_of_ns"],
+        "generator_provider_run_id": provenance["provider_run_id"],
+        "source_slice_sha256": _canonical_sha256(source["source_files"]),
+    }
+    return TimeSpaceExportBundle(export=export, provenance=provenance, checkpoint=checkpoint)
+
+
+def hash_execution_materials(materials: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, str]:
+    """Hash each production-material stream independently in canonical order."""
+
+    payload = _plain_mapping(materials, "execution materials")
+    if set(payload) != set(MATERIAL_NAMES):
+        raise ValueError("execution materials must contain exactly snapshots, targets, orders, fills, equity, episodes")
+    return {name: _canonical_sha256(payload[name]) for name in MATERIAL_NAMES}
+
+
+def validate_registered_time_space_export(
+    export: Mapping[str, Any],
+    provenance: Mapping[str, Any],
+    checkpoint: Mapping[str, Any],
+    receipt: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
+    *,
+    provider_fetcher=None,
+) -> str:
+    """Return VERIFIED only through the checked-in independent trust root."""
+
+    try:
+        as_of_ns = int(export["as_of_ns"])
+        trust, persisted_receipt, persisted_export, persisted_provenance = _load_persisted_registration(
+            as_of_ns,
+            receipt,
+            export,
+            provenance,
+        )
+        fetcher = provider_fetcher or _fetch_provider
+        provider = fetcher(trust["remote_identity"], int(trust["provider_run_id"]))
+        generator_provider = fetcher(trust["remote_identity"], int(trust["generator_provider_run_id"]))
+        recomputed = recompute_time_space_export(
+            ReplayRequest(
+                execution_manifest=_PROJECT_ROOT / "config/research/registrations/time_space_shadow_execution_v1.json",
+                hypothesis_manifest=_PROJECT_ROOT / "config/research/time_space_shadow_hypothesis_v1.json",
+                as_of_ns=as_of_ns,
+            ),
+            repository_identity=str(provenance["repository_identity"]),
+            commit_sha=str(provenance["commit_sha"]),
+            provider_run_id=str(provenance["provider_run_id"]),
+        )
+    except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError, OSError):
+        return EXPORT_REGISTRATION_REQUIRED
+    return _validate_registered_time_space_export_payloads(
+        persisted_export,
+        persisted_provenance,
+        checkpoint,
+        persisted_receipt,
+        trust_payload=trust,
+        provider_payload=provider,
+        generator_provider_payload=generator_provider,
+        generator_path=_GENERATOR_PATH,
+        recomputed_bundle=recomputed,
+    )
+
+
+def _load_persisted_registration(
+    as_of_ns: int,
+    supplied_receipt: Mapping[str, Any] | None,
+    supplied_export: Mapping[str, Any] | None,
+    supplied_provenance: Mapping[str, Any] | None,
+    *,
+    registration_root: Path = _REGISTRATION_ROOT,
+) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Load immutable in-repo evidence; expiring provider artifacts are not a runtime dependency."""
+
+    registration_dir = Path(registration_root) / str(as_of_ns)
+    trust = _load_canonical_json(
+        registration_dir / "time_space_export_registration_trust_v1.json",
+        "export registration trust root",
+    )
+    persisted_receipt = _load_canonical_json(
+        registration_dir / _PERSISTED_RECEIPT_NAME,
+        "persisted export registration receipt",
+    )
+    persisted_export = _load_canonical_json(
+        registration_dir / _PERSISTED_EXPORT_NAME,
+        "persisted canonical export",
+    )
+    persisted_provenance = _load_canonical_json(
+        registration_dir / _PERSISTED_PROVENANCE_NAME,
+        "persisted canonical provenance",
+    )
+    if (
+        trust.get("registration_status") != VERIFIED
+        or trust.get("remote_identity") != _CANONICAL_REPOSITORY
+        or supplied_receipt is None
+        or supplied_export is None
+        or supplied_provenance is None
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("export registration is not verified")
+    if _plain_mapping(supplied_receipt, "receipt") != persisted_receipt:
+        raise ValueError("supplied receipt is not the immutable checked-in receipt")
+    if _plain_mapping(supplied_export, "export") != persisted_export:
+        raise ValueError("supplied export is not the immutable checked-in export")
+    if _plain_mapping(supplied_provenance, "provenance") != persisted_provenance:
+        raise ValueError("supplied provenance is not the immutable checked-in provenance")
+    return trust, persisted_receipt, persisted_export, persisted_provenance
+
+
+def _validate_registered_time_space_export_payloads(
+    export: Mapping[str, Any],
+    provenance: Mapping[str, Any],
+    checkpoint: Mapping[str, Any],
+    receipt: Mapping[str, Any],
+    *,
+    trust_payload: Mapping[str, Any],
+    provider_payload: Mapping[str, Any] | None,
+    generator_provider_payload: Mapping[str, Any] | None,
+    generator_path: Path,
+    recomputed_bundle: TimeSpaceExportBundle,
+) -> str:
+    """Pure validator used behind the pinned public gate."""
+
+    try:
+        _validate_registered(
+            _plain_mapping(export, "export"),
+            _plain_mapping(provenance, "provenance"),
+            _plain_mapping(checkpoint, "checkpoint"),
+            _plain_mapping(receipt, "receipt"),
+            trust=_plain_mapping(trust_payload, "trust root"),
+            provider=None if provider_payload is None else _plain_mapping(provider_payload, "provider receipt"),
+            generator_provider=(
+                None
+                if generator_provider_payload is None
+                else _plain_mapping(generator_provider_payload, "generator provider receipt")
+            ),
+            generator_path=Path(generator_path),
+            recomputed_bundle=recomputed_bundle,
+        )
+    except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError, OSError):
+        return EXPORT_REGISTRATION_REQUIRED
+    return VERIFIED
+
+
+def _fetch_provider(remote_identity: str, provider_run_id: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    if remote_identity != _CANONICAL_REPOSITORY:
+        raise ValueError("provider lookup is restricted to the canonical repository")
+    request = urllib.request.Request(
+        f"https://api.github.com/repos/{_CANONICAL_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/{provider_run_id}",
+        headers={"Accept": "application/vnd.github+json", "User-Agent": "zenquant-time-space-export/1"},
+    )
+    with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=30) as response:
+        payload = json.loads(response.read().decode("utf-8"))
+    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
+        raise ValueError("provider checkpoint response must be an object")
+    return payload
+
+
+def _validate_registered(
+    export: dict[str, Any],
+    provenance: dict[str, Any],
+    checkpoint: dict[str, Any],
+    receipt: dict[str, Any],
+    *,
+    trust: dict[str, Any],
+    provider: dict[str, Any] | None,
+    generator_provider: dict[str, Any] | None,
+    generator_path: Path,
+    recomputed_bundle: TimeSpaceExportBundle,
+) -> None:
+    if set(export) != _EXPORT_KEYS or set(provenance) != _PROVENANCE_KEYS or set(checkpoint) != _CHECKPOINT_KEYS:
+        raise ValueError("export envelope schema is invalid")
+    if set(trust) != _TRUST_KEYS or trust.get("registration_status") != VERIFIED:
+        raise ValueError("checkpoint trust root is not verified")
+    if trust.get("remote_identity") != _CANONICAL_REPOSITORY:
+        raise ValueError("checkpoint trust root is not pinned to the canonical repository")
+    if (
+        checkpoint.get("registration_status") != "PENDING"
+        or checkpoint.get("receipt") is not None
+        or provider is None
+        or generator_provider is None
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("checkpoint is not independently registered")
+    if export.get("schema_version") != "time-space-shadow-export.v1" or export.get("layer") != "time_space_shadow":
+        raise ValueError("export identity is invalid")
+    if provenance.get("schema_version") != "time-space-shadow-export-provenance.v1":
+        raise ValueError("provenance identity is invalid")
+    if checkpoint.get("schema_version") != "time-space-export-checkpoint.v1":
+        raise ValueError("checkpoint identity is invalid")
+    if trust.get("schema_version") != "time-space-export-registration-trust.v1":
+        raise ValueError("trust identity is invalid")
+    if export != recomputed_bundle.export or provenance != recomputed_bundle.provenance:
+        raise ValueError("registered export does not match independent replay recomputation")
+    if export.get("seeds") != list(FROZEN_SEEDS) or provenance.get("seeds") != list(FROZEN_SEEDS):
+        raise ValueError("frozen seeds changed")
+    _validate_windows(export.get("windows"))
+    if provenance.get("windows") != export["windows"] or provenance.get("as_of_ns") != export.get("as_of_ns"):
+        raise ValueError("window or as_of provenance mismatch")
+    identity_names = (
+        "hypothesis_sha256",
+        "execution_sha256",
+        "formula_sha256",
+        "config_sha256",
+        "source_set_sha256",
+    )
+    if any(provenance.get(name) != export.get(name) for name in identity_names):
+        raise ValueError("registered identities diverged")
+    if provenance.get("generator_code_sha256") != _sha256_file(generator_path):
+        raise ValueError("generator code changed")
+    dependencies, tree_sha256 = _generator_dependency_identity()
+    if (
+        provenance.get("generator_dependencies") != dependencies
+        or provenance.get("generator_tree_sha256") != tree_sha256
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("generator dependency identity changed")
+    expected_semantic = canonical_sha256(
+        {
+            "schema_version": "time-space-export-generator.v1",
+            "source_schema": "architecture-time-space-replay.v2",
+            "export_schema": "time-space-shadow-export.v1",
+            "decision_stages": list(DECISION_STAGES),
+            "seeds": list(FROZEN_SEEDS),
+            "row_keys": sorted(_ROW_KEYS),
+        }
+    )
+    if provenance.get("generator_semantic_sha256") != expected_semantic:
+        raise ValueError("generator semantic identity changed")
+    rows = export.get("rows")
+    if not isinstance(rows, list) or not rows:
+        raise ValueError("export rows are invalid")
+    _validate_export_rows(rows, export)
+    perturbations = export.get("perturbation_paths")
+    if not isinstance(perturbations, dict) or set(perturbations) != {str(seed) for seed in FROZEN_SEEDS}:
+        raise ValueError("perturbation paths are invalid")
+    for seed in FROZEN_SEEDS:
+        _validate_export_rows(perturbations[str(seed)], export)
+    if provenance.get("ordered_row_ids") != [row["row_id"] for row in rows]:
+        raise ValueError("ordered row identities changed")
+    expected_perturbation_ids = {
+        str(seed): [row["row_id"] for row in perturbations[str(seed)]] for seed in FROZEN_SEEDS
+    }
+    if provenance.get("ordered_perturbation_row_ids") != expected_perturbation_ids:
+        raise ValueError("perturbation row identities changed")
+    transitions = _build_transitions(rows)
+    if export.get("market_state_transition_events") != transitions:
+        raise ValueError("market-state transitions changed")
+    if provenance.get("ordered_transition_ids") != [item["transition_id"] for item in transitions]:
+        raise ValueError("transition identities changed")
+    export_sha256 = canonical_sha256(export)
+    if provenance.get("export_sha256") != export_sha256 or checkpoint.get("export_sha256") != export_sha256:
+        raise ValueError("export digest mismatch")
+    provenance_sha256 = canonical_sha256(provenance)
+    if checkpoint.get("provenance_sha256") != provenance_sha256:
+        raise ValueError("provenance digest mismatch")
+    if set(receipt) != _RECEIPT_KEYS:
+        raise ValueError("checkpoint receipt is invalid")
+    checkpoint_bytes = (json.dumps(checkpoint, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n").encode()
+    manifest_sha256 = hashlib.sha256(checkpoint_bytes).hexdigest()
+    if (
+        receipt.get("schema_version") != "time-space-export-registration-receipt.v1"
+        or receipt.get("manifest_path") != _checkpoint_manifest_path(int(export["as_of_ns"]))
+        or receipt.get("manifest_sha256") != manifest_sha256
+        or receipt.get("export_sha256") != export_sha256
+        or receipt.get("provenance_sha256") != provenance_sha256
+        or receipt.get("generator_artifact", {}).get("export_sha256") != export_sha256
+        or receipt.get("generator_artifact", {}).get("provenance_sha256") != provenance_sha256
+        or receipt.get("generator_artifact", {}).get("source_slice_sha256") != checkpoint["source_slice_sha256"]
+        or receipt.get("generator_artifact", {}).get("id") != trust["generator_artifact_id"]
+        or receipt.get("generator_artifact", {}).get("name") != trust["generator_artifact_name"]
+        or receipt.get("provider_run_id") != trust["provider_run_id"]
+        or receipt.get("commit_sha") != trust["commit_sha"]
+        or receipt.get("remote_identity") != _CANONICAL_REPOSITORY
+        or receipt.get("provider_created_at_ns") != trust["provider_created_at_ns"]
+        or receipt.get("workflow") != {"id": trust["checkpoint_workflow_id"], "path": trust["checkpoint_workflow_path"]}
+        or receipt.get("event") != "push"
+        or receipt.get("ref") != f"refs/heads/{trust['checkpoint_branch']}"
+        or receipt.get("artifact") != {"id": trust["checkpoint_artifact_id"], "name": trust["checkpoint_artifact_name"]}
+        or trust.get("checkpoint_manifest_sha256") != manifest_sha256
+        or trust.get("receipt_artifact_sha256") != _artifact_sha256(receipt)
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("checkpoint receipt is not pinned")
+    if (
+        provider.get("id") != int(receipt["provider_run_id"])
+        or provider.get("head_sha") != receipt["commit_sha"]
+        or provider.get("conclusion") != "success"
+        or provider.get("event") != "push"
+        or provider.get("head_branch") != trust["checkpoint_branch"]
+        or provider.get("path") != trust["checkpoint_workflow_path"]
+        or provider.get("workflow_id") != trust["checkpoint_workflow_id"]
+        or _provider_created_at_ns(provider.get("created_at")) != receipt["provider_created_at_ns"]
+        or not isinstance(provider.get("repository"), dict)
+        or provider["repository"].get("full_name") != _CANONICAL_REPOSITORY
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("provider receipt does not match checkpoint")
+    if provenance.get("repository_identity") != _CANONICAL_REPOSITORY:
+        raise ValueError("repository identity mismatch")
+    if provenance.get("commit_sha") != trust.get("generator_commit_sha") or provenance.get(
+        "provider_run_id"
+    ) != trust.get("generator_provider_run_id"):
+        raise ValueError("generator checkout or provider identity is not pinned")
+    if (
+        generator_provider.get("id") != int(provenance["provider_run_id"])
+        or generator_provider.get("head_sha") != provenance["commit_sha"]
+        or generator_provider.get("conclusion") != "success"
+        or generator_provider.get("workflow_id") != trust["generator_workflow_id"]
+        or generator_provider.get("path") != trust["generator_workflow_path"]
+        or generator_provider.get("event") != trust["generator_event"]
+        or generator_provider.get("head_branch") != trust["generator_branch"]
+        or _provider_created_at_ns(generator_provider.get("created_at")) != trust["generator_created_at_ns"]
+        or not isinstance(generator_provider.get("repository"), dict)
+        or generator_provider["repository"].get("full_name") != _CANONICAL_REPOSITORY
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("generator provider does not attest the pinned checkout")
+
+
+def _provider_created_at_ns(value: Any) -> int:
+    if not isinstance(value, str):
+        raise ValueError("provider created_at is invalid")
+    try:
+        parsed = datetime.strptime(value, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ").replace(tzinfo=UTC)
+    except ValueError as exc:
+        raise ValueError("provider created_at is invalid") from exc
+    return int(parsed.timestamp()) * 1_000_000_000
+
+
+def _checkpoint_manifest_path(as_of_ns: int) -> str:
+    if isinstance(as_of_ns, bool) or not isinstance(as_of_ns, int) or as_of_ns % FOUR_HOURS_NS:
+        raise ValueError("checkpoint as_of is not a confirmed 4h cutoff")
+    return f"config/research/registrations/time_space_exports/{as_of_ns}/time_space_shadow_export_checkpoint_v1.json"
+
+
+def _validate_source(source: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    if set(source) != {
+        "schema_version",
+        "as_of_ns",
+        "windows",
+        "seeds",
+        "canonical",
+        "perturbations",
+        "execution_materials",
+        "source_files",
+    }:
+        raise ValueError("source replay schema is invalid")
+    if source["schema_version"] != "architecture-time-space-replay.v2":
+        raise ValueError("source replay identity is invalid")
+    if source["seeds"] != list(FROZEN_SEEDS):
+        raise ValueError("source replay seeds are not frozen")
+    _validate_windows(source["windows"])
+    as_of = source["as_of_ns"]
+    if isinstance(as_of, bool) or not isinstance(as_of, int) or as_of % FOUR_HOURS_NS:
+        raise ValueError("source as_of must be an exact 4h cutoff")
+    perturbations = source["perturbations"]
+    if not isinstance(perturbations, dict) or set(perturbations) != {str(seed) for seed in FROZEN_SEEDS}:
+        raise ValueError("source perturbation paths are invalid")
+    hash_execution_materials(source["execution_materials"])
+    source_files = source["source_files"]
+    if not isinstance(source_files, list) or not source_files:
+        raise ValueError("source replay must bind registered source files")
+    if any(not isinstance(item, dict) or set(item) != {"source_id", "path", "sha256"} for item in source_files):
+        raise ValueError("source file identity is invalid")
+
+
+def _validate_windows(windows: Any) -> None:
+    if not isinstance(windows, dict) or set(windows) != {"reused", "embargo", "forward"}:
+        raise ValueError("evidence windows are invalid")
+    reused, embargo, forward = windows["reused"], windows["embargo"], windows["forward"]
+    if not (
+        isinstance(reused, list)
+        and isinstance(embargo, list)
+        and isinstance(forward, list)
+        and len(reused) == len(embargo) == len(forward) == 2
+        and all(isinstance(value, int) and not isinstance(value, bool) for value in (*reused, *embargo))
+        and isinstance(forward[0], int)
+        and not isinstance(forward[0], bool)
+        and forward[1] is None
+        and reused[0] < reused[1] == embargo[0] < embargo[1] == forward[0]
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("evidence windows overlap or are malformed")
+
+
+def _build_rows(path: Any, identities: dict[str, str]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    if not isinstance(path, dict) or set(path) != {"market_rows", "stage_rows"}:
+        raise ValueError("replay path schema is invalid")
+    market_rows = path["market_rows"]
+    stages = path["stage_rows"]
+    if not isinstance(market_rows, list) or not market_rows:
+        raise ValueError("market rows are empty")
+    if not isinstance(stages, dict) or tuple(stages) != DECISION_STAGES:
+        raise ValueError("decision stages must be exactly A1_SIGN, A5_SHADOW, FILLED_POSITION")
+    indexed: dict[str, dict[int, dict[str, Any]]] = {}
+    for stage in DECISION_STAGES:
+        stage_rows = stages[stage]
+        if not isinstance(stage_rows, list):
+            raise ValueError(f"{stage} rows must be a list")
+        stage_index: dict[int, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+        for row in stage_rows:
+            if not isinstance(row, dict) or set(row) != _STAGE_ROW_KEYS:
+                raise ValueError(f"{stage} row schema is invalid")
+            cutoff = row["cutoff_time_ns"]
+            if cutoff in stage_index:
+                raise ValueError(f"{stage} contains duplicate cutoffs")
+            stage_index[cutoff] = row
+        indexed[stage] = stage_index
+    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    previous: int | None = None
+    for market in market_rows:
+        if not isinstance(market, dict) or set(market) != _MARKET_KEYS:
+            raise ValueError("market row schema is invalid")
+        cutoff = market["cutoff_time_ns"]
+        if isinstance(cutoff, bool) or not isinstance(cutoff, int) or cutoff % FOUR_HOURS_NS:
+            raise ValueError("market cutoff is not on the 4h grid")
+        if previous is not None and cutoff <= previous:
+            raise ValueError("market cutoffs must be strictly increasing")
+        previous = cutoff
+        if any(cutoff not in indexed[stage] for stage in DECISION_STAGES):
+            raise ValueError("stage join is incomplete")
+        decisions = {stage: indexed[stage][cutoff]["decision_id"] for stage in DECISION_STAGES}
+        values = {stage: indexed[stage][cutoff]["value"] for stage in DECISION_STAGES}
+        row = {
+            **market,
+            "formula_hash": identities["formula_sha256"],
+            "config_hash": identities["config_sha256"],
+            "source_data_hash": identities["source_set_sha256"],
+            "decision_id_by_stage": decisions,
+            "alpha_sign": values["A1_SIGN"],
+            "approved_target": values["A5_SHADOW"],
+            "filled_position": values["FILLED_POSITION"],
+        }
+        _validate_numeric_row(row)
+        row["row_id"] = canonical_sha256(row)
+        rows.append(row)
+    cutoffs = {row["cutoff_time_ns"] for row in market_rows}
+    if any(set(indexed[stage]) != cutoffs for stage in DECISION_STAGES):
+        raise ValueError("stage rows contain cutoffs outside the market path")
+    return rows
+
+
+def _validate_export_rows(rows: Any, export: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    if not isinstance(rows, list) or not rows:
+        raise ValueError("export path is empty")
+    previous = None
+    for row in rows:
+        if not isinstance(row, dict) or set(row) != _ROW_KEYS:
+            raise ValueError("export row schema is invalid")
+        cutoff = row["cutoff_time_ns"]
+        if previous is not None and cutoff <= previous:
+            raise ValueError("export rows are not ordered")
+        previous = cutoff
+        if set(row["decision_id_by_stage"]) != set(DECISION_STAGES):
+            raise ValueError("export decision stages changed")
+        if (
+            row["formula_hash"] != export["formula_sha256"]
+            or row["config_hash"] != export["config_sha256"]
+            or row["source_data_hash"] != export["source_set_sha256"]
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("export row identity changed")
+        expected = canonical_sha256({key: value for key, value in row.items() if key != "row_id"})
+        if row["row_id"] != expected:
+            raise ValueError("export row digest changed")
+        _validate_numeric_row(row)
+
+
+def _validate_numeric_row(row: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    for name in ("close", "alpha_sign", "approved_target", "filled_position"):
+        value = row[name]
+        if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int | float) or not math.isfinite(float(value)):
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be finite")
+    if row["alpha_sign"] not in (-1, 0, 1):
+        raise ValueError("A1_SIGN value must be -1, 0, or 1")
+
+
+def _build_transitions(rows: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    states = build_time_space_states(tuple(_state_input(row) for row in rows))
+    events = []
+    for prior, current in pairwise(states):
+        if prior.market_structure_side == current.market_structure_side:
+            continue
+        event = {
+            "cutoff_time_ns": current.cutoff_time_ns,
+            "prior_state_id": prior.state_id,
+            "state_id": current.state_id,
+        }
+        event["transition_id"] = canonical_sha256(event)
+        events.append(event)
+    return events
+
+
+def _state_input(row: dict[str, Any]) -> TimeSpaceInputRow:
+    values = {key: row[key] for key in _MARKET_KEYS}
+    return TimeSpaceInputRow(
+        **values,
+        formula_hash=row["formula_hash"],
+        config_hash=row["config_hash"],
+        source_data_hash=row["source_data_hash"],
+        decision_id_by_stage=tuple(sorted(row["decision_id_by_stage"].items())),
+    )
+
+
+def _plain_mapping(value: Mapping[str, Any], name: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    if not isinstance(value, Mapping):
+        raise TypeError(f"{name} must be a mapping")
+    return copy.deepcopy(dict(value))
+
+
+def _load_json(path: Path, name: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    try:
+        payload = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    except (OSError, UnicodeError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
+        raise ValueError(f"cannot load {name}") from exc
+    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be an object")
+    return payload
+
+
+def _load_canonical_json(path: Path, name: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    try:
+        content = path.read_bytes()
+        payload = json.loads(content.decode("utf-8"))
+    except (OSError, UnicodeError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
+        raise ValueError(f"cannot load {name}") from exc
+    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be an object")
+    canonical = (json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False) + "\n").encode()
+    if content != canonical:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} bytes are not canonical")
+    return payload
+
+
+def _required_string(value: Any, name: str) -> str:
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value or value.strip() != value:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a non-empty canonical string")
+    return value
+
+
+def _sha_string(value: Any, length: int, name: str) -> str:
+    text = _required_string(value, name)
+    if len(text) != length or any(char not in "0123456789abcdef" for char in text):
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be lowercase hexadecimal")
+    return text
+
+
+def _digits(value: Any, name: str) -> str:
+    text = _required_string(value, name)
+    if not text.isdigit() or text.startswith("0"):
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be canonical decimal digits")
+    return text
+
+
+def _sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as handle:
+        for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
+            digest.update(chunk)
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def _generator_dependency_identity(*, read_bytes=None) -> tuple[list[dict[str, str]], str]:
+    loader = read_bytes or (lambda path: path.read_bytes())
+    python_paths = {path.relative_to(_PROJECT_ROOT).as_posix() for path in (_PROJECT_ROOT / "zenquant").rglob("*.py")}
+    dependency_paths = sorted(python_paths | set(_STATIC_DEPENDENCY_PATHS))
+    files = []
+    for relative in dependency_paths:
+        path = _PROJECT_ROOT / relative
+        files.append({"path": relative, "sha256": hashlib.sha256(loader(path)).hexdigest()})
+    return files, canonical_sha256({"files": files})
+
+
+def _canonical_sha256(value: Any) -> str:
+    encoded = json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False).encode("utf-8")
+    return hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest()
+
+
+def _artifact_sha256(value: Any) -> str:
+    encoded = (json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
+    return hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest()
+

+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class ReplayRequest:
+    execution_manifest: Path
+    hypothesis_manifest: Path
+    as_of_ns: int

+def produce_frozen_architecture_replay(request: ReplayRequest) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Run the real replay and target-tracking kernel over registered files."""
+
+    if type(request) is not ReplayRequest:
+        raise TypeError("request must be ReplayRequest")
+    if Path(request.execution_manifest).resolve() != _EXECUTION_MANIFEST.resolve():
+        raise ValueError("replay request execution manifest is not the registered allowlisted path")
+    if Path(request.hypothesis_manifest).resolve() != _HYPOTHESIS_MANIFEST.resolve():
+        raise ValueError("replay request hypothesis manifest is not the registered allowlisted path")
+    execution = load_execution_manifest(Path(request.execution_manifest))
+    hypothesis = load_hypothesis_manifest(Path(request.hypothesis_manifest))
+    if execution.layer != "time_space_shadow" or hypothesis.layer != "time_space_shadow":
+        raise ValueError("replay request must use TimeSpace manifests")
+    if execution.hypothesis_sha256 != hypothesis.sha256:
+        raise ValueError("execution and hypothesis manifests are not bound")
+    if request.as_of_ns != hypothesis.reused_end_ns and request.as_of_ns < FROZEN_FORWARD_START_NS:
+        raise ValueError("export as_of must be the reused cutoff or an eligible forward cutoff")
+    if request.as_of_ns % (4 * 60 * 60 * 1_000_000_000):
+        raise ValueError("export as_of must be a confirmed 4h cutoff")
+    source_files = _registered_source_files(execution.payload["sources"])
+
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="zenquant-time-space-replay-") as directory:
+        root = Path(directory)
+        source_files.extend(
+            _build_replay_view(
+                root,
+                source_files,
+                as_of_ns=request.as_of_ns,
+                reused_end_ns=hypothesis.reused_end_ns,
+            )
+        )
+        canonical_path, materials = _run_path(
+            root,
+            start_ns=hypothesis.reused_start_ns,
+            end_ns=request.as_of_ns,
+            perturbation=PerturbationConfig(seed=42),
+        )
+        perturbations = {}
+        manifest = load_architecture_experiment_manifest()
+        for seed in FROZEN_SEEDS:
+            perturbations[str(seed)], _unused = _run_path(
+                root,
+                start_ns=hypothesis.reused_start_ns,
+                end_ns=request.as_of_ns,
+                perturbation=PerturbationConfig(seed=seed, **dict(manifest.perturbation)),
+            )
+    return {
+        "schema_version": "architecture-time-space-replay.v2",
+        "as_of_ns": request.as_of_ns,
+        "windows": {
+            "reused": [hypothesis.reused_start_ns, hypothesis.reused_end_ns],
+            "embargo": [hypothesis.reused_end_ns, FROZEN_FORWARD_START_NS],
+            "forward": [FROZEN_FORWARD_START_NS, None],
+        },
+        "seeds": list(FROZEN_SEEDS),
+        "canonical": canonical_path,
+        "perturbations": perturbations,
+        "execution_materials": materials,
+        "source_files": source_files,
+    }

+def _run_path(
+    root: Path,
+    *,
+    start_ns: int,
+    end_ns: int,
+    perturbation: PerturbationConfig,
+) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
+    manifest = load_architecture_experiment_manifest()
+    params = dict(manifest.candidate_params)
+    strategy_config = replace(
+        build_strategy_config(params),
+        execution_timeframe=Timeframe(manifest.a0_execution_timeframe),
+        emit_architecture_alpha_snapshots_v2=True,
+    )
+    config = HistoricalBacktestConfig(
+        root_dir=root,
+        symbol=manifest.symbol,
+        portfolio_symbol=manifest.portfolio_symbol,
+        start_ns=start_ns,
+        end_ns=end_ns,
+        starting_equity=100_000.0,
+        execution_timeframe=Timeframe(manifest.a0_execution_timeframe),
+        context_timeframe=Timeframe(manifest.a0_context_timeframe),
+        direction_timeframe=Timeframe(manifest.a0_direction_timeframe),
+        bias_timeframe=Timeframe(manifest.a0_bias_timeframe),
+        strategy_config=strategy_config,
+        risk_config=build_risk_config(params),
+        execution_config=build_execution_config(params),
+        indicator_config=replace(build_indicator_config(params), expected_symbols=(manifest.portfolio_symbol,)),
+        signal_weight_overrides=build_signal_weight_overrides(params),
+        plugin_config_overrides=build_plugin_config_overrides(params),
+        perturbation=perturbation,
+        liquidation_data_enabled=False,
+        state_liquidation_overlay_enabled=False,
+        profile_path=manifest.profile_path,
+        macro_dir=root / "unused-macro",
+        options_dir=root / "unused-options",
+        cot_path=root / "unused-cot.parquet",
+        liquidation_dir=root / "unused-liquidations",
+    )
+    runner = HistoricalBacktest(config)
+    runner.run()
+    execution_config = config.execution_config
+    assert execution_config is not None
+    batch = runner.build_architecture_stage_rows(
+        exchange_min_quantity=execution_config.min_trade_qty,
+        estimated_fee_bps=FROZEN_TAKER_FEE_BPS,
+        estimated_slippage_bps=FROZEN_FALLBACK_SLIPPAGE_BPS,
+    )
+    observations = tuple(observations_from_rows(batch["observations"]))
+    a5 = run_architecture_stage_replay(
+        observations,
+        stage=ArchitectureStage.A5_SHADOW,
+        fixed_notional=100_000.0,
+        symbol=manifest.portfolio_symbol,
+        portfolio="architecture-v2",
+        min_trade_qty=execution_config.min_trade_qty,
+        max_trade_qty_per_bar=execution_config.max_trade_qty_per_bar,
+        quantity_precision=execution_config.quantity_precision,
+        taker_fee_bps=FROZEN_TAKER_FEE_BPS,
+        fallback_slippage_bps=FROZEN_FALLBACK_SLIPPAGE_BPS,
+        funding_settlements_by_cutoff=batch["funding_settlements_by_cutoff"],
+    )
+    path = _extract_path(runner, observations, a5.rows)
+    materials = {
+        "snapshots": to_jsonable(a5.snapshots),
+        "targets": to_jsonable(a5.targets),
+        "orders": to_jsonable(a5.audits),
+        "fills": to_jsonable(a5.reports),
+        "equity": to_jsonable(a5.equity),
+        "episodes": to_jsonable(a5.position_episodes),
+    }
+    return path, materials

+def _extract_path(runner, observations, a5_rows) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    indicators = {item.cutoff_time_ns: item for item in runner._indicators if item.timeframe is Timeframe.TF_4H}
+    states = {item.cutoff_time_ns: item for item in runner._market_states if item.timeframe is Timeframe.TF_4H}
+    stage_by_cutoff = {item.cutoff_time_ns: item for item in a5_rows}
+    market_rows = []
+    a1_rows = []
+    a5_stage_rows = []
+    filled_rows = []
+    prior_indicator = None
+    for observation in observations:
+        cutoff = observation.cutoff_time_ns
+        indicator = indicators[cutoff]
+        state = states[cutoff]
+        stage = stage_by_cutoff[cutoff]
+        current_high = _optional_positive(indicator.values.get("last_swing_high"))
+        current_low = _optional_positive(indicator.values.get("last_swing_low"))
+        prior_high = _optional_positive(
+            None if prior_indicator is None else prior_indicator.values.get("last_swing_high")
+        )
+        prior_low = _optional_positive(
+            None if prior_indicator is None else prior_indicator.values.get("last_swing_low")
+        )
+        market_rows.append(
+            {
+                "alpha_id": observation.alpha_id,
+                "cutoff_time_ns": cutoff,
+                "interval_start_ns": cutoff - 4 * 60 * 60 * 1_000_000_000,
+                "close": float(observation.reference_price),
+                "structure_side": 1 if state.direction_signal > 0 else -1 if state.direction_signal < 0 else 0,
+                "prior_long_boundary": prior_high,
+                "prior_short_boundary": prior_low,
+                "current_long_pivot": current_high if current_high != prior_high else None,
+                "current_short_pivot": current_low if current_low != prior_low else None,
+                "prior_long_invalidation": prior_low,
+                "prior_short_invalidation": prior_high,
+            }
+        )
+        a1_rows.append(
+            {
+                "cutoff_time_ns": cutoff,
+                "decision_id": observation.alpha_id,
+                "value": 1 if observation.raw_score > 0 else -1 if observation.raw_score < 0 else 0,
+            }
+        )
+        a5_stage_rows.append(
+            {"cutoff_time_ns": cutoff, "decision_id": stage.decision_id, "value": stage.approved_target_qty}
+        )
+        filled_rows.append(
+            {
+                "cutoff_time_ns": cutoff,
+                "decision_id": _payload_sha256({"stage": "FILLED_POSITION", **asdict(stage)}),
+                "value": stage.filled_position_after,
+            }
+        )
+        prior_indicator = indicator
+    return {
+        "market_rows": market_rows,
+        "stage_rows": {
+            "A1_SIGN": a1_rows,
+            "A5_SHADOW": a5_stage_rows,
+            "FILLED_POSITION": filled_rows,
+        },
+    }
+
